words.enDefinition: possessions left behind without plans to collect them

examples.en: The agent asked whether the boxes in the hallway were our abandoned belongings.
examples.zh: 中介问，走廊里的纸箱是不是我们「弃置的个人物品」。

examples.en: We challenged the removal charge because the abandoned belongings were there before our tenancy began.
examples.zh: 我们对清运费提出异议，因为那些「弃置的个人物品」在我们起租前就在那里了。

words.enDefinition: a bill much larger than expected given normal usage

examples.en: An abnormally high bill prompted us to check which meter the supplier had read.
examples.zh: 一张「明显偏高的账单」让我们去核实供应商读的是哪块表。

examples.en: I took the abnormally high bill to the student housing office for advice.
examples.zh: 我拿着「明显偏高的账单」去学生住宿办公室咨询。

words.enDefinition: plans for how an authorized person can enter a property

examples.en: I emailed the access arrangements because neither of my flatmates could be home that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午两位室友都没法在家，我就发邮件说明了「入户安排」。

examples.en: The housing office confirmed our access arrangements before giving the contractor permission to enter.
examples.zh: 住房办公室确认了我们的「入户安排」，才准许承包商进入。

words.enDefinition: harm caused unintentionally to property or belongings

examples.en: Our roommate reported accidental damage after dropping a heavy pan on the glass cooktop.
examples.zh: 室友把一只重锅掉在玻璃灶面上，事后报告了这次「意外损坏」。

examples.en: I checked whether the optional policy covered accidental damage to furniture supplied with the flat.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，那份可选保单是否涵盖公寓配套家具的「意外损坏」。

words.enDefinition: an account with no overdue obligations or other restrictions

examples.en: The new payment option is available to any tenant with an account in good standing.
examples.zh: 租客的「账户状态正常」，就可以用这种新的付款方式。

examples.en: I needed an account in good standing to spread my rent over three months.
examples.zh: 只有「账户状态正常」，我才能把房租分三个月付。

collocations: keep an account in good standing
maintain an account in good standing
an account in good standing with the landlord

words.enDefinition: interest earned over time but not yet paid

examples.en: The final statement showed the deposit amount and any accrued interest separately on two lines.
examples.zh: 最终账单分两行列出了押金金额和「累计利息」。

examples.en: I asked why the refund didn't include the accrued interest listed on the previous year's statement.
examples.zh: 我问这次退款为什么没包含去年账单上列的「累计利息」。

words.enDefinition: a US bank transfer through the automated clearing house network

examples.en: An ACH transfer is cheaper than paying my rent with a credit card.
examples.zh: 通过「美国清算网络转账」付房租，比刷信用卡便宜。

examples.en: The rent office asked me to allow two days for the ACH transfer.
examples.zh: 房租办公室让我为这笔「美国清算网络转账」预留两天时间。

words.enDefinition: move quickly before someone else takes the place

examples.en: Act fast when a decent room appears under eight hundred.
examples.zh: 看到八百以下还像样的房间，就要「赶紧行动」。

examples.en: We had to act fast, so we booked the viewing for the same evening.
examples.zh: 我们必须「赶紧行动」，当晚就约了看房。

collocations: act fast on a good listing
act fast before it is gone

words.enDefinition: the day when a service is switched on for use

examples.en: Can you confirm the activation date before I move into the new flat?
examples.zh: 你能在我搬进新公寓之前确认一下「开通日期」吗？

examples.en: The provider moved our activation date to Monday after the engineer became unavailable.
examples.zh: 工程师来不了，供应商把我们的「开通日期」改到了周一。

words.enDefinition: a one-time charge for starting a service

examples.en: The broadband deal looked cheap until we noticed the activation fee in the checkout.
examples.zh: 这个宽带优惠看着便宜，直到我们在付款页面看到「开通费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the company could waive the activation fee for student customers.
examples.zh: 我问公司能否为学生客户免掉「开通费」。

words.enDefinition: to make another person a party to the tenancy

examples.en: We asked to add a tenant after a classmate offered to share the second bedroom.
examples.zh: 有位同学提出合租第二间卧室后，我们申请「增加一名租客」。

examples.en: The agent explained which pages we'd need to update if we wanted to add a tenant.
examples.zh: 中介解释了我们想「增加一名租客」的话，需要更新哪几页。

collocations: add a tenant to the lease

words.enDefinition: conditions added to the main set of contractual rules

examples.en: We found additional terms about shared laundry facilities on the last page of the lease.
examples.zh: 我们在租约最后一页发现了共用洗衣设施的「附加条款」。

examples.en: I checked the additional terms carefully before agreeing to keep an indoor cat in my room.
examples.zh: 我仔细看过「附加条款」，才同意把猫养在自己房间里。

words.enDefinition: the designated address for receiving formal documents

examples.en: I checked the address for service before mailing the notice to the management company.
examples.zh: 把通知寄给物业公司前，我核对了「法律文件送达地址」。

examples.en: The landlord changed the address for service and notified everyone living in the shared flat.
examples.zh: 房东变更了「法律文件送达地址」，并通知了合租公寓的每个住户。

collocations: send notices to the address for service

words.enDefinition: a person appointed to make a decision in a dispute

examples.en: The adjudicator asked for clear photographs of the flat from the start of our tenancy.
examples.zh: 「争议裁决员」要求提供租期开始时拍摄的清晰公寓照片。

examples.en: I sent the adjudicator a dated copy of the invoice before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我在截止前给「争议裁决员」发了一份注明日期的发票副本。

words.enDefinition: arm supports that can be moved to different positions

examples.en: The adjustable armrests slide down so my chair fits under the desk.
examples.zh: 「可调扶手」能往下滑，这样椅子就能推进书桌下面。

examples.en: I looked for adjustable armrests when comparing chairs at the secondhand shop.
examples.zh: 在二手店比较几把椅子时，我特意找带「可调扶手」的。

words.enDefinition: supports whose height can be changed to level furniture

examples.en: The adjustable feet keep my desk level on these old floorboards upstairs.
examples.zh: 有了「可调节支脚」，我的书桌放在楼上这些旧木地板上也能保持水平。

examples.en: We put the adjustable feet on before lifting the cabinet into place.
examples.zh: 我们先装好「可调节支脚」，再把柜子抬到预定位置。

collocations: level a cabinet with adjustable feet

words.enDefinition: a shelf that can be installed at different heights

examples.en: We moved an adjustable shelf to fit a tall jug in our shared fridge.
examples.zh: 我们挪了下「可调层架」，好把一个高水壶放进共用冰箱。

examples.en: The landlord left an extra adjustable shelf in the cupboard after installing the new refrigerator.
examples.zh: 房东装好新冰箱后，在橱柜里留了一块备用的「可调层架」。

collocations: a fridge with an adjustable shelf

words.enDefinition: a charge for handling paperwork and managing a request

examples.en: I asked what the administration fee covered before agreeing to the other move-in charges.
examples.zh: 我先问清「行政手续费」涵盖哪些事项，再同意其他入住费用。

examples.en: There was no administration fee listed on the estimate the housing office gave us.
examples.zh: 住房办公室给我们的费用估算表上没有列「行政手续费」。

words.enDefinition: rental homes priced for people on small budgets

examples.en: The city's affordable housing list is long, so apply the moment you land.
examples.zh: 本市「可负担住房」的排队名单很长，一落地就要去申请。

examples.en: Graduate families often qualify for affordable housing near the medical school.
examples.zh: 研究生家庭常常符合医学院附近「可负担住房」的申请条件。

words.enDefinition: maintenance support provided outside regular office hours

examples.en: Reception gave me the number for after-hours maintenance when the office closed over the weekend.
examples.zh: 办公室周末关闭时，前台给了我「非工作时间维修」的联系电话。

examples.en: The website explains which faults are handled by after-hours maintenance at student apartment buildings.
examples.zh: 网站说明了学生公寓有哪些故障可由「非工作时间维修」服务处理。

words.enDefinition: accept amounts being subtracted from money to be returned

examples.en: We didn't agree to deductions until we had seen receipts for both of the proposed charges.
examples.zh: 我们看到两笔拟收费的收据后，才「同意扣款」。

examples.en: Please read all the charges before you agree to deductions on the online form.
examples.zh: 请先读完所有收费项目，再在网上的表格里选择「同意扣款」。

collocations: ask tenants to agree to deductions

words.enDefinition: a mattress filled with air when needed for sleeping

examples.en: I slept on an air mattress until my new bed was delivered.
examples.zh: 我的新床送到之前，我一直睡「充气床垫」。

examples.en: We keep an air mattress in the cupboard for visitors during term.
examples.zh: 我们把一张「充气床垫」收在柜子里，留给学期中来访的客人。

words.enDefinition: a device that removes particles from air indoors

examples.en: We placed the air purifier in the living room because that's where we study together.
examples.zh: 我们把「空气净化器」放在客厅，因为我们都在那里一起学习。

examples.en: My roommate asked which air purifier the previous tenant had left behind in the flat.
examples.zh: 室友问，前租客留在公寓里的「空气净化器」是哪一款。

words.enDefinition: a small bent tool that turns bolts with hexagonal sockets

examples.en: I found an Allen key in the box with the desk legs.
examples.zh: 我在装书桌腿的盒子里找到了一把「内六角扳手」。

examples.en: We needed a smaller Allen key to finish putting the chair together.
examples.zh: 我们需要一把更小的「内六角扳手」才能装完椅子。

collocations: tighten a bolt with an Allen key

words.enDefinition: taken by another tenant and no longer open

examples.en: By the time I called, the flat was already rented to a nursing student.
examples.zh: 等我打电话过去，那套公寓「已租出」，租给了护理系的学生。

examples.en: Good places near campus are already rented by June, so start early.
examples.zh: 学校附近的好房子六月就「已租出」，一定要趁早。

collocations: find out it is already rented

words.enDefinition: a lease provision regulating changes to the property

examples.en: I reread the alterations clause before drilling holes for shelves in the study area.
examples.zh: 在书桌区打孔装架子前，我又看了一遍「改装条款」。

examples.en: The alterations clause lets us repaint if we use a color approved in advance.
examples.zh: 按「改装条款」，我们可以重新刷墙，但要用事先批准的颜色。

collocations: an alterations clause in the lease

words.enDefinition: ways to settle disagreements without using the ordinary court process

examples.en: The advice centre suggested alternative dispute resolution because neither of us wanted to go to court.
examples.zh: 我们双方都不想打官司，所以咨询中心建议采用「替代性争议解决」。

examples.en: The scheme's website describes alternative dispute resolution and explains how tenants can submit their evidence.
examples.zh: 押金保障计划的网站介绍了「替代性争议解决」，还解释了租客怎样提交证据。

collocations: a form of alternative dispute resolution

words.enDefinition: a new version of a bill that corrects earlier charges

examples.en: The supplier issued an amended bill after we sent photographs of both meters.
examples.zh: 收到我们发的两张表的照片后，供应商开出了「修正后的账单」。

examples.en: Wait for the amended bill before collecting any more money from your housemates.
examples.zh: 等「修正后的账单」出来，再向合租室友收钱。

words.enDefinition: the total sum recorded as having arrived

examples.en: The amount received was slightly lower because the sending bank deducted a fee.
examples.zh: 汇款银行扣了一笔手续费，所以「实收金额」少一点。

examples.en: Please check the amount received before you mark our rent as unpaid.
examples.zh: 把我们的房租标成未付款之前，请核对一下「实收金额」。

words.enDefinition: a prediction of how much a property will use in one year

examples.en: The comparison site asks for an annual consumption estimate before it shows any prices.
examples.zh: 比价网站要先填「年用量估算」，才会显示价格。

examples.en: Our annual consumption estimate was based on readings taken before we moved in.
examples.zh: 我们的「年用量估算」是根据搬进来前采集的读数算出来的。

words.enDefinition: the total cost of renting accommodation for a year

examples.en: I worked out the annual rent before deciding whether to live off campus.
examples.zh: 决定是否住校外之前，我算了算「年租金」。

examples.en: The landlord quoted the annual rent, so we divided it by twelve.
examples.zh: 房东报的是「年租金」，我们就把它除以十二。

words.enDefinition: hardware for anchoring furniture so it cannot tip forward

examples.en: The dresser came with an anti-tip kit so we could anchor it safely.
examples.zh: 抽屉柜带了一套「防倾倒配件」，我们可以把柜子稳妥地固定住。

examples.en: I asked the landlord about using the anti-tip kit on this wall.
examples.zh: 我问了房东能不能在这面墙上安装「防倾倒配件」。

collocations: secure a dresser with an anti-tip kit

words.enDefinition: a large group of rental apartments in one place

examples.en: Our apartment complex has a laundry room and a study lounge downstairs.
examples.zh: 我们「公寓小区」楼下有洗衣房和自习休息室。

examples.en: The apartment complex office keeps spare keys and handles package lockers.
examples.zh: 「公寓小区」的管理处保管备用钥匙，也负责快递柜。

words.enDefinition: searching for an apartment to rent

examples.en: Apartment hunting in August is stressful because almost everything is taken.
examples.zh: 八月「找公寓」很熬人，因为差不多都租出去了。

examples.en: My advisor gave me some apartment hunting tips before I arrived.
examples.zh: 来之前，导师给了我一些「找公寓」的建议。

words.enDefinition: an advertisement for a place that is available to rent

examples.en: I found an apartment listing near campus with photos of every room.
examples.zh: 我找到一条学校附近的「房源信息」，每个房间都拍了照片。

examples.en: That apartment listing was posted three days ago, so ask if the place is still open.
examples.zh: 那条「房源信息」是三天前发的，先问问房子是不是还空着。

words.enDefinition: a guided walk through the apartment for renters

examples.en: The apartment tour lasted ten minutes because two groups were waiting outside.
examples.zh: 这次「公寓带看」只有十分钟，外面还有两组人在排队。

examples.en: During the apartment tour, open the taps and check the wardrobe depth.
examples.zh: 「公寓带看」时，拧开水龙头，量一量衣柜的深度。

words.enDefinition: the landlord has accepted your rental application

examples.en: My application was approved the same evening, so I signed the next morning.
examples.zh: 我的「申请通过」当晚就收到通知，第二天上午就去签了约。

examples.en: Two other people applied, so I felt lucky my application got approved.
examples.zh: 还有两个人也在申请，我的「申请通过」真是运气好。

words.enDefinition: a small charge to process your rental application

examples.en: The application fee is forty dollars and it is not refundable.
examples.zh: 「租房申请费」是四十美元，而且不予退还。

examples.en: Some landlords waive the application fee if you view the unit first.
examples.zh: 有些房东只要你先看过房，就免收「租房申请费」。

words.enDefinition: where your rental application stands in the process

examples.en: I emailed the agent twice to check my application status.
examples.zh: 我发了两封邮件询问「申请进度」。

examples.en: The application status changed to approved this morning, so we got the flat.
examples.zh: 今天早上「申请进度」变成了已通过，房子拿到手了。

words.enDefinition: record an available amount against an account or charge

examples.en: Could you apply a credit to my next bill instead of refunding the money?
examples.zh: 能把这笔钱「记成下期账单的抵扣款」，不用退款吗？

examples.en: The office agreed to apply a credit before collecting the August rent.
examples.zh: 办公室同意在收八月房租前先把「抵扣款入账」。

collocations: apply a credit to your account
apply a credit to the balance
ask the office to apply a credit

words.enDefinition: use the money held as security to cover a charge

examples.en: We agreed to apply the deposit to the repair costs and ask for the remainder back.
examples.zh: 我们同意「用押金抵扣」维修费用，再要求退回余额。

examples.en: The agent wanted to apply the deposit against the final charge for replacing a damaged desk.
examples.zh: 中介想「用押金抵扣」更换受损书桌的最后一笔费用。

words.enDefinition: a rug that covers part of a room's floor

examples.en: We put an area rug under the coffee table to soften the room.
examples.zh: 我们在茶几下面铺了一张「块毯」，让房间看起来更温馨。

examples.en: The area rug is small enough to roll up when I move out.
examples.zh: 这张「块毯」不大，搬走时可以卷起来。

collocations: place an area rug under the sofa

words.enDefinition: a comfortable chair with supports for the arms

examples.en: I found a comfortable armchair in the secondhand shop near the bus stop.
examples.zh: 我在公交站附近的二手店找到了一把舒服的「扶手椅」。

examples.en: My flatmate reads in the armchair while I work at the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 我在厨房桌前学习，室友在「扶手椅」里看书。

collocations: place an armchair by the window

words.enDefinition: the period during which a visitor is expected to arrive

examples.en: The arrival window was between ten and noon, so my flatmate agreed to stay home.
examples.zh: 「预计上门时间段」是十点到中午，所以室友答应留在家里。

examples.en: The office narrowed the arrival window after the contractor finished an earlier job ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 承包商提前完成了上一单，办公室便缩小了「预计上门时间段」。

words.enDefinition: the item's current state with no promise to address problems

examples.en: The seller listed the desk in as-is condition and pointed out the scratches.
examples.zh: 卖家声明书桌「按现状出售」，还特意指出了上面的划痕。

examples.en: I accepted the chair in as-is condition after checking that it was sturdy.
examples.zh: 我确认椅子结实后，同意按「现状」买下。

words.enDefinition: the rent the landlord asks for in the listing

examples.en: The asking rent is one thousand two hundred, bills not included.
examples.zh: 「标价租金」一千二，不含账单。

examples.en: They dropped the asking rent by fifty after the flat sat empty for a month.
examples.zh: 房子空了一个月后，房东把「标价租金」降了五十。

words.enDefinition: small pieces used to fasten furniture parts together

examples.en: The assembly hardware came in a little bag taped to the bottom shelf.
examples.zh: 「组装五金件」在一个小袋子里，袋子用胶带贴在最下面的搁板上。

examples.en: Keep the assembly hardware in a labeled bag if you take the desk apart.
examples.zh: 如果拆开书桌，就把「组装五金件」放到贴了标签的袋子里。

words.enDefinition: directions for connecting the parts of an item correctly

examples.en: We found the assembly instructions tucked between the two big cardboard panels.
examples.zh: 我们在两块大纸板之间找到了夹着的「组装说明」。

examples.en: If the assembly instructions are missing, try searching for the model number online.
examples.zh: 如果没有「组装说明」，可以试着上网搜一下型号。

words.enDefinition: paid help putting together the parts of purchased furniture

examples.en: I booked an assembly service because the bunk bed looked difficult to put together.
examples.zh: 那张双层床看上去不好装，我就预约了「组装服务」。

examples.en: The assembly service costs extra, but my flatmates agreed to share the fee.
examples.zh: 「组装服务」要另外收费，但室友们同意一起分担。

words.enDefinition: someone allowed to live there without being a tenant

examples.en: My sister was listed as an authorized occupant and received her own building key.
examples.zh: 我姐姐被登记为「获准居住者」，拿到了一把自己的楼门钥匙。

examples.en: The manager asked if my partner should be listed as an authorized occupant instead.
examples.zh: 物业经理问要不要改把我的伴侣列为「获准居住者」。

words.enDefinition: a function that measures and dispenses detergent automatically

examples.en: My roommate chose a washer with auto-dose to make sharing the machine easier.
examples.zh: 我室友选了带「自动定量投放」的洗衣机，大家用起来更方便。

examples.en: I checked the display to see whether auto-dose was active on the selected program.
examples.zh: 我看了一眼显示屏，确认选中的程序有没有启用「自动定量投放」。

words.enDefinition: a feature that turns a device off without user input

examples.en: I chose a coffee machine with auto shut-off because the old one lacked that feature.
examples.zh: 旧咖啡机没有「自动关机功能」，所以我选了台带这个功能的。

examples.en: The manual explains when auto shut-off happens after the toaster oven finishes its program.
examples.zh: 说明书解释了台式烤炉的程序结束后，什么时候会触发「自动关机功能」。

words.enDefinition: continuation for another period without a new agreement

examples.en: I checked for automatic renewal before assuming the lease would end with my last exam.
examples.zh: 我没急着认定租约会随最后一门考试结束，先看了有没有「自动续约」。

examples.en: The manager explained how automatic renewal worked when I asked whether I needed to sign again.
examples.zh: 我问还要不要再签字，物业经理解释了「自动续约」的流程。

words.enDefinition: the amount in an account that can currently be spent

examples.en: I checked my available balance before buying my textbooks and paying rent.
examples.zh: 买教材和交房租之前，我查看了自己的「可用余额」。

examples.en: The rent payment reduced my available balance before it showed on my statement.
examples.zh: 房租付款还没显示在对账单上，我的「可用余额」就已经少了。

words.enDefinition: waiting for components before a repair can continue

examples.en: The portal shows awaiting parts because the correct handle has not arrived from the supplier.
examples.zh: 供应商还没把合适的拉手发来，所以门户网站显示「等待零件到货」。

examples.en: My request was marked 'awaiting parts' until the contractor received a replacement door closer.
examples.zh: 承包商收到替换用的闭门器之前，我的报修单一直标着「等待零件到货」。

collocations: mark a repair as awaiting parts

words.enDefinition: rent still owed for earlier months of a tenancy

examples.en: I used my first paycheck to pay the back rent for May.
examples.zh: 我用第一笔工资补交了五月的「积欠租金」。

examples.en: The landlord says I owe back rent, but my receipts show otherwise.
examples.zh: 房东说我还有「积欠租金」，但收据显示并不是这样。

words.enDefinition: a toilet that cannot drain and may fill with wastewater

examples.en: We used the bathroom downstairs while the plumber dealt with the backed-up toilet in our flat.
examples.zh: 水管工处理公寓里「排水受阻的马桶」时，我们去楼下用洗手间。

examples.en: I called the after-hours line about a backed-up toilet that we could no longer use.
examples.zh: 有个「排水受阻的马桶」不能用了，我就打了夜间报修电话。

words.enDefinition: an ordered component that is currently unavailable from stock

examples.en: The contractor could not finish because the backordered part had not reached the supplier's warehouse.
examples.zh: 「缺货待补的零件」还没到供应商仓库，承包商没法做完。

examples.en: The office said the backordered part would ship once the supplier received its next delivery.
examples.zh: 办公室说等供应商收到下一批货，「缺货待补的零件」就会发出。

words.enDefinition: a second choice kept ready in case plans fail

examples.en: Keep a backup option in case your first application falls through.
examples.zh: 留一个「备选方案」，以防第一份申请黄了。

examples.en: Our backup option was a pricier flat two subway stops further out.
examples.zh: 我们的「备选方案」是远两站地铁但更贵的一套公寓。

words.enDefinition: the amount that still needs to be paid

examples.en: The balance due was smaller because the agent applied my earlier credit.
examples.zh: 中介用了我之前的抵扣款，所以「应付余额」少了。

examples.en: Could you confirm the balance due before I send my final transfer?
examples.zh: 我转最后一笔款前，能请您确认一下「应付余额」吗？

words.enDefinition: a high seat designed for use at a tall counter

examples.en: I eat breakfast on a bar stool at our narrow kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 我坐在「吧台凳」上，就着厨房窄窄的台面吃早饭。

examples.en: We bought a second bar stool so my flatmate could sit there too.
examples.zh: 我们又买了一把「吧台凳」，这样室友也能坐那里。

words.enDefinition: a soft chair filled with small beads that shifts shape

examples.en: I read in the beanbag chair because there is no room for a sofa.
examples.zh: 没地方摆沙发，所以我就窝在「豆袋椅」里看书。

examples.en: The beanbag chair was light enough to carry to my room alone.
examples.zh: 「豆袋椅」很轻，我自己就能搬进房间。

words.enDefinition: the structure that supports a mattress above the floor

examples.en: The bed frame fits in my room, but the headboard blocks one socket.
examples.zh: 「床架」放得进我房间，但床头板挡住了一个插座。

examples.en: We sold the bed frame to another student before we moved out.
examples.zh: 搬出去之前，我们把「床架」卖给了另一个学生。

words.enDefinition: blocks fitted under bed legs to raise the frame

examples.en: I used bed risers to make space for two boxes underneath my bed.
examples.zh: 我用了「床脚增高垫」，在床下面腾出了放两个箱子的空间。

examples.en: The hall rules say we need permission before we add bed risers.
examples.zh: 宿舍规定说，加装「床脚增高垫」之前要先获得许可。

collocations: raise the frame with bed risers

words.enDefinition: fabric hanging from the bed base to conceal storage underneath

examples.en: I used a bed skirt to hide the boxes underneath the bed.
examples.zh: 我用「床裙」遮住了床底下的箱子。

examples.en: The bed skirt is long enough to cover the metal frame in my room.
examples.zh: 「床裙」够长，能把我房间床的金属床架遮住。

collocations: hide boxes behind a bed skirt

words.enDefinition: strips supporting the mattress across the width of a bed frame

examples.en: The bed slats were bundled separately at the bottom of the box.
examples.zh: 「床板条」单独捆成一束，放在箱子底下。

examples.en: The store sells replacement bed slats for the most common sizes of bed.
examples.zh: 这家店有几种常见床尺寸配套的替换「床板条」。

words.enDefinition: professional work intended to remove bedbugs from a room

examples.en: The housing office scheduled bedbug treatment after a specialist confirmed what was found in the room.
examples.zh: 专业人员确认房间里发现的是床虱后，住房办公室安排了「床虱治理」。

examples.en: I asked how long our shared bedroom would be unavailable during the bedbug treatment.
examples.zh: 我问做「床虱治理」时，合用卧室会有多久不能用。

words.enDefinition: a wash setting designed for sheets or other bulky bedding

examples.en: I used the bedding cycle when I washed all my sheets after the guests left.
examples.zh: 客人走后，我用「床品洗程序」把床单都洗了一遍。

examples.en: My flatmate showed me the bedding cycle on the new washer when I brought down my blanket.
examples.zh: 我拿着毯子下楼时，室友给我指了新洗衣机上的「床品洗程序」。

words.enDefinition: a decorative cover spread over a made bed

examples.en: I put a light bedspread on the bed before the room inspection.
examples.zh: 宿舍检查前，我在床上铺了一条薄「床罩」。

examples.en: The bedspread was too big for our shared washing machine in the basement.
examples.zh: 「床罩」太大，地下室的公用洗衣机放不下。

collocations: spread a bedspread over the bed

words.enDefinition: images showing how something looked on two different occasions

examples.en: We shared before-and-after photos of the kitchen to show that we'd cleaned it properly.
examples.zh: 我们发了厨房的「前后对照照片」，证明已经认真打扫过了。

examples.en: The manager compared our before-and-after photos to make sure the stain didn't spread after cleaning.
examples.zh: 物业经理对比了我们的「前后对照照片」，确认污渍在清洗后并未扩散。

words.enDefinition: rent noticeably cheaper than similar local homes

examples.en: A room below market rent usually means a catch, so read the ad twice.
examples.zh: 「低于市价的租金」往往有猫腻，广告要读两遍。

examples.en: University-owned flats are often below market rent for graduate students.
examples.zh: 学校名下公寓的租金对研究生来说通常「低于市价」。

words.enDefinition: an improvement beyond the property's condition before the damage

examples.en: The adviser raised betterment when the landlord tried to replace our old carpet with hardwood.
examples.zh: 房东打算把旧地毯换成实木地板时，顾问提到了这种「超出原状的增益」。

examples.en: We questioned the charge for betterment because the new countertop was a substantial upgrade.
examples.zh: 我们对「超出原状的增益」这部分费用提出疑问，因为新台面比原来的好很多。

words.enDefinition: a change to an amount previously charged on a bill

examples.en: The bill adjustment appeared the following month after they checked the account history.
examples.zh: 他们查完账户记录后，这笔「账单金额调整」在下个月显示出来了。

examples.en: I asked the supplier to explain each bill adjustment before paying the balance.
examples.zh: 付清余额之前，我请供应商解释每笔「账单金额调整」。

words.enDefinition: an amount taken off a bill or applied to future charges

examples.en: A bill credit appeared on our statement after we reported an overpayment online.
examples.zh: 我们在网上报了多付款的情况后，账单上多了一笔「抵扣额」。

examples.en: My housemate used the bill credit to reduce what we owed in March.
examples.zh: 室友用这笔「账单抵扣额」减少了我们三月应付的钱。

words.enDefinition: the address where a company sends bills or payment notices

examples.en: I changed my billing address because letters still went to my old hall.
examples.zh: 信件还寄到原来的宿舍，所以我更新了「账单地址」。

examples.en: Check that your billing address matches the one registered with your bank card.
examples.zh: 确认「账单地址」与银行卡登记的地址一致。

words.enDefinition: a mistake in the amount or account being charged

examples.en: A billing error made it look as though I owed two months of rent.
examples.zh: 一个「账单错误」让我看起来欠了两个月房租。

examples.en: The office fixed the billing error after I forwarded my previous rent receipt.
examples.zh: 我转发上次的房租收据后，办公室更正了「账单错误」。

words.enDefinition: the span of time covered by charges on a bill

examples.en: I checked the billing period because the amount looked high for two weeks.
examples.zh: 这个金额对两周来说显得有点高，于是我核对了「账单周期」。

examples.en: The billing period on our rent statement runs from Monday through the following Sunday.
examples.zh: 我们的租金对账单上的「账单周期」是星期一到下一周的星期天。

words.enDefinition: the day when household bins are emptied by a collection service

examples.en: Our bin collection day changed after the bank holiday, according to the notice.
examples.zh: 通知说公共假日过后，我们的「垃圾收运日」改了。

examples.en: I checked the bin collection day before putting the heavy recycling bin outside.
examples.zh: 把沉甸甸的回收桶推出去之前，我先查了「垃圾收运日」。

words.enDefinition: an enclosed area where a building keeps its rubbish bins

examples.en: The caretaker unlocked the bin store so we could put our recycling away.
examples.zh: 管理员打开了「垃圾桶存放处」，让我们把可回收物放进去。

examples.en: The map near the lift shows how to find the bin store downstairs.
examples.zh: 电梯旁的示意图标出了楼下「垃圾桶存放处」怎么走。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement that creates enforceable obligations for the parties

examples.en: I asked the adviser when the signed lease would become a binding agreement for everyone.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，签好的租约什么时候会成为对每个人都有「约束力的协议」。

examples.en: We read the draft before deciding whether to enter a binding agreement with the house owner.
examples.zh: 我们先看了草案，再决定是否和屋主签一份「有约束力的协议」。

words.enDefinition: a ruling that the parties involved are required to follow

examples.en: The officer explained that both sides would have to follow the binding decision once it arrived.
examples.zh: 工作人员解释说，一旦作出「有约束力的裁决」，双方都得遵守。

examples.en: We read the binding decision carefully to check how the held money would be divided.
examples.zh: 我们仔细阅读了「有约束力的裁决」，确认暂扣的款项会怎么分配。

words.enDefinition: dark mold that grows in persistently damp places

examples.en: I sent photos of black mold around the bathroom window to the housing office.
examples.zh: 我把浴室窗户周围「黑色霉菌」的照片发给了住房办公室。

examples.en: The contractor noticed black mold behind the chest of drawers and inspected the wall nearby.
examples.zh: 承包商发现抽屉柜后面有「黑色霉菌」，就检查了附近的墙面。

words.enDefinition: curtains designed to block nearly all light entering a room

examples.en: I hung blackout curtains because the streetlight shines directly into my room.
examples.zh: 因为路灯直照进我房间，我挂了「遮光窗帘」。

examples.en: The blackout curtains kept the room dark enough for me to sleep late.
examples.zh: 「遮光窗帘」让房间一直很暗，我可以多睡一会儿。

words.enDefinition: paint that has formed raised bubbles on a surface

examples.en: I noticed blistering paint near the window after several days of heavy rain in October.
examples.zh: 十月连下几天大雨后，我注意到窗边有「起泡的油漆」。

examples.en: The contractor asked when the blistering paint first appeared because the timing might explain the problem.
examples.zh: 承包商问「油漆起泡」最早是什么时候出现的，因为时间也许能解释原因。

collocations: repair an area with blistering paint

words.enDefinition: a drain that water cannot flow through properly

examples.en: The technician cleared a blocked drain after water backed up onto the shower floor.
examples.zh: 水漫到淋浴间地面后，技术员疏通了「堵塞的排水口」。

examples.en: I called the maintenance office about a blocked drain in the basement laundry room.
examples.zh: 我给维修办公室打电话，报告地下室洗衣房有「堵塞的排水口」。

words.enDefinition: an outdoor channel obstructed so rainwater cannot drain

examples.en: The manager linked the dripping above our window to a blocked gutter on the building.
examples.zh: 物业经理说，窗户上方滴水是因为楼上有个「堵塞的屋檐排水槽」。

examples.en: I reported a blocked gutter after noticing rainwater spill over the edge above the doorway.
examples.zh: 注意到门上方有雨水从边缘溢出，我报修了「堵塞的屋檐排水槽」。

words.enDefinition: to cover a window opening with boards for protection

examples.en: The contractor offered to board up a window until the replacement glass could be delivered.
examples.zh: 承包商提出先「用木板封住窗户」，等新的玻璃送到再处理。

examples.en: Our manager had to board up a window after a tree branch broke the glass.
examples.zh: 树枝砸碎玻璃后，物业经理不得不「用木板封住窗户」。

collocations: arrange to board up a window

words.enDefinition: a request for payment from a registered rental bond

examples.en: The agent submitted a bond claim for the broken cupboard door after our tenancy ended.
examples.zh: 租期结束后，中介就损坏的柜门提交了「保证金申领」。

examples.en: We received an email about a bond claim and logged in to check the amount.
examples.zh: 我们收到一封关于「保证金申领」的邮件，就登录查看了金额。

words.enDefinition: the submission of rental security money to a designated authority

examples.en: The agent sent confirmation of bond lodgement after the money reached the bond authority.
examples.zh: 保证金到账后，中介发来了「租房保证金登记」的确认凭证。

examples.en: Our Australian housing adviser asked to see the bond lodgement form before contacting the agent.
examples.zh: 我们在澳大利亚的住房顾问想先看「租房保证金登记」表，再与中介联系。

words.enDefinition: the reference identifying a registered rental security payment

examples.en: The online refund form asks for the bond number on our original registration email.
examples.zh: 网上退款表需要填最初登记邮件里的「保证金登记编号」。

examples.en: I saved our bond number with the lease so either roommate could find it.
examples.zh: 我把「保证金登记编号」和租约放在一起，这样两个室友都能找到。

words.enDefinition: money returned from a rental bond after a tenancy ends

examples.en: My bond refund arrived two days after the property manager approved the amount online.
examples.zh: 物业经理在网上确认金额后两天，我收到了「保证金退款」。

examples.en: Please check that the bond refund will go to both roommates in the agreed shares.
examples.zh: 请确认「保证金退款」会按约定比例分别退给两位室友。

words.enDefinition: arrange a time to visit a rental in person

examples.en: Book a viewing immediately because this studio will not last the week.
examples.zh: 赶紧「预约看房」，这套单身公寓撑不过这个星期。

examples.en: You can book a viewing directly on the site and pick a time slot.
examples.zh: 你可以直接在网站上「预约看房」，挑选时间段。

words.enDefinition: a holder that keeps bottles organized inside a refrigerator

examples.en: I put the juice on the bottle rack so the middle shelf stayed free.
examples.zh: 我把果汁放在「瓶架」上，这样中间那层就空出来了。

examples.en: We removed the bottle rack temporarily to make room for the cake my roommate brought.
examples.zh: 为了放室友带来的蛋糕，我们暂时取下了「瓶架」。

collocations: put drinks on the bottle rack

words.enDefinition: the lower sliding shelf that holds dishes inside a dishwasher

examples.en: The frying pan fit on the bottom rack after I moved two large plates.
examples.zh: 我挪开两个大盘子后，煎锅就放得进「下层碗架」了。

examples.en: My roommate unloaded the bottom rack while I put away the glasses and mugs.
examples.zh: 室友在清空「下层碗架」，我则把玻璃杯和马克杯收起来。

collocations: put plates in the bottom rack

words.enDefinition: a check the bank could not pay

examples.en: I replaced the bounced check with a money order later that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午晚些时候，我用汇票替换了那张「被退票的支票」。

examples.en: The office called about a bounced check I had written for June rent.
examples.zh: 关于我六月交租那张「被退票的支票」，办公室给我打了电话。

collocations: a fee for a bounced check
notify someone of a bounced check

words.enDefinition: a partition placed inside a box to separate individual objects

examples.en: A box divider kept my mugs in place during the ride across town.
examples.zh: 「箱内隔板」固定了马克杯，才没在穿城路上晃动。

examples.en: I slipped a box divider between the glasses before sealing the carton up.
examples.zh: 封箱前，我在玻璃杯之间加了一块「箱内隔板」。

words.enDefinition: a sprung base placed underneath a mattress for support

examples.en: The box spring and mattress were too bulky to fit in our van.
examples.zh: 「弹簧床座」和床垫太占地方，我们的面包车装不下。

examples.en: Ask whether the bed frame can support a mattress without a box spring.
examples.zh: 问问这个床架不用「弹簧床座」能不能撑住床垫。

words.enDefinition: failure to fulfill an obligation in a rental contract

examples.en: My adviser explained which facts might count as a breach of lease under the agreement.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了按这份合同哪些情况可能算「违反租约」。

examples.en: The manager called the unauthorized alteration a breach of lease and asked us to restore the wall.
examples.zh: 物业经理说擅自改装属于「违反租约」，并要求我们把墙恢复原状。

words.enDefinition: an appliance that mixes dough and bakes bread automatically

examples.en: My roommate uses a bread maker to make fresh bread for breakfast on the weekends.
examples.zh: 周末我室友用「面包机」做新鲜面包当早餐。

examples.en: The bread maker was too big for our shelf, so we kept it on the counter.
examples.zh: 「面包机」太大，架子放不下，我们就搁在台面上。

words.enDefinition: a lease provision allowing early termination under specified conditions

examples.en: I checked the break clause before accepting a placement in another city for the spring term.
examples.zh: 我去另一个城市做春季实习之前，先看了「提前解约条款」。

examples.en: The landlord and I discussed adding a break clause because my course dates might change.
examples.zh: 我的课程时间可能会变，我和房东讨论了加一项「提前解约条款」。

words.enDefinition: an agreement for internet access under specified terms and prices

examples.en: We checked the broadband contract for charges that might apply if we moved.
examples.zh: 我们查了「宽带合同」，看看搬家时可能要付哪些费用。

examples.en: My broadband contract ends a month after I move out of this flat.
examples.zh: 我的「宽带合同」在我搬出这套公寓一个月后到期。

words.enDefinition: the work needed to connect a property to broadband

examples.en: The broadband installation is on Thursday, so I'll stay home that afternoon.
examples.zh: 周四「安装宽带」，所以那天下午我会在家。

examples.en: We asked the landlord whether broadband installation would require drilling through a wall.
examples.zh: 我们问了房东，「宽带安装」是否需要在墙上钻孔。

words.enDefinition: a recurring charge for using a line that carries broadband

examples.en: The headline price didn't include broadband line rental, so the monthly cost was higher.
examples.zh: 醒目的报价没算「宽带线路月租费」，所以实际月费更高。

examples.en: I checked whether broadband line rental was still charged when we stopped using the phone.
examples.zh: 停用座机后，我查了还会不会收「宽带线路月租费」。

words.enDefinition: an internet plan sold with a particular speed and price

examples.en: The cheapest broadband package was fast enough for me and my two flatmates.
examples.zh: 最便宜的「宽带套餐」网速也够我和两个室友使用。

examples.en: We compared each broadband package because we only needed access during term time.
examples.zh: 我们比较了各个「宽带套餐」，因为我们只需要在学期内上网。

words.enDefinition: cook food directly under a strong heat source

examples.en: The recipe asks us to broil the cheese topping until it begins to turn golden.
examples.zh: 食谱说，要「用上火烤」最上面的芝士层，直到开始变成金黄色。

examples.en: My roommate likes to broil the bread briefly to finish our open sandwiches.
examples.zh: 我室友喜欢把敞口三明治上的面包短暂「用上火烤」一下。

words.enDefinition: a faulty device that ordinarily closes a door automatically

examples.en: The stairwell door kept slamming because a broken door closer no longer slowed it down.
examples.zh: 楼梯间的门总是砰地关上，因为「损坏的闭门器」已经起不到减速作用。

examples.en: The contractor ordered a replacement for the broken door closer near the laundry room.
examples.zh: 承包商订了一个替换件，准备用来换洗衣房附近「损坏的闭门器」。

words.enDefinition: a damaged handle used to flush a toilet

examples.en: My flatmate told the office about the broken flush handle before heading off to lectures.
examples.zh: 室友去上课前，向办公室报告了「坏掉的冲水把手」。

examples.en: The plumber carried a replacement for the broken flush handle when she came upstairs.
examples.zh: 水管工上楼时，带了一个零件来换「坏掉的冲水把手」。

words.enDefinition: a damaged catch that normally holds a window shut

examples.en: I asked the manager to repair the broken window latch before I left for winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假离开前，我请物业经理修好「损坏的窗闩」。

examples.en: The technician brought a replacement for the broken window latch in our ground-floor study room.
examples.zh: 技术员带来了替换件，准备更换底层自习室里「损坏的窗闩」。

words.enDefinition: a control for setting how dark toast becomes

examples.en: I turned down the browning control because I prefer my toast lightly browned at breakfast.
examples.zh: 我把「烤色调节」调低了，因为早餐的吐司我喜欢烤得浅一些。

examples.en: My roommate explained the browning control when I asked why one setting made darker toast.
examples.zh: 我问为什么某一档烤出来的吐司更深，室友给我解释了「烤色调节」。

words.enDefinition: plastic sheeting with small air pockets for protecting fragile objects

examples.en: Wrap the picture frame in bubble wrap before putting it next to the books.
examples.zh: 相框先用「气泡包装膜」包好，再放在书旁边。

examples.en: I saved the bubble wrap from a parcel for the night we packed up.
examples.zh: 包裹里的「气泡包装膜」我留了下来，准备搬家打包那晚用。

words.enDefinition: plan how much money to reserve for upcoming rent

examples.en: I budget for rent before deciding how much I can spend on groceries.
examples.zh: 我先「为房租做预算」，再决定买菜能花多少钱。

examples.en: The guide shows how to budget for rent on a part-time income.
examples.zh: 这份指南教你怎么用兼职收入「为房租做预算」。

words.enDefinition: a board for announcements aimed at building residents

examples.en: I checked the building noticeboard for the dates when the bins would be moved.
examples.zh: 我去看了「楼内公告栏」，确认垃圾桶哪几天会挪位置。

examples.en: Someone put a note about a lost set of keys on the building noticeboard.
examples.zh: 有人在「楼内公告栏」上贴了张丢钥匙的启事。

words.enDefinition: a dishwasher designed to be fitted into kitchen cabinetry

examples.en: The flat had a built-in dishwasher, which left more room on the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 公寓配了「嵌入式洗碗机」，厨房台面就更宽敞了。

examples.en: We checked whether the built-in dishwasher was included in the list of supplied appliances.
examples.zh: 我们查了「嵌入式洗碗机」在不在随房电器清单里。

collocations: a kitchen with a built-in dishwasher

words.enDefinition: a service that collects large items discarded by households

examples.en: We booked a bulky waste collection for the mattress we could not take.
examples.zh: 那张床垫带不走，我们预约了「大件垃圾清运」。

examples.en: The council's bulky waste collection service would not take any old computer batteries.
examples.zh: 市政的「大件垃圾清运」服务不收旧电脑电池。

words.enDefinition: two beds stacked one above the other

examples.en: A bunk bed gave us enough floor space for two desks in the room.
examples.zh: 用了「双层床」，房间的地面空间才够摆两张桌子。

examples.en: My sister always picked the top of the bunk bed when she visited.
examples.zh: 姐姐来做客时，总想睡「双层床」的上铺。

collocations: the top of the bunk bed

words.enDefinition: a light bulb that no longer works after failing

examples.en: The office replaced a burned-out bulb in the entryway after I reported it this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上报修后，办公室更换了入口处「烧坏的灯泡」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the maintenance team could remove the burned-out bulb from our ceiling fixture.
examples.zh: 室友问维修团队能不能把我们顶灯里「烧坏的灯泡」取下来。

words.enDefinition: a water pipe that has split open under pressure

examples.en: We contacted building management after a burst pipe flooded part of the shared laundry room.
examples.zh: 一根「爆裂的水管」把共用洗衣房的一部分淹了，我们就联系了物业。

examples.en: The maintenance team repaired the burst pipe while residents waited in the common room.
examples.zh: 维修团队修理「爆裂的水管」时，住户们在公共休息室等候。

words.enDefinition: a fitting lining a hole through which cables pass

examples.en: I threaded the charger through the cable grommet at the back of the desk.
examples.zh: 我把充电线从书桌后侧的「穿线孔套」里穿了过去。

examples.en: The cable grommet was too small for the plug on my monitor.
examples.zh: 「穿线孔套」太小了，显示器的插头穿不过去。

collocations: feed wires through a cable grommet

words.enDefinition: internet access supplied over a cable television network

examples.en: We used cable internet because it was available before the fiber installation date.
examples.zh: 光纤还没到安装日期，我们就先用了「有线电视网宽带」。

examples.en: Our landlord said cable internet was still active when the previous tenants left.
examples.zh: 房东说，上任租客离开时，「有线电视网宽带」还没停。

words.enDefinition: a channel or rack used to hold and route cables

examples.en: My flatmate installed a cable tray underneath our desk to clear the floor.
examples.zh: 室友在书桌下面装了「理线槽」，把地上的线收了起来。

examples.en: The cable tray keeps my power strip out of reach of the cat.
examples.zh: 「理线槽」把插线板收了起来，猫就够不着了。

collocations: hide wires in a cable tray

words.enDefinition: a round fitting that turns to grip a furniture bolt

examples.en: Turn the cam lock until it grips the bolt underneath the shelf.
examples.zh: 把「偏心连接件」拧到卡住搁板下面的螺栓。

examples.en: I put the cam lock in backwards and had to start again.
examples.zh: 我把「偏心连接件」装反了，只能重新来。

words.enDefinition: stop scheduled automatic payments from going through

examples.en: I need to cancel autopay before the new tenant starts paying in August.
examples.zh: 八月新租户开始交租前，我得「取消自动付款」。

examples.en: Please cancel autopay after confirming that your last payment has gone through.
examples.zh: 请在确认最后一笔款项成功支付后「取消自动付款」。

words.enDefinition: an appliance that brews coffee from sealed individual pods

examples.en: There's a capsule coffee machine in the student lounge, but you need to bring your own pods.
examples.zh: 学生休息区有一台「胶囊咖啡机」，不过得自己带胶囊。

examples.en: My housemate bought a capsule coffee machine that fits on our narrow kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 室友买了一台「胶囊咖啡机」，放得下我们家窄窄的厨房台面。

collocations: pods for a capsule coffee machine

words.enDefinition: a payment made with a credit or debit card

examples.en: The office refused a card payment during a temporary outage last Monday.
examples.zh: 上星期一系统临时故障，办公室不收「银行卡付款」。

examples.en: My card payment appeared in the rent portal by the end of class.
examples.zh: 到下课时，我的「银行卡付款」已经显示在交租平台里了。

words.enDefinition: a strap used to stop transported items from moving

examples.en: We used a cargo strap to keep the bookcase still inside the van.
examples.zh: 我们用一条「货物固定带」把书架固定在货车里。

examples.en: The driver checked every cargo strap before pulling away from our old flat.
examples.zh: 司机把车开离旧公寓前，检查了每条「货物固定带」。

words.enDefinition: removing an existing carpet and installing another in its place

examples.en: The agent wanted to charge us for carpet replacement after finding one small stain.
examples.zh: 中介发现一小块污渍，就想向我们收取「更换地毯」的费用。

examples.en: We asked for a quote for carpet replacement rather than relying on the manager's estimate.
examples.zh: 我们要求提供「更换地毯」的报价，以便核对物业经理的估算。

words.enDefinition: to take packed boxes to a lower floor by carrying them

examples.en: Our friends came early to help us carry the boxes downstairs before lunch.
examples.zh: 朋友们早早就到了，帮我们赶在午饭前「把箱子搬下楼」。

examples.en: I can carry the boxes downstairs if you hold the front door open.
examples.zh: 你帮我撑着大门的话，我可以「把箱子搬下楼」。

collocations: help to carry the boxes downstairs
start to carry the boxes downstairs

words.enDefinition: to lift and take something to a higher floor

examples.en: We asked what the movers could carry upstairs without using a furniture lift.
examples.zh: 我们问了搬家工人，不用家具升降设备的话，什么东西能「搬上楼」。

examples.en: This box is too heavy to carry upstairs on your own after class.
examples.zh: 这个箱子太重，你下课后一个人没法「搬上楼」。

words.enDefinition: exchange a specific check for money in cash

examples.en: The landlord plans to cash the check tomorrow on her way to work.
examples.zh: 房东打算明天上班路上「把支票兑成现金」。

examples.en: My agent could not cash the check because I misspelled the company name.
examples.zh: 我把公司名称拼错了，中介没法「兑现支票」。

collocations: cash the check at a bank

words.enDefinition: a check issued and guaranteed by a bank

examples.en: I got a cashier's check because the office would not accept a personal one.
examples.zh: 办公室不收个人支票，所以我开了一张「银行本票」。

examples.en: The teller asked who should be listed as payee on the cashier's check.
examples.zh: 柜员问我「银行本票」的收款人应该写谁。

collocations: a cashier's check payable to the landlord

words.enDefinition: pay enough to make overdue housing payments current again

examples.en: I should be able to catch up on rent after my next payday.
examples.zh: 下次发工资后，我应该就能「补齐拖欠的房租」。

examples.en: The adviser helped me make a plan to catch up on rent.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我制定了一个「补齐拖欠房租」的计划。

collocations: catch up on rent by Friday
help someone catch up on rent
a plan to catch up on rent

words.enDefinition: a smooth glass-ceramic cooktop heated by elements underneath

examples.en: The ceramic hob looks like an induction cooktop, but the heaters glow beneath the surface.
examples.zh: 这个「陶瓷电炉灶面」看起来像电磁灶，但面板下的发热元件会发亮。

examples.en: We spotted a mark on the ceramic hob while checking our new flat's inventory.
examples.zh: 我们核对新公寓的房屋清单时，发现「陶瓷电炉灶面」上有道印子。

collocations: a mark on the ceramic hob

words.enDefinition: a protective floor covering placed underneath a rolling chair

examples.en: I bought a chair mat to protect the wooden floor under my desk.
examples.zh: 我买了块「座椅地垫」，保护书桌下面的木地板。

examples.en: The chair mat makes it easier to move my desk chair across the carpet.
examples.zh: 有了「座椅地垫」，我的书桌椅更容易在地毯上滑动。

words.enDefinition: a form used to report a new postal or residential address

examples.en: The university sent me a change of address form when I left student housing.
examples.zh: 我搬出学生公寓时，学校发给我一份「地址变更表」。

examples.en: I filled out a change of address form before leaving for the summer.
examples.zh: 暑假离校前，我填好了一份「地址变更表」。

collocations: fill in a change of address form
submit a change of address form
download the change of address form

words.enDefinition: the replacement of the person responsible as landlord

examples.en: The letter about a change of landlord listed the person to contact for future repairs.
examples.zh: 关于「出租人变更」的信写明了今后负责报修的联系人。

examples.en: Our adviser explained what to check in the lease after a change of landlord.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「出租人变更」后要查看租约的哪些内容。

collocations: notify tenants of a change of landlord
a notice of change of landlord

words.enDefinition: the banking process of confirming and settling a check

examples.en: My landlord asks us to allow two business days for check clearing.
examples.zh: 房东让我们为「支票清算」预留两个工作日。

examples.en: I chose to pay by card because check clearing takes longer over holidays.
examples.zh: 节假日「支票清算」更慢，所以我选择刷卡付款。

words.enDefinition: a record of a property's condition at the start of a tenancy

examples.en: We noted the loose window handle in the check-in report and signed the form together.
examples.zh: 我们在「入住交接报告」里注明了窗把手松动，并一起签了字。

examples.en: I used the check-in report to show that the wardrobe door had never closed properly.
examples.zh: 我拿出「入住交接报告」，证明衣柜门从一开始就关不严。

collocations: compare the check-in report with photographs

words.enDefinition: a note on a check explaining what it pays for

examples.en: I wrote my apartment number in the check memo so they could identify it.
examples.zh: 我把公寓门牌号写在「支票备注」里，好让对方知道是哪户付的。

examples.en: The office asked me to put my student number in the check memo.
examples.zh: 办公室让我在「支票备注」里填上学号。

collocations: write the apartment number in the check memo

words.enDefinition: a record of what is found when a tenant leaves

examples.en: The check-out report listed several marks on the wall but didn't include any photos.
examples.zh: 「退租交接报告」列了墙上的几处印记，但没有附照片。

examples.en: I added a note to the check-out report about the key that had already been returned.
examples.zh: 我在「退租交接报告」里加了一条备注，说明那把钥匙已经归还。

collocations: provide comments on the check-out report

words.enDefinition: a deep freezer with a lid on the top

examples.en: Our landlord keeps a chest freezer in the garage for food from the shared garden.
examples.zh: 房东在车库放了个「卧式冷冻柜」，存从公用菜园收来的食材。

examples.en: We chose a chest freezer that would fit under the basement window without blocking it.
examples.zh: 我们选了个能放在地下室窗户下面、又不会挡住窗的「卧式冷冻柜」。

collocations: store food in a chest freezer

words.enDefinition: a piece of furniture containing a stack of drawers

examples.en: My room came with a small chest of drawers under the window.
examples.zh: 我房间里原本在窗下配了个小「抽屉柜」。

examples.en: We moved the chest of drawers into the hall to make more floor space.
examples.zh: 我们把「抽屉柜」搬到门厅，腾出了更多地面空间。

collocations: put clothes in a chest of drawers

words.enDefinition: a feature preventing accidental operation of buttons or doors

examples.en: I noticed that the child lock icon was lit on the washer's control panel.
examples.zh: 我注意到洗衣机面板上的「童锁」图标亮着。

examples.en: My roommate checked the owner's manual to find out where the child lock setting was.
examples.zh: 室友查了使用说明书，想知道「童锁」设置在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: contribute some money toward a shared rent payment

examples.en: My partner offered to chip in for rent while staying over this summer.
examples.zh: 我对象说这个夏天过来住的时候，愿意「凑一份房租钱」。

examples.en: Can everyone chip in for rent before I send the landlord our payment?
examples.zh: 我把钱转给房东之前，大家能先「凑齐各自那份房租」吗？

collocations: offer to chip in for rent
agree to chip in for rent
ask someone to chip in for rent

words.zhGloss: 间歇发出短响的烟雾报警器
words.enDefinition: a smoke alarm making repeated short warning sounds
acceptedZhAnswers: 间歇发出短响的烟雾报警器

examples.en: We notified the office about a chirping smoke alarm in the hallway outside our rooms.
examples.zh: 我们通知办公室，房间外的走廊里有一个「间歇发出短响的烟雾报警器」。

examples.en: The manager sent a technician to check the chirping smoke alarm near our kitchen.
examples.zh: 物业经理派技术员检查厨房附近「间歇发出短响的烟雾报警器」。

collocations: a chirping smoke alarm in the hallway

words.enDefinition: a switch that cuts power when a circuit becomes unsafe

examples.en: We called maintenance after the circuit breaker kept switching off in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房里的「断路器」一直跳闸，我们就打电话叫人来维修。

examples.en: The circuit breaker for my room is labelled inside the panel by the door.
examples.zh: 门旁边的配电箱里标明了我房间对应的「断路器」。

words.enDefinition: money held against the cost of leaving a property dirty

examples.en: The manager returned our cleaning deposit once she saw that we'd cleaned the oven and fridge.
examples.zh: 物业经理看到烤箱和冰箱都已清理，就退还了「清洁押金」。

examples.en: The fee table listed a separate cleaning deposit and explained when it would be returned.
examples.zh: 收费表单独列出了「清洁押金」，还说明了什么时候会退。

words.enDefinition: money charged for cleaning a place after someone leaves

examples.en: We disputed the cleaning fee because our photographs showed the kitchen was already clean.
examples.zh: 我们对「清洁费」提出了异议，因为照片显示厨房当时已经干净。

examples.en: The listing mentioned a cleaning fee, so we asked whether cleaning the room ourselves was an option.
examples.zh: 房源信息写着要收「清洁费」，于是我们问能不能自己打扫房间。

words.enDefinition: a document requesting payment for cleaning services already performed

examples.en: Could you forward the cleaning invoice so we can see which rooms the company cleaned?
examples.zh: 能转发一下「清洁服务账单」吗？我们想看看清洁公司打扫了哪些房间。

examples.en: The cleaning invoice showed a two-hour visit, which matched the deduction on our final statement.
examples.zh: 「清洁服务账单」上写的是两小时，和最终账单上的扣款相符。

collocations: request a copy of the cleaning invoice

words.enDefinition: a schedule assigning cleaning duties to different people in turn

examples.en: Our cleaning rota is on the fridge, next to the grocery list.
examples.zh: 我们的「轮值清洁表」贴在冰箱上，挨着买菜清单。

examples.en: We updated the cleaning rota because my evening classes now finish on Thursday.
examples.zh: 我的晚课现在最后一节在周四，所以我们更新了「轮值清洁表」。

words.enDefinition: the expected level of cleanliness for a particular place

examples.en: The residence sent a cleaning standard that included pictures of a properly cleaned kitchen.
examples.zh: 宿舍发来一份「清洁标准」，里面有打扫到位的厨房照片。

examples.en: We asked what cleaning standard applied to the fridge before deciding whether to book cleaners.
examples.zh: 决定要不要请保洁前，我们问了冰箱适用什么「清洁标准」。

words.enDefinition: pay off amounts that should already have been paid

examples.en: I agreed to clear the arrears in three payments over the summer.
examples.zh: 我同意暑假分三次「付清欠款」。

examples.en: The adviser helped me clear the arrears before my next rent became due.
examples.zh: 在下一笔房租到期前，顾问帮我「付清了欠款」。

words.enDefinition: storage in a space with regulated temperature and often humidity

examples.en: We chose climate-controlled storage because our boxes contained books and some musical instruments.
examples.zh: 箱子里有书和一些乐器，所以我们选了「控温储存」。

examples.en: The extra cost of climate-controlled storage was worth it for storing my guitar.
examples.zh: 为寄存吉他多花点钱办「控温储存」，我觉得值。

words.enDefinition: a lamp that fastens to an edge with a clip

examples.en: We bought a clip-on lamp because the bedside table was already full.
examples.zh: 床头柜已经放满了，所以我们买了一盏「夹式灯」。

examples.en: I attached a clip-on lamp to the shelf above my desk for reading.
examples.zh: 我在书桌上方的搁板上夹了一盏「夹式灯」看书用。

words.enDefinition: to end tracking of a job in a request system

examples.en: The portal lets residents close a ticket after confirming that the maintenance team fixed the problem.
examples.zh: 维修团队解决问题后，住户可以在门户网站上确认并「关闭工单」。

examples.en: I asked the office not to close a ticket until someone had checked our upstairs bathroom.
examples.zh: 我请办公室等有人检查楼上浴室后再「关闭工单」。

words.enDefinition: to formally end your account with a utility company

examples.en: Our supplier needs a final reading to close a utility account at this address.
examples.zh: 要在这个地址「注销公用服务账户」，供应商需要最后一次读数。

examples.en: You can close a utility account without cutting off supply for the next tenant.
examples.zh: 你可以「注销公用服务账户」，同时让下一任房客继续使用原服务。

collocations: close a utility account after moving
request to close a utility account

words.enDefinition: the last reading used to calculate charges when an account ends

examples.en: The closing meter reading must be from the day you actually leave the property.
examples.zh: 「结账时的表计读数」要用你真正离开住处那天的数字。

examples.en: I kept a photograph of the closing meter reading in case the bill was wrong.
examples.zh: 我留了张「结账时的表计读数」的照片，以防账单有误。

words.enDefinition: an appliance using steam to smooth wrinkles from hanging clothes

examples.en: I borrowed my roommate's clothes steamer to smooth my shirt before the interview.
examples.zh: 面试前，我借了室友的「挂烫机」把衬衫烫平。

examples.en: The clothes steamer fit in our cupboard even though there was little space left.
examples.zh: 橱柜里没剩多少位置，不过还是放得下这台「挂烫机」。

words.enDefinition: a person who signs the rental agreement with you

examples.en: My uncle in Chicago agreed to act as my co-signer.
examples.zh: 我在芝加哥的舅舅同意当我的「共同签约人」。

examples.en: The agent asked for a co-signer because my income does not meet the rule.
examples.zh: 因为收入不达标，中介要求我找一位「共同签约人」。

words.enDefinition: someone who rents a property alongside another tenant

examples.en: Each co-tenant received an electronic copy after everyone had signed the same apartment lease.
examples.zh: 所有人签完同一份公寓租约后，每位「共同承租人」都收到了一份电子副本。

examples.en: My co-tenant and I checked the renewal dates together before emailing the management office.
examples.zh: 我和「共同承租人」一起核对了续租日期，然后才给物业办公室发邮件。

words.enDefinition: the established presence of many cockroaches in a property

examples.en: The manager sent someone to inspect a possible cockroach infestation in the shared kitchen downstairs.
examples.zh: 物业经理派人去检查楼下共用厨房的情况，看是否已经「蟑螂成患」。

examples.en: The technician discussed a follow-up visit because the cockroach infestation affected more than one flat.
examples.zh: 因为不止一套公寓「蟑螂成患」，技术员谈到了后续上门的安排。

words.enDefinition: a machine that crushes coffee beans into small particles

examples.en: The coffee grinder is noisy, so I usually make coffee after my flatmates wake up.
examples.zh: 「咖啡磨豆机」声音大，所以我通常等室友起床后再做咖啡。

examples.en: I tried the library café's beans at home with the coffee grinder on our kitchen shelf.
examples.zh: 我用厨房架子上的「咖啡磨豆机」试了试图书馆咖啡店的豆子。

words.enDefinition: a low table usually placed in front of a sofa

examples.en: We moved the coffee table closer to the couch for our board game.
examples.zh: 为了玩桌游，我们把「茶几」挪得离沙发近一点。

examples.en: I left my library books on the coffee table in the living room.
examples.zh: 我把从图书馆借的书落在客厅的「茶几」上了。

collocations: set drinks on the coffee table

words.enDefinition: a wash using cold water instead of heated water

examples.en: I chose a cold wash for the T-shirts because their labels specified cold water.
examples.zh: 这些 T 恤的衣标上写明要用冷水，所以我选了「冷水洗」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the short program could also run as a cold wash.
examples.zh: 室友问，短程序能不能也选「冷水洗」。

words.enDefinition: to pick up a package waiting at a named location

examples.en: You can collect a parcel from reception during its opening hours on weekdays.
examples.zh: 工作日开放时间内，你可以去前台「领取包裹」。

examples.en: I stopped to collect a parcel on my way back from the library.
examples.zh: 我从图书馆回来的路上顺便去「领取包裹」。

words.enDefinition: receive the money that tenants owe for their accommodation

examples.en: The letting agent will collect rent while our landlord is away this summer.
examples.zh: 房东今年夏天不在，租房中介会代为「收房租」。

examples.en: Our landlord used to collect rent in person on the first Monday of each month.
examples.zh: 以前房东会在每月的第一个星期一上门「收房租」。

collocations: collect rent on behalf of the owner

words.enDefinition: the date on which a rental agreement takes effect

examples.en: The commencement date falls on a Tuesday, two days after I arrive in town.
examples.zh: 「租约起始日」是星期二，在我到这座城市之后两天。

examples.en: The agent corrected the commencement date after I showed her the email confirming September first.
examples.zh: 我给中介看了确认九月一日的邮件，她就改了「租约起始日」。

words.enDefinition: shared spaces like the kitchen and living room

examples.en: Everyone cleans the common areas on a rota every Sunday.
examples.zh: 每周日大家按轮值表打扫「公共区域」。

examples.en: Keep the common area tidy or the landlord may blame all of us.
examples.zh: 「公共区域」要保持整洁，不然房东会把账算到我们所有人头上。

words.enDefinition: a reservation made to use a shared recreation room

examples.en: I made a common room booking for our flat's first movie night in March.
examples.zh: 我办了「公共活动室预约」，准备三月第一次和室友一起看电影。

examples.en: Our common room booking ends at nine, so we need to start early.
examples.zh: 我们的「公共活动室预约」到九点结束，所以得早点开始。

words.enDefinition: an entrance shared by residents of more than one home

examples.en: Please keep the communal entrance clear so other residents can get through the door.
examples.zh: 请别在「共用入口」堆东西，方便其他住户进出。

examples.en: The delivery driver left our parcels at the communal entrance instead of ringing the bell.
examples.zh: 快递员没按门铃，把包裹放在了「共用入口」。

words.enDefinition: a garden shared by residents of a building or neighbourhood

examples.en: Two of my neighbours grow tomatoes in the communal garden behind our building.
examples.zh: 我有两个邻居在楼后的「共用花园」里种西红柿。

examples.en: We asked if students could volunteer to help look after the communal garden.
examples.zh: 我们问了学生能不能当志愿者，一起打理「共用花园」。

words.enDefinition: a heating system shared by multiple homes in one building

examples.en: Our building uses communal heating instead of having a boiler in each flat.
examples.zh: 我们楼用的是「楼栋共用供暖」，各户没有自己的锅炉。

examples.en: The notice says communal heating will come on at the beginning of October.
examples.zh: 通知说「楼栋共用供暖」将于十月初开始运行。

words.enDefinition: repair work on spaces or facilities shared by residents

examples.en: The main entrance will stay open while communal repairs continue in the rear stairwell.
examples.zh: 后楼梯间进行「公共区域维修」时，大门会照常开放。

examples.en: We received an email about communal repairs planned for the courtyard during the semester break.
examples.zh: 我们收到一封邮件，讲的是学期间歇时庭院的「公共区域维修」计划。

collocations: report a need for communal repairs

words.enDefinition: a small growing area assigned to someone in a shared garden

examples.en: I put my name down for a community garden plot at the open day.
examples.zh: 开放日那天，我报名申请了一块「社区花园种植地块」。

examples.en: My neighbour showed me the community garden plot where she grows fresh herbs.
examples.zh: 邻居给我看了她种香草的「社区花园种植地块」。

collocations: apply for a community garden plot

words.enDefinition: how long it takes to travel from home to campus

examples.en: Cheap rent means nothing if the commute time reaches an hour each way.
examples.zh: 如果「通勤时间」单程要一小时，房租再便宜也没意义。

examples.en: Google Maps estimates my commute time at twenty minutes by bike.
examples.zh: 谷歌地图估算我的「通勤时间」骑车是二十分钟。

words.enDefinition: look at several rental ads side by side

examples.en: Compare listings for a week before you visit anything in person.
examples.zh: 实地看房之前，先花一周时间「对比房源」。

examples.en: It helps to compare listings in a spreadsheet with price, commute, and bills.
examples.zh: 用表格「对比房源」很有用，可以记下价格、通勤和账单。

words.enDefinition: a rental scene where many tenants chase few homes

examples.en: September is a competitive market, so applications go out the same day.
examples.zh: 九月就是「竞争激烈的市场」，看中当天就得交申请。

examples.en: In a competitive market, a complete application folder makes you stand out.
examples.zh: 在「竞争激烈的市场」里，材料齐全的申请最占优势。

words.enDefinition: moisture that collects inside a sealed double-glazed window

examples.en: The glazier linked the condensation between panes to a failed seal in the bedroom window.
examples.zh: 玻璃安装师傅说，卧室窗户的密封失效导致了「玻璃夹层结露」。

examples.en: I sent a photo of the condensation between panes because the glass stayed cloudy all day.
examples.zh: 玻璃一整天都雾蒙蒙的，我就发了一张「玻璃夹层结露」的照片。

words.enDefinition: a dryer that collects moisture as liquid water

examples.en: We looked at a condenser dryer because the laundry room has no outside vent.
examples.zh: 洗衣房没有通往室外的排气口，所以我们看了看「冷凝式烘干机」。

examples.en: My housemate checked the manual to see how our condenser dryer collects water.
examples.zh: 室友查了说明书，想了解我们的「冷凝式烘干机」怎么收集冷凝水。

collocations: an appliance manual for a condenser dryer

words.enDefinition: contract conditions that cannot both be followed or applied

examples.en: The adviser flagged conflicting terms about whether visitors could stay longer than a week in March.
examples.zh: 顾问指出，一些条款对三月访客能否留宿超过一周「规定相互冲突」。

examples.en: We found conflicting terms in the lease and the attachment about where to park bikes.
examples.zh: 关于自行车停在哪里，租约和附件里有「相互冲突的条款」。

words.enDefinition: permission to transfer a lease to another tenant

examples.en: I asked when the landlord would give consent to assignment so I could plan my move.
examples.zh: 我问房东何时会给「转让租约的许可」，这样我好安排搬家。

examples.en: The office confirmed consent to assignment after checking my replacement's enrollment letter and references.
examples.zh: 办公室核对了接替我的租客的在读证明和推荐材料，随后确认给予「转让租约的许可」。

words.enDefinition: a landlord's interference that effectively forces a tenant out

examples.en: The clinic mentioned constructive eviction when I said the landlord had made the room unlivable.
examples.zh: 我说房东让房间变得没法住，法律咨询点提到了「迫使租客搬离」。

examples.en: My adviser explained why a claim of constructive eviction depends on more than ordinary inconvenience.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么单有日常不便，还不能认定房东「迫使租客搬离」。

words.enDefinition: the main box that distributes electricity to circuits in a home

examples.en: The caretaker showed me the consumer unit behind the front door of the flat.
examples.zh: 管理员给我指了公寓大门后面的「家用配电箱」。

examples.en: Our electrician labelled each switch in the consumer unit after checking the kitchen sockets.
examples.zh: 电工检查完厨房的插座后，给「家用配电箱」里的每个开关贴了标签。

words.enDefinition: the surface containing an appliance's controls and indicators

examples.en: I could see the program name right on the control panel of our washer.
examples.zh: 我直接在洗衣机的「控制面板」上就能看到程序名称。

examples.en: The control panel was above the door, within easy reach when I loaded things.
examples.zh: 「控制面板」在门上方，我往机器里放东西时很容易够到。

words.enDefinition: a separate electricity rate for appliances supplied during set hours

examples.en: The electrician told us our hot water system was on a controlled load tariff.
examples.zh: 电工说我们的热水系统用的是「专用回路优惠电价」。

examples.en: Ask the retailer whether the controlled load tariff covers your storage heater as well.
examples.zh: 问问电力零售商，你的蓄热式取暖器能不能也用「专用回路优惠电价」。

collocations: qualify for a controlled load tariff
switch to a controlled load tariff

words.enDefinition: an oven with a fan that circulates hot air

examples.en: The kitchen has a convection oven, so the fan runs during some baking programs.
examples.zh: 厨房配有「热风循环烤箱」，因此部分烘烤程序会开风扇。

examples.en: My roommate chose the convection oven for baking two trays of cookies at once.
examples.zh: 我室友选用「热风循环烤箱」，一次烤两盘饼干。

words.enDefinition: an extra charge for using a particular payment option

examples.en: There is a convenience fee if I use the agent's online payment link.
examples.zh: 用中介的网上付款链接，会收一笔「支付渠道服务费」。

examples.en: We pay by check because the portal adds a convenience fee every month.
examples.zh: 我们用支票付，因为用平台每个月都会加收「支付渠道服务费」。

words.enDefinition: a marked area on a cooktop that heats a pan

examples.en: The largest cooking zone on our hob is wide enough for my big frying pan.
examples.zh: 我们灶面的最大一个「灶面加热区」，放得下我的大煎锅。

examples.en: My roommate pointed out which cooking zone was active on the new cooktop's display.
examples.zh: 室友指着新灶面的显示屏，告诉我哪个「灶面加热区」在工作。

words.enDefinition: a vacuum cleaner powered by a rechargeable battery

examples.en: We chose a cordless vacuum because the stair landing has no nearby power outlet.
examples.zh: 楼梯平台附近没有插座，所以我们选了「无线吸尘器」。

examples.en: My roommate used the cordless vacuum to pick up crumbs near our breakfast table.
examples.zh: 室友用「无线吸尘器」清掉了早餐桌附近的碎屑。

words.enDefinition: a desk shaped to make use of a room corner

examples.en: I chose a corner desk to keep the center of my room clear.
examples.zh: 我选了「转角书桌」，这样房间中间就不会被占。

examples.en: The corner desk gives me enough space for my laptop and sketchbook.
examples.zh: 「转角书桌」面积够大，能同时放下笔记本电脑和速写本。

collocations: fit a corner desk into a room

words.enDefinition: a protective piece placed over the corner of an object

examples.en: Put a corner protector on the frame before loading it into the van.
examples.zh: 把相框装车前，先在框角套一个「边角护垫」。

examples.en: One corner protector fell off the mirror as we took it down the stairs.
examples.zh: 往楼下搬镜子时，有个「边角护垫」掉了下来。

words.enDefinition: a shelf designed to use the space where walls meet

examples.en: I keep my clock on a corner shelf next to the bed.
examples.zh: 我把钟放在床边的「转角置物板」上。

examples.en: A corner shelf gave me somewhere to put small plants by the window.
examples.zh: 装了一块「转角置物板」，我就有地方在窗边摆小盆栽了。

words.enDefinition: to add a confirming signature to the lease

examples.en: The building manager will countersign the lease after both roommates have signed their parts.
examples.zh: 两位室友各自签字后，物业经理会「在租约上加签确认」。

examples.en: I asked when the landlord would countersign the lease because I needed a completed copy.
examples.zh: 我需要完整的副本，就问房东什么时候「在租约上加签确认」。

collocations: countersign the lease after the tenant

words.enDefinition: money paid to submit a case or document to a court

examples.en: We checked the court filing fee before deciding whether to submit a claim for the deposit.
examples.zh: 决定要不要为这笔押金提起诉讼以前，我们先查了「法院立案费」。

examples.en: The adviser explained where to find the current court filing fee on the court website.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了在法院网站的哪里能查到现行「法院立案费」。

words.enDefinition: pay another person's part of a shared cost

examples.en: I can cover your share this month if your grant is coming late.
examples.zh: 如果补助款晚到，这个月我可以先「垫付你那份」。

examples.en: Could you cover her share of the rent until she gets paid again?
examples.zh: 她下次领到工资之前，你能先「垫付她那份」房租吗？

collocations: cover someone's share for a week

words.enDefinition: provide enough money to pay for the accommodation

examples.en: My research stipend is just enough to cover the rent this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期我的科研津贴刚好够「付房租」。

examples.en: Dad offered to cover the rent until my summer job finally starts.
examples.zh: 爸爸说暑期工作开始前，他可以先帮我「付房租」。

collocations: earn enough to cover the rent

words.enDefinition: material between tiles that has split and left gaps

examples.en: The contractor found cracked grout along the base of the tiled wall in our bathroom.
examples.zh: 承包商在我们浴室瓷砖墙的底部发现了「开裂的瓷砖填缝剂」。

examples.en: I sent a close-up photo of the cracked grout because water had collected below it.
examples.zh: 因为下方有积水，我发了一张「开裂的瓷砖填缝剂」的特写照片。

words.enDefinition: a pane of window glass with a visible split

examples.en: I attached a photo of the cracked windowpane to the message about last night's storm.
examples.zh: 我在那条关于昨晚暴风雨的消息里附了一张「开裂的窗玻璃」照片。

examples.en: The contractor measured the cracked windowpane before ordering a replacement for our study room.
examples.zh: 承包商先测量了「开裂的窗玻璃」，才给自习室订新玻璃。

words.enDefinition: money in an account available to offset new charges

examples.en: My account shows a credit balance after I accidentally paid rent twice.
examples.zh: 我不小心交了两次房租，账户上就有了「抵扣余额」。

examples.en: Can I use the credit balance toward the rent due next month?
examples.zh: 我能用这笔「账户抵扣余额」抵下个月的房租吗？

words.enDefinition: an extra charge for paying by credit card

examples.en: I used a check instead to avoid the credit card surcharge on rent.
examples.zh: 为省下交租的「信用卡附加费」，我改用支票付了。

examples.en: The portal shows the credit card surcharge before you confirm the payment.
examples.zh: 平台会在你确认付款前显示「信用卡附加费」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for checking someone's record of borrowing and repayment

examples.en: The leasing office explained the credit check fee before asking for permission to check my history.
examples.zh: 租赁办公室先说明了「信用核查费」，才请我授权查询信用记录。

examples.en: The manager waived the credit check fee after I supplied a recent report from my bank.
examples.zh: 我给物业经理看了一份近期的银行报告，之后对方免了「信用核查费」。

words.enDefinition: money already credited that can reduce an upcoming rent payment

examples.en: The landlord offered a credit toward rent for the days without hot water.
examples.zh: 没有热水的那几天，房东给了一笔「可抵扣房租的款项」。

examples.en: My account shows a credit toward rent from an overpayment last month.
examples.zh: 账户上显示一笔「可抵扣房租的款项」，是上个月多交的钱。

words.enDefinition: a narrow attachment for vacuuming small spaces and gaps

examples.en: My flatmate used the crevice tool to reach the gap beside the fridge.
examples.zh: 室友用「吸尘器缝隙吸嘴」清理了冰箱旁边的缝。

examples.en: I found the missing crevice tool in the box of spare attachments under our sink.
examples.zh: 我在水槽下放备用配件的盒子里，找到了先前找不到的「吸尘器缝隙吸嘴」。

collocations: use the crevice tool around the edges

words.enDefinition: a measure of reported crimes in an area over time

examples.en: The crime rate varied across the areas where my classmates were looking for a flat.
examples.zh: 我同学找房的几个区域，「犯罪率」各不相同。

examples.en: A low crime rate matters more to my parents than a gym in the building.
examples.zh: 比起楼里的健身房，我父母更看重「犯罪率」低。

words.enDefinition: a refrigerator drawer designed to keep produce fresh

examples.en: I put the lettuce in the crisper drawer to keep it from going limp.
examples.zh: 我把生菜放进「蔬果保鲜抽屉」，免得叶子蔫了。

examples.en: My roommates keep fruit separate from vegetables by using a different crisper drawer in the fridge.
examples.zh: 室友用不同的「蔬果保鲜抽屉」把冰箱里的水果和蔬菜分开放。

collocations: store lettuce in the crisper drawer

words.enDefinition: delivery to the roadside outside an address rather than indoors

examples.en: I chose curbside delivery and asked my flatmate to help move the boxes upstairs.
examples.zh: 我选了「路边交货」，请室友帮我把箱子搬上楼。

examples.en: Curbside delivery was cheaper, but I had to move the table myself.
examples.zh: 「路边交货」比较便宜，不过桌子得我自己搬进来。

words.enDefinition: a service that collects recyclables left by the road

examples.en: The leaflet explained which plastics our town accepts for curbside recycling each week.
examples.zh: 宣传单讲了镇上的「路边回收」每周收哪些塑料。

examples.en: We used curbside recycling for the empty boxes after unpacking over the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末拆完箱后，我们把空箱子交给了「路边回收」。

words.enDefinition: the time allowed to correct a reported contract violation

examples.en: The notice describes a cure period for removing my belongings from the common hallway.
examples.zh: 通知写明了「违约整改期限」，要求我在期限内把东西从公共走廊清走。

examples.en: I asked the adviser when the cure period began because I was away that week.
examples.zh: 那周我不在，就问顾问「违约整改期限」从什么时候开始算。

words.enDefinition: the person living in the unit right now

examples.en: I asked the current tenant whether the heating actually works in January.
examples.zh: 我问了「现任租客」，一月份暖气到底够不够热。

examples.en: The current tenant is moving out early, so the unit was still furnished at the viewing.
examples.zh: 「现任租客」要提前搬走，所以看房时家具还在。

collocations: ask the current tenant about the landlord

words.enDefinition: a bar across a window that holds curtains up

examples.en: I measured the curtain rod before ordering curtains for my new bedroom.
examples.zh: 给新卧室订窗帘之前，我量了「窗帘杆」的长度。

examples.en: The curtain rod was already there, so I just bought two panels.
examples.zh: 原来就有「窗帘杆」，所以我只买了两片帘布。

collocations: hang curtains from a curtain rod

words.enDefinition: a removable fabric case covering a cushion

examples.en: I slipped the cushion cover off after someone spilled coffee on the sofa.
examples.zh: 有人把咖啡洒在沙发上，我就把「靠垫套」拆了下来。

examples.en: This cushion cover fits the old insert, so I didn't buy a new one.
examples.zh: 这个「靠垫套」的尺寸适合旧靠垫芯，所以我没再买新的。

words.enDefinition: a plan in which the provider holds tenants' deposits in its own account

examples.en: Under the custodial scheme, the scheme provider holds the money until we move out.
examples.zh: 采用「托管式押金保障」后，押金由计划运营方保管到我们退租。

examples.en: The agent prefers a custodial scheme because the office never has to hold our money.
examples.zh: 中介更倾向用「托管式押金保障」，因为他们办公室不用经手我们的钱。

words.enDefinition: a removable dishwasher container for forks, knives, and spoons

examples.en: I lifted the cutlery basket out of the dishwasher to put the spoons away.
examples.zh: 我把「餐具篮」从洗碗机提出来，好把勺子收好。

examples.en: We use the cutlery basket for forks and keep long utensils on a separate shelf.
examples.zh: 我们把叉子放进「餐具篮」，长柄餐具则放另一层。

words.enDefinition: a shallow dishwasher shelf that holds utensils lying flat

examples.en: The new dishwasher has a cutlery tray instead of a basket in the lower rack.
examples.zh: 新洗碗机用的是「餐具平托盘」，不是放在下层的餐具篮。

examples.en: We put large spoons on the cutlery tray so they wouldn't fall through the rack.
examples.zh: 我们把大勺子放在「餐具平托盘」上，免得从架子的缝里掉下去。

words.enDefinition: an examination of harm and its likely repair cost

examples.en: The manager completed a damage assessment before deciding how much to deduct from the deposit.
examples.zh: 物业经理先做了「损坏评估」，再决定要从押金里扣多少。

examples.en: We asked to see the damage assessment because the work appeared more extensive than necessary.
examples.zh: 维修范围看起来超出了实际需要，所以我们要求查看「损坏评估」。

words.enDefinition: money billed for harm to rented property or furnishings

examples.en: The damage charge was for a cracked shelf that we'd photographed on our first day.
examples.zh: 这笔「损坏赔偿费」针对的是一块裂开的搁板，我们入住第一天就拍过照。

examples.en: The landlord removed the damage charge when the worker confirmed that the damage was already there.
examples.zh: 维修人员证实损坏早就存在，房东取消了「损坏赔偿费」。

words.enDefinition: an agreement limiting what someone pays for certain damage

examples.en: I read the damage waiver carefully because it covered only a few types of accidental damage.
examples.zh: 我仔细读了「损坏赔偿豁免」，因为它只涵盖几种意外损坏。

examples.en: The damage waiver excluded missing furniture, so we checked every item before moving out.
examples.zh: 「损坏赔偿豁免」不涵盖家具丢失，所以搬走前我们逐件核对了家具。

collocations: the scope of a damage waiver

words.enDefinition: a damaged rail supporting the movement of a drawer

examples.en: The drawer tilted because a damaged drawer runner no longer held one side in place.
examples.zh: 抽屉歪了，因为一侧「受损的抽屉滑轨」固定不住了。

examples.en: I showed the contractor the damaged drawer runner while he was checking the cupboards.
examples.zh: 承包商检查橱柜时，我让他看了「受损的抽屉滑轨」。

collocations: a drawer with a damaged drawer runner

words.enDefinition: a plaster wall covering that has deteriorated or broken

examples.en: The office asked me to move my desk away from the damaged plaster before the visit.
examples.zh: 办公室让我在维修人员来之前，把书桌搬离「受损的灰泥层」。

examples.en: The contractor removed the damaged plaster after checking what was behind the affected patch.
examples.zh: 承包商查看受影响区域的内部后，拆除了「受损的灰泥层」。

words.enDefinition: sealing material that no longer blocks gaps effectively

examples.en: I reported the damaged sealant around the bath after seeing water collect along the wall.
examples.zh: 看到水沿着墙角积起来，我就报修了浴缸边「破损的密封胶」。

examples.en: The damaged sealant was visible once the contractor lifted the edge of the loose trim.
examples.zh: 承包商掀开松动装饰条的一边，就看见了「破损的密封胶」。

words.enDefinition: a limit on how much internet data a customer can use

examples.en: The provider warned us that we were approaching the data cap for this month.
examples.zh: 供应商提醒我们，快达到这个月的「数据用量上限」了。

examples.en: We asked if the plan had a data cap before signing up online.
examples.zh: 网上办理之前，我们先问了这个套餐有没有「数据用量上限」。

words.enDefinition: the date on which a person signs a document

examples.en: The date of signature is on the final page, next to the name of the landlord.
examples.zh: 「签署日期」在最后一页，紧挨着房东的姓名。

examples.en: I entered the date of signature after the portal prompted me to confirm my details.
examples.zh: 门户网站提示我确认信息后，我填了「签署日期」。

words.enDefinition: a photograph with the date visibly printed on the image

examples.en: I attached a date-stamped photo to show that the ceiling was still leaking on Friday.
examples.zh: 我附了一张「带日期水印的照片」，证明星期五天花板还在漏水。

examples.en: The manager asked for a date-stamped photo of the damaged door after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，物业经理要了一张受损门的「带日期水印的照片」。

words.enDefinition: images that show when they were taken or created

examples.en: I sent dated photos showing that the stain was already visible on move-in day.
examples.zh: 我发去了「注明日期的照片」，可以看出入住当天污渍就已存在。

examples.en: The dated photos showed that the missing stool had been removed before we moved in.
examples.zh: 「注明日期的照片」显示，那把找不到的凳子在我们入住前就被搬走了。

words.enDefinition: a bed designed to double as seating during the day

examples.en: We put a daybed in the living room for guests who stay over.
examples.zh: 我们在客厅放了张「两用坐卧床」，方便客人留宿。

examples.en: I use the daybed as a sofa when friends come around after class.
examples.zh: 朋友下课过来时，我把「两用坐卧床」当沙发用。

collocations: use a daybed as a sofa

words.enDefinition: subtract a charge from money held as security

examples.en: These are the only costs the manager says she can deduct from the deposit this month.
examples.zh: 物业经理说，她这个月只会把这几笔费用「从押金扣除」。

examples.en: Please show me each repair cost you intend to deduct from the deposit before issuing the refund.
examples.zh: 退款之前，请列明每笔打算「从押金扣除」的维修费用。
