collocations: an amount to deduct from the deposit
the right to deduct from the deposit
claim an amount to deduct from the deposit

words.enDefinition: a formal deed recording an agreement to end a tenancy

examples.en: The housing clinic explained the deed of surrender before I signed it with my landlord.
examples.zh: 我和房东在「租约退租契据」上签字前，住房咨询点给我解释了这份文件。

examples.en: We both kept a copy of the deed of surrender in case questions came up later.
examples.zh: 我们双方都保存了一份「租约退租契据」，以免以后有疑问。

collocations: keep a copy of the deed of surrender

words.enDefinition: thorough cleaning that goes beyond everyday tidying and washing

examples.en: My roommates chipped in for deep cleaning because we'd all cooked in the kitchen daily.
examples.zh: 我们每天都在厨房做饭，所以大家凑钱做了一次「深度清洁」。

examples.en: The quote for deep cleaning included the oven, the blinds, and the grout around the shower.
examples.zh: 「深度清洁」报价包括烤箱、百叶窗和淋浴间四周的瓷砖缝。

words.enDefinition: a mode for thawing frozen food before cooking

examples.en: Our microwave has a defrost setting that I use for the fruit I freeze.
examples.zh: 我们这台微波炉有「解冻档」，我会用来解冻自己冻的水果。

examples.en: I looked for the defrost setting because the bag of frozen berries had stuck together.
examples.zh: 那袋冻浆果粘成了一块，我就找了一下「解冻档」。

words.enDefinition: a machine that removes excess moisture from indoor air

examples.en: We used a dehumidifier in the room where our laundry was drying indoors.
examples.zh: 在室内晾衣服的那个房间里，我们用了「除湿机」。

examples.en: The landlord lent us a dehumidifier after noticing damp air in the basement flat.
examples.zh: 房东发现地下室公寓空气潮湿，就借给我们一台「除湿机」。

words.enDefinition: a feature that starts a machine after a set delay

examples.en: Am I reading this right, or did I accidentally set a delayed start for tomorrow?
examples.zh: 我没看错吧，还是我不小心设成了明天「延时启动」？

examples.en: I use the delayed start feature so the dishwasher doesn't run during our weekly house meeting.
examples.zh: 我用「延时启动」功能，这样每周室友开会时洗碗机就不会运行。

words.enDefinition: a mesh bag that protects delicate items during machine washing

examples.en: I put my thin scarf in a delicates bag before starting the gentle wash.
examples.zh: 启动轻柔洗之前，我把薄围巾放进了「细软衣物洗护袋」。

examples.en: My roommate keeps a delicates bag next to the washer for her delicate clothes.
examples.zh: 室友在洗衣机旁边放了个「细软衣物洗护袋」，专门用来装不好直接机洗的衣服。

collocations: put lace in a delicates bag

words.enDefinition: a specific time period assigned for a delivery

examples.en: I chose a delivery slot that starts after my last lecture on Friday.
examples.zh: 我选的「预约送货时段」从周五最后一节课之后开始。

examples.en: We lost our delivery slot when the checkout page froze just before payment.
examples.zh: 付款前结账页面卡住了，我们选的「预约送货时段」就没保住。

words.enDefinition: a range of times during which a delivery may arrive

examples.en: I picked an afternoon delivery window because I had a morning tutorial on campus.
examples.zh: 早上要到学校上辅导课，我就选了下午的「送达时间段」。

examples.en: We planned lunch around the delivery window for the boxes from our old flat.
examples.zh: 我们根据旧公寓那批箱子的「送达时间段」安排午饭。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount that can be required upfront as security

examples.en: We asked the housing office whether the deposit cap applies to our furnished student flat.
examples.zh: 我们问了学校住房办公室，这套带家具的学生公寓是否也受「押金上限」约束。

examples.en: The agent reduced the amount after we pointed out the deposit cap for this property.
examples.zh: 我们指出这套房适用的「押金上限」后，中介调低了金额。

words.enDefinition: the amount one person puts towards a shared deposit

examples.en: I asked for my deposit contribution back after another student moved into my old room.
examples.zh: 另一名学生搬进我原来的房间后，我要求退还我「分摊的押金」。

examples.en: We wrote down each deposit contribution so there would be no confusion when we moved out.
examples.zh: 我们记清每个人「分摊的押金」，免得退租时说不清。

words.enDefinition: an amount subtracted from a tenant's security money

examples.en: The only deposit deduction we accepted was the cost of replacing the missing house key.
examples.zh: 我们只同意一笔「押金扣款」，用于补配丢失的房门钥匙。

examples.en: I asked the agency to justify the deposit deduction for the mark on the counter.
examples.zh: 我请中介说明，台面上的痕迹为什么会产生这笔「押金扣款」。

words.enDefinition: a disagreement about who should receive held security money

examples.en: The housing adviser helped us prepare for a deposit dispute about the cost of repainting.
examples.zh: 住房顾问帮我们为重刷费用引发的「押金争议」做了准备。

examples.en: We negotiated directly with the landlord before asking the scheme to handle the deposit dispute.
examples.zh: 我们先直接与房东协商，再请押金保障计划运营方处理这起「押金争议」。

words.enDefinition: a third party's promise to cover a potential claim

examples.en: My university offered a deposit guarantee that the landlord could accept instead of upfront cash.
examples.zh: 学校提供了一种「租房押金担保」，房东可以用它代替先收现金。

examples.en: The landlord liked the deposit guarantee but asked who would handle a claim about damage.
examples.zh: 房东觉得「租房押金担保」不错，但想知道房屋受损时由谁处理索赔。

words.enDefinition: one of several payments making up a total deposit

examples.en: I paid the first deposit installment when I signed and scheduled the second for next month.
examples.zh: 我签约时交了「分期支付的第一笔押金」，把第二笔安排在下个月。

examples.en: The agent sent a reminder about the next deposit installment three days before it was due.
examples.zh: 下一笔「分期支付的押金」到期前三天，中介发来了提醒。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement that safeguards tenants' deposits and helps resolve disputes

examples.en: Our landlord emailed the name of the deposit protection scheme and explained how to check registration.
examples.zh: 房东发邮件告知了「押金保障计划」的名称，还说明怎么查登记。

examples.en: I contacted the deposit protection scheme after the agent stopped answering questions about our deposit.
examples.zh: 中介不再回答押金问题后，我联系了「押金保障计划」的运营方。

collocations: register with a deposit protection scheme

words.enDefinition: a document confirming that rental security money was received

examples.en: I asked the agent to send a deposit receipt showing the amount paid by each roommate.
examples.zh: 我请中介开一份「押金收据」，写明每位室友分别交了多少。

examples.en: The manager couldn't find our payment until I showed her the deposit receipt from August.
examples.zh: 我把八月份的「押金收据」给物业经理看，她才找到那笔付款。

words.enDefinition: the worth of an item after allowing for age and use

examples.en: We offered to pay the depreciated value of the worn desk rather than its original price.
examples.zh: 我们提出按这张旧书桌的「折旧后价值」赔偿，而不按它的原价赔。

examples.en: The final statement used the depreciated value of the broken appliance to calculate what we owed.
examples.zh: 最终账单按照损坏电器的「折旧后价值」计算了我们应付的金额。

words.enDefinition: to explain what is wrong with something

examples.en: The form asked me to describe the issue and explain when it first started.
examples.zh: 表单要求我「描述问题」，并说明问题第一次是什么时候出现的。

examples.en: I tried to describe the issue over the phone because the portal would not load.
examples.zh: 门户网站加载不出来，我试着在电话里「描述问题」。

words.enDefinition: a particular parking spot assigned to a person or purpose

examples.en: Our designated parking space was too far from the entrance for unloading the van.
examples.zh: 我们的「指定停车位」离入口太远，不方便从货车上卸东西。

examples.en: Someone parked in my designated parking space while I was away for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我周末外出时，有人把车停在了我的「指定停车位」上。

collocations: park in a designated parking space

words.enDefinition: a container with sections for small items on a desk

examples.en: I put a desk organizer by my laptop for pencils and sticky notes.
examples.zh: 我在笔记本电脑旁放了个「桌面收纳盒」，装铅笔和便利贴。

examples.en: The desk organizer has a narrow slot that fits my calculator perfectly.
examples.zh: 「桌面收纳盒」有个窄槽，我的计算器放进去正合适。

collocations: sort pens into a desk organizer

words.enDefinition: a compartment that releases detergent during an appliance cycle

examples.en: I checked that the detergent dispenser had closed before starting the dishwasher after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后启动洗碗机前，我确认了「洗涤剂投放盒」已经扣好。

examples.en: My roommate couldn't find the detergent dispenser on the inside of the new dishwasher door.
examples.zh: 室友在新洗碗机的门内侧没找到「洗涤剂投放盒」。

words.enDefinition: a sliding tray that feeds detergent into a washing machine

examples.en: The instructions show which part of the detergent drawer is for the main wash.
examples.zh: 说明书上标明了「洗衣液抽屉盒」哪个格子用于主洗。

examples.en: My roommate showed me the detergent drawer because I'd never used this model before.
examples.zh: 我以前没用过这种型号，室友指给我看了「洗衣液抽屉盒」在哪里。

collocations: the main compartment of the detergent drawer

words.enDefinition: one small packet of detergent that dissolves in water

examples.en: My flatmate offered me a detergent pod because I'd run out of laundry liquid.
examples.zh: 我的洗衣液用完了，室友给了我一颗「洗衣凝珠」。

examples.en: I keep one detergent pod in my laundry tote when I go downstairs to wash clothes.
examples.zh: 下楼洗衣服时，我会在装衣服的袋子里放一颗「洗衣凝珠」。

words.enDefinition: a visit intended to determine the cause of a problem

examples.en: We arranged a diagnostic visit because photographs alone did not explain why the door kept sticking.
examples.zh: 光看照片解释不了门为什么总卡住，我们安排了「上门排查」。

examples.en: The first diagnostic visit helped the contractor decide what equipment to bring the following day.
examples.zh: 第一次「上门排查」帮助承包商确定了第二天要带什么设备。

words.enDefinition: an electronic signature used to sign a digital document such as a lease

examples.en: The specialist verified the landlord's digital signature before releasing the lease to my university housing adviser.
examples.zh: 把租约发给我的学校住房顾问前，工作人员核验了房东的「电子签名」。

examples.en: The portal let me verify the digital signature on the landlord's copy of the lease.
examples.zh: 我在门户网站上核验了房东那份租约上的「电子签名」。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement letting an organization pull funds from an account

examples.en: I set up a direct debit so the housing office can collect rent automatically.
examples.zh: 我办了「授权自动扣款」，住宿办公室就能自动收房租。

examples.en: The direct debit came out earlier than I expected after the long weekend.
examples.zh: 长周末之后，这笔「授权扣款」比我预想的早。

words.enDefinition: a screen that collects food particles inside a dishwasher

examples.en: The instructions show where to find the dishwasher filter in our particular model.
examples.zh: 说明书画出了我们这个型号的「洗碗机滤网」在哪里。

examples.en: I noted a little food residue in the dishwasher filter after unloading the dishes.
examples.zh: 取出餐具后，我发现「洗碗机滤网」里有少量食物残渣。

words.enDefinition: coarse salt used to recharge a dishwasher's water softener

examples.en: The manual calls for dishwasher salt because our model has a built-in water softener.
examples.zh: 说明书上说要用「洗碗机专用盐」，因为我们这款内置软水器。

examples.en: I wrote dishwasher salt on the shopping list next to sponges and washing-up liquid.
examples.zh: 我在购物清单上写了「洗碗机专用盐」，就在海绵和洗洁精旁边。

words.enDefinition: a solid portion of detergent made for a dishwasher

examples.en: I found one dishwasher tablet left in the box under our kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 我发现厨房水槽下面的盒子里只剩一块「洗碗机清洁块」。

examples.en: My flatmate added a dishwasher tablet before running the machine after our dinner party.
examples.zh: 聚餐结束后，室友放了一块「洗碗机清洁块」才开机。

words.enDefinition: to send a technician to a place needing service

examples.en: The front desk offered to dispatch a technician after I reported that the door would not lock.
examples.zh: 我报告门锁不上后，前台表示可以「派出技术员」。

examples.en: The manager can dispatch a technician when a leak threatens another apartment in the building.
examples.zh: 漏水可能殃及同楼其他公寓时，物业经理可以「派出技术员」。

collocations: dispatch a technician to the property

words.enDefinition: formally question whether an amount billed is correct

examples.en: I had to dispute a charge after the portal billed me twice.
examples.zh: 平台扣了我两次钱，我只能「对这笔收费提出异议」。

examples.en: You can dispute a charge by emailing the office with your transfer receipt.
examples.zh: 你可以把转账收据发给办公室，「对收费提出异议」。

collocations: dispute a charge on the portal
a deadline to dispute a charge

words.enDefinition: an amount billed that the person paying challenges

examples.en: The manager put the disputed charge on hold while she checked our dated photos.
examples.zh: 物业经理核对我们带日期的照片期间，暂缓收取这笔「有争议的收费」。

examples.en: We kept a copy of the bill with the disputed charge circled in red.
examples.zh: 我们留了一份账单副本，用红笔圈出了「有争议的收费」。

words.enDefinition: heat supplied to several buildings from a shared central system

examples.en: The housing team told us our hall gets its heat from district heating.
examples.zh: 住宿团队说，我们宿舍楼的热量来自「区域供暖」。

examples.en: District heating serves several blocks, so we don't have a boiler in our flat.
examples.zh: 「区域供暖」覆盖好几座楼，所以我们公寓里没有锅炉。

words.enDefinition: give usable furniture to a charity or community group

examples.en: We plan to donate furniture we cannot take home at the end of term.
examples.zh: 我们打算把学期末带不回家的家具「捐出去」。

examples.en: You can donate furniture to the student reuse scheme near the library.
examples.zh: 你可以把家具「捐给」图书馆附近的学生循环利用项目。

words.enDefinition: a place where people can leave items for donation

examples.en: The donation drop-off point on campus filled up quickly during the last week.
examples.zh: 最后一周，学校的「捐赠物品投放点」很快就满了。

examples.en: I checked which items the donation drop-off point would accept before carrying everything over.
examples.zh: 把东西全搬过去之前，我先确认了「捐赠物品投放点」收哪些东西。

words.enDefinition: the unobstructed space available through an open doorway

examples.en: We checked the door clearance before buying the sofa from our neighbors.
examples.zh: 从邻居那儿买沙发之前，我们确认了「门洞净空」。

examples.en: I sent the driver the door clearance so he could check the measurements.
examples.zh: 我把「门洞净空」发给司机，好让他核对尺寸。

words.enDefinition: a flexible strip that seals the edges of an appliance door

examples.en: The landlord checked the door gasket when we noticed that the fridge door didn't close tightly.
examples.zh: 我们发现冰箱门关不严，房东检查了「门封条」。

examples.en: I pointed out the loose door gasket while showing the landlord around our kitchen.
examples.zh: 带房东看我们厨房时，我指出了松动的「门封条」。

words.enDefinition: a door closes but its catch fails to engage

examples.en: The door won't latch unless I pull it hard toward me from the hallway.
examples.zh: 我站在走廊里不用力往自己这边拉的话，「门闩就扣不上」。

examples.en: Our front door won't latch after the frame gets wet during a heavy storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨把门框淋湿之后，我们的「大门门闩就扣不上」。

collocations: the door won't latch after closing
the door won't latch from outside

words.enDefinition: a short round peg that aligns two pieces before joining

examples.en: The first dowel pin goes into the small hole beside the screw.
examples.zh: 第一根「定位销」要插进螺丝旁边那个小孔里。

examples.en: A dowel pin rolled under the bed while we were building the bookcase.
examples.zh: 我们装书架时，一根「定位销」滚到了床底下。

words.enDefinition: the rate at which data arrives over an internet connection

examples.en: Our download speed drops when everyone in the building gets home from class.
examples.zh: 楼里的人都下课回来时，我们的「下载速度」会变慢。

examples.en: I ran a test to check the download speed before contacting the broadband provider.
examples.zh: 联系宽带供应商之前，我先测了一下「下载速度」。

words.enDefinition: a proposed rental contract that can still be changed

examples.en: My roommate caught an error in our names when she read the draft lease.
examples.zh: 室友看「租约草案」的时候发现我们的名字写错了。

examples.en: Could you send me the draft lease before I commit to taking the room?
examples.zh: 我决定租下这个房间前，你能先把「租约草案」发给我吗？

words.enDefinition: work that stops unwanted air entering through gaps

examples.en: The landlord agreed to pay for draft-proofing after noticing cold air around both bedroom windows.
examples.zh: 房东发现两扇卧室窗户周围都有冷风吹进来，就同意出钱做「门窗缝防漏风处理」。

examples.en: We felt a noticeable difference after the contractor completed draft-proofing around both bedroom windows.
examples.zh: 承包商给两扇卧室窗户做完「门窗缝防漏风处理」后，我们明显感到了变化。

words.enDefinition: pieces that separate a drawer into smaller compartments

examples.en: The drawer dividers keep my socks separate from the rest of my clothes.
examples.zh: 「抽屉分隔板」让我能把袜子和其他衣服分开放。

examples.en: I cut the drawer dividers to fit the narrow top drawer properly.
examples.zh: 我把「抽屉分隔板」裁短，正好装进最上面那个窄抽屉。

words.enDefinition: an appliance that brews coffee by dripping water through grounds

examples.en: Our drip coffee maker makes enough coffee for all three roommates before we leave for campus.
examples.zh: 「滴滤咖啡机」能在我们去学校前煮出够三个室友喝的咖啡。

examples.en: I bought a used drip coffee maker because the one in the kitchen belonged to my roommate.
examples.zh: 厨房那台是室友的，于是我买了一台二手「滴滤咖啡机」。

collocations: a filter for a drip coffee maker

words.enDefinition: to visit someone without telling them in advance

examples.en: Our neighbours asked us to text first rather than drop by unannounced after dinner.
examples.zh: 邻居请我们晚饭后拜访前先发短信，别「不打招呼就登门」。

examples.en: I don't want to drop by unannounced while she's studying for her final exams.
examples.zh: 她在复习期末考试，我不想「不打招呼就登门」。

collocations: decide not to drop by unannounced
ask before you drop by unannounced

words.enDefinition: a table with hinged sides that fold down to save space

examples.en: We use a drop-leaf table because our kitchen has very little room.
examples.zh: 厨房很窄，所以我们用的是「折板桌」。

examples.en: We open the drop-leaf table when friends come over for Sunday lunch.
examples.zh: 朋友周日来吃午饭时，我们会展开「折板桌」。

collocations: open both sides of a drop-leaf table

words.enDefinition: reusable balls placed with laundry to separate items while drying

examples.en: We use dryer balls so the towels don't bunch together in the shared machine.
examples.zh: 我们用「烘干球」，让毛巾在公用烘干机里不至于结成一团。

examples.en: My flatmate keeps a pair of dryer balls in the basket next to the dryer.
examples.zh: 室友在烘干机旁边的篮子里放了两个「烘干球」。

words.enDefinition: a program stage that removes moisture from washed items

examples.en: The glasses were still damp because we opened the door before the drying cycle ended.
examples.zh: 杯子还是湿的，因为「烘干程序」还没结束我们就开了门。

examples.en: Our dishwasher has a quiet drying cycle that runs after the last rinse.
examples.zh: 我们家的洗碗机有个很安静的「烘干程序」，在最后一次漂洗后启动。

words.enDefinition: a pricing plan that covers gas and electricity from one supplier

examples.en: The dual fuel tariff gave us a single statement for gas and electricity.
examples.zh: 用了「燃气电力合并计费」，燃气和用电就只出一张账单。

examples.en: We checked whether the dual fuel tariff was cheaper than buying each service separately.
examples.zh: 我们查了「燃气电力合并计费」是否比分开买两个服务更便宜。

collocations: sign up for a dual fuel tariff

words.enDefinition: a second bill or payment for the same expense

examples.en: I found a duplicate charge for cleaning after comparing the online bill with my receipt.
examples.zh: 我把网上账单和收据一对，发现清洁费被「重复扣费」了。

examples.en: The office corrected the duplicate charge and sent a new copy of the final statement.
examples.zh: 办公室更正了「重复扣费」，重新发来了一份最终账单。

words.enDefinition: the same amount being paid twice for one charge

examples.en: My flatmate spotted a duplicate payment when she checked our shared account.
examples.zh: 室友查我们的共同账户时，发现有一笔「重复付款」。

examples.en: Please contact the rent office if a duplicate payment appears on your statement.
examples.zh: 如果对账单上出现「重复付款」，请联系房租管理办公室。

words.enDefinition: a bag that holds debris picked up by a vacuum

examples.en: We bought the wrong dust bag because our vacuum has an older model number.
examples.zh: 我们的吸尘器型号老，买错了「集尘袋」。

examples.en: The landlord left an extra dust bag on the shelf with the vacuum manual.
examples.zh: 房东在放吸尘器说明书的架子上留了一个备用「集尘袋」。

words.enDefinition: a detachable container where a bagless vacuum collects dirt

examples.en: The dust cup was almost full after I vacuumed our living room rug.
examples.zh: 我吸完客厅地毯，「集尘杯」已经快满了。

examples.en: My roommate could see how much dust had collected in the clear dust cup.
examples.zh: 室友透过透明「集尘杯」看得见里面积了多少灰。

words.enDefinition: a Canadian bank transfer sent using an email address or mobile number

examples.en: My landlord in Toronto prefers an e-transfer to a check for rent.
examples.zh: 我在多伦多的房东更喜欢用「电子转账」收房租，胜过收支票。

examples.en: I sent an e-transfer to the email address listed on the rent notice.
examples.zh: 我用交租通知上写的电子邮箱地址发了一笔「电子转账」。

words.enDefinition: the first day the landlord allows you to move in

examples.en: The earliest move-in date is August 25, which suits my visa interview.
examples.zh: 「最早入住日期」是八月二十五号，正好赶在我办签证之后。

examples.en: Email the agent to ask whether the earliest move-in date can slip a week.
examples.zh: 发邮件问问中介，「最早入住日期」能不能往后推一周。

collocations: ask about the earliest move-in date

words.enDefinition: bringing an agreement to an end before its scheduled expiry

examples.en: I asked about early termination after receiving an offer to study abroad in January.
examples.zh: 我收到一月出国交换的录取通知后，询问了「提前终止」租约的事。

examples.en: Our housing adviser explained early termination before we decided whether to leave the flat in May.
examples.zh: 决定要不要五月搬离公寓前，住房顾问解释了「提前终止」租约的情况。

words.enDefinition: a fee charged for ending an agreement before its minimum term

examples.en: The broadband provider wanted an early termination fee when my exchange semester ended.
examples.zh: 我的交换学期结束时，宽带供应商要收「提前解约费」。

examples.en: Ask about the early termination fee before agreeing to a two-year broadband plan.
examples.zh: 同意办两年期宽带之前，先问清「提前解约费」。

words.enDefinition: an appliance setting designed to reduce energy or water use

examples.en: Our dishwasher takes longer in eco mode, but we don't need the dishes right away.
examples.zh: 我们家的洗碗机用「节能模式」会花更久，不过我们不急着用餐具。

examples.en: My flatmate showed me how to tell whether eco mode was selected on the display.
examples.zh: 室友教我看显示屏，确认有没有选中「节能模式」。

collocations: run the dishwasher in eco mode

words.enDefinition: a blanket with electrical elements that produce heat

examples.en: My sister gave me an electric blanket when I moved into a colder room.
examples.zh: 我搬进较冷的房间时，姐姐给了我一条「电热毯」。

examples.en: The shop showed me an electric blanket with separate settings for each side of the bed.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了一条「电热毯」，床的左右两边可以分别调节。

collocations: the controller for an electric blanket

words.enDefinition: a problem preventing part of an electrical system from working safely

examples.en: The building manager sent a qualified electrician to investigate the electrical fault in our corridor.
examples.zh: 物业经理派了有资质的电工，调查我们走廊里的「电气故障」。

examples.en: We reported the electrical fault when several lights stopped working at the same time.
examples.zh: 好几盏灯同时不亮了，我们就报告了「电气故障」。

words.enDefinition: a device measuring the electrical energy a property uses

examples.en: Our electricity meter is in a locked cupboard behind the stairs downstairs.
examples.zh: 我们的「电表」在楼下楼梯后面一个锁着的柜子里。

examples.en: Take a photo of the electricity meter when you move in next week.
examples.zh: 下周搬进来时，给「电表」拍张照。

words.enDefinition: digital proof that a payment was received

examples.en: The portal sent an electronic receipt as soon as my rent went through.
examples.zh: 房租一付成功，平台就发来了「电子收据」。

examples.en: I saved my electronic receipt in the folder with my other housing documents.
examples.zh: 我把「电子收据」放在了存其他住房文件的文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: money charged for booking exclusive elevator use during a move

examples.en: An elevator reservation fee appeared on our bill because we booked the service elevator for Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们预约了周六用货梯，所以账单上多了一笔「电梯预约费」。

examples.en: I asked about the elevator reservation fee before confirming the delivery date for my new desk.
examples.zh: 确定新书桌的送货日期前，我先问了「电梯预约费」。

words.enDefinition: temporary credit available when a prepaid meter runs low

examples.en: We used emergency credit until the shop where we top up opened again.
examples.zh: 充值点没开门前，我们先用了「应急用量额度」。

examples.en: The meter showed how much emergency credit was left after we switched on the heater.
examples.zh: 开暖气之后，表上显示还剩多少「应急用量额度」。

words.enDefinition: access to a property in an urgent situation

examples.en: The lease mentions emergency entry for situations such as a burst pipe in the apartment.
examples.zh: 租约提到，公寓水管爆裂之类的情况允许「紧急进入」。

examples.en: I asked who records an emergency entry when the tenant is away on a trip.
examples.zh: 我问租客外出旅行时，谁负责记录「紧急进入」的情况。

words.enDefinition: temporary help paying for housing during a financial crisis

examples.en: The student union helped me apply for emergency rental assistance on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 学生会帮我在星期二申请了「紧急租房援助」。

examples.en: Emergency rental assistance helped him stay housed while he waited for his first paycheck.
examples.zh: 第一次发工资前，「紧急租房援助」让他还能继续有地方住。

words.enDefinition: a sound indicating that an appliance program has finished

examples.en: I heard the end-of-cycle signal from upstairs and went down to get my laundry.
examples.zh: 我在楼上听到「程序结束提示音」，就下楼取洗好的衣服。

examples.en: The new dryer gives a softer end-of-cycle signal than the one in my old residence.
examples.zh: 新烘干机的「程序结束提示音」比我旧宿舍里那台轻柔。

words.enDefinition: cleaning done before handing a rented home back

examples.en: We scheduled end-of-tenancy cleaning for the morning after the last roommate moved out of the flat.
examples.zh: 我们安排在最后一位室友搬出后的那个上午做「退租清洁」。

examples.en: My friend shared a checklist for end-of-tenancy cleaning before I picked up supplies from the shop.
examples.zh: 我去商店买清洁用品之前，朋友发给我一份「退租清洁」清单。

words.enDefinition: a small table placed beside the end of a sofa

examples.en: There is an end table where you can set your cup of tea.
examples.zh: 旁边有个「沙发边几」，你的茶杯可以放上面。

examples.en: I bought a secondhand end table for the corner beside our sofa.
examples.zh: 我买了个二手「沙发边几」，放在我们沙发旁的角落。

collocations: set a drink on the end table
an end table beside the sofa

words.enDefinition: to bring the rental arrangement to an end

examples.en: We asked the adviser how to end the tenancy before moving into university housing.
examples.zh: 搬进学校宿舍前，我们问顾问怎么「结束租赁关系」。

examples.en: My landlord agreed to end the tenancy once I had returned both sets of keys.
examples.zh: 房东同意，在我交还两套钥匙后「结束租赁关系」。

collocations: move out and end the tenancy

words.enDefinition: a statement for household electricity or gas charges

examples.en: I opened the energy bill while we were discussing the flat's winter budget.
examples.zh: 我们在商量公寓冬季开销时，我打开了「能源账单」。

examples.en: The energy bill went down once all three of us turned off unused heaters.
examples.zh: 我们三个都关掉闲置暖气之后，「能源账单」的金额降了。

words.enDefinition: the amount of energy used over a period

examples.en: Our energy consumption fell after we stopped heating the rooms nobody used.
examples.zh: 不用的房间不再供暖之后，我们的「能耗」降了。

examples.en: I checked our energy consumption before deciding whether to change electricity plans.
examples.zh: 决定要不要换用电套餐之前，我先查了我们的「能耗」。

words.enDefinition: a score showing how efficiently a building or device uses energy

examples.en: The flat's energy efficiency rating helped us compare likely winter costs before signing.
examples.zh: 签约前，我们用公寓的「能效等级」比较了冬天可能的开销。

examples.en: I asked for the energy efficiency rating because the rooms felt cold even in September.
examples.zh: 才九月房间就觉得冷，所以我问了「能效等级」。

words.enDefinition: a payment or discount that offsets the cost of an eligible energy-saving purchase or upgrade

examples.en: The landlord checked whether the new water heater qualified for an energy-efficiency rebate from the utility.
examples.zh: 房东查看新热水器是否符合公用事业公司的「节能返款」条件。

examples.en: The utility asked for a receipt before processing our energy-efficiency rebate for the replacement appliance.
examples.zh: 公用事业公司先要求我们出示收据，再办理更换电器的「节能返款」。

words.enDefinition: a document recording how efficiently a property uses energy

examples.en: The landlord sent the energy performance certificate with the information pack before our viewing.
examples.zh: 看房前，房东把「建筑能效证书」连同资料一起发给了我们。

examples.en: I compared the energy performance certificate for both flats before choosing the warmer one.
examples.zh: 我对比了两套公寓的「建筑能效证书」，最后选了更暖和的。

words.enDefinition: a company that sells electricity or gas to customers

examples.en: The energy supplier asked me to check the reading on the meter again.
examples.zh: 「能源供应商」让我再核对一遍表上的读数。

examples.en: Our new energy supplier sent the first bill to the wrong email address.
examples.zh: 我们新换的「能源供应商」把第一张账单发到了错误的邮箱。

words.enDefinition: the prices and terms used to charge for energy

examples.en: We asked if a different energy tariff would make our winter bills lower.
examples.zh: 我们问，换种「能源计费方案」能不能减少冬季账单。

examples.en: This energy tariff works well for students who are usually home during the day.
examples.zh: 这种「能源计费方案」很适合通常白天在家的学生。

words.enDefinition: a provision identifying the document as the complete agreement

examples.en: The adviser explained the entire agreement clause before I relied on something the agent had said.
examples.zh: 顾问先解释了「完整协议条款」，免得我轻信中介之前的口头说法。

examples.en: Our lease has an entire agreement clause, so we asked to include the promised bicycle storage.
examples.zh: 租约有「完整协议条款」，所以我们要求把承诺的自行车存放处写进去。

collocations: rely on the entire agreement clause

words.enDefinition: a buzzer visitors use to alert someone inside a building

examples.en: The entry buzzer rang just as I was putting my headphones on for class.
examples.zh: 我刚戴上耳机准备上课，「门禁呼叫铃」就响了。

examples.en: Tell the driver which entry buzzer to press when she gets to the building.
examples.zh: 告诉司机，到楼下该按哪个「门禁呼叫铃」。

words.enDefinition: a record showing who entered a property and when

examples.en: The manager checked the entry log when I asked whether anyone had been to my flat.
examples.zh: 我问有没有人来过我住的公寓，物业经理查了「出入记录」。

examples.en: I asked for the entry log because the contractor visited while everyone was at the library.
examples.zh: 承包商来时大家都在图书馆，我就要求查看「出入记录」。

collocations: record a visit in the entry log

words.enDefinition: an arrangement in which everyone pays the same amount

examples.en: We agreed to an equal split because our rooms were almost identical.
examples.zh: 我们的房间几乎一样，所以同意房租「平均分摊」。

examples.en: An equal split keeps the monthly payments simple for all three roommates.
examples.zh: 「平均分摊」让三个室友每月付钱都省事。

words.enDefinition: a chair designed to support the body during prolonged sitting

examples.en: I tried the ergonomic chair at the store before buying it online.
examples.zh: 我在店里试坐了这把「人体工学椅」，之后才在网上下单。

examples.en: My flatmate bought an ergonomic chair because she studies at home most days.
examples.zh: 室友大多数时候在家里学习，所以买了一把「人体工学椅」。

collocations: an ergonomic chair for a home office

words.enDefinition: an account holding funds until specified conditions are met

examples.en: Our agent uses an escrow account to keep tenants' deposits separate from ordinary rent payments.
examples.zh: 中介用「第三方托管账户」保管租客押金，让押金和日常租金分开。

examples.en: I asked which conditions would trigger a payment out of the escrow account after moving.
examples.zh: 我问，搬走后在什么条件下可以从「第三方托管账户」放款。

collocations: deposit money into an escrow account
release money from an escrow account

words.enDefinition: a bill calculated from predicted rather than measured usage

examples.en: The estimated bill was high because the flat had been empty all summer.
examples.zh: 「估算账单」金额偏高，因为那套公寓整个夏天都空着。

examples.en: If you receive an estimated bill, compare it with the number on your meter.
examples.zh: 如果收到「估算账单」，就拿它跟表上的读数核对一下。

words.enDefinition: a predicted meter value used when an actual reading is unavailable

examples.en: Once I sent a photo, the supplier removed the estimated meter reading from the bill.
examples.zh: 我传了照片以后，供应商从账单上撤掉了「估算的仪表读数」。

examples.en: Our estimated meter reading was much higher than what the dial actually showed.
examples.zh: 我们的「估算仪表读数」比表盘实际显示的高得多。

words.enDefinition: a device that cools air by evaporating water

examples.en: I saw an evaporative cooler in the shop but wasn't sure it suited our damp flat.
examples.zh: 我在店里看到一台「蒸发式冷风机」，但不确定它适不适合我们潮湿的公寓。

examples.en: Our old evaporative cooler was easy to move between the kitchen and the living room.
examples.zh: 我们原来那台「蒸发式冷风机」在厨房和客厅之间搬来搬去很方便。

collocations: an evaporative cooler with a water tank

words.enDefinition: a formal notice starting or warning of eviction

examples.en: I took the eviction notice to the campus housing office to ask what it meant.
examples.zh: 我把「驱逐通知」拿到学校住房办公室，询问具体是什么意思。

examples.en: The adviser explained the difference between an eviction notice and an order from a court.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「驱逐通知」和法院命令有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: an official decision requiring a tenant to leave

examples.en: I asked the legal clinic whether the document I received was actually an eviction order.
examples.zh: 我问法律咨询点，我收到的文件是不是真正的「强制迁出令」。

examples.en: The handbook explains which authority can issue an eviction order in the city where I study.
examples.zh: 手册说明了我上学的城市里，哪个机构可以签发「强制迁出令」。

words.enDefinition: a formal legal process seeking removal of a tenant

examples.en: The adviser explained what eviction proceedings might involve before my roommate spoke to the landlord.
examples.zh: 室友找房东沟通之前，顾问解释了「驱逐租客程序」里可能有哪些环节。

examples.en: I kept copies of our emails because the landlord had mentioned starting eviction proceedings.
examples.zh: 房东提到要启动「驱逐租客程序」，我就保存了我们的邮件副本。

words.enDefinition: the latest time allowed for submitting material that supports a case

examples.en: We put the evidence deadline in our shared calendar so neither roommate would miss it.
examples.zh: 我们把「举证截止日期」记在共享日历里，免得有室友错过。

examples.en: The office moved the evidence deadline after granting more time to obtain the repair invoice.
examples.zh: 办公室批准延长索取维修发票的时间，同时推迟了「举证截止日期」。

words.enDefinition: a collection of documents and other material supporting a case

examples.en: We added the dated photos and two invoices to our evidence pack before sending it.
examples.zh: 发出「证据材料包」之前，我们把注明日期的照片和两张发票放了进去。

examples.en: The housing adviser checked my evidence pack and suggested putting the emails in date order.
examples.zh: 住房顾问看了我的「证据材料包」，建议把邮件按日期排序。

words.enDefinition: an amount billed that is unreasonably large

examples.en: We called it an excessive charge after comparing the invoice with two quotes from local cleaners.
examples.zh: 对照本地两家清洁公司的报价和发票后，我们认为这是「过高收费」。

examples.en: My roommate asked how to challenge an excessive charge without delaying the rest of the refund.
examples.zh: 室友问，怎样对「过高收费」提出异议，又不耽误其余退款。

words.enDefinition: harm beyond the deterioration expected from ordinary use

examples.en: The landlord called the marks excessive damage, but our check-out report described them as minor.
examples.zh: 房东把这些痕迹称为「超出正常损耗的损坏」，但我们的退租报告记录的是轻微痕迹。

examples.en: We asked what counted as excessive damage before signing the form about the final deduction.
examples.zh: 签署最终扣款表之前，我们先问清哪些情况算「超出正常损耗的损坏」。

words.enDefinition: to give each other your telephone numbers

examples.en: My new flatmate suggested we exchange numbers in case either of us got locked out.
examples.zh: 新室友建议「互留电话号码」，以防谁被锁在门外。

examples.en: We can exchange numbers if you want updates about the delivery time tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果你想知道明天送货时间的变化，我们可以「互留电话号码」。

words.enDefinition: the right to occupy premises and exclude others

examples.en: The clinic explained exclusive possession when I asked whether my landlord could use my bedroom.
examples.zh: 我问房东能不能使用我的卧室，咨询点解释了「排他性占有权」。

examples.en: My agreement gives me exclusive possession of the bedroom while I share the kitchen.
examples.zh: 按合同，我对卧室有「排他性占有权」，厨房则和别人共用。

words.enDefinition: the date on which work is supposed to finish

examples.en: I asked for an expected completion date before deciding whether to stay with a friend.
examples.zh: 我问了「预计完工日期」，再决定要不要在朋友家住几天。

examples.en: The office changed the expected completion date after finding more damage under the floorboards.
examples.zh: 办公室发现地板下面还有损坏，就更改了「预计完工日期」。

words.enDefinition: a table that can be made longer when needed

examples.en: I found an extendable table that seats six when the extra leaf is in.
examples.zh: 我找到一张「可加长桌」，加上加长板之后可以坐六个人。

examples.en: The extendable table stays small until we need it for a group meal.
examples.zh: 平时「可加长桌」都收着，聚餐时才把它加长。

collocations: fit an extra leaf into an extendable table

words.enDefinition: an additional rinse selected after the regular wash stages

examples.en: My roommate selected extra rinse after noticing soap left on the towels last time.
examples.zh: 室友上次发现毛巾还有洗衣液残留，这次选了「额外漂洗」。

examples.en: The washer has an extra rinse option beside the temperature button on the display.
examples.zh: 这台洗衣机的显示面板上，温度按钮旁边有一个「额外漂洗」选项。

words.enDefinition: the section of a detergent tray for liquid softener

examples.en: The flower symbol marks the fabric softener compartment on the washer in the downstairs laundry.
examples.zh: 楼下洗衣房那台机器上，花朵图标标出了「柔顺剂专用槽」。

examples.en: I mistook the fabric softener compartment for the detergent slot the first time I used this washer.
examples.zh: 第一次用这台洗衣机时，我把「柔顺剂专用槽」误认成了洗衣液槽。

collocations: the fabric softener compartment in the drawer

words.enDefinition: an impostor who pretends to own the rental

examples.en: A fake landlord cannot meet you at the address because the flat is not his.
examples.zh: 「假房东」没法带你去房子那里，因为房子根本不是他的。

examples.en: The fake landlord claimed to be abroad and pushed for a wire transfer.
examples.zh: 「假房东」谎称人在国外，催我马上电汇。

words.enDefinition: a rental ad posted by someone dishonest

examples.en: The price seemed impossible, and it turned out to be a fake listing.
examples.zh: 那个价格低得离谱，结果是一条「虚假房源」。

examples.en: A fake listing usually asks you to send money before you see the room.
examples.zh: 「虚假房源」通常会让你在没看房之前就先转账。

words.enDefinition: fail to keep up with regular payments for housing

examples.en: I could fall behind on rent if my work hours drop again.
examples.zh: 如果工时再减少，我可能会「拖欠房租」。

examples.en: People sometimes fall behind on rent when their scholarship payments arrive late.
examples.zh: 奖学金迟迟不到账，有人就会「拖欠房租」。

collocations: start to fall behind on rent
worry about falling behind on rent

words.enDefinition: an electric heater that blows warm air using a fan

examples.en: We borrowed a fan heater for the spare room during a spell of cold weather.
examples.zh: 天气冷的那段时间，我们给备用房间借了一台「暖风机」。

examples.en: The fan heater was louder than I'd expected, so I could hear it from the hallway.
examples.zh: 「暖风机」比我预想的响，在走廊上都听得见。

collocations: the controls on a fan heater

words.enDefinition: the rate at which a fan blows air

examples.en: We lowered the fan speed so we could hear the film from the sofa.
examples.zh: 我们调低了「风速档位」，这样在沙发上就能听清电影。

examples.en: The remote lets me change the fan speed without getting out of my chair.
examples.zh: 有了遥控器，我不用从椅子上起来就能换「风速档位」。

collocations: set the fan speed to low

words.enDefinition: an intercom that does not transmit or respond correctly

examples.en: I met the technician in the lobby because the faulty intercom would not ring upstairs.
examples.zh: 「故障的楼宇对讲机」在楼上不响，我就在大厅接技术员。

examples.en: Several students reported a faulty intercom after visitors could not hear replies from their rooms.
examples.zh: 来访者听不到房间里的人应答，几名学生报告说有一台「故障的楼宇对讲机」。

words.enDefinition: the highest charge permitted for a particular service

examples.en: The adviser helped me check whether the fee cap applied to this administration charge.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我确认了这笔行政手续费是否适用「收费上限」。

examples.en: I asked which services were covered by the fee cap mentioned in the residence handbook.
examples.zh: 我问了宿舍手册提到的「收费上限」适用于哪些服务。

words.enDefinition: a published list of charges for specific services

examples.en: The residence posted its fee schedule near the front desk where students could check it.
examples.zh: 宿舍把「收费项目表」贴在前台旁边，方便学生查看。

examples.en: The key replacement cost in the fee schedule was lower than the one quoted by email.
examples.zh: 「收费项目表」上的补配钥匙费比邮件里的报价低。

words.enDefinition: permission not to pay an otherwise applicable charge

examples.en: I requested a fee waiver because the office had issued the wrong access card.
examples.zh: 办公室发错了门禁卡，所以我申请了「费用豁免」。

examples.en: The fee waiver covered the new key but didn't cover the locksmith's weekend visit.
examples.zh: 「费用豁免」免掉了新钥匙的钱，但没有免掉锁匠周末上门的费用。

words.enDefinition: soft pads under furniture legs that protect the floor

examples.en: I added felt pads to the dining chairs to protect our wooden floor.
examples.zh: 我在餐椅腿上贴了「毛毡脚垫」，以免刮伤木地板。

examples.en: The chair scrapes whenever I move it, so I bought new felt pads.
examples.zh: 椅子一挪就刮地板，所以我买了新的「毛毡脚垫」。

collocations: fit felt pads to chair legs

words.enDefinition: broadband internet delivered using fiber-optic lines for some or all of the connection

examples.en: We checked whether fiber broadband was available before choosing a place off campus.
examples.zh: 我们先查了能不能装「光纤宽带」，然后才选校外住处。

examples.en: Our building finally got fiber broadband, so I can attend seminars from home.
examples.zh: 我们楼终于通了「光纤宽带」，我可以在家上研讨课了。

words.enDefinition: a connection in which fiber runs all the way to a home

examples.en: The engineer confirmed that our building supports fiber-to-the-home rather than just street-level fiber.
examples.zh: 工程师确认我们楼支持「光纤到户」，光纤可以直接接到住处。

examples.en: The availability page showed fiber-to-the-home was an option for the flat upstairs.
examples.zh: 覆盖查询页面显示，楼上那套公寓可以办理「光纤到户」。

words.enDefinition: a cabinet with drawers for storing and organizing documents

examples.en: The small filing cabinet holds my tenancy papers and old course notes.
examples.zh: 这个小「文件柜」装着我的租房文件和旧课程笔记。

examples.en: We found a filing cabinet that was narrow enough to fit beside our desk.
examples.zh: 我们找到一个够窄的「文件柜」，能摆在书桌旁。

collocations: store papers in a filing cabinet

words.enDefinition: narrow search results by setting a rent range

examples.en: Filter by price first, then sort the results by distance to campus.
examples.zh: 先「按价格筛选」，再按离学校的远近排序。

examples.en: The site lets you filter by price so you never see apartments over your budget.
examples.zh: 网站支持「按价格筛选」，超预算的公寓根本不会出现。

words.enDefinition: a light or display showing when a filter needs attention

examples.en: The filter indicator turned orange, so I looked up the recommended replacement filter.
examples.zh: 「滤网状态指示灯」变成橙色，我就去查推荐的替换滤网。

examples.en: I hadn't noticed the small filter indicator when we bought the vacuum cleaner secondhand.
examples.zh: 我们买二手吸尘器时，我没有注意到那个小小的「滤网状态指示灯」。

words.enDefinition: a document showing the balance after all charges and payments

examples.en: Our final account statement showed that the landlord still owed us part of the deposit.
examples.zh: 我们的「最终结算单」显示，房东还应退还一部分押金。

examples.en: I asked for a corrected final account statement because the key fee appeared on it twice.
examples.zh: 补配钥匙费列了两遍，我要求给一份更正后的「最终结算单」。

collocations: request a corrected final account statement

words.enDefinition: the last bill issued when a utility account ends

examples.en: The final utility bill arrived two weeks after we handed back the keys.
examples.zh: 我们交还钥匙两周后，收到了「公用服务结清账单」。

examples.en: Please send me the final utility bill so I can pay my share.
examples.zh: 请把「公用服务结清账单」发给我，我好付自己那份。

words.enDefinition: a sheet with elastic edges that grip the mattress

examples.en: The fitted sheet keeps slipping off because this mattress is unusually thick.
examples.zh: 这张床垫特别厚，「床笠」老是从边上滑下来。

examples.en: I bought a fitted sheet before my first night in the residence hall.
examples.zh: 第一晚住宿舍之前，我买了一个「床笠」。

words.enDefinition: an energy contract with agreed rates for a set period

examples.en: A fixed-rate energy plan sounded sensible while we were sharing the house.
examples.zh: 合租期间，我们觉得选「固定费率能源套餐」比较稳妥。

examples.en: The fixed-rate energy plan ends in June, shortly after my final exam.
examples.zh: 「固定费率能源套餐」六月到期，离我最后一门考试结束没多久。

collocations: switch to a fixed-rate energy plan

words.enDefinition: a rental contract for a specified length of time

examples.en: My fixed-term lease runs through July, even though my course finishes at the end of May.
examples.zh: 虽然我的课五月底就结束，「固定期限租约」却要到七月底。

examples.en: They offered a fixed-term lease that matched the dates of our university exchange program.
examples.zh: 对方提供了一份「固定期限租约」，正好覆盖我们的大学交换项目。

collocations: the end of a fixed-term lease

words.enDefinition: home internet delivered by radio signals to a fixed location

examples.en: The landlord suggested fixed wireless broadband because the flat had no cable connection.
examples.zh: 公寓没有有线连接，房东建议用「固定无线宽带」。

examples.en: We asked whether fixed wireless broadband would work in our basement flat.
examples.zh: 我们问了地下室的公寓能不能用「固定无线宽带」。

words.enDefinition: a set total charge regardless of time or other factors

examples.en: The moving service quoted a flat fee rather than charging us for every extra box.
examples.zh: 搬家服务报的是「固定费用」，没有按多出来的箱子逐个收费。

examples.en: The manager said the flat fee was the same for every apartment in our building.
examples.zh: 物业经理说，我们这栋楼每套公寓交的「固定费用」都一样。

words.enDefinition: furniture packaged in pieces that the buyer assembles

examples.en: We bought flat-pack furniture because it fit in my flatmate's small car.
examples.zh: 我们买的是「平板包装家具」，因为室友的小车能装得下。

examples.en: Flat-pack furniture is easier to carry up the stairs to my room.
examples.zh: 「平板包装家具」比较容易沿楼梯搬到我房间。

words.enDefinition: a set utility charge that does not depend on usage

examples.en: Our hall uses a flat-rate utility charge to cover heating and electricity.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼用一笔「统一标准的公用费」来支付供暖和电费。

examples.en: I asked whether the flat-rate utility charge stayed the same over the summer.
examples.zh: 我问夏天收的「统一标准公用费」是不是也一样。

words.enDefinition: a rectangular bed sheet without elastic around the edges

examples.en: I layered a flat sheet under the blanket because the room was cold.
examples.zh: 房间有点冷，我在毯子底下又铺了条「无松紧床单」。

examples.en: A flat sheet is easier to fold than the one with elastic corners.
examples.zh: 「无松紧床单」比四角有松紧带的床笠好叠。

words.enDefinition: a light warm blanket made of soft fuzzy fabric

examples.en: I keep a fleece blanket on my chair for cold evenings at my desk.
examples.zh: 我在椅子上放了条「绒毯」，晚上坐在书桌前冷的时候用。

examples.en: We bought a fleece blanket for guests who sleep on the sofa.
examples.zh: 我们买了条「绒毯」，给睡沙发的客人用。

collocations: wrap up in a fleece blanket

words.enDefinition: a light that repeatedly becomes brighter and dimmer

examples.en: I emailed the manager about a flickering light above the stairs in our building.
examples.zh: 我给物业经理发邮件，说楼里楼梯上方有一盏「忽明忽暗的灯」。

examples.en: The electrician asked where the flickering light was before she went upstairs to inspect it.
examples.zh: 电工先问「忽明忽暗的灯」在哪儿，才上楼检查。

collocations: a flickering light in the hallway

words.enDefinition: shelves mounted to the wall with their supports hidden

examples.en: The floating shelves make room for my plants without covering the desk.
examples.zh: 「隐形支架搁板」给我的植物留了地方，又没占桌面。

examples.en: I asked my landlord before putting up floating shelves in the bedroom.
examples.zh: 在卧室安装「隐形支架搁板」之前，我先问了房东。

words.enDefinition: a tall lamp that stands directly on the floor

examples.en: I put a floor lamp by the sofa for reading after dinner.
examples.zh: 我在沙发旁放了一盏「落地灯」，方便晚饭后看书。

examples.en: The floor lamp lights up the corner that the ceiling light never reaches.
examples.zh: 天花板上的灯照不到那个角落，「落地灯」刚好能照亮那里。

collocations: stand a floor lamp by the sofa

words.enDefinition: a drawing showing the layout of the unit

examples.en: The floor plan shows the bedroom is beside the kitchen, not the street.
examples.zh: 「户型图」显示卧室紧挨厨房，并不临街。

examples.en: Compare the floor plan with the photos because listings sometimes stretch rooms.
examples.zh: 把「户型图」和照片对照一下，房源有时会把房间画大。

words.enDefinition: money held until an electronic access device is returned

examples.en: The housing office kept my fob deposit until I handed back the electronic key.
examples.zh: 我把电子钥匙交回住房办公室后，才拿回「门禁感应钥匙押金」。

examples.en: We paid one fob deposit for each of the two access devices issued to us.
examples.zh: 我们领了两把门禁感应钥匙，每把都交了一份「门禁感应钥匙押金」。

words.enDefinition: a desk whose work surface folds down from a support

examples.en: We installed a fold-down desk so the bedroom door could still open fully.
examples.zh: 我们装了张「下翻式书桌」，这样卧室门还能完全打开。

examples.en: I use the fold-down desk for homework and close it before having friends over.
examples.zh: 我打开「下翻式书桌」写作业，朋友来之前再把它合上。

words.enDefinition: a bed that folds up for storage when unused

examples.en: We keep a foldaway bed behind the wardrobe for friends who miss the last train.
examples.zh: 我们在衣柜后备了一张「折叠收纳床」，给赶不上末班车的朋友用。

examples.en: The foldaway bed came in handy when my parents visited for graduation.
examples.zh: 父母来参加毕业典礼时，「折叠收纳床」派上了用场。

words.enDefinition: a chair whose frame folds flat for easy storage

examples.en: I keep a folding chair behind the wardrobe for anyone who drops by.
examples.zh: 我在衣柜后面放了一把「折叠椅」，有人顺路来坐坐就能用。

examples.en: The folding chair is lighter than our spare dining chair and easier to carry.
examples.zh: 「折叠椅」比我们备用的餐椅轻，搬起来也容易。

words.enDefinition: a movable panel arrangement that folds up and provides privacy

examples.en: We used a folding screen to give guests privacy in the living room.
examples.zh: 我们在客厅摆了「折叠屏风」，给客人留点私人空间。

examples.en: I moved the folding screen out of the way before our study group arrived.
examples.zh: 学习小组来之前，我把「折叠屏风」挪到了一边。

words.enDefinition: a table that folds up when it is not needed

examples.en: I set up a folding table when our study group needed more space.
examples.zh: 学习小组需要更多地方，我就支了一张「折叠桌」。

examples.en: The folding table fits behind my door when we are not using it.
examples.zh: 不用的时候，「折叠桌」可以收在我的房门后面。

words.enDefinition: to check what has happened after a reported repair

examples.en: I emailed to follow up on a repair that we originally requested during the winter break.
examples.zh: 我们寒假时就报修了，我发了邮件「跟进维修」。

examples.en: My roommate offered to follow up on a repair while I was away at a conference.
examples.zh: 我外出参会期间，室友主动帮忙「跟进维修」。

collocations: call to follow up on a repair
follow up on a repair by email
follow up on a repair request

words.enDefinition: a later visit to check or finish earlier work

examples.en: The contractor planned a follow-up visit to make sure the ceiling had dried after the leak.
examples.zh: 承包商安排了「后续上门」，确认漏水后天花板已经干透。

examples.en: I scheduled the follow-up visit for Wednesday because the first repair had only been temporary.
examples.zh: 第一次只做了临时修补，我把「后续上门」安排在星期三。

words.enDefinition: a kitchen appliance that chops or slices food mechanically

examples.en: We borrowed a food processor to chop the vegetables for a big batch of salsa.
examples.zh: 我们借了台「食物料理机」切菜，好做一大份莎莎酱。

examples.en: The shared kitchen has a food processor, so I didn't buy one when I moved in.
examples.zh: 公用厨房有一台「食物料理机」，我入住时就没再买。

collocations: pulse food in a food processor

words.enDefinition: a panel attached at the end of a bed

examples.en: We removed the footboard to make more space at the end of the bed.
examples.zh: 我们拆了「床尾板」，好让床尾多留一点空间。

examples.en: I hit my shin on the footboard when I walked past in the dark.
examples.zh: 我摸黑走过时，小腿撞到了「床尾板」。

words.enDefinition: a low stool used to support a seated person's feet

examples.en: I put a footstool in front of the armchair beside my bedroom window.
examples.zh: 我在卧室窗边的扶手椅前面放了一个「脚凳」。

examples.en: The footstool slides under the chair when I need to clear the floor.
examples.zh: 要把地面腾出来的时候，可以把「脚凳」推到椅子底下。

collocations: put your feet on a footstool

words.enDefinition: offered to tenants, usually on a sign or ad

examples.en: There is a for rent sign on the corner house two blocks from the gym.
examples.zh: 离健身房两个街区的那栋房子门口挂着「房屋出租」。

examples.en: I filtered the group posts down to three rooms for rent near the metro.
examples.zh: 我把群里的帖子筛了筛，留下三套地铁附近的「房屋出租」。

words.enDefinition: lose the right to recover previously paid security money

examples.en: My roommate feared we'd forfeit the deposit if we cancelled the reservation before signing the lease.
examples.zh: 我室友担心，签租约前取消预留，我们就会「失去押金」。

examples.en: Before withdrawing my application, I asked whether I would have to forfeit the deposit.
examples.zh: 撤回申请前，我问这样做会不会让我「失去押金」。

collocations: risk having to forfeit the deposit

words.enDefinition: the new address used to send mail after a move

examples.en: I gave the landlord my forwarding address so the final cheque wouldn't go to the old flat.
examples.zh: 我把「邮件转寄地址」给了房东，免得最后的退款支票寄到旧公寓。

examples.en: Can I leave my parents' home as a forwarding address until I find another rental?
examples.zh: 在找到下一套出租房之前，我能先把父母家留作「邮件转寄地址」吗？

collocations: mail a refund to a forwarding address

words.enDefinition: a label warning that an item can break easily

examples.en: I put a fragile label on the box with all the coffee mugs.
examples.zh: 我在装马克杯的箱子上贴了张「易碎品标签」。

examples.en: The movers spotted the fragile label and set that carton down first.
examples.zh: 搬家工人看到「易碎品标签」，先把那只纸箱放了下来。

words.enDefinition: carpet with worn edges or loose threads

examples.en: We reported the frayed carpet after someone tripped on the edge near our front door.
examples.zh: 有人在楼门附近被地毯边绊了一下，我们就报告了「磨出毛边的地毯」。

examples.en: The office plans to replace the frayed carpet in the stairwell over the winter break.
examples.zh: 办公室计划在寒假更换楼梯间里「磨出毛边的地毯」。

words.enDefinition: available at no cost to anyone who collects it

examples.en: I found a sofa advertised as free for collection in our neighborhood group.
examples.zh: 我在小区群里看到一张可以「免费自取」的沙发。

examples.en: The shelves are free for collection if you can pick them up by Friday.
examples.zh: 星期五前能搬走的话，这些架子可以「免费自取」。

words.enDefinition: a dishwasher that stands separately from fitted kitchen cabinets

examples.en: The landlord suggested a freestanding dishwasher because there was no space inside the existing cabinets.
examples.zh: 原来的橱柜里面没有空位，房东建议用「独立式洗碗机」。

examples.en: We left a gap next to the cabinets for the freestanding dishwasher the landlord ordered.
examples.zh: 我们在橱柜旁给房东订的「独立式洗碗机」留了个空位。

words.enDefinition: a movable wardrobe that is separate from the wall structure

examples.en: I chose a freestanding wardrobe so I could take it when I moved.
examples.zh: 我选了「独立式衣柜」，这样搬家时还能带走。

examples.en: The freestanding wardrobe blocks the socket unless we move it toward the door.
examples.zh: 除非把「独立式衣柜」往门那边挪一挪，否则它会挡住插座。

words.enDefinition: dry patches on frozen food caused by air exposure

examples.en: We found patches of freezer burn on the bread we'd forgotten in the freezer.
examples.zh: 我们在忘在冷冻柜里的面包上发现了几块「食物冷冻干斑」。

examples.en: My roommate showed me how to spot freezer burn on the leftover food we'd frozen.
examples.zh: 室友教我识别冻起来的剩菜上有没有「食物冷冻干斑」。

words.enDefinition: the section of a refrigerator used for freezing food

examples.en: Our freezer compartment is so small that two boxes of frozen pizza fill it.
examples.zh: 我们的「冷冻隔室」太小，两盒冷冻比萨就塞满了。

examples.en: My flatmate keeps one bag of peas in the freezer compartment for quick dinners.
examples.zh: 室友在「冷冻隔室」备了一袋豌豆，方便做简单的晚饭。

collocations: store food in the freezer compartment

words.enDefinition: a unit with separate sections for chilling and freezing

examples.en: The fridge freezer in our new flat has a generous lower section for frozen food.
examples.zh: 我们新公寓的「冷藏冷冻一体冰箱」下面有一块挺大的空间，可以放冷冻食品。

examples.en: We checked the door clearance before ordering a fridge freezer for our narrow kitchen.
examples.zh: 给窄厨房订购「冷藏冷冻一体冰箱」前，我们先核对了开门空间。

words.enDefinition: a washing machine with a door on its front

examples.en: The utility closet is low, so our landlord chose a front-loading washer for it.
examples.zh: 杂物间上方净空不大，房东就选了一台「前开门洗衣机」。

examples.en: The campus laundry has a front-loading washer with enough space for my bedding.
examples.zh: 校园洗衣房有台「前开门洗衣机」，空间够放我的床上用品。

words.enDefinition: designed to prevent frost from accumulating during normal use

examples.en: I chose a frost-free freezer because I'd had to defrost our old one by hand.
examples.zh: 我选了「免除霜」冷冻柜，因为旧的得我手动除霜。

examples.en: The frost-free model was slightly bigger, but it still fit in the student kitchen.
examples.zh: 「免除霜」款稍大一些，不过学生公寓的厨房还是放得下。

words.enDefinition: a pipe blocked by water that has turned to ice

examples.en: A frozen pipe left the kitchen tap dry on a particularly cold morning in January.
examples.zh: 一月一个特别冷的早晨，厨房水龙头因为「水管冻住」不出水了。

examples.en: The landlord called a plumber to inspect the frozen pipe before the students returned from break.
examples.zh: 学生们放假回来前，房东请水管工检查了「冻住的水管」。

words.enDefinition: a mirror tall enough to reflect someone's whole body

examples.en: I borrowed a full-length mirror to check my outfit before the interview.
examples.zh: 面试前我借了一面「全身镜」，照了照自己的穿搭。

examples.en: The full-length mirror in the hallway makes the narrow space look bigger.
examples.zh: 走廊里的「全身镜」让狭窄的空间显得更大。

collocations: lean a full-length mirror against the wall
stand in front of a full-length mirror

words.enDefinition: the return of all the money that was paid

examples.en: The agent issued a full refund because the advertised room was no longer available.
examples.zh: 中介发现广告里的房间已经租出去了，就给了我们「全额退款」。

examples.en: I expected a full refund because we had left the flat in good condition.
examples.zh: 我原本以为会收到「全额退款」，因为我们退租时房况很好。

words.enDefinition: painting all of an affected room or area again

examples.en: The landlord proposed a full repaint, although the only mark was next to the doorway.
examples.zh: 房东提出要「整体重刷」，尽管只有门口旁边有一个印记。

examples.en: We received separate estimates for touching up one wall and doing a full repaint.
examples.zh: 我们分别收到了局部补刷一面墙和「整体重刷」的费用估算。

words.enDefinition: a lease formally signed by all required parties

examples.en: The international student office asked for a fully executed lease as evidence of my address.
examples.zh: 国际学生办公室要求提供一份「各方签署完毕的租约」作为地址证明。

examples.en: Our agent filed the fully executed lease and gave each roommate a copy to keep.
examples.zh: 中介存档了「各方签署完毕的租约」，并给每位室友留了一份。

collocations: a copy of the fully executed lease

words.enDefinition: equipped with all the main furniture you need

examples.en: The listing says the flat comes fully furnished with bedding and lamps.
examples.zh: 房源说这套公寓「家具齐全」，连床上用品和台灯都有。

examples.en: Our room was not fully furnished, so we bought a desk secondhand.
examples.zh: 我们的房间并不「家具齐全」，只好二手买了张书桌。

words.enDefinition: put furniture and other useful items into a room

examples.en: I never expected it to cost this much to furnish a room near campus.
examples.zh: 没想到在学校附近「给房间配家具」要花这么多钱。

examples.en: You can furnish a room cheaply if you start with the student swap group.
examples.zh: 可以先去学生交换群看看，这样「给房间配家具」能省不少钱。

collocations: furnish a room on a budget

words.enDefinition: a rental that comes with bed, desk, and sofa included

examples.en: As an international student I chose a furnished apartment to avoid buying furniture.
examples.zh: 作为国际学生，我选了「带家具公寓」，省得自己买家具。

examples.en: This furnished apartment includes a bed, desk, wardrobe, and even a microwave.
examples.zh: 这套「带家具公寓」配了床、书桌、衣柜，连微波炉都有。

words.enDefinition: items that make a room usable or comfortable

examples.en: The apartment comes with basic furnishings, but we still need a dining table.
examples.zh: 公寓配了基本的「室内陈设」，不过我们还需要一张餐桌。

examples.en: The residence adviser showed us which furnishings belonged to the university when we moved in.
examples.zh: 我们搬进去时，宿舍管理员告诉我们哪些「室内陈设」是学校的。

words.enDefinition: a thick cover that protects furniture during a move

examples.en: We borrowed a furniture blanket to stop the dresser getting scratched in the van.
examples.zh: 我们借了块「家具防护毯」，免得五斗柜在车里刮花。

examples.en: The movers wrapped the table in a furniture blanket before taking it downstairs.
examples.zh: 搬家工人先用「家具防护毯」包上桌子，再往楼下搬。

words.enDefinition: discs placed under furniture legs to make moving easier

examples.en: I put furniture sliders under the bookcase before moving it across the carpet.
examples.zh: 沿地毯挪书架前，我在书架下面垫了「家具助滑垫」。

examples.en: We used furniture sliders to rearrange the sitting room before our guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人来之前，我们用「家具助滑垫」重新摆了客厅的家具。

collocations: place furniture sliders under the legs
slide a dresser on furniture sliders

words.enDefinition: a freestanding frame with a bar for hanging clothing

examples.en: I bought a garment rack because this room doesn't have a closet.
examples.zh: 房间没有衣柜，所以我买了个「落地挂衣架」。

examples.en: We put our coats on the garment rack when the hall closet filled up.
examples.zh: 门厅的壁橱满了，我们就把外套挂到「落地挂衣架」上。

collocations: hang clothes on a garment rack

words.enDefinition: a statement showing charges for gas supplied to a property

examples.en: We left some money in the shared account for the last gas bill.
examples.zh: 我们在共同账户里留了点钱，用来付最后一张「燃气费账单」。

examples.en: Our gas bill covers the cooker as well as the central heating system.
examples.zh: 我们的「燃气费账单」包含了灶台和中央供暖系统的用气。

words.enDefinition: the flat cooking surface of a stove with gas burners

examples.en: The flat had a gas hob with four burners and a separate electric oven.
examples.zh: 这套公寓有一个四眼的「燃气灶面」，另配电烤箱。

examples.en: I asked the landlord whether the gas hob shown in the photos came with the flat.
examples.zh: 我问房东，照片上的「燃气灶面」是不是公寓自带的。

collocations: a pan on the gas hob

words.enDefinition: a device measuring the gas supplied to a property

examples.en: My flatmate showed me where to find the gas meter under the stairs.
examples.zh: 室友给我指了楼梯下「燃气表」的位置。

examples.en: The gas meter is outside the back door, next to the bins.
examples.zh: 「燃气表」在后门外面，挨着几个垃圾桶。

words.enDefinition: a wash program with less movement to protect fabrics

examples.en: The label recommends the gentle cycle, so I kept the blouse away from my jeans.
examples.zh: 衣标建议用「轻柔洗程序」，我就没把这件衬衫和牛仔裤放一起。

examples.en: I washed my scarf on the gentle cycle before hanging it in my room.
examples.zh: 我用「轻柔洗程序」洗了围巾，然后把它挂在房间里。

words.enDefinition: previously owned but showing only a little wear

examples.en: I bought a gently used desk from a student who just graduated.
examples.zh: 我从一位刚毕业的学生手里买了张「轻度使用过的」书桌。

examples.en: The photos show a gently used chair with no noticeable marks or stains.
examples.zh: 照片里是一把「轻度使用过的」椅子，没有明显痕迹或污渍。

words.enDefinition: receive rental security money paid earlier

examples.en: We wanted to get the deposit back, so both roommates stayed to finish cleaning the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们想「拿回押金」，所以两个室友都留下来把厨房打扫完了。

examples.en: How long does it usually take to get the deposit back after handing over the keys?
examples.zh: 交还钥匙后，一般多久能「拿回押金」？

collocations: hope to get the deposit back
get the deposit back in full

words.enDefinition: internet service with speeds around one gigabit per second

examples.en: The website says gigabit broadband is available in our new block of flats.
examples.zh: 网站说我们的新公寓楼可以办理「千兆宽带」。

examples.en: We decided gigabit broadband was more than we needed for a two-person flat.
examples.zh: 我们觉得，两人合住的公寓用不上「千兆宽带」。

words.enDefinition: to formally tell someone of a planned change or departure

examples.en: I need to give notice before I book a room near my new campus.
examples.zh: 我得先「正式告知房东我要搬走」，再订新校区附近的房间。

examples.en: The landlord agreed to give notice before sending someone to repair the ceiling in our room.
examples.zh: 房东同意先「正式通知我们」，再派人修房间的天花板。

words.enDefinition: to tell neighbours in advance about something that might affect them

examples.en: We should give the neighbours a heads-up before the moving van blocks the driveway.
examples.zh: 在搬家货车堵住车道前，我们应该「提前知会邻居」。

examples.en: I'll give the neighbours a heads-up if we decide to have friends over Friday.
examples.zh: 我们要是决定周五请朋友过来，我就「提前知会邻居」。

collocations: remember to give the neighbours a heads-up
offer to give the neighbours a heads-up
call to give the neighbours a heads-up

words.enDefinition: an energy plan linked to electricity from renewable sources

examples.en: Our flatmates chose a green energy tariff because the price difference was small.
examples.zh: 差价不大，所以我们合租的几个人选了「绿色能源费率方案」。

examples.en: Before choosing a green energy tariff, ask how the supplier backs its renewable claims.
examples.zh: 选「绿色能源费率方案」之前，问一下供应商如何证明能源来自可再生来源。

collocations: switch to a green energy tariff

words.enDefinition: someone who promises to pay your rent if you cannot

examples.en: Most international students ask a parent to act as guarantor.
examples.zh: 大多数国际学生请父母担任「担保人」。

examples.en: Without a UK guarantor we had to pay six months of rent upfront.
examples.zh: 因为没有英国的「担保人」，我们只好预付了半年房租。

words.enDefinition: a separate Wi-Fi network for people visiting a home

examples.en: I set up a guest network before my classmates came over to study.
examples.zh: 同学来家里学习前，我开了一个「访客网络」。

examples.en: The guest network lets visitors connect without using our shared household password.
examples.zh: 使用「访客网络」来客就能上网，不用知道家里共用的密码。

words.enDefinition: a permit that lets a visitor park at a property

examples.en: Reception gave my dad a guest parking pass while he helped me move.
examples.zh: 爸爸帮我搬家时，前台给了他一张「访客停车证」。

examples.en: I returned the guest parking pass after my friend drove back to campus.
examples.zh: 朋友开车回学校后，我归还了「访客停车证」。

words.enDefinition: the house rules about friends staying or visiting

examples.en: The guest policy limits each of us to two weekend nights a month.
examples.zh: 「访客规定」限制我们每人每月最多留宿客人两个周末晚上。

examples.en: A strict guest policy is not a dealbreaker if the rent is right.
examples.zh: 只要房租合适，「访客规定」严一点也能接受。

words.enDefinition: an extremely narrow split in a solid surface

examples.en: I took a close photo of the hairline crack just above the bathroom door.
examples.zh: 我给浴室门正上方的「细微裂缝」拍了张近照。

examples.en: The contractor said the hairline crack had appeared where two sections of plaster met.
examples.zh: 承包商说，「细微裂缝」出现在两部分灰泥的接合处。

collocations: a hairline crack in the plaster

words.enDefinition: a washing option for fewer items than the machine's capacity

examples.en: With only three plates in the dishwasher, my roommate chose the half load setting.
examples.zh: 洗碗机里只有三个盘子，室友选了「半载洗涤」设置。

examples.en: We asked whether the half load option was available on both racks of this model.
examples.zh: 我们问，这个型号上下两层碗架都能用「半载洗涤」选项吗？

words.enDefinition: take a check to the recipient in person

examples.en: I can hand-deliver a check to the office after my morning seminar.
examples.zh: 上午研讨课结束后，我可以去办公室「当面递交支票」。

examples.en: We decided to hand-deliver a check after the mail service reported delays.
examples.zh: 得知邮递延误后，我们决定「当面递交支票」。

collocations: hand-deliver a check to the office

words.enDefinition: a handheld appliance with beaters for mixing food

examples.en: I used a hand mixer to whip cream for the cake we took to dinner.
examples.zh: 我用「手持打蛋器」打发了奶油，抹到我们带去聚餐的蛋糕上。

examples.en: We found a hand mixer in the kitchen drawer while looking for the measuring cups.
examples.zh: 找量杯的时候，我们在厨房抽屉里发现了一个「手持打蛋器」。

collocations: beat eggs with a hand mixer

words.enDefinition: tighten a fastener by hand rather than with a tool

examples.en: The instructions say to hand-tighten each bolt before turning the desk upright.
examples.zh: 说明书说，先「用手拧紧」每个螺栓，再把书桌扶正。

examples.en: You can hand-tighten the knobs once both shelf brackets are in place.
examples.zh: 两个隔板支架都装好之后，就可以「用手拧紧」旋钮。

words.enDefinition: a two-wheeled frame for moving heavy or stacked items

examples.en: The caretaker lent us a hand truck to move the boxes from reception.
examples.zh: 管理员借给我们一辆「两轮搬运车」，好把箱子从前台搬走。

examples.en: You can take two boxes at once if you use the hand truck.
examples.zh: 用「两轮搬运车」的话，一次能搬两箱。

collocations: move boxes with a hand truck

words.enDefinition: a small vacuum cleaner held and operated by hand

examples.en: I used a handheld vacuum to pick up crumbs that had fallen between the cushions.
examples.zh: 我用「手持吸尘器」把掉在坐垫缝里的碎屑吸走了。

examples.en: The handheld vacuum is light enough to carry from my room to the stairs.
examples.zh: 这台「手持吸尘器」够轻，从房间拎到楼梯那儿不费劲。

words.enDefinition: a list used to check tasks when transferring a property

examples.en: We went through the handover checklist before giving the flat back to the owner.
examples.zh: 我们把「交接清单」过了一遍，才把公寓交还房东。

examples.en: The handover checklist helped us remember to return both sets of keys to reception.
examples.zh: 靠这份「交接清单」提醒，我们记得把两套钥匙都还给前台。

words.enDefinition: a holder with compartments that hangs from a support

examples.en: The hanging organizer gives me several small shelves without taking up floor space.
examples.zh: 「悬挂式收纳架」给我多添了几层小搁板，还不占地儿。

examples.en: I use a hanging organizer for shoes in my tiny dorm closet.
examples.zh: 我的宿舍衣柜很小，就用「悬挂式收纳架」放鞋。

words.zhGloss: 困难期间分期付款安排
words.enDefinition: an installment arrangement for a person experiencing financial difficulty
acceptedZhAnswers: 困难期间分期付款安排

examples.en: The university offered a hardship payment plan after I explained my situation.
examples.zh: 我说明情况后，学校提供了「困难期间分期付款安排」。

examples.en: Can I apply for a hardship payment plan before my rent is overdue?
examples.zh: 房租逾期前，我能申请「困难期间分期付款安排」吗？

collocations: qualify for a hardship payment plan

words.enDefinition: a tenant who rents directly and sublets to others

examples.en: I arranged the room with the head tenant, who had signed the main lease.
examples.zh: 我和签了主租约的「主承租人」谈妥了租房间的事。

examples.en: The head tenant introduced me to the landlord before I moved into the shared flat.
examples.zh: 我搬进合租公寓前，「主承租人」把我介绍给了房东。

words.enDefinition: a panel attached at the head of a bed

examples.en: The headboard was too wide for the narrow nook in my room.
examples.zh: 「床头板」太宽了，放不进我房间那个窄凹位。

examples.en: I leaned against the padded headboard to read before my roommate woke up.
examples.zh: 室友醒来前，我靠在软包「床头板」上看书。

words.enDefinition: the rent covers heating with no extra charge

examples.en: Choose the room with heat included because it saves about sixty a month in winter.
examples.zh: 选那间「包暖气」的房间吧，冬天每月能省六十左右。

examples.en: The listing says heat included, so confirm what happens in February.
examples.zh: 房源写着「包暖气」，但二月份的情况还是要确认一下。

words.enDefinition: a dryer that reuses warmed air through a heat pump

examples.en: The landlord chose a heat pump dryer for our flat and left its manual on the counter.
examples.zh: 房东给我们公寓选了台「热泵烘干机」，把说明书放在台面上了。

examples.en: My roommate asked if the new heat pump dryer would fit beside the washing machine.
examples.zh: 室友问，新「热泵烘干机」放不放得下洗衣机旁边的空位。

collocations: compare a heat pump dryer with a vented model

words.enDefinition: a failure affecting how a heating system works

examples.en: The housing office posted an update after a heating fault affected several student apartments.
examples.zh: 几套学生公寓发生「供暖故障」后，住房办公室发布了进度。

examples.en: I reported a heating fault when the living room stayed cold through the evening.
examples.zh: 客厅整个晚上都很冷，我就报告了「供暖故障」。

words.enDefinition: a stronger wash program for sturdy and heavily soiled items

examples.en: We picked the heavy-duty cycle after coming back from a very muddy volunteer cleanup.
examples.zh: 参加志愿清理活动时蹭得都是泥，回来后我们选了「重污洗程序」。

examples.en: I checked the care label before using the heavy-duty cycle for my work trousers.
examples.zh: 用「重污洗程序」洗我的工作裤之前，我先确认了衣标。

words.enDefinition: a filter designed to capture very small airborne particles

examples.en: I checked the package to see if the HEPA filter fit our air purifier.
examples.zh: 我看了包装，确认这块「高效空气滤网」能不能装在我们家的空气净化器上。

examples.en: The salesperson showed us where the HEPA filter sat inside the demo vacuum cleaner.
examples.zh: 店员指给我们看展示用吸尘器里的「高效空气滤网」在哪儿。

collocations: an appliance with a HEPA filter

words.enDefinition: to keep a delivered package until I can collect it

examples.en: Could you hold a package for me if it arrives before I get home?
examples.zh: 包裹要是在我到家前送到，你能「帮我暂收包裹」吗？

examples.en: I asked reception if they could hold a package for me until after class.
examples.zh: 我问前台能不能「帮我暂收包裹」，等我下课再取。

collocations: offer to hold a package for me
ask someone to hold a package for me
agree to hold a package for me

words.enDefinition: keep money with a neutral party pending agreed conditions

examples.en: The agent volunteered to hold funds in escrow until both sides agreed what the tenant owed.
examples.zh: 中介主动提出先「托管款项」，等双方就租客应付金额达成一致再处理。

examples.en: We asked whether a neutral third party could hold funds in escrow while the claim was reviewed.
examples.zh: 我们问，审核索赔期间能否由中立第三方「托管款项」。

collocations: hold funds in escrow until settlement
agree to hold funds in escrow
hold funds in escrow pending approval

words.enDefinition: money paid to reserve a place before signing

examples.en: Before I send the holding deposit, could you confirm how long you'll hold the room?
examples.zh: 我付「预留押金」以前，能确认一下你们会给我留房多久吗？

examples.en: The agent deducted the holding deposit from the amount we owed when we moved in.
examples.zh: 我们入住时，中介从应付款中扣除了已交的「预留押金」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for keeping a rental available for someone temporarily

examples.en: The agent in Sydney said our holding fee would go toward rent if we signed.
examples.zh: 悉尼的中介说，如果签约，这笔「房源预留费」会抵作房租。

examples.en: We asked for the terms of the holding fee before paying anything to reserve the flat.
examples.zh: 我们先问清「房源预留费」的条款，再决定要不要付钱留房。

words.enDefinition: a lease provision addressing occupancy after the term ends

examples.en: I checked the holdover clause when my new room would not be ready until October.
examples.zh: 我的新房间要到十月才准备好，我就去看了「租期届满后留住条款」。

examples.en: The manager explained the holdover clause after I asked about staying beyond the end date.
examples.zh: 我问过了截止日期能不能继续住，物业经理解释了「租期届满后留住条款」。

words.zhGloss: 租期届满后留住的租客
words.enDefinition: a renter who remains after the lease term expires
acceptedZhAnswers: 租期届满后留住的租客

examples.en: The adviser explained what a holdover tenant was when I asked to stay another week.
examples.zh: 我问能不能多住一周，顾问解释了什么是「租期届满后仍留住的租客」。

examples.en: The handbook discusses a holdover tenant staying in the apartment after the agreed term expires.
examples.zh: 手册介绍了「租期届满后仍留住的租客」继续住在公寓里的情况。

words.enDefinition: looking for a house or flat to rent

examples.en: We spent our whole weekend house hunting and saw six places.
examples.zh: 整个周末我们都在「找房子」，看了六处地方。

examples.en: Take photos during house hunting so you can compare the rooms later.
examples.zh: 「找房子」时多拍些照片，方便之后对比各个房间。

words.enDefinition: a meeting of housemates to discuss how their shared home is run

examples.en: We called a house meeting to decide how to share fridge space fairly.
examples.zh: 我们开了个「合租室友会议」，商量怎样公平分配冰箱空间。

examples.en: The new tenant introduced herself at a house meeting the evening she arrived.
examples.zh: 新室友到的那晚，在「合租室友会议」上作了自我介绍。

collocations: bring something up at a house meeting

words.enDefinition: a gift for someone who has just moved into a home

examples.en: My neighbour brought a plant as a housewarming gift on the day I moved.
examples.zh: 我搬家那天，邻居送了一盆植物作「乔迁礼物」。

examples.en: We chose a second-hand cookbook as a housewarming gift for our former flatmate.
examples.zh: 我们选了本二手食谱，送给以前的室友当「乔迁礼物」。

words.enDefinition: a party held to celebrate moving into a new home

examples.en: My new flatmates threw a housewarming party and invited the neighbours from upstairs.
examples.zh: 新室友办了场「乔迁聚会」，也邀请了楼上的邻居。

examples.en: We kept the housewarming party small because several people had morning classes the next day.
examples.zh: 好几个人隔天早上有课，所以我们的「乔迁聚会」只请了少数人。

collocations: invite someone to a housewarming party

words.enDefinition: money provided to help someone pay for accommodation

examples.en: My scholarship includes a housing allowance that covers part of my weekly rent.
examples.zh: 我的奖学金里有「住房津贴」，能覆盖一部分周租金。

examples.en: I asked whether the housing allowance would continue during the summer break.
examples.zh: 我问了暑假期间「住房津贴」会不会继续发放。

words.enDefinition: a formal request for university or housing office accommodation

examples.en: The housing application for next year opens in early February.
examples.zh: 明年的「住宿申请」二月初开放。

examples.en: Attach your offer letter before you submit the housing application.
examples.zh: 提交「住宿申请」之前，记得附上录取信。

words.enDefinition: deterioration caused by a home needing repairs

examples.en: Students discussed housing disrepair at a meeting after several reports about leaks in the same building.
examples.zh: 同一栋楼收到多起漏水报修后，同学们开会讨论了「住房失修」。

examples.en: The campus clinic explained how to gather evidence of housing disrepair over several weeks.
examples.zh: 校园咨询点讲解了如何在几周内收集「住房失修」的证据。

words.enDefinition: the university office that helps students find housing

examples.en: The housing office keeps a list of landlords who rent to students.
examples.zh: 「住房办公室」有一份愿意租给学生的房东名单。

examples.en: Take your scam story to the housing office so they can warn others.
examples.zh: 把你遇到的骗局告诉「住房办公室」，让他们提醒其他同学。

words.enDefinition: not enough rental homes for everyone looking

examples.en: The housing shortage near campus means even basements get five applicants.
examples.zh: 学校附近「房源紧张」，连地下室都有五个人抢。

examples.en: During the housing shortage, landlords pick their tenants within hours.
examples.zh: 「房源紧张」的时候，房东几个小时就能定下租客。

words.enDefinition: a body that hears and decides housing disputes

examples.en: The adviser helped me prepare copies of my emails before the housing tribunal hearing.
examples.zh: 「住房纠纷裁决机构」举行听证之前，顾问帮我准备了邮件副本。

examples.en: We asked which housing tribunal could hear a complaint about our off-campus rental agreement.
examples.zh: 我们问哪个「住房纠纷裁决机构」能受理与校外租房合同有关的投诉。

collocations: refer a case to the housing tribunal

words.enDefinition: official assistance that can pay part of eligible housing costs

examples.en: My aunt asked whether the landlord would accept a housing voucher from the city.
examples.zh: 我姨妈问房东愿不愿意接受市里发的「住房补助券」。

examples.en: The adviser explained which apartments near campus would accept a housing voucher.
examples.zh: 顾问介绍了学校附近哪些公寓接受「住房补助券」。

words.enDefinition: a site with rental ads and housing advice

examples.en: The university housing website lists rooms that landlords rent to students.
examples.zh: 学校「租房网站」上列着房东租给学生的房间。

examples.en: I saved the housing website to my bookmarks so I can check new posts daily.
examples.zh: 我把这个「租房网站」收藏了，方便每天查看新帖。

words.enDefinition: a device that freezes water into cubes or pieces

examples.en: The ice maker in our shared kitchen was useful when we hosted a summer party.
examples.zh: 我们办夏日聚会时，公用厨房里的「制冰机」很有用。

examples.en: My student flat came with a refrigerator and a built-in ice maker for drinks.
examples.zh: 我的学生公寓配了冰箱和内置的「制冰机」，可以给饮料加冰。

words.enDefinition: to determine specifically what is not working

examples.en: The plumber used the notes I had left to identify the fault in the shared bathroom.
examples.zh: 水管工根据我留下的便条，在共用浴室「找出了故障」。

examples.en: They could not identify the fault on Friday because the building's service area was locked.
examples.zh: 星期五楼里的设备区锁着，他们没能「找出故障」。

collocations: take time to identify the fault

words.zhGloss: 非法换锁拒绝租客进入
words.enDefinition: unlawful exclusion of a tenant by blocking access
acceptedZhAnswers: 非法换锁拒绝租客进入

examples.en: After finding my key no longer worked, I asked the clinic about a possible illegal lockout.
examples.zh: 发现钥匙打不开门后，我咨询了法律服务点，问这是否涉嫌「非法换锁拒绝租客进入」。

examples.en: The housing office asked whether the landlord had changed the locks before discussing an illegal lockout.
examples.zh: 住房办公室在讨论是否存在「非法换锁拒绝租客进入」前，先问房东有没有换锁。

words.enDefinition: a handheld appliance with blades dipped directly into food

examples.en: I used an immersion blender to make the squash soup smooth without transferring it.
examples.zh: 我用「手持搅拌棒」把南瓜汤打细，不用另换容器。

examples.en: My roommate brought an immersion blender from home for the soup we make on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我室友从家里带来一根「手持搅拌棒」，方便我们周日一起做汤。

collocations: blend soup with an immersion blender

words.enDefinition: visiting the unit physically before deciding

examples.en: Never send money before an in-person viewing, no matter how urgent the ad sounds.
examples.zh: 无论广告多急人，「实地看房」之前都不要打钱。

examples.en: The agent offers video tours, but I still want an in-person viewing.
examples.zh: 中介可以视频带看，但我还是想要「实地看房」。

words.enDefinition: the minimum earnings a landlord expects from tenants

examples.en: The income requirement is three times the monthly rent before tax.
examples.zh: 「收入要求」是月房租的三倍，且按税前算。

examples.en: Most students cannot meet the income requirement alone, so add a guarantor.
examples.zh: 大多数学生单独达不到「收入要求」，所以要加担保人。

words.enDefinition: the gap between actual income and the money needed

examples.en: I turned to the student support office after an unexpected income shortfall.
examples.zh: 遇到意外的「收入缺口」后，我向学生支持办公室求助。

examples.en: A small grant helped cover my income shortfall during the summer term.
examples.zh: 一笔小额补助帮我填上了夏季学期的「收入缺口」。

words.enDefinition: to include outside material through an explicit reference

examples.en: The agent explained that the lease can incorporate by reference the building's separate bicycle storage rules.
examples.zh: 中介解释，租约可以「通过引用纳入」大楼单独制定的自行车停放规则。

examples.en: I checked which documents the landlord wanted to incorporate by reference before agreeing to sign.
examples.zh: 我先弄清房东想「通过引用纳入」哪些文件，再同意签合同。
