collocations: incorporate by reference into the lease

words.enDefinition: an outside professional who records a rental property's condition

examples.en: An independent inventory clerk photographed the front room and checked the listed furniture against the report.
examples.zh: 「独立房屋清点员」给客厅拍了照，并对照报告核对了清单上的家具。

examples.en: The landlord and I agreed that an independent inventory clerk should record the condition at checkout.
examples.zh: 我和房东同意由一位「独立房屋清点员」在退租时记录房况。

collocations: ask an independent inventory clerk to attend
the report from an independent inventory clerk

words.enDefinition: a rental contract held separately by one resident

examples.en: I signed an individual lease for my room rather than sharing one agreement with everyone.
examples.zh: 我为自己的房间签了一份「单独租约」，没有和大家共用一份合同。

examples.en: The manager offered an individual lease to each student in the four-bedroom apartment near campus.
examples.zh: 物业经理给校区附近那套四居公寓的每个学生都提供了一份「单独租约」。

collocations: an individual lease for each bedroom

words.enDefinition: a cooktop that heats compatible pans using magnetic fields

examples.en: My old frying pan doesn't work on the induction hob in our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我的旧煎锅用不了我们公用厨房的「电磁炉灶面」。

examples.en: The landlord showed us the induction hob when we toured the newly renovated flat.
examples.zh: 我们看那套刚翻新的公寓时，房东给我们看了「电磁炉灶面」。

collocations: an induction hob on the island

words.enDefinition: to mark every page with one's initials

examples.en: The agent asked us to initial each page before signing our full names at the end.
examples.zh: 中介让我们「在每页签上姓名首字母」，最后一页再签全名。

examples.en: We took turns at the kitchen table to initial each page of the updated lease.
examples.zh: 我们轮流坐在厨房桌边，「在新版租约的每一页签上姓名首字母」。

collocations: initial each page of the lease

words.enDefinition: the first period of an agreement before any renewal

examples.en: Once the initial term ended, I asked to remain in the flat for another semester.
examples.zh: 「初始租期」结束后，我提出在公寓里再住一学期。

examples.en: The agent said the initial term would run from September to the end of June.
examples.zh: 中介说「初始租期」从九月开始，持续到六月底。

words.enDefinition: an agreed time for a technician to install a service

examples.en: I rescheduled the installation appointment because it clashed with my lab session.
examples.zh: 安装时间和实验课撞了，我就改了「安装预约」。

examples.en: The provider sent a text to confirm our installation appointment for Wednesday morning.
examples.zh: 供应商发短信确认了周三上午的「安装预约」。

words.enDefinition: a lack of enough money for a requested payment

examples.en: My rent transfer failed due to insufficient funds in my checking account.
examples.zh: 因为支票账户「余额不足」，我的房租转账失败了。

examples.en: I saw an insufficient funds notice before the office contacted me about rent.
examples.zh: 办公室联系我谈房租之前，我就看到了「账户余额不足」的通知。

words.enDefinition: a plan backed by insurance where landlords keep deposit money

examples.en: The landlord uses an insured scheme, so she keeps the deposit during our tenancy.
examples.zh: 房东采用「保险式押金保障」，所以租期内由她保管押金。

examples.en: We checked the paperwork because an insured scheme had replaced the previous arrangement this year.
examples.zh: 今年改用「保险式押金保障」后，我们核对了相关文件。

words.enDefinition: a powerful washing program for heavily soiled dishes or items

examples.en: We chose the intensive cycle after loading several greasy baking trays from the party.
examples.zh: 聚餐用的好几个烤盘都油乎乎的，装进去后我们选了「强力洗程序」。

examples.en: The manual recommends the intensive cycle for our heavy casserole dish when it has baked-on food.
examples.zh: 说明书建议，我们的大炖锅有烤结的食物残渣时用「强力洗程序」。

words.enDefinition: an account that earns interest on money kept in it

examples.en: Our landlord put the deposit in an interest-bearing account and sent us the bank confirmation.
examples.zh: 房东把押金存进了「计息账户」，还发来了银行的确认凭证。

examples.en: I asked whether the interest-bearing account provided an annual statement we could keep for our records.
examples.zh: 我问这个「计息账户」是否提供年度账单，以便我们留存。

collocations: deposit funds in an interest-bearing account

words.enDefinition: a connection that repeatedly drops and comes back

examples.en: The intermittent connection made it hard to follow the lecturer's instructions from home.
examples.zh: 网络「间歇断线」，我在家很难跟上老师的讲解。

examples.en: I reported an intermittent connection after my video call froze for the third time.
examples.zh: 视频通话第三次卡住后，我报修了网络「间歇断线」的问题。

words.enDefinition: a problem that appears and disappears at different times

examples.en: I recorded a video of the intermittent fault before the door buzzer started working again.
examples.zh: 门铃呼叫装置恢复之前，我拍下了「间歇性故障」的视频。

examples.en: The technician asked when the intermittent fault usually happened because it did not occur during his visit.
examples.zh: 技术员上门时故障没出现，他就问「间歇性故障」通常什么时候发生。

collocations: an intermittent fault in the system

words.enDefinition: a period when an internet service is unavailable

examples.en: An internet outage cut off my video call halfway through the student meeting.
examples.zh: 学生会议开到一半时，「网络中断」把我的视频通话切断了。

examples.en: I checked whether the internet outage affected other flats before calling for help.
examples.zh: 联系报修之前，我查了这次「网络中断」有没有影响别的公寓。

words.enDefinition: a company that supplies internet access to homes and businesses

examples.en: Our internet service provider asked us to restart the router before arranging a visit.
examples.zh: 「互联网服务提供商」让我们先重启路由器，再安排人员上门。

examples.en: I compared reviews before choosing an internet service provider for the new flat.
examples.zh: 给新公寓选「互联网服务提供商」之前，我先比较了评价。

words.enDefinition: to tell nearby residents your name when you first meet

examples.en: It's easier to introduce yourself to the neighbours when you see them outside.
examples.zh: 在室外碰到邻居时，比较容易开口「向邻居自我介绍」。

examples.en: My flatmate told me, “Introduce yourself to the neighbours before asking about bin day.”
examples.zh: 室友说，在问哪天收垃圾之前，先「向邻居自我介绍」。

collocations: remember to introduce yourself to the neighbours
go and introduce yourself to the neighbours
try to introduce yourself to the neighbours

words.enDefinition: a lower starting price offered to new internet customers

examples.en: The introductory broadband rate only lasts six months, according to the order summary.
examples.zh: 订单摘要写着，「宽带首期优惠价」只维持六个月。

examples.en: We picked a shorter contract after seeing when the introductory broadband rate would end.
examples.zh: 看到「宽带首期优惠价」什么时候结束后，我们选了更短的合约。

collocations: qualify for an introductory broadband rate

words.enDefinition: a document listing individual amounts and what each covers

examples.en: We requested an itemized statement because the email gave only a single total for cleaning.
examples.zh: 邮件只给出了清洁费用总额，所以我们要求提供「逐项明细账单」。

examples.en: The itemized statement showed separate amounts for the replacement key and the missing parking pass.
examples.zh: 「逐项明细账单」分别列出了补配钥匙和补办遗失停车证的金额。

words.enDefinition: a lock that cannot turn or release as intended

examples.en: I waited in the lobby while my flatmate called the office about our jammed lock.
examples.zh: 室友给办公室打电话报告「卡住的锁」时，我在大厅里等着。

examples.en: The locksmith tried the spare key before examining the jammed lock on my bedroom door.
examples.zh: 锁匠先试了备用钥匙，再检查我卧室门上那把「卡住的锁」。

words.enDefinition: a window that cannot move in its frame

examples.en: I booked a visit because a jammed window left my room with very little ventilation.
examples.zh: 一扇「卡住的窗户」让房间没法怎么通风，我就约了人上门。

examples.en: The contractor worked on the jammed window after checking for damage to the frame.
examples.zh: 承包商检查窗框是否受损后，开始修理「卡住的窗户」。

words.enDefinition: liability enforceable against any of several responsible parties

examples.en: The adviser explained joint and several liability after my roommate asked to leave the lease.
examples.zh: 我室友提出退出租约后，顾问给我解释了「连带责任」。

examples.en: Before signing, I asked whether joint and several liability applied to damage in shared areas.
examples.zh: 签字前，我问公共区域的损坏是否适用「连带责任」。

collocations: a joint and several liability clause

words.enDefinition: security money provided together by two or more renters

examples.en: We paid a joint deposit and asked the agent how it would be split on refund.
examples.zh: 我们「共同缴纳了押金」，并问中介退款时会怎么分。

examples.en: The landlord asked everyone named on the joint deposit to confirm the refund arrangement.
examples.zh: 房东请所有列在「共同缴纳的押金」记录上的租客确认退款安排。

words.enDefinition: one rental contract signed by several tenants together

examples.en: We signed a joint lease after our adviser explained what it meant to share responsibility.
examples.zh: 顾问讲清如何共同担责后，我们签了「共同租约」。

examples.en: Could we ask the agent whether a joint lease would suit the three of us?
examples.zh: 我们能问问中介，签一份「共同租约」适不适合我们三个人吗？

collocations: be named on a joint lease

words.enDefinition: a request to make less noise

examples.en: Could you keep it down until my online interview finishes in ten minutes?
examples.zh: 能「声音小点」吗？我的线上面试还有十分钟结束。

examples.en: We asked them to keep it down because several students had exams the next day.
examples.zh: 好几个同学第二天考试，我们请他们「声音小点」。

collocations: ask someone to keep it down

words.enDefinition: to avoid leaving things that might block people in the hallway

examples.en: The warden asked us to keep the hallway clear while the kitchen was being painted.
examples.zh: 厨房刷漆时，宿舍管理员请我们「保持走廊畅通」。

examples.en: Please keep the hallway clear so everyone can get past with their moving boxes.
examples.zh: 请「保持走廊畅通」，方便大家搬着箱子通过。

collocations: try to keep the hallway clear
remember to keep the hallway clear
help to keep the hallway clear

words.enDefinition: a mode that keeps cooked food warm until served

examples.en: The cooker switched to its keep-warm setting just before my housemates came home for dinner.
examples.zh: 室友到家吃饭前，锅刚切换到「保温档」。

examples.en: I used the keep-warm setting while we waited for the rest of the meal to finish.
examples.zh: 等其余菜做好期间，我用了「保温档」。

words.enDefinition: a secure box for returning keys without meeting someone

examples.en: The office was closed, so I left the keys in the key drop box.
examples.zh: 办公室关门了，我就把钥匙投进「钥匙投递箱」。

examples.en: Reception told us the key drop box was next to the front entrance.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我们，「钥匙投递箱」就在正门旁边。

collocations: leave keys in the key drop box

words.enDefinition: money charged for issuing a substitute for a missing key

examples.en: I paid the key replacement fee because one of the apartment keys disappeared during our move.
examples.zh: 搬家时有一把公寓钥匙找不到了，我交了「补配钥匙费」。

examples.en: The office reversed the key replacement fee after I found the key and handed it in.
examples.zh: 我找到钥匙并交回去后，办公室撤销了「补配钥匙费」。

words.enDefinition: a secure box for storing keys at a property

examples.en: The manager took the keys from the key safe so the contractor could start early.
examples.zh: 物业经理从「钥匙保管盒」里取出钥匙，好让承包商早点开工。

examples.en: I asked whether the building had a key safe before making arrangements to let the plumber in.
examples.zh: 在安排怎么让水管工进门之前，我问楼里有没有「钥匙保管盒」。

collocations: put the key in a key safe

words.enDefinition: the energy used by one kilowatt over one hour

examples.en: The new plan charges less for each kilowatt-hour we use overnight at home.
examples.zh: 新套餐下，我们夜间每用一个「千瓦时」都比以前便宜。

examples.en: I compared the price per kilowatt-hour on both offers before choosing a supplier.
examples.zh: 选供应商之前，我对比了两个报价里每「千瓦时」的价格。

words.enDefinition: to knock on a neighbouring home's door

examples.en: I went to knock next door after hearing water running down the wall.
examples.zh: 听到水沿墙往下流，我就去「敲了隔壁的门」。

examples.en: Could you knock next door and ask whether our parcel was delivered there?
examples.zh: 你能「敲一下隔壁的门」，问问包裹是不是送过去了吗？

words.enDefinition: to mark food with your name so people know who owns it

examples.en: Please label your food before putting it in the fridge on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 食物放进一楼冰箱之前，请先「给自己的食物贴标签」。

examples.en: You don't need to label your food if it's for everyone in the house.
examples.zh: 如果是给全屋人一起吃的，就不用「给自己的食物贴标签」。

collocations: label your food with your name

words.enDefinition: the amount billed for a worker's time on a job

examples.en: The invoice listed a labor charge but didn't say how long the worker had been there.
examples.zh: 发票列了「人工费」，但没有说明工人在那里干了多久。

examples.en: We agreed to the labor charge after the repair company explained its minimum call-out time.
examples.zh: 维修公司说明最低上门计时后，我们同意支付这笔「人工费」。

words.enDefinition: a shelving unit with shelves arranged like steps on a ladder

examples.en: I put a ladder shelf beside the window for books and plants.
examples.zh: 我在窗边放了个「梯形置物架」，用来放书和植物。

examples.en: The ladder shelf is narrow enough to fit between my desk and door.
examples.zh: 这个「梯形置物架」够窄，能放进书桌和门之间。

collocations: lean a ladder shelf against the wall

words.enDefinition: duties the owner owes to renters under an agreement

examples.en: I checked the landlord obligations in our lease after the building's front lock stopped working.
examples.zh: 楼门锁坏了以后，我看了租约关于「房东义务」的规定。

examples.en: The student guide covers landlord obligations for common areas in buildings with several rented flats.
examples.zh: 学生指南介绍了一栋楼里有多套出租公寓时，公共区域方面的「房东义务」。

words.enDefinition: a previous landlord's opinion of you as a tenant

examples.en: My landlord in Vancouver sent a landlord reference saying I always paid on time.
examples.zh: 温哥华的房东给我写了封「房东推荐信」，说我从没拖欠过房租。

examples.en: A missing landlord reference slows down the whole referencing process.
examples.zh: 少了「房东推荐信」，整个审查流程都会被拖慢。

words.enDefinition: the landlord's obligation to keep certain property components working

examples.en: The adviser explained the landlord's duty to repair after we described the damp in our bedrooms.
examples.zh: 我们说了卧室受潮的情况，顾问解释了「房东的维修义务」。

examples.en: I asked whether a broken stair rail might fall within the landlord's duty to repair.
examples.zh: 我问坏掉的楼梯扶手是否属于「房东的维修义务」。

collocations: explain the landlord's duty to repair
understand the landlord's duty to repair
comply with the landlord's duty to repair

words.enDefinition: the circumstances in which a landlord may enter

examples.en: I checked the landlord's right of entry after a contractor arrived while I was in class.
examples.zh: 维修人员在我上课时到了，我就去查了「房东入内权」的规定。

examples.en: The adviser explained the landlord's right of entry before I decided what to ask the agent.
examples.zh: 顾问先解释了「房东入内权」，我才决定要问中介什么。

collocations: limits on the landlord's right of entry
explain the landlord's right of entry
exercise the landlord's right of entry

words.enDefinition: a rushed housing search just before term starts

examples.en: A last-minute search in August left me choosing between two awful rooms.
examples.zh: 八月的「临时找房」让我只能在两个糟糕的房间之间挑。

examples.en: Avoid a last-minute search by listing your requirements before you land.
examples.zh: 落地前先把需求列清楚，避免「临时找房」。

words.enDefinition: an extra amount billed because a payment was late

examples.en: The office added a late charge even though I paid on Friday.
examples.zh: 虽然我星期五已经付了钱，办公室还是加收了「逾期费」。

examples.en: I paid before the weekend to avoid a late charge on my rent.
examples.zh: 为了不让房租产生「逾期费」，我在周末前就付了。

words.enDefinition: a message saying a required payment missed its deadline

examples.en: I received a late payment notice while I was away on a field trip.
examples.zh: 我在外参加实地考察时收到了一封「付款逾期通知」。

examples.en: I replied to the late payment notice with a copy of my receipt.
examples.zh: 我回复了那封「付款逾期通知」，附上了一份收据。

collocations: respond to a late payment notice

words.enDefinition: a toilet tank that allows water to escape

examples.en: We took a picture of the leaking cistern before the plumber visited the shared bathroom.
examples.zh: 水管工来共用浴室之前，我们拍了张「漏水的马桶水箱」的照片。

examples.en: The contractor found a leaking cistern had left the floor damp behind the toilet.
examples.zh: 承包商发现，马桶后面地板潮湿是因为有个「漏水的马桶水箱」。

words.enDefinition: a shower base that lets water escape into surrounding areas

examples.en: The leaking shower tray left a wet patch on the ceiling of the apartment below.
examples.zh: 「漏水的淋浴底盘」让楼下公寓的天花板出现一块湿痕。

examples.en: The contractor tested the leaking shower tray after my landlord gave permission to enter.
examples.zh: 房东同意进入后，承包商检查了「漏水的淋浴底盘」。

words.enDefinition: a document that adds terms to an existing lease

examples.en: The landlord put the bike storage arrangement in a lease addendum that we signed separately.
examples.zh: 房东把自行车存放安排写进了一份「租约补充文件」，我们单独签了字。

examples.en: Please check whether the lease addendum covers our agreement to install a second desk.
examples.zh: 请确认「租约补充文件」里是否写了我们同意再装一张书桌的事。

words.enDefinition: a document that changes terms in an existing lease

examples.en: We used a lease amendment to correct the apartment number without replacing the whole agreement.
examples.zh: 我们用「租约修订文件」纠正了公寓门牌号，整份合同不用重签。

examples.en: The lease amendment reflects the date we agreed on after my exchange placement changed.
examples.zh: 我交换项目的安排有变，「租约修订文件」上写的是后来商定的日期。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of a tenant's lease interest to someone else

examples.en: My classmate asked about a lease assignment when I said I was transferring universities.
examples.zh: 我说要转学时，同学问能不能办理「租约转让」。

examples.en: The landlord wanted to meet my replacement before approving the lease assignment we had requested.
examples.zh: 房东想先见见接替我的租客，再批准我们申请的「租约转让」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for transferring an existing lease to another person

examples.en: The manager quoted a lease assignment fee when another student agreed to take over my tenancy.
examples.zh: 另一名学生同意接手我的租约时，物业经理给出了「租约转让手续费」的报价。

examples.en: We asked who was responsible for the lease assignment fee before sending in the paperwork.
examples.zh: 提交材料前，我们问清了「租约转让手续费」由谁来付。

words.enDefinition: the date when the agreed rental period ends

examples.en: I put the lease end date in my phone so I could plan my flight.
examples.zh: 我把「租约到期日」存进手机，方便安排航班。

examples.en: Please confirm the lease end date before I book a van to move my things.
examples.zh: 请先确认「租约到期日」，我再预约搬东西用的货车。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement that lengthens the existing agreement's duration

examples.en: My thesis defense was postponed, so I asked the landlord for a short lease extension.
examples.zh: 论文答辩推迟了，我就问房东能不能短期「延长租约」。

examples.en: The manager confirmed a lease extension through September after the incoming tenant changed her plans.
examples.zh: 新租客改了计划，物业经理确认可以「延长租约」到九月底。

words.enDefinition: an individual rule or condition in a rental contract

examples.en: A lease provision lets us keep bicycles in a locked room on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 一项「租约规定」允许我们把自行车停在底层一个上锁的房间里。

examples.en: I asked the adviser how to interpret the lease provision about renewing after graduation.
examples.zh: 我请顾问解释毕业后续租的那项「租约规定」。

words.enDefinition: the continuation of a lease for a new term

examples.en: I saved the email about lease renewal so my roommate could read it after her class.
examples.zh: 我留着有关「租约续签」的邮件，让室友下课后也能看。

examples.en: The leasing office handles lease renewal once students confirm they are staying for another year.
examples.zh: 学生确认要再住一年后，租赁办公室会办理「租约续签」。

words.enDefinition: an attachment listing detailed information that supplements a lease

examples.en: The lease schedule lists the items the landlord agreed to leave in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 「租约附表」列出了房东同意留在厨房里的物品。

examples.en: I checked the lease schedule to see which storage locker came with the apartment.
examples.zh: 我看了看「租约附表」，想知道公寓配的是哪一个储物柜。

collocations: list an item in the lease schedule

words.enDefinition: the period for which a rental agreement is in effect

examples.en: We asked for a shorter lease term to match the length of our research placement.
examples.zh: 为了配合科研实习时间，我们要求缩短「租约期限」。

examples.en: Before signing, I checked whether the lease term covered the entire academic year in Toronto.
examples.zh: 签字前，我确认了「租约期限」是否覆盖我在多伦多的整个学年。

words.expression: leave it as you found it
words.lemma: leave it as you found it
words.enDefinition: a request to return a place or object to its prior condition
acceptedEnVariants: leave it as you found it

examples.en: If you use our shared study room, please leave it as you found it.
examples.zh: 如果使用我们的共用自习室，请「用完恢复原样」。

examples.en: The note says to leave it as you found it after using the laundry room.
examples.zh: 纸条上写着，洗衣房「用完要恢复原样」。

collocations: please leave it as you found it
remember to leave it as you found it
try to leave it as you found it

words.enDefinition: a service offering legal help to eligible people

examples.en: A fellow student told me the legal aid clinic could read my rental agreement with me.
examples.zh: 另一位同学说，「法律援助咨询点」可以和我一起看租房合同。

examples.en: I called the legal aid clinic after my landlord sent an unexpected letter about the lease.
examples.zh: 房东突然发来一封有关租约的信，我就打电话给「法律援助咨询点」。

collocations: an appointment at a legal aid clinic

words.enDefinition: the person who leases property from another party

examples.en: The contract lists me as the lessee because I am renting the studio myself.
examples.zh: 合同上我是「承租人」，因为这套开间是我自己租的。

examples.en: Please check that the name of the lessee matches the name on your passport.
examples.zh: 请核对「承租人」的姓名是否和护照上的一致。

words.enDefinition: the party that grants another person a lease

examples.en: I had to look up lessor before I knew which signature was the landlord's.
examples.zh: 我查了一下「出租人」这个词，才知道哪个签名是房东的。

examples.en: The student asked the lessor for permission to repaint the bedroom over the summer.
examples.zh: 学生问「出租人」能否在暑假重新粉刷卧室。

words.enDefinition: to open the door and admit the technician

examples.en: Could you let the technician in if I am still on campus when she arrives?
examples.zh: 技术员到的时候如果我还在学校，你能「让技术员进屋」吗？

examples.en: I offered to let the technician in because my roommate was taking an online exam.
examples.zh: 室友在参加线上考试，我主动去「让技术员进屋」。

collocations: be home to let the technician in
arrange to let the technician in
wait to let the technician in

words.enDefinition: a written warning that legal action may follow unless a dispute is resolved

examples.en: The adviser helped me write a letter before action about the amount still owed to us.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我就尚未退还的款项写了一份「诉前告知函」。

examples.en: The landlord responded to our letter before action with a copy of the missing repair invoice.
examples.zh: 房东回复了我们的「诉前告知函」，附上了先前缺失的维修发票副本。

collocations: reply to a letter before action

words.enDefinition: permission to occupy property without granting a tenancy

examples.en: The adviser explained the licence to occupy that the hall office had asked me to sign.
examples.zh: 宿舍办公室让我签一份「居住使用许可」，顾问给我解释了它的意思。

examples.en: I compared the licence to occupy with the document my previous landlord called a lease.
examples.zh: 我把「居住使用许可」和上一位房东称作租约的那份文件做了比较。

words.enDefinition: substituting an item with another of comparable kind and quality

examples.en: The manager requested a like-for-like replacement after one of the dining chairs broke during our tenancy.
examples.zh: 租期内一把餐椅坏了，物业经理要求做「同等规格更换」。

examples.en: We found a like-for-like replacement online that cost less than the chair quoted by the agent.
examples.zh: 我们在网上找到了可用于「同等规格更换」的椅子，比中介报价里的椅子便宜。

collocations: the cost of a like-for-like replacement

words.enDefinition: a screen that catches fibers released while clothes dry

examples.en: I checked the lint trap before using the shared dryer, as the sign asked.
examples.zh: 我按提示牌上的要求，先检查了「绒屑过滤网」，再用共用烘干机。

examples.en: The residence put a label near the lint trap so new students could find it.
examples.zh: 宿舍在「绒屑过滤网」旁贴了标签，方便新生找到它。

words.enDefinition: a notification when a matching rental is posted

examples.en: Set up a listing alert with your budget so good places reach you first.
examples.zh: 按你的预算设置一个「房源提醒」，好房子会第一时间推送给你。

examples.en: My listing alert woke me up at midnight because a room near campus opened.
examples.zh: 半夜「房源提醒」把我吵醒了，学校附近出了间空房。

words.enDefinition: the images attached to a rental advertisement

examples.en: Zoom into the listing photos to spot damp corners and old sockets.
examples.zh: 把「房源照片」放大看，找出潮湿的角落和老化的插座。

examples.en: She sent photos of the unit taken that morning, not stock listing photos.
examples.zh: 她发来的是当天早上拍的房间实照，不是库存的「房源照片」。

words.enDefinition: a website where landlords post places for rent

examples.en: This listing site lets you filter apartments by price and distance to campus.
examples.zh: 这个「房源平台」可以按价格和到学校的距离筛选公寓。

examples.en: Compare the same apartment on two listing sites before you book a viewing.
examples.zh: 约看房之前，先在两个「房源平台」上对比同一套公寓。

collocations: filter results on a listing site

words.enDefinition: the activity of collecting rubbish from outdoor public spaces

examples.en: I joined the neighbours for litter picking along our street on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 周六上午我和邻居们一起沿街「捡拾散落垃圾」。

examples.en: The student union supplied gloves for litter picking near the local bus stops.
examples.zh: 学生会为公交站附近的「捡拾散落垃圾」活动提供了手套。

words.enDefinition: to put the items being moved inside a van

examples.en: The driver let us load the van while he checked the new address.
examples.zh: 司机去核对新地址，让我们先「把东西装上货车」。

examples.en: We had to load the van before the student housing office closed for lunch.
examples.zh: 我们得在住宿办公室午休关门前「把东西装上货车」。

words.enDefinition: a designated space where vehicles load and unload cargo

examples.en: The caretaker told us to use the loading bay instead of blocking the entrance.
examples.zh: 管理员让我们用「装卸区」，别堵在入口。

examples.en: Our building only lets residents reserve the loading bay for two hours at a time.
examples.zh: 我们这栋楼的住户一次只能预约「装卸区」两小时。

words.enDefinition: a move between homes within the same area

examples.en: We booked a local move because our two flats were in the same neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 两套公寓在同一片街区，我们约的是「本地搬家」。

examples.en: The company had a weekday slot for a local move at the end of term.
examples.zh: 学期末那家公司有个工作日的「本地搬家」时段。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement for collecting an item nearby rather than shipping it

examples.en: The seller offers local pickup at a garage two blocks from campus.
examples.zh: 卖家支持「当地自提」，地点在离学校两个街区的车库。

examples.en: I chose local pickup so I could check the desk before paying.
examples.zh: 我选了「当地自提」，这样付钱前能先看桌子。

collocations: list an item for local pickup

words.enDefinition: small wheels fitted with brakes to keep furniture stationary

examples.en: The storage cart has locking casters so it stays next to my desk.
examples.zh: 收纳车装了「带锁脚轮」，能稳稳停在书桌旁。

examples.en: I checked the locking casters before putting heavy books on the rolling shelf.
examples.zh: 把重书放到带轮书架上之前，我检查了「带锁脚轮」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for letting a locked-out occupant back inside

examples.en: My landlord warned me about the lockout fee before coming over to let me inside.
examples.zh: 房东来给我开门之前，先告诉我需要付「开门服务费」。

examples.en: The residence charges a lockout fee after hours, so I left a spare key with my roommate.
examples.zh: 宿舍下班后帮忙开门要收「开门服务费」，所以我把一把备用钥匙交给了室友。

words.enDefinition: a contract for renting space in the owner's home

examples.en: I read the lodger agreement before moving into a furnished room in the owner's home.
examples.zh: 搬进屋主家里一间带家具的房间前，我看了「寄宿租住协议」。

examples.en: The lodger agreement says when I can use the kitchen while the owner is at home.
examples.zh: 「寄宿租住协议」写明了屋主在家时，我在什么时间能用厨房。

words.enDefinition: a raised bed with usable open space below it

examples.en: I put my desk under the loft bed to make room for a chair.
examples.zh: 我把书桌搬到「高架床」下，腾出地方放椅子。

examples.en: The ceiling is too low for a loft bed in this attic room.
examples.zh: 这间阁楼房的天花板太低，放不了「高架床」。

collocations: put a desk under a loft bed

words.enDefinition: to enter a repair problem in a tracking system

examples.en: The receptionist offered to log a repair for me when the online form would not load.
examples.zh: 在线表单加载不出来，前台主动帮我「登记报修」。

examples.en: Can you log a repair for the loose railing outside my apartment on the second floor?
examples.zh: 你能把我二楼公寓外的栏杆松动问题「登记报修」吗？

collocations: ask someone to log a repair

words.enDefinition: a move that covers a considerable distance between homes

examples.en: I sold the desk before my long-distance move rather than paying to transport it.
examples.zh: 「长途搬家」之前我卖掉了书桌，省得花钱运过去。

examples.en: A long-distance move can take longer if the company combines several customers' loads.
examples.zh: 如果搬家公司把几家的物品合车运输，「长途搬家」可能更费时间。

words.enDefinition: a visitor who stays for an extended period

examples.en: The lease defines a long-term guest as anyone who stays beyond the stated number of nights.
examples.zh: 租约把留宿超过指定晚数的人定义为「长期留宿访客」。

examples.en: I asked whether my cousin would count as a long-term guest during her summer course.
examples.zh: 我问表姐暑期上课期间住在我这里算不算「长期留宿访客」。

collocations: notify management about a long-term guest

words.enDefinition: a rental meant to last a year or more

examples.en: Landlords prefer a long-term rental because it avoids empty months.
examples.zh: 房东更喜欢「长租」，因为不用愁空置的月份。

examples.en: Sign a long-term rental only after you have walked the neighborhood at night.
examples.zh: 晚上在社区走过一遍之后，再签「长租」也不迟。

words.enDefinition: searching for someone to share your rented home

examples.en: My post says I am looking for a roommate to share a two-bedroom flat.
examples.zh: 我的帖子写着「找室友」，一起合租两居室。

examples.en: I have been looking for a roommate since Maya moved back home.
examples.zh: 自从玛雅搬回家之后，我一直在「找室友」。

words.enDefinition: a round door handle that moves more than intended

examples.en: I reported the loose doorknob after it nearly came off in my hand one morning.
examples.zh: 一天早上门把手差点被我拉掉，我就报修了这个「松动的圆形门把手」。

examples.en: My roommate showed the maintenance worker the loose doorknob in our hallway on Friday.
examples.zh: 星期五，室友带维修人员看了走廊里那个「松动的圆形门把手」。

words.enDefinition: a floorboard that shifts because it is not secure

examples.en: My landlord agreed to secure a loose floorboard that moved whenever I crossed the hallway.
examples.zh: 有一块地板条每次我走过走廊都会动，房东同意固定这块「松动的地板条」。

examples.en: The contractor marked the loose floorboard with tape before going downstairs to get his tools.
examples.zh: 承包商用胶带标记了「松动的地板条」，才下楼去拿工具。

words.enDefinition: a support rail that moves when held

examples.en: The office sent someone to inspect the loose handrail after we reported it near the stairs.
examples.zh: 我们报告楼梯附近的「松动的扶手」之后，办公室派人来检查。

examples.en: I told the new tenants about the loose handrail while we waited for the repair.
examples.zh: 等维修期间，我向新租客提到了那段「松动的扶手」。

words.enDefinition: a hinge that has shifted or is poorly secured

examples.en: I mentioned the loose hinge after the kitchen door started sagging on one side.
examples.zh: 厨房门一边开始下垂，我就报告了这处「松动的铰链」。

examples.en: The worker spotted a loose hinge while inspecting the utility cupboard outside our apartment.
examples.zh: 工人检查我们公寓外的设备柜时，发现有一个「松动的铰链」。

words.enDefinition: an electrical outlet that has become physically loose

examples.en: I photographed the loose outlet from a distance and sent the picture to my landlord.
examples.zh: 我在远处拍下了「松动的电源插座」，把照片发给房东。

examples.en: The manager sent an electrician to assess the loose outlet beside my desk on Monday.
examples.zh: 物业经理星期一派了电工，来检查我书桌旁边那个「松动的电源插座」。

words.enDefinition: a toilet seat that shifts because it is not secure

examples.en: I reported the loose toilet seat after it shifted every time someone sat down.
examples.zh: 一坐上去马桶圈就会移位，我就报修了这个「松动的马桶圈」。

examples.en: The manager asked for a photo of the loose toilet seat before assigning the request.
examples.zh: 物业经理先要了一张「松动的马桶圈」的照片，再分派工单。

words.enDefinition: a towel rail that is not firmly attached

examples.en: I reported the loose towel rail as soon as I noticed it pulling away from the wall.
examples.zh: 我一发现毛巾架开始脱离墙面，就报修了这个「松动的毛巾架」。

examples.en: The technician brought new fittings for the loose towel rail in the shared bathroom.
examples.zh: 技术员带来了新的固定配件，用来修共用浴室里「松动的毛巾架」。

words.enDefinition: a compact sofa with room for two people

examples.en: The loveseat gives us somewhere to sit without taking up the whole room.
examples.zh: 有了「双人小沙发」，我们有地方坐，又不会把整间房占满。

examples.en: My roommate found a gray loveseat that would fit under the window.
examples.zh: 室友找到了一张能放在窗下的灰色「双人小沙发」。

words.enDefinition: insufficient force in the water coming through the pipes

examples.en: The low water pressure made it hard to shower on the top floor during busy mornings.
examples.zh: 早高峰时顶楼「水压偏低」，洗澡很不方便。

examples.en: I asked whether the low water pressure affected the entire building or just our flat.
examples.zh: 我问「水压偏低」是整栋楼都有的问题，还是只发生在我们公寓。

collocations: low water pressure in the shower

words.enDefinition: a chair feature that supports the lower back

examples.en: The chair has lumbar support, which I can move higher or lower.
examples.zh: 这把椅子有「腰部支撑」，我可以把它往上或往下调。

examples.en: I wanted some lumbar support for the chair I use during long study sessions.
examples.zh: 我长时间学习时坐的椅子，需要一点「腰部支撑」。

words.enDefinition: a postal service that sends mail from an old address to a new one

examples.en: I arranged mail forwarding because my internship letters might still go to the old flat.
examples.zh: 实习信件可能还会寄到旧公寓，所以我办了「邮件转寄」。

examples.en: Set up mail forwarding before moving if you are expecting any important letters.
examples.zh: 如果还在等重要信件，搬家前办好「邮件转寄」。

words.enDefinition: a collection of reported jobs still waiting for completion

examples.en: The manager apologized for the maintenance backlog that had built up during the winter holidays.
examples.zh: 物业经理为寒假期间「积压的维修工作」道歉。

examples.en: I asked whether our bathroom fault was still in the maintenance backlog after two weeks.
examples.zh: 两周过去了，我问浴室的故障是不是还在「积压的维修工作」里。

words.enDefinition: a person or company hired to maintain a property

examples.en: The landlord hired a maintenance contractor to repair the handrail outside our shared apartment.
examples.zh: 房东请了「维修承包商」来修我们合租公寓外的扶手。

examples.en: I asked when the maintenance contractor would arrive so I could meet them downstairs.
examples.zh: 我问「维修承包商」什么时候到，方便下楼接人。

words.enDefinition: a team of workers who maintain a building

examples.en: The maintenance crew closed the side entrance while they worked on the damaged steps.
examples.zh: 「维修班组」在修损坏的台阶时关闭了侧门。

examples.en: My roommate left a note for the maintenance crew beside the broken cabinet door.
examples.zh: 室友把给「维修班组」的便条留在了坏掉的橱柜门旁。

words.enDefinition: a phone number for reporting building maintenance problems

examples.en: I saved the maintenance hotline on my phone before moving into the university flat.
examples.zh: 搬进学校公寓前，我把「报修热线」存进了手机。

examples.en: The maintenance hotline redirected me to reception because my problem could wait until the morning.
examples.zh: 因为我的问题可以等到早上处理，「报修热线」把我转接给了前台。

words.enDefinition: a record of problems reported and work carried out

examples.en: We checked the maintenance log to see how often our stairwell door had needed repairs.
examples.zh: 我们查了「维护记录」，看楼梯间的门总共修过几次。

examples.en: The manager updated the maintenance log after the contractor replaced the loose handrail upstairs.
examples.zh: 承包商换了楼上松动的扶手后，物业经理更新了「维护记录」。

words.enDefinition: a website for submitting and tracking maintenance requests

examples.en: The maintenance portal lets me choose which room has the problem before adding a description.
examples.zh: 「在线报修平台」让我先选择出问题的房间，再补充描述。

examples.en: I could not upload the photo at first because the maintenance portal limits attachment sizes.
examples.zh: 由于「在线报修平台」限制附件大小，我起初没能上传照片。

collocations: upload photos to the maintenance portal

words.enDefinition: a formal request for work on rented property

examples.en: I filed a maintenance request when the kitchen sink stopped draining after dinner last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚吃完饭发现厨房水槽不排水，我就提交了「报修申请」。

examples.en: The building manager called about my maintenance request while I was walking home from class.
examples.zh: 我下课走回家时，物业经理打电话问起我的「报修申请」。

words.enDefinition: a trained worker who diagnoses and repairs building faults

examples.en: The maintenance technician asked which window was sticking before bringing tools up to the flat.
examples.zh: 「维修技术员」把工具拿上楼前，先问公寓里哪扇窗户卡住了。

examples.en: I met the maintenance technician downstairs and showed him where the bathroom ceiling was leaking.
examples.zh: 我在楼下接到「维修技术员」，带他看了浴室天花板漏水的位置。

words.enDefinition: a numbered record for tracking a maintenance problem

examples.en: The portal created a maintenance ticket and showed who would handle the leaking bathroom drain.
examples.zh: 门户网站生成了「报修工单」，并显示谁来处理浴室排水口漏水的问题。

examples.en: I gave reception my maintenance ticket number so they could find the original report.
examples.zh: 我把「报修工单」的编号告诉前台，方便他们找到最初的报修记录。

words.enDefinition: to restore the property after it has been damaged

examples.en: The contractor agreed to make good the damage around the window after finishing the repair.
examples.zh: 承包商同意维修完毕后，「修复由此造成的损坏」，把窗边恢复原状。

examples.en: Our lease asks residents to make good the damage caused by removing fixtures they installed.
examples.zh: 我们的租约要求住户拆除自行安装的固定装置后，「修复所造成的损坏」。

collocations: make good the damage to the wall
agree to make good the damage
be required to make good the damage

words.enDefinition: write the name of a particular recipient on a check

examples.en: Please make the check out to the university, not to your residence adviser.
examples.zh: 请把「支票收款人写成」大学，而不是宿舍管理员。

examples.en: Should I make the check out to the owner or the rental company?
examples.zh: 我应该把「支票收款人写成」房东还是租赁公司？

collocations: say who to make the check out to
make the check out to the landlord
make the check out to the housing office

words.enDefinition: a person hired with a van to move a small load

examples.en: We hired a man with a van to take our boxes across town.
examples.zh: 我们雇了个「个人搬运司机」，把装箱的东西运到城另一头。

examples.en: A man with a van was cheaper than hiring a whole removal crew.
examples.zh: 请一个「个人搬运司机」比雇整支搬家队便宜。

collocations: hire a man with a van
book a man with a van

words.enDefinition: to label a request as needing quick attention

examples.en: The form says mark as urgent if the landlord needs to know about the problem immediately.
examples.zh: 表单说如果要马上让房东知道问题，就「标记为紧急」。

examples.en: I asked which cases the housing office would mark as urgent on the maintenance dashboard.
examples.zh: 我问住房办公室会把哪些情况在维修后台「标记为紧急」。

collocations: mark as urgent on the form

words.enDefinition: a failure that substantially undermines an agreement

examples.en: The adviser asked which obligation I thought was serious enough to constitute a material breach.
examples.zh: 顾问问我，哪项义务没履行的后果严重到足以构成「重大违约」。

examples.en: We read the letter together because the term material breach was new to both of us.
examples.zh: 我们一起看了那封信，因为两个人都没见过「重大违约」这个词。

words.enDefinition: the amount spent on items needed to do work

examples.en: The materials cost was low because the carpenter only needed screws and a small bracket.
examples.zh: 木工只用了螺丝和一个小支架，所以「材料成本」不高。

examples.en: The invoice showed a materials cost that was much higher than we expected for one shelf.
examples.zh: 发票上列的「材料成本」远高于我们对一块搁板的预估。

words.enDefinition: a large protective bag used to cover a mattress during transport

examples.en: We put the mattress in a mattress bag before carrying it through the rain.
examples.zh: 我们把床垫套进「床垫防护袋」，才冒雨把它搬出去。

examples.en: The mattress bag tore when we tried to squeeze it through the narrow doorway.
examples.zh: 我们试着把床垫挤过窄门时，「床垫防护袋」撕裂了。

collocations: put a mattress in a mattress bag

words.enDefinition: a covering that shields a mattress from moisture and stains

examples.en: I bought a mattress protector before bringing my coffee anywhere near the bed.
examples.zh: 我先买了「床垫保护套」，这才敢把咖啡端到床边。

examples.en: The hall cleaner gave us a new mattress protector at the start of term.
examples.zh: 开学时，宿舍保洁员给了我们一个新的「床垫保护套」。

words.enDefinition: a provision directing parties to try facilitated negotiation

examples.en: The adviser pointed to the mediation clause when I asked how we could resolve the disagreement.
examples.zh: 我问怎么解决分歧，顾问指给我看了「调解条款」。

examples.en: I checked what the mediation clause said before contacting the neighborhood housing advice service.
examples.zh: 我先看了「调解条款」的内容，再联系社区的住房咨询服务。

words.enDefinition: a meeting where a neutral person helps both parties negotiate

examples.en: We booked a mediation session after disagreeing with the charges for repainting the living room.
examples.zh: 我们不同意客厅重刷的费用，随后预约了一场「调解会议」。

examples.en: My roommate brought both copies of the inventory to the mediation session on Monday.
examples.zh: 周一的「调解会议」上，我室友带来了两份房屋清单。

words.enDefinition: to get to know the people living near you

examples.en: I finally got to meet the neighbours when we all cleared the courtyard.
examples.zh: 大家一起收拾庭院时，我终于有机会「认识邻居」。

examples.en: The building manager organised a barbecue so new students could meet the neighbours.
examples.zh: 管理员组织了场烧烤，让新来的同学有机会「认识邻居」。

collocations: a chance to meet the neighbours

words.enDefinition: spend time with future flatmates before agreeing

examples.en: Always meet the roommates before signing because chemistry matters more than rent.
examples.zh: 签约前一定要「和室友见面」，合不合得来比房租更重要。

examples.en: Can I meet the roommates this Thursday evening after my seminar?
examples.zh: 我可以周四讨论课之后「和室友见面」吗？

words.enDefinition: a mattress made with foam that molds to the body

examples.en: The memory foam mattress came rolled up in a surprisingly small box.
examples.zh: 「记忆棉床垫」是卷起来装的，箱子小得出乎意料。

examples.en: I tried a memory foam mattress in the shop before ordering one online.
examples.zh: 我先去店里试了「记忆棉床垫」，再上网下单。

collocations: sleep on a memory foam mattress

words.enDefinition: a chair with an open-weave fabric seat or back

examples.en: The mesh chair felt cooler than the padded one during the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午天气热的时候，「网布椅」坐起来比软垫椅凉快。

examples.en: I found a secondhand mesh chair for my desk at the campus fair.
examples.zh: 我在校园集市上找到了一把二手「网布椅」，配我的书桌用。

collocations: a mesh chair with lumbar support

words.enDefinition: the ability to reach a meter for inspection or reading

examples.en: I asked the building manager about meter access before the supplier's visit tomorrow.
examples.zh: 供应商明天上门前，我先问了管理员怎么取得「进入抄表处的权限」。

examples.en: We arranged meter access with reception because the cupboard was never left unlocked.
examples.zh: 仪表柜平时总是锁着，我们就跟前台约好了供应商怎么「进入抄表处」。

words.enDefinition: a cupboard that houses utility meters in a property

examples.en: The meter cupboard is in the hall, next to the entrance to the basement.
examples.zh: 「仪表柜」在门厅，就在地下室入口旁边。

examples.en: The caretaker unlocked the meter cupboard so I could photograph the reading before moving out.
examples.zh: 管理员打开了「仪表柜」，好让我搬出去之前拍下读数。

words.enDefinition: the UK identifier for a property's gas supply point

examples.en: The new supplier asked for the meter point reference number on my old bill.
examples.zh: 新供应商让我提供旧账单上的「燃气供气点编号」。

examples.en: We needed the meter point reference number when we changed the gas account over.
examples.zh: 我们办理燃气账户转移时，需要提供「燃气供气点编号」。

collocations: look up a meter point reference number
find your meter point reference number
provide your meter point reference number

words.enDefinition: the number shown on a meter at a particular time

examples.en: I wrote down the meter reading before we handed our keys back on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五交还钥匙之前，我记下了「仪表读数」。

examples.en: The supplier asked for a meter reading from the day our tenancy started.
examples.zh: 供应商要我们提供租期开始当天的「仪表读数」。

words.enDefinition: the installation of a new meter in place of an old one

examples.en: The landlord gave us a window for the meter replacement on Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 房东告诉我们周二下午「更换计量表」的大致时间。

examples.en: I took a final photo of the old reading before the meter replacement.
examples.zh: 「更换计量表」前，我最后拍了一张旧表读数的照片。

words.enDefinition: a unique number identifying the physical meter

examples.en: The meter serial number helped us identify which meter belonged to our flat.
examples.zh: 我们靠「计量表序列号」辨认出哪个表是我们公寓的。

examples.en: I checked the meter serial number because the bill showed a different address.
examples.zh: 账单显示的是另一个地址，所以我核对了「计量表序列号」。

words.enDefinition: an appliance that cooks or heats food using microwaves

examples.en: Our floor has a microwave oven in the common room for reheating lunches after class.
examples.zh: 我们楼层的公共休息室有台「微波炉」，下课后可以热午饭。

examples.en: I bought a smaller bowl because the old one barely fit in the microwave oven.
examples.zh: 原来的碗勉强能放进「微波炉」，于是我买了个小一点的。

collocations: heat soup in a microwave oven

words.enDefinition: a small refrigerator designed for a room or countertop

examples.en: My dorm room came with a mini fridge that could hold a few drinks.
examples.zh: 我的宿舍配了个「迷你冰箱」，能放几瓶饮料。

examples.en: I left enough space next to the desk for a mini fridge of my own.
examples.zh: 我在书桌旁边留了够放一台自己用的「迷你冰箱」的空间。

collocations: store drinks in a mini fridge
fit a mini fridge under a desk

words.enDefinition: a stated minimum download speed used to assess poor service

examples.en: The sales email included a minimum guaranteed download speed for our new address.
examples.zh: 销售邮件列出了我们新地址的「最低保证下载速度」。

examples.en: I quoted the minimum guaranteed download speed when I complained about our poor connection.
examples.zh: 投诉网络质量差时，我提到了合同里的「最低保证下载速度」。

collocations: check the minimum guaranteed download speed
below the minimum guaranteed download speed
meet the minimum guaranteed download speed

words.enDefinition: the shortest period required under a rental arrangement

examples.en: I chose a different room because the minimum term was longer than my exchange program.
examples.zh: 我另外选了一个房间，因为这里的「最短租期」比我的交换项目还长。

examples.en: We asked whether the minimum term applied if we joined the lease in March.
examples.zh: 我们问如果三月加入租约，「最短租期」的规定还适不适用。

collocations: a minimum term of six months

words.enDefinition: small surface marks from objects rubbing against something

examples.en: The cabinet has minor scuffs, but all the drawers still slide smoothly.
examples.zh: 柜子有几处「轻微擦痕」，不过所有抽屉都还能顺畅推拉。

examples.en: I noticed some minor scuffs on the legs when I picked up the table.
examples.zh: 提起桌子时，我发现桌腿上有几处「轻微擦痕」。

words.enDefinition: a package delivered to the wrong person or place

examples.en: I returned a misdelivered parcel to the neighbour whose flat number was on it.
examples.zh: 有个「送错地址的包裹」，我按上面的房号还给了邻居。

examples.en: The label on the misdelivered parcel showed an address in the next block.
examples.zh: 那个「送错地址的包裹」上写的是隔壁街区的地址。

words.enDefinition: images that make the unit look better than it is

examples.en: The bedroom looked double in the ad, classic misleading photos from a wide lens.
examples.zh: 广告里卧室显得大了一倍，典型的广角「失真照片」。

examples.en: Report misleading photos so the platform can warn future renters.
examples.zh: 遇到「失真照片」要举报，让平台提醒后来的租客。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled visit that did not take place

examples.en: I phoned the office about the missed appointment after waiting at home all morning.
examples.zh: 我在家等了一个上午，就打电话给办公室问那次「未履行的预约」。

examples.en: The manager apologized for the missed appointment and offered to send another contractor the following afternoon.
examples.zh: 物业经理为那次「未履行的预约」道歉，并提出第二天下午另派承包商来。

collocations: follow up on a missed appointment

words.enDefinition: money sent or expected but absent from a record

examples.en: I called the agent about a missing payment and read out my reference number.
examples.zh: 我为一笔「查不到的付款」给中介打电话，报了付款编号。

examples.en: The office finally found the missing payment under my old room number.
examples.zh: 办公室最后在我原来的房间号下找到了那笔「查不到的付款」。

words.enDefinition: professional action to remove mold and address moisture problems

examples.en: The landlord scheduled mold remediation because the growth kept coming back in the same corner.
examples.zh: 由于霉菌总在同一个角落反复长出来，房东安排了「霉菌治理」。

examples.en: I asked which rooms would be affected during mold remediation so we could move our things.
examples.zh: 我问「霉菌治理」会影响哪些房间，以便我们搬开东西。

words.enDefinition: a prepaid document used to send money to someone

examples.en: I bought a money order at the post office to pay my rent.
examples.zh: 我在邮局买了一张「汇票」交房租。

examples.en: The front desk said I could use a money order instead of cash.
examples.zh: 前台说我可以用「汇票」代替现金。

collocations: make a money order payable to someone

words.enDefinition: a platform used to raise a computer screen

examples.en: My monitor stand leaves enough room to slide the keyboard underneath after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我可以把键盘推进「显示器增高架」下的空位。

examples.en: I use a monitor stand because the screen sits too low on my desk.
examples.zh: 显示器放在书桌上太低了，所以我用了「显示器增高架」。

words.enDefinition: internet access renewed monthly without a long minimum term

examples.en: We chose month-to-month broadband because our summer lease only lasts twelve weeks.
examples.zh: 我们的暑期租约只有十二周，所以我们选了「按月续订的宽带」。

examples.en: Month-to-month broadband looked expensive until we included the cost of leaving a longer contract.
examples.zh: 把长期合约的解约成本也算进去之后，「按月续订的宽带」就没那么贵了。

words.enDefinition: a rental arrangement that continues one month at a time

examples.en: A month-to-month tenancy gave me time to decide where I wanted to live after graduation.
examples.zh: 「按月续期的租赁」让我有时间决定毕业后住在哪里。

examples.en: I asked the agent if a month-to-month tenancy was possible during the summer placement.
examples.zh: 我问中介，暑期实习期间能不能「按月续期租住」。

words.enDefinition: one in a series of amounts due each month

examples.en: Our halls ask for one monthly installment rather than the full sum upfront.
examples.zh: 宿舍只要求逐月交「分期款」，不用一次付清。

examples.en: The final monthly installment for my dorm room is due during exams.
examples.zh: 我宿舍费最后一笔「月度分期款」在考试期间到期。

words.enDefinition: small pieces of feces left behind by mice

examples.en: My flatmate reported mouse droppings after spotting them in a cupboard away from our food.
examples.zh: 室友在一个不放食物的柜子里发现了「鼠粪」，就报告了这件事。

examples.en: The pest technician asked exactly where we had seen the mouse droppings in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 虫鼠防治人员问，我们在厨房的什么位置看到的「鼠粪」。

words.enDefinition: the total expenses associated with taking possession of a home

examples.en: I made a spreadsheet of move-in costs so my roommate and I could compare our options.
examples.zh: 我把「入住前后费用」做成了表格，方便我和室友比较几个选择。

examples.en: The move-in costs included the deposit, the access card, and the charge for booking the lift.
examples.zh: 「入住前后费用」包括押金、门禁卡费用和电梯预约费。

words.enDefinition: the day you start living in the rental

examples.en: My lease starts June first, but the move-in date is negotiable.
examples.zh: 租约六月一号生效，不过「入住日期」可以商量。

examples.en: Set the move-in date at least a week before orientation week.
examples.zh: 「入住日期」最好定在迎新周前一个星期。

words.enDefinition: a charge collected when a tenant first occupies a home

examples.en: I found a move-in fee in the cost breakdown that wasn't mentioned in the listing.
examples.zh: 我在费用明细里发现一笔房源信息没提到的「入住手续费」。

examples.en: The manager said the move-in fee covered booking the lift and registering our access cards.
examples.zh: 物业经理说「入住手续费」包含预约电梯和登记门禁卡。

words.enDefinition: a time reserved for a resident to move belongings in

examples.en: I chose the first move-in slot so my parents could drive home before dark.
examples.zh: 我选了最早的「搬入时段」，这样爸妈就能天黑前开车回家。

examples.en: Reception asked everyone to stick to their move-in slot because the lifts were busy.
examples.zh: 电梯比较忙，前台请大家按自己预约的「搬入时段」到场。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled meeting for leaving a property and handing it back

examples.en: I booked a move-out appointment for the morning after my final exam ended.
examples.zh: 我把「搬离交接预约」定在最后一门考试结束后的次日上午。

examples.en: Bring all sets of keys to your move-out appointment at the housing office.
examples.zh: 去住宿办公室办理「搬离交接预约」时，把所有钥匙都带上。

words.enDefinition: a charge collected when a tenant vacates a property

examples.en: The agent mentioned a move-out fee when we arranged to hand back the keys.
examples.zh: 我们约时间还钥匙时，中介提到了一笔「退租手续费」。

examples.en: Before paying the move-out fee, I asked the manager to explain what it covered.
examples.zh: 交「退租手续费」之前，我请物业经理说明这笔钱都用于什么。

words.enDefinition: a final check of a property's condition when tenants leave

examples.en: Our landlord arranged a move-out inspection for noon and asked both roommates to be there.
examples.zh: 房东把「退租检查」约在中午，并请两位室友都到场。

examples.en: I brought the original condition report to the move-out inspection in case there was a dispute.
examples.zh: 我带着最初的房屋状况报告参加了「退租检查」，以备发生争议。

words.enDefinition: a strong box made for packing items during a move

examples.en: One moving box was enough for all the clothes in my narrow wardrobe.
examples.zh: 我那个窄衣柜里的全部衣服，一个「搬家纸箱」就装下了。

examples.en: The corner shop gave us a moving box for the rest of our books.
examples.zh: 街角商店给了我们一个「搬家纸箱」，用来装剩下的书。

words.enDefinition: a business that transports belongings to a new home

examples.en: The moving company called to confirm when it could collect our boxes.
examples.zh: 「搬家公司」打来电话，确认什么时候来取我们的箱子。

examples.en: We booked a moving company because neither of us could drive a van.
examples.zh: 我们俩都不会开厢式货车，所以预约了「搬家公司」。

words.enDefinition: the workers who lift and transport belongings during a move

examples.en: The moving crew carried the sofa down without touching the freshly painted wall.
examples.zh: 「搬家工人组」把沙发搬下楼，没蹭到刚刷好的墙。

examples.en: I showed the moving crew which boxes needed to stay in the hallway.
examples.zh: 我告诉「搬家工人组」哪些箱子要留在走廊里。

words.enDefinition: a low wheeled platform used to move heavy items

examples.en: A moving dolly helped us slide the dresser along the hall without lifting it.
examples.zh: 借助「平板搬运车」，我们不用抬，就把五斗柜推过了走廊。

examples.en: The movers brought a moving dolly for the heavier boxes of books and records.
examples.zh: 搬家工人带了辆「平板搬运车」，用来运比较重的几箱书和唱片。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred when relocating to another home

examples.en: I set some money aside for moving expenses before signing the summer lease.
examples.zh: 签暑期租约前，我留了一笔钱付「搬家开销」。

examples.en: Our moving expenses were lower because a friend helped carry the heavy boxes.
examples.zh: 有朋友帮忙搬重箱子，我们的「搬家开销」就少了。

words.enDefinition: a list of items that are being transported during a move

examples.en: We used the moving inventory to check that every box had been delivered.
examples.zh: 我们照着「搬家物品清单」核对，确认每箱东西都送到了。

examples.en: The bookshelf was missing from the moving inventory, so I added it myself.
examples.zh: 「搬家物品清单」上漏了书架，我就自己加上了。

words.enDefinition: an estimate of what a moving service will charge

examples.en: I requested a moving quote after counting how many boxes we would have.
examples.zh: 数了大概会装几箱之后，我询了「搬家报价」。

examples.en: The moving quote included the cost of carrying everything up three flights of stairs.
examples.zh: 「搬家报价」包含把所有东西搬上三段楼梯的费用。

words.enDefinition: a sale of belongings by someone preparing to move

examples.en: We found two matching chairs at a moving sale around the corner.
examples.zh: 拐角那家正在「搬家清仓甩卖」，我们在那里淘到了两把一样的椅子。

examples.en: Our neighbors are holding a moving sale before they leave for another city.
examples.zh: 邻居要搬去别的城市，走之前打算办一场「搬家清仓甩卖」。

words.enDefinition: a strap used by people to lift and carry heavy objects

examples.en: One moving strap slipped while we were lifting the desk onto the stairs.
examples.zh: 我们把书桌抬上楼梯时，有一根「搬运背带」滑掉了。

examples.en: The movers had a spare moving strap for the cabinet in the study.
examples.zh: 搬家工人有条备用的「搬运背带」，正好用来搬书房的柜子。

words.enDefinition: an electric cooking pot with several different programs

examples.en: We wanted a multicooker because our room has very little space for kitchen appliances.
examples.zh: 我们房间没多少地方放厨房电器，所以想买个「多功能电煮锅」。

examples.en: The multicooker has separate settings for rice and soup, which I use most often.
examples.zh: 「多功能电煮锅」有煮饭和煲汤两种独立模式，也是我最常用的。

words.enDefinition: someone identified by name as a renter in a lease

examples.en: As a named tenant, I wanted my own copy of the agreement for my records.
examples.zh: 作为租约上「列名的承租人」，我也想留存一份合同。

examples.en: The agent verified that every named tenant had signed before sending us the final copy.
examples.zh: 中介确认每位「列名承租人」都签字后，才把最终版本发给我们。

collocations: a named tenant on the agreement
the signature of a named tenant

words.enDefinition: daylight that comes in through the windows

examples.en: I study at home, so I need a desk corner with natural light.
examples.zh: 我在家自习，所以书桌那角一定要有「自然采光」。

examples.en: Tall buildings across the street block most natural light in our living room.
examples.zh: 街对面的大楼挡住了我们客厅的大部分「自然采光」。

words.enDefinition: contract conditions that the parties can discuss and change

examples.en: I asked which parts of the draft were negotiable terms before my meeting with management.
examples.zh: 和物业见面前，我问了草案里哪些是「可协商条款」。

examples.en: The landlord listed a few negotiable terms, including how long our visitors could stay.
examples.zh: 房东列出了几项「可协商条款」，其中包括访客可以留宿多久。

words.enDefinition: persuade the landlord to change when you move in

examples.en: I negotiated the move-in date to September 1 so I do not pay for August.
examples.zh: 我跟房东「协商入住日期」，最后定在九月一号，省下了八月的房租。

examples.en: Ask to negotiate the move-in date before you sign, not after.
examples.zh: 签之前就「协商入住日期」，别等签完再谈。

collocations: negotiate the move-in date with the landlord
negotiate the move-in date before signing

words.enDefinition: try to agree a lower rent with the landlord

examples.en: You can negotiate the rent if you offer a twelve-month lease.
examples.zh: 如果你愿意签十二个月租约，可以试着「协商房租」。

examples.en: Students rarely negotiate the rent, but asking politely sometimes works.
examples.zh: 学生很少「协商房租」，但礼貌地开口有时真管用。

collocations: negotiate the rent with the landlord

words.enDefinition: comments from residents about living in an area

examples.en: One neighborhood review warned that the recycling truck arrives at six.
examples.zh: 有条「社区评价」提醒，垃圾车早上六点就来。

examples.en: Read a few neighborhood reviews before you trust the listing photos.
examples.zh: 先读几条「社区评价」，再决定信不信房源照片。

words.enDefinition: how safe an area is, especially after dark

examples.en: Neighborhood safety is my first question whenever an agent offers a bargain.
examples.zh: 中介一报低价，我第一个问题就是「社区治安」。

examples.en: The campus police page shares tips on researching neighborhood safety.
examples.zh: 校园警察网页上介绍了调查「社区治安」的方法。

words.enDefinition: an online conversation shared by people living in the same area

examples.en: Someone in the neighbourhood group chat asked who owned the bike by our gate.
examples.zh: 「邻里群聊」里有人问，我们门口那辆自行车是谁的。

examples.en: I joined the neighbourhood group chat a few days after moving into the flat.
examples.zh: 搬进公寓几天后，我加入了「邻里群聊」。

collocations: post in the neighbourhood group chat
set up a neighbourhood group chat

words.enDefinition: a fee for delivering energy through pipes or power lines

examples.en: The statement lists a network charge for delivering electricity to our building.
examples.zh: 账单列了一项把电送到我们楼的「供能网络使用费」。

examples.en: I emailed the energy supplier to ask how it calculated the network charge.
examples.zh: 我发邮件问能源供应商「供能网络使用费」是怎么算的。

words.enDefinition: a rental ad that has just been posted

examples.en: Check the site every evening because new listings in September go fast.
examples.zh: 每天晚上都刷刷网站，九月的「新房源」很快就没了。

examples.en: I set an alert so I see every new listing within minutes.
examples.zh: 我设了提醒，每条「新房源」几分钟内就能看到。

words.enDefinition: someone living in the property immediately beside yours

examples.en: My next-door neighbour lent me a screwdriver on the afternoon I moved in.
examples.zh: 我搬进去的当天下午，「隔壁邻居」借给我一把螺丝刀。

examples.en: I gave my next-door neighbour a heads-up about the moving van on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我提前跟「隔壁邻居」打了声招呼，说周六有搬家货车来。

collocations: introduce yourself to a next-door neighbour

words.enDefinition: a small table or cabinet beside a bed

examples.en: I leave my glasses on the nightstand so I can find them at night.
examples.zh: 我把眼镜放在「床头柜」上，晚上好找。

examples.en: The nightstand has two drawers, so I use one for spare chargers.
examples.zh: 「床头柜」有两个抽屉，我用其中一个放备用充电器。

collocations: put a lamp on the nightstand

words.enDefinition: a situation in which a home has no working hot water supply

examples.en: There was no hot water in the flat when I returned from class.
examples.zh: 我下课回来时，公寓里「没有热水」。

examples.en: We had no hot water for two days and contacted the housing office.
examples.zh: 我们连续两天「没有热水」，就联系了住宿办公室。

words.enDefinition: a contract provision forbidding smoking in specified areas

examples.en: The no-smoking clause covers shared hallways as well as the rooms inside our flat.
examples.zh: 「禁烟条款」适用于公共走廊，也适用于我们公寓里的房间。

examples.en: Does the no-smoking clause apply to the outdoor area next to the laundry room?
examples.zh: 洗衣房旁边的室外区域也适用「禁烟条款」吗？

words.enDefinition: a report about noise that is disturbing other people

examples.en: The housing office received a noise complaint after a party in the flat above.
examples.zh: 楼上公寓开过一次派对后，住宿办公室收到了一起「噪音投诉」。

examples.en: I spoke to my neighbour before calling reception to make a noise complaint.
examples.zh: 打电话去前台作「噪音投诉」之前，我先和邻居聊了聊。

words.enDefinition: noise that disrupts other people's ability to rest or concentrate

examples.en: The caretaker asked us when the noise disturbance started and how long it lasted.
examples.zh: 管理员问我们「噪音扰民」是从什么时候开始的，持续了多久。

examples.en: We reported a noise disturbance because the music carried through the wall every night.
examples.zh: 音乐每晚都穿墙传过来，我们就报告了「噪音扰民」。

words.enDefinition: rules governing the amount or timing of noise

examples.en: The agent explained the noise restrictions after I asked if I could practice violin at home.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在家练小提琴，中介就解释了「噪声限制」。

examples.en: Our building has noise restrictions that apply even on weekends during the exam period.
examples.zh: 考试期间，我们这栋楼的「噪声限制」周末也适用。

words.enDefinition: unable to be returned after the payment is made

examples.en: The application payment is non-refundable, so I asked to see the room before applying.
examples.zh: 申请时交的钱「不可退还」，所以我提出先看房再申请。

examples.en: We checked which charges were non-refundable before deciding to reserve the larger room.
examples.zh: 决定预留大一点的房间前，我们问清了哪些费用「不可退还」。

words.enDefinition: repair work that can reasonably wait for normal scheduling

examples.en: The manager booked the non-urgent repair for Friday, when both my roommates would be home.
examples.zh: 物业经理把「非紧急维修」安排在星期五，那天两位室友都在家。

examples.en: I labeled the loose cupboard handle as a non-urgent repair on the building's online form.
examples.zh: 我在大楼的在线表单上把橱柜拉手松动标为「非紧急维修」。

collocations: classify work as a non-urgent repair

words.enDefinition: failure to pay the housing amount owed under a rental arrangement

examples.en: The notice cited nonpayment of rent, so I collected my receipts and called the agent.
examples.zh: 通知上写着「未支付租金」，于是我整理好收据，给中介打了电话。

examples.en: I spoke to a housing adviser about a dispute over nonpayment of rent.
examples.zh: 我为一起「未支付租金」的纠纷咨询了住宿顾问。

collocations: a notice for nonpayment of rent
a dispute over nonpayment of rent

words.enDefinition: a tenant's formal statement of plans to leave

examples.en: We emailed our notice of intent to vacate as soon as we confirmed our flights home.
examples.zh: 我们一确认回国的航班，就发邮件提交了「拟搬离通知」。

examples.en: The portal lets students submit a notice of intent to vacate directly to the leasing office.
examples.zh: 学生可以在门户网站上直接向租赁办公室提交「拟搬离通知」。

collocations: submit a notice of intent to vacate
acknowledge a notice of intent to vacate
file a notice of intent to vacate

words.enDefinition: a formal statement that a lease will not renew

examples.en: I saved the notice of nonrenewal and asked the adviser to explain the next steps.
examples.zh: 我保存了「不续租通知」，并请顾问解释接下来该怎么办。

examples.en: We sent a notice of nonrenewal before moving to a different campus for our final year.
examples.zh: 最后一学年转到另一个校区之前，我们发了「不续租通知」。

words.enDefinition: formal notice requiring correction of an alleged contract violation

examples.en: I received a notice to cure after storing my bicycle in the building's fire exit.
examples.zh: 我把自行车放在大楼消防出口后，收到了「违约整改通知」。

examples.en: The student adviser helped me read the notice to cure and note the deadline.
examples.zh: 学生顾问帮我读了「违约整改通知」，并记下截止日期。

collocations: respond to a notice to cure

words.enDefinition: a formal notice intended to end a tenancy

examples.en: I took the notice to quit to the student housing adviser the morning it arrived.
examples.zh: 收到「终止租赁通知」的当天早上，我就拿给了学生住房顾问。

examples.en: As a lodger, I asked my live-in landlord to explain the date on the notice to quit.
examples.zh: 身为与房东同住的房客，我请房东解释「终止租赁通知」上的日期。

words.enDefinition: a formal notice that the property is to be vacated

examples.en: I brought the notice to vacate to the adviser because I wasn't sure what it required.
examples.zh: 我把「搬离通知」拿给顾问看，因为不确定具体要求是什么。

examples.en: The notice to vacate listed a date that fell right in the middle of my exams.
examples.zh: 「搬离通知」上写的日期恰好在我的考试周中间。

collocations: respond to a notice to vacate

words.enDefinition: a lease rule against conduct that seriously disturbs others

examples.en: We read the nuisance clause after a neighbor complained about our late-night gatherings upstairs.
examples.zh: 楼下邻居投诉我们深夜聚会后，我们看了「禁止扰邻条款」。

examples.en: The owner referred to the nuisance clause when she asked us to stop blocking the hallway.
examples.zh: 房东让我们别再堵住走廊时，提到了「禁止扰邻条款」。

words.enDefinition: the greatest number of people allowed to live somewhere

examples.en: The occupancy limit means our friend cannot move in with us next semester as planned.
examples.zh: 受「居住人数上限」限制，我们的朋友下学期不能按原计划搬来同住。

examples.en: I checked the occupancy limit before asking a third classmate to share the apartment.
examples.zh: 我先确认了「居住人数上限」，才邀请第三位同学来合租。

words.enDefinition: to live in the property specified in an agreement

examples.en: The lease says only the people named in the agreement may occupy the premises.
examples.zh: 租约写明，只有合同上列名的人才可以「居住在该处房屋」。

examples.en: We asked whether a visiting researcher could occupy the premises while we were abroad.
examples.zh: 我们问出国期间，能否让一位访问研究人员「居住在该处房屋」。

collocations: be permitted to occupy the premises
occupy the premises as a residence

words.enDefinition: accommodation located away from the university campus

examples.en: Two students in my seminar started looking for off-campus housing in February.
examples.zh: 跟我上同一门研讨课的两位同学二月份开始找「校外住房」。

examples.en: The housing office publishes an off-campus housing list with vetted landlords.
examples.zh: 住房办公室发布了经过审核房东的「校外住房」清单。

words.enDefinition: a lower price charged during quieter periods of demand

examples.en: We run the dishwasher after dinner when the off-peak rate starts at nine.
examples.zh: 晚上九点开始按「低谷费率」计费，我们吃过饭就等到那时用洗碗机。

examples.en: The off-peak rate made it cheaper to heat water in the early morning.
examples.zh: 按「低谷费率」计费时，清晨烧热水更省钱。

words.enDefinition: a proposal to continue a rental agreement

examples.en: The landlord made an offer to renew shortly before we left for the winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假离开前不久，房东提出了「续租提议」。

examples.en: I wanted to compare the offer to renew with the lease for a room nearer campus.
examples.zh: 我想把这份「续租提议」和另一个离学校更近的房间的租约比一比。

words.enDefinition: a portable electric heater that warms sealed oil inside it

examples.en: The landlord provided an oil-filled radiator for the study where we revised for exams.
examples.zh: 房东在我们复习备考的书房里配了一台「充油式电暖器」。

examples.en: I checked how wide the oil-filled radiator was before bringing it into my room.
examples.zh: 把「充油式电暖器」带进我房间前，我先看了一下它有多宽。

words.enDefinition: a technician available when needed outside scheduled duties

examples.en: The on-call technician arrived shortly after reception reported the problem with the main entrance.
examples.zh: 前台报告大门故障后，「值班技术员」很快就到了。

examples.en: We asked the on-call technician when the contractor checking the building would reach our floor.
examples.zh: 我们问「值班技术员」，检查大楼的承包商什么时候能到我们这一层。

words.enDefinition: an apartment with one separate bedroom plus a living area

examples.en: Sharing a one-bedroom apartment with a friend saves a lot of rent.
examples.zh: 和朋友合租一套「一室公寓」能省下不少房租。

examples.en: The one-bedroom apartment is small, but the kitchen is surprisingly modern.
examples.zh: 这套「一室公寓」不大，厨房却出奇地新。

words.enDefinition: a charge paid once rather than at regular intervals

examples.en: Is that a one-off fee for issuing the card, or will it appear every term?
examples.zh: 这笔办卡费是「一次性费用」，还是每学期都要交？

examples.en: The residence listed a one-off fee for registering a bicycle in the basement storage area.
examples.zh: 宿舍收费表列出了一笔「一次性费用」，用于登记停在地下存放区的自行车。

collocations: include a one-off fee in the quote

words.enDefinition: a rental that allows pickup and return in different places

examples.en: A one-way van rental meant we could leave the vehicle in the next city.
examples.zh: 办了「异地还车的货车租用」，我们就能把车还在另一个城市。

examples.en: I compared the one-way van rental with driving back after unloading all my things.
examples.zh: 我比较了「异地还车的货车租用」和卸完东西再开回去还车的成本。

words.enDefinition: a bank service for sending scheduled payments to payees online

examples.en: My bank offers online bill pay, so I stopped mailing rent checks myself.
examples.zh: 银行有「网上账单支付」服务，所以我不用自己寄房租支票了。

examples.en: I set up online bill pay with the address on the rent statement.
examples.zh: 我用租金对账单上的地址设置了「网上账单支付」。

collocations: sign in to online bill pay

words.enDefinition: a rental ad published on the internet

examples.en: The online listing looked perfect, but the photos were all taken years ago.
examples.zh: 这条「网上房源」看着很完美，但照片全是好多年前拍的。

examples.en: Always visit in person because an online listing can hide problems.
examples.zh: 一定要实地看看，因为「网上房源」可能藏着问题。

words.enDefinition: to register as a new customer with a utility supplier

examples.en: We tried to open a utility account on the day we got our keys.
examples.zh: 拿到钥匙那天，我们就试着「开立公用服务账户」。

examples.en: Bring your lease if you want to open a utility account in person.
examples.zh: 如果想现场「开立公用服务账户」，记得带上租约。

collocations: open a utility account in person
open a utility account with the provider

words.enDefinition: a set time when anyone can visit the rental

examples.en: The landlord holds an open house on Sunday afternoon for the ground-floor unit.
examples.zh: 房东周日下午为底层那套房子办「看房开放日」。

examples.en: At the open house, arrive early because serious renters come first.
examples.zh: 「看房开放日」要早点到，认真租房的人都赶早。

words.enDefinition: the reading used to start a utility account at a property

examples.en: I sent the opening meter reading so our first bill would start from the right amount.
examples.zh: 我提交了「开账时的表计读数」，这样第一张账单就会从正确读数开始算。

examples.en: The opening meter reading in the landlord's notes matched my photo from move-in day.
examples.zh: 房东记录的「开账时的表计读数」跟我搬进来那天拍的照片相符。

words.enDefinition: the first version of a bill issued by its supplier

examples.en: The agent revised the charge after I compared the amount with the original invoice.
examples.zh: 我把扣款金额与「原始发票」核对后，中介修改了收费。

examples.en: We asked for the original invoice because the statement only listed a rounded amount.
examples.zh: 账单上只列了一个凑整的金额，所以我们索要了「原始发票」。

words.enDefinition: repeated side-to-side movement that spreads airflow from a fan

examples.en: The fan has oscillation, so it can send air across both desks.
examples.zh: 这台风扇有「摇头功能」，可以吹到两张书桌。

examples.en: My roommate turned off oscillation because she wanted the airflow aimed directly at her.
examples.zh: 室友想让风直吹自己，于是关掉了「摇头功能」。

words.enDefinition: a bed with a lift-up mattress base above storage

examples.en: The mattress on our ottoman bed lifts to reveal space for two suitcases.
examples.zh: 我们的「上翻收纳床」掀起床垫后，下面能放两个行李箱。

examples.en: I chose an ottoman bed because side drawers would hit my desk.
examples.zh: 侧边的抽屉会碰到书桌，所以我选了「上翻收纳床」。

collocations: lift the base of an ottoman bed
an ottoman bed with a gas lift

words.enDefinition: the price charged after the minimum contract term ends

examples.en: Our out-of-contract price was much higher than what we paid in the first year.
examples.zh: 我们的「合约期满后价格」比第一年付的高很多。

examples.en: I checked the out-of-contract price before deciding whether to keep the broadband plan.
examples.zh: 决定是否继续用这个宽带套餐前，我查了「合约期满后的价格」。

words.enDefinition: an online map showing where a service is unavailable

examples.en: The outage map showed that our entire block was affected rather than just our flat.
examples.zh: 「停供范围地图」上显示，受影响的是整片街区，并非只有我们公寓。

examples.en: I checked the outage map before calling to ask when the power would return.
examples.zh: 打电话问什么时候来电之前，我先看了「停供范围地图」。

words.enDefinition: old pictures that no longer match the unit

examples.en: The kitchen in the outdated photos still had the old oven and no stains.
examples.zh: 「过时照片」里的厨房还是旧烤箱，也没有油渍。

examples.en: Ask the agent for fresh pictures if the listing only has outdated photos.
examples.zh: 如果房源用的都是「过时照片」，就让中介拍几张新的。

words.enDefinition: repair work that has been requested but remains unfinished

examples.en: The outstanding repair is listed right below the completed work on our kitchen window.
examples.zh: 「尚未完成的维修」就列在已完成的厨房窗户维修下面。

examples.en: I asked the manager to check on the outstanding repair before the university closed for holidays.
examples.zh: 我请物业经理在学校放假前查看那项「尚未完成的维修」。

collocations: follow up on an outstanding repair

words.enDefinition: the amount of utility charges that still needs to be paid

examples.en: I cleared the outstanding utility balance before closing our shared account last week.
examples.zh: 上周关闭共同账户之前，我付清了「未付的公用费用」。

examples.en: The email lists an outstanding utility balance from before we moved into the house.
examples.zh: 邮件列出一笔我们搬进去之前产生的「未付公用费用」。

words.enDefinition: the lamp illuminating the inside of an oven

examples.en: I switched on the oven light to see whether the cookies were starting to brown.
examples.zh: 我开了「烤箱照明灯」，看饼干是不是开始上色了。

examples.en: The oven light lets me check the cake without opening the door halfway through baking.
examples.zh: 有了「烤箱照明灯」，烤到一半时我不用开门即可查看蛋糕。

words.enDefinition: a removable metal shelf that supports food inside an oven

examples.en: My flatmate needed the top oven rack free for a tray of vegetables.
examples.zh: 室友要空出上层的「烤箱烤架」，放一盘蔬菜。

examples.en: The baking dish barely fit on the bottom oven rack in our small kitchen oven.
examples.zh: 我们的厨房烤箱很小，烤盘勉强放得进最下层的「烤箱烤架」。

collocations: place a tray on the oven rack

words.enDefinition: a device that signals when a set cooking period ends

examples.en: I set the oven timer for the cookies before going back to my reading.
examples.zh: 我给饼干设好「烤箱定时器」，然后接着看书。

examples.en: We heard the oven timer from the living room just as the first guests arrived.
examples.zh: 第一批客人刚到，我们就在客厅听见「烤箱定时器」响了。

words.enDefinition: hooks that hang over the top edge of a door

examples.en: I put over-the-door hooks on the closet door to hang my bags.
examples.zh: 我在衣柜门上装了「门顶挂钩」，用来挂包。

examples.en: The over-the-door hooks fit without stopping the bedroom door from closing properly.
examples.zh: 「门顶挂钩」卡得进去，也不影响卧室门正常关上。

words.enDefinition: a toilet with water spilling over the bowl

examples.en: The overflowing toilet soaked the floor before my roommate noticed and called the building manager.
examples.zh: 室友发现并给物业经理打电话之前，「溢水的马桶」已经把地板泡湿了。

examples.en: Reception sent a plumber when I reported an overflowing toilet on the second floor.
examples.zh: 我报告二楼有一个「溢水的马桶」，前台就派了水管工。

words.enDefinition: a friend who stays at your place for the night

examples.en: Ask about the overnight guest rule before you sign anything.
examples.zh: 签约之前先问清楚「留宿客人」的规定。

examples.en: My roommate said overnight guests are fine as long as we get advance notice.
examples.zh: 室友说「留宿客人」没问题，只要提前打个招呼。

words.enDefinition: pay more than the amount due for the accommodation

examples.en: I might overpay the rent if I leave both automatic transfers active.
examples.zh: 如果两笔自动转账都不取消，我可能会「多交房租」。

examples.en: Check the credit on your account so you do not overpay the rent.
examples.zh: 检查一下账户里的抵扣余额，以免「多交房租」。

collocations: avoid having to overpay the rent

words.enDefinition: still need to pay money for occupying a property

examples.en: The portal says we owe rent for June, but I have the receipt.
examples.zh: 平台显示我们六月还有「房租没交」，可我有收据。

examples.en: I might still owe rent for the week before my flatmate moved in.
examples.zh: 室友搬进来前那一周，我可能还「欠着房租」。

words.enDefinition: to pack a bag of necessities to keep within reach

examples.en: I decided to pack an essentials bag so I could find my charger later.
examples.zh: 我决定「打包一袋随身必需品」，之后找充电器方便些。

examples.en: Remember to pack an essentials bag for your first night in the new flat.
examples.zh: 为在新公寓的第一晚，记得「打包一袋随身必需品」。

collocations: plan to pack an essentials bag
remember to pack an essentials bag

words.enDefinition: to gather and pack the belongings in a room

examples.en: I still need to pack up the room before my parents collect me.
examples.zh: 爸妈来接我之前，我还得「把房间里的东西打包」。

examples.en: We took the photos down first before we started to pack up the room.
examples.zh: 开始「把房间里的东西打包」之前，我们先把照片取了下来。

collocations: help to pack up the room
start to pack up the room
need to pack up the room

words.enDefinition: paper used to wrap and protect items before transport

examples.en: We used packing paper to keep the glasses from knocking against one another.
examples.zh: 我们用「打包用纸」把玻璃杯隔开，免得磕碰。

examples.en: Save the packing paper when you unpack because we can use it again later.
examples.zh: 拆箱时把「打包用纸」留下来，以后还能用。

words.enDefinition: small pieces placed in packages to cushion the contents

examples.en: The shop packed the lamp in packing peanuts so it would not move around.
examples.zh: 店家用「泡沫填充粒」把台灯填实了，免得它在箱里晃动。

examples.en: I sorted the packing peanuts into a separate bag after setting up the lamp.
examples.zh: 装好台灯后，我把「泡沫填充粒」另装进一个袋子。

collocations: fill a box with packing peanuts

words.enDefinition: a paid service that boxes and protects items before transport

examples.en: We skipped the packing service and spent Friday evening boxing everything up ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们没选「打包服务」，周五晚上自己装好了所有东西。

examples.en: I asked whether the packing service included materials for wrapping glasses and plates.
examples.zh: 我问了「打包服务」是否包含包玻璃杯和盘子的材料。

words.enDefinition: strong adhesive tape used to seal shipping or moving boxes

examples.en: The bottom of the box split because I had used too little packing tape.
examples.zh: 我用的「封箱胶带」太少，箱子底一下就裂了。

examples.en: Can you bring some packing tape when you come to help us on Friday?
examples.zh: 周五来帮忙的时候，能带点「封箱胶带」吗？

words.enDefinition: a series of documents showing what happened over time

examples.en: I sent a follow-up email after our call to keep a paper trail about the refund.
examples.zh: 电话结束后我又发了封邮件，好让退款沟通有「可追溯的书面记录」。

examples.en: The paper trail made it easy to work out when both roommates had paid their shares.
examples.zh: 有了「可追溯的书面记录」，很容易查到两位室友各自是什么时候交钱的。

words.enDefinition: the practice of sending bills electronically instead of by post

examples.en: I switched to paperless billing because post often goes missing in our building.
examples.zh: 我们楼里常有信件丢失，所以我改用了「无纸化账单」。

examples.en: With paperless billing, you get an email whenever a new statement is ready.
examples.zh: 使用「无纸化账单」后，每次出新账单都会收到邮件通知。

words.enDefinition: a secure compartment where delivery companies can leave packages

examples.en: The driver left my textbooks in the parcel locker near the bike racks.
examples.zh: 快递员把我的教材放进了自行车架旁的「包裹自提柜」。

examples.en: I collected the parcel locker code from my email after my lecture ended.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在邮箱里找到了「包裹自提柜」的取件码。

words.enDefinition: a temporary closure of a parking space to ordinary users

examples.en: We asked about a parking suspension so the van could stop outside our flat.
examples.zh: 我们咨询了「暂停路边停车」的办法，好给搬家货车留个位置。

examples.en: The sign warned drivers about the parking suspension during our move on Monday.
examples.zh: 标牌提醒司机，我们周一搬家时这里将「暂停路边停车」。

words.enDefinition: the return of less than the entire amount paid

examples.en: We accepted a partial refund after the landlord showed us the receipt for the broken lamp.
examples.zh: 房东出示了更换损坏台灯的收据，我们接受了「部分退款」。

examples.en: I received a partial refund and asked for a list of what had been deducted.
examples.zh: 我收到了「部分退款」，并要求提供扣款明细。

words.enDefinition: having some basic furniture but not everything

examples.en: The flat is partially furnished, so we still need a sofa and curtains.
examples.zh: 这套公寓只是「部分带家具」，我们还得买沙发和窗帘。

examples.en: Partially furnished rooms suit students who already have a desk and chair.
examples.zh: 「部分带家具」的房间适合已经有桌椅的学生。

words.enDefinition: not paid by the deadline specified for payment
