examples.en: The portal marked my rent as past due before my transfer had cleared.
examples.zh: 转账还没结算，平台就把我的房租标为「已逾期」。

examples.en: I called the office because July still showed as past due on my account.
examples.zh: 因为账户上的七月房租依然显示「已逾期」，我给办公室打了电话。

collocations: mark a payment as past due

words.enDefinition: to repair a small damaged area of drywall

examples.en: The contractor will patch the drywall in my bedroom before anyone comes to repaint it.
examples.zh: 承包商会先「修补石膏板墙」，之后才有人来重新粉刷我的卧室。

examples.en: I asked whether they could patch the drywall without removing the shelf above my desk.
examples.zh: 我问他们能不能在不拆掉书桌上方架子的情况下「修补石膏板墙」。

collocations: ask someone to patch the drywall
hire a contractor to patch the drywall

words.enDefinition: fill openings in a wall to make the surface whole

examples.en: The manager asked us to patch the holes left by the shelves before we handed over the keys.
examples.zh: 物业经理让我们交钥匙之前「补墙上的孔」，这些孔是拆下搁板后留下的。

examples.en: My roommate offered to patch the holes while I cleaned out the wardrobe in our bedroom.
examples.zh: 我清理卧室衣柜时，室友主动提出帮忙「补墙上的孔」。

collocations: use filler to patch the holes
patch the holes in the wall

words.enDefinition: send money before you have seen the place

examples.en: I refused to pay before viewing when the advertiser would not answer basic questions.
examples.zh: 发布广告的人连基本问题都不回答，我拒绝「没看房就付钱」。

examples.en: The scammer invented an emergency and begged me to pay before viewing.
examples.zh: 骗子编了个急事，求我「没看房就付钱」。

words.enDefinition: use a debit or credit card to make a payment

examples.en: Can I pay by card at the housing office after my lecture?
examples.zh: 下课后我可以去住宿办公室「刷卡付款」吗？

examples.en: Some tenants pay by card because it is quicker than mailing a check.
examples.zh: 有些房客会「刷卡付款」，因为比邮寄支票快。

collocations: allow customers to pay by card

words.enDefinition: use a written check to settle an amount owed

examples.en: Can I pay by check while I wait for my debit card?
examples.zh: 借记卡还没寄到，我能先「用支票付款」吗？

examples.en: We still pay by check because the landlord lives in the same building.
examples.zh: 因为房东就住在同一栋楼，我们还是「用支票付款」。

collocations: allow tenants to pay by check

words.enDefinition: reduce the amount owed by making payments toward it

examples.en: I used my weekend wages to pay down the balance on my rent account.
examples.zh: 我用周末打工挣的钱「偿还一部分」房租账户里的欠款。

examples.en: We can pay down the balance a little faster during the summer break.
examples.zh: 暑假期间我们可以更快一点「还清剩下的欠款」。

collocations: make extra payments to pay down the balance

words.enDefinition: hand over notes or coins to settle a bill

examples.en: If you pay in cash, ask the landlord for a receipt that day.
examples.zh: 如果你「用现金付款」，当天就找房东要收据。

examples.en: I had to pay in cash because my new card had not arrived.
examples.zh: 新卡还没寄到，我只好「用现金付款」。

collocations: allow tenants to pay in cash

words.enDefinition: pay the entire housing amount owed for that period

examples.en: The agent expects us to pay rent in full by the first.
examples.zh: 中介要求我们在一号前「全额交租」。

examples.en: Can we pay rent in full once both of our stipends arrive?
examples.zh: 等我们俩的津贴都到账后，可以再「全额交租」吗？

collocations: pay rent in full by Friday
unable to pay rent in full
agree to pay rent in full

words.enDefinition: give the landlord the agreed sum for living there

examples.en: I always pay the rent as soon as my scholarship money arrives.
examples.zh: 奖学金一到账，我就「付房租」。

examples.en: Can you pay the rent this month while I cover the groceries?
examples.zh: 这个月你能「付房租」吗？买菜的钱我来出。

words.enDefinition: make a payment while formally stating that you dispute it

examples.en: I decided to pay under protest while the housing office reviewed the disputed charge.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室审查有争议的费用期间，我决定「先付款并保留异议」。

examples.en: My adviser explained how to pay under protest and keep a written record.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我怎样「先付款并保留异议」，同时留好书面记录。

words.enDefinition: the person or organization named to receive a payment

examples.en: The payee on my rent check is the housing company, not the agent.
examples.zh: 我的房租支票上，「收款人」写的是住房公司，而不是中介。

examples.en: I checked the payee before sending money to the new management company.
examples.zh: 给新的物业管理公司转账前，我核对了「收款人」。

words.enDefinition: the day on which money is paid or scheduled

examples.en: My bank and the rent portal show a different payment date for June.
examples.zh: 银行和房租平台显示的六月「付款日期」不一样。

examples.en: Can I move the payment date to the day after my stipend arrives?
examples.zh: 我能把「付款日期」改到津贴到账后的那天吗？

words.enDefinition: the latest time by which a payment must be made

examples.en: The payment deadline for the replacement key is Friday, but I can pay today.
examples.zh: 补配钥匙的「付款截止日」是周五，但我今天就可以付。

examples.en: The housing office moved the payment deadline because the portal was down.
examples.zh: 由于平台无法使用，住宿办公室推迟了「付款截止日」。

words.enDefinition: a mismatch between a payment and how it appears in records

examples.en: I reported a payment discrepancy after comparing my bank app with the rent portal.
examples.zh: 我对照银行应用和房租平台，发现「付款记录有差异」后就报了上去。

examples.en: The office asked for a screenshot to resolve the payment discrepancy on my account.
examples.zh: 办公室让我提供截图，以核实我账户里的「付款记录差异」。

words.enDefinition: additional time officially granted to make a payment

examples.en: I asked for a payment extension because my new bank account was still blocked.
examples.zh: 新开的银行账户还用不了，所以我申请「延长付款期限」。

examples.en: The owner offered a payment extension until the end of next week.
examples.zh: 房东提出把「付款期限延长」到下周末。

words.enDefinition: how often a payment is made or required

examples.en: The portal lets me choose my payment frequency before I confirm the arrangement.
examples.zh: 确认付款安排前，我可以在平台上选择「付款频率」。

examples.en: I asked about the payment frequency because my wages come in every Friday.
examples.zh: 我每周五领工资，所以问了「付款频率」。

words.enDefinition: a record of when and how payments were made

examples.en: I downloaded my payment history before the landlord closed my portal account.
examples.zh: 房东关闭我的平台账户前，我下载了「付款记录」。

examples.en: The housing adviser checked my payment history for gaps before calling the agent.
examples.zh: 住宿顾问先看了我的「付款记录」有没有漏记，再给中介打电话。

words.enDefinition: a web address that takes someone to a payment page

examples.en: The office sent a payment link after I reported a problem with the portal.
examples.zh: 我反映平台出了故障，办公室就发来一个「付款链接」。

examples.en: The payment link expired before my roommate could send her share of rent.
examples.zh: 室友还没来得及付她那份房租，「付款链接」就失效了。

words.enDefinition: an agreed schedule for paying an amount in stages

examples.en: The agent agreed to a payment plan when my stipend was delayed.
examples.zh: 我的津贴延迟到账，中介同意了「分期付款计划」。

examples.en: I asked whether the payment plan would cover both months of overdue rent.
examples.zh: 我问了「分期付款计划」是否包含拖欠的两个月房租。

words.enDefinition: an identifying note or code entered when sending a payment

examples.en: Use your room number as the payment reference when you send the transfer.
examples.zh: 转账时请在「付款附言」里填上你的房间号。

examples.en: I forgot to enter the payment reference, so the office could not match my transfer.
examples.zh: 我忘了填「付款附言」，办公室没法识别这笔转账。

words.enDefinition: the higher price charged during periods of high demand

examples.en: The peak rate starts at five, when everyone is getting home from work.
examples.zh: 大家差不多下班回家的五点，就开始按「高峰费率」计费了。

examples.en: We avoided running the dryer at the peak rate after seeing our first bill.
examples.zh: 看过第一张账单后，我们就尽量避开「高峰费率」时段用烘干机。

words.enDefinition: the months when everyone is looking for housing

examples.en: August is the peak season here, so landlords ignore discount requests.
examples.zh: 这里的八月是「租房旺季」，房东根本不理砍价请求。

examples.en: Apply in June, before peak season pushes prices up by a fifth.
examples.zh: 六月就申请，赶在「租房旺季」把价格推高两成之前。

words.enDefinition: an electric fan elevated on a vertical support stand

examples.en: Our pedestal fan stood next to the sofa during a hot week in September.
examples.zh: 九月有一周很热，我们把「落地式风扇」放在了沙发旁边。

examples.en: I wanted a pedestal fan that could reach above the edge of my desk.
examples.zh: 我想要一台高度能超过桌沿的「落地式风扇」。

words.enDefinition: dampness caused by water entering through a building's exterior

examples.en: The surveyor identified penetrating damp where rain had entered through damaged bricks beside my bedroom.
examples.zh: 查勘人员确认，雨水通过我卧室旁破损的砖墙进入，造成了「雨水渗入受潮」。

examples.en: The housing office sent someone to investigate penetrating damp after the wall darkened during rain.
examples.zh: 下雨时墙面颜色变深，住房办公室派了人调查「雨水渗入受潮」。

collocations: a wall affected by penetrating damp

words.enDefinition: a tenancy that continues from one rental period to another

examples.en: The adviser showed me which notice rules apply to a periodic tenancy where I live.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了我这里「周期性租赁」适用的通知规定。

examples.en: The agreement describes a periodic tenancy that continues weekly until one party properly ends it.
examples.zh: 合同写的是「周期性租赁」，按周延续，直到一方按程序终止。

words.enDefinition: a lasting repair that addresses the source of a problem

examples.en: The contractor came back with a new seal to make a permanent fix to the window.
examples.zh: 承包商带着新密封条回来，对窗户做了「彻底修复」。

examples.en: I asked for a permanent fix because the door had jammed twice this month already.
examples.zh: 这扇门本月已经卡住两次了，我要求「彻底修复」。

words.enDefinition: a check written against an individual's bank account

examples.en: The agent will take a personal check if I bring it before closing.
examples.zh: 只要关门前把「个人支票」送过去，中介就收。

examples.en: I wrote a personal check for rent and put it in a sealed envelope.
examples.zh: 我开了一张「个人支票」交房租，把它放进了封好的信封。

words.enDefinition: a visit to inspect or treat unwanted animals or insects

examples.en: The manager arranged a pest control visit after we reported unexplained damage to food packaging.
examples.zh: 我们报告食品包装莫名破损后，物业经理安排了「上门防治虫鼠」。

examples.en: I changed my work shift so I could stay home for the pest control visit.
examples.zh: 为了留在家里等「上门防治虫鼠」的人员，我换了班。

collocations: prepare for a pest control visit

words.enDefinition: a document adding pet conditions to a lease

examples.en: The landlord sent a pet addendum after I asked to bring my indoor cat.
examples.zh: 我问能不能带上我的家养猫后，房东发来了一份「宠物补充协议」。

examples.en: I read the pet addendum to see whether my roommate could adopt a dog.
examples.zh: 我看了「宠物补充协议」，想确认室友能不能领养一只狗。

words.enDefinition: money held against damage that a renter's animal might cause

examples.en: Our landlord asked for a pet deposit before letting my roommate bring her cat upstairs.
examples.zh: 房东要求室友先交「宠物押金」，才允许她把猫带上楼。

examples.en: We got our pet deposit back after the manager checked the carpet for damage.
examples.zh: 物业经理确认地毯没有损坏后，我们拿回了「宠物押金」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for allowing a renter to keep an animal

examples.en: The listing showed a one-time pet fee, which we included when comparing the two flats.
examples.zh: 房源信息列了一笔一次性的「宠物费」，我们比较两套房时也把它算进去了。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the pet fee was charged per animal or per apartment.
examples.zh: 我室友问「宠物费」是按宠物数量收，还是按每套公寓收。

words.enDefinition: available to collect in person with no delivery offered

examples.en: The listing says pickup only, so I need to borrow a car.
examples.zh: 商品页面写着「仅限自提」，所以我得借辆车。

examples.en: All the chairs are pickup only because the seller is moving tomorrow.
examples.zh: 卖家明天就搬家，所以这几把椅子都「仅限自提」。

words.enDefinition: a protective cover worn under the outer pillowcase

examples.en: I washed the pillow protector along with the sheets before my guest arrived.
examples.zh: 客人来之前，我把「枕芯保护套」和床单一起洗了。

examples.en: The pillow protector goes under the pillowcase and closes with a small zipper.
examples.zh: 「枕芯保护套」套在枕套里面，有个小拉链可以拉上。

words.enDefinition: a connection where two pieces of pipe meet

examples.en: A plumber found a loose pipe joint beneath our bathroom sink during the second visit.
examples.zh: 水管工第二次上门时，发现浴室洗手池下面有一个松动的「管道接头」。

examples.en: I sent a photo of the pipe joint after the manager asked where the water appeared.
examples.zh: 物业经理问水是从哪里出来的，我就发了「管道接头」的照片。

words.enDefinition: a bed with a base that supports a mattress directly

examples.en: I chose a platform bed so I would not need a separate box spring.
examples.zh: 我选了「平台床」，这样不用另外买弹簧床座。

examples.en: The platform bed is low enough for the attic room I rent.
examples.zh: 「平台床」够矮，放得进我租的阁楼房间。

words.enDefinition: an escape of water from a plumbing system

examples.en: The building manager asked us to describe the plumbing leak and show where water was pooling.
examples.zh: 物业经理让我们说明「管道漏水」的情况，并指出哪里有积水。

examples.en: A plumbing leak in the bathroom upstairs left our hallway carpet wet overnight.
examples.zh: 楼上浴室「管道漏水」，一夜之间把我们走廊的地毯弄湿了。

words.enDefinition: a mattress with springs enclosed separately in fabric pockets

examples.en: The pocket spring mattress felt firmer than the foam one beside it.
examples.zh: 这张「独立袋装弹簧床垫」摸起来比旁边的泡沫床垫硬一些。

examples.en: My flatmate suggested a pocket spring mattress for the bed in my new room.
examples.zh: 室友建议我新房间的床用「独立袋装弹簧床垫」。

collocations: shop for a pocket spring mattress

words.enDefinition: a movable cooling unit usually vented through a window

examples.en: I borrowed a portable air conditioner during the hottest week of my summer course.
examples.zh: 暑期课程最热的那个星期，我借了台「移动空调」。

examples.en: We checked where the hose would go before renting a portable air conditioner for our room.
examples.zh: 给房间租「移动空调」之前，我们先看了排风管能从哪里伸出去。

collocations: a portable air conditioner with a hose
fit a portable air conditioner in a room

words.enDefinition: the date the tenant may take control of the property

examples.en: The possession date is two days before orientation, so I can unpack over the weekend.
examples.zh: 「可接收房屋的日期」在迎新前两天，我可以周末拆箱整理。

examples.en: The manager moved the possession date forward after the previous tenant returned the keys early.
examples.zh: 上一位租客提前交还钥匙后，物业经理把「可接收房屋的日期」提前了。

words.enDefinition: a check dated for a later day

examples.en: The agent asked for a postdated check for the first of December.
examples.zh: 中介要了一张日期写为十二月一号的「远期支票」。

examples.en: I left a postdated check with my roommate before going home for winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假回家前，我留了一张「远期支票」给室友。

words.enDefinition: a reusable soft adhesive for hanging lightweight pictures or paper

examples.en: I used poster putty to hang my timetable above the desk without nails.
examples.zh: 我用「海报黏胶泥」把课表贴在桌子上方，不用钉钉子。

examples.en: The poster putty peeled off easily when I cleared the wall at term's end.
examples.zh: 学期结束时我收拾墙面，「海报黏胶泥」很容易就揭下来了。

collocations: press poster putty onto the corners

words.enDefinition: the day when an account officially records a transaction

examples.en: The posting date was Tuesday, although I sent the transfer on Friday.
examples.zh: 尽管我星期五就转账了，「入账日期」却是星期二。

examples.en: The agent compared the posting date with the date printed on my receipt.
examples.zh: 中介把「入账日期」和我收据上印的日期对照了一下。

words.enDefinition: a mark that was present before the tenant moved in

examples.en: I showed the agent a photo of the pre-existing stain on the bedroom carpet.
examples.zh: 我给中介看了卧室地毯上「入住前已有的污渍」的照片。

examples.en: The review found that the landlord had charged us for a pre-existing stain near the door.
examples.zh: 复核发现，房东把门边「入住前已有的污渍」算成了我们的费用。

words.enDefinition: rinse dishes briefly before beginning the main wash

examples.en: We don't usually pre-rinse the plates before putting them into the new dishwasher.
examples.zh: 我们用这台新洗碗机时，通常不先「预冲洗」盘子。

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether she should pre-rinse the bowls after scraping off the leftovers.
examples.zh: 室友问，刮掉剩菜之后要不要先「预冲洗」这些碗。

words.enDefinition: heat a cooking appliance before putting food inside

examples.en: I usually preheat the oven while I finish mixing the dough for the rolls.
examples.zh: 我通常一边把小面包的面团和好，一边「预热」烤箱。

examples.en: The recipe says to preheat the oven before putting the vegetables inside to roast.
examples.zh: 食谱说，放蔬菜进去烤之前要先「预热」烤箱。

words.enDefinition: a meter that requires credit before a service can be used

examples.en: Our flat has a prepayment meter, so we buy credit before using gas.
examples.zh: 公寓用的是「预付费计量表」，所以用燃气之前先要充值。

examples.en: The landlord explained how the prepayment meter works when she showed us the flat.
examples.zh: 房东带我们看房时，解释了「预付费计量表」怎么用。

words.enDefinition: a sealed pot that cooks food quickly under pressure

examples.en: My aunt gave me a pressure cooker when I moved into my first flat.
examples.zh: 我搬进第一套公寓时，姨妈送了我一口「压力锅」。

examples.en: The pressure cooker came with a recipe booklet that included several simple dishes with beans.
examples.zh: 这口「压力锅」附带一本食谱，有几道简单的豆类菜。

words.enDefinition: regular servicing aimed at avoiding breakdowns before they happen

examples.en: Our building closes the bike lift briefly each term for preventive maintenance by a specialist.
examples.zh: 我们这栋楼每学期会短时间停用自行车升降机，请专业人员做「预防性维护」。

examples.en: The manager said preventive maintenance on the drains had reduced flooding in the basement.
examples.zh: 物业经理说，排水管道做了「预防性维护」后，地下室被淹的次数少了。

words.enDefinition: the amount carried forward from the previous account statement

examples.en: The previous balance was zero, so I only paid this month's rent.
examples.zh: 「上期余额」为零，所以我只付了这个月的房租。

examples.en: I questioned the previous balance because it still included a charge I had paid.
examples.zh: 「上期余额」里还有一笔我已经结清的费用，我因此提出了疑问。

words.enDefinition: a preliminary washing stage before the main cleaning program

examples.en: I selected a prewash for the muddy clothes I wore on our hike.
examples.zh: 徒步时穿的衣服沾了泥，我就选了「预洗」。

examples.en: The machine's display showed the prewash had finished and the main program was starting.
examples.zh: 洗衣机显示「预洗」已经结束，主洗程序正在启动。

collocations: use a prewash for muddy clothes

words.enDefinition: a reduction in the advertised rent

examples.en: The listing shows a price drop of one hundred after three weeks on the market.
examples.zh: 挂了三周之后，房源显示「房租降价」一百。

examples.en: I saved the listing to get an email whenever there is a price drop.
examples.zh: 我收藏了那条房源，一有「房租降价」就发邮件提醒我。

words.enDefinition: required permission given in writing before an action

examples.en: Our lease requires prior written consent before we can install a lock on the bedroom door.
examples.zh: 租约规定，给卧室门加锁前必须取得「事先书面同意」。

examples.en: I obtained prior written consent to mount a small bookshelf above the desk in my room.
examples.zh: 我在房间书桌上方装小书架之前，取得了「事先书面同意」。

words.enDefinition: a bathroom used only by you, not shared

examples.en: I chose a room with a private bathroom because I wanted more privacy.
examples.zh: 我选了带「独立卫浴」的房间，因为想要多一点隐私。

examples.en: The ad promises a private bathroom, though the photos only show a sink.
examples.zh: 广告说有「独立卫浴」，可照片里只拍到个洗手池。

words.enDefinition: an individual owner who rents out property directly

examples.en: Renting from a private landlord often means more flexible move-in dates.
examples.zh: 跟「私人房东」租房，入住日期往往更灵活。

examples.en: Our private landlord fixes things slowly, so report problems in writing.
examples.zh: 我们的「私人房东」修东西很慢，报修一定要留书面记录。

words.enDefinition: a bedroom in a shared flat that only you use

examples.en: A private room in a shared flat costs two hundred more than a shared one.
examples.zh: 合租公寓里的「独立房间」比合住房间贵两百。

examples.en: I need a private room because I take late calls for my group project.
examples.zh: 我需要一个「独立房间」，因为小组作业经常要开晚上的电话会。

collocations: private room in a shared flat

words.enDefinition: cleaning carried out by a paid service or trained worker

examples.en: We booked professional cleaning for the carpets and kept the invoice in case questions came up.
examples.zh: 我们请人给地毯做了「专业清洁」，并保留账单备查。

examples.en: The agent asked whether we had arranged professional cleaning or intended to clean the room ourselves.
examples.zh: 中介问，我们是安排了「专业清洁」，还是打算自己打扫房间。

words.enDefinition: an activity that a property agreement does not allow

examples.en: The lease lists running a shop from the apartment as a prohibited use of the unit.
examples.zh: 租约把在公寓里开店列为房屋的「禁止用途」。

examples.en: Before starting her tutoring service here, Lena checked what the agreement calls a prohibited use.
examples.zh: 在这里做辅导之前，莉娜先看了合同列出的「禁止用途」。

words.enDefinition: a letter from an employer confirming your job

examples.en: Part-time workers may need proof of employment plus a guarantor.
examples.zh: 兼职工作者可能需要「在职证明」，外加一个担保人。

examples.en: My campus job supervisor wrote proof of employment for my rental file.
examples.zh: 校内工作的主管为我的租房材料开具了「在职证明」。

words.enDefinition: documents showing you earn enough to pay the rent

examples.en: Bring proof of income or three months of bank statements to the viewing.
examples.zh: 看房时带上「收入证明」或三个月的银行流水。

examples.en: Scholarship letters count as proof of income for many student lets.
examples.zh: 对很多学生租房来说，奖学金证明也可以当作「收入证明」。

words.enDefinition: evidence showing that money was paid for rented accommodation

examples.en: The bursary office asked for proof of rent payment before reviewing my application.
examples.zh: 助学金办公室要我先提供「交租凭证」，然后才审核申请。

examples.en: I uploaded proof of rent payment after the portal marked my account overdue.
examples.zh: 平台标记我逾期后，我上传了「交租凭证」。

collocations: ask for proof of rent payment

words.enDefinition: evidence that a formal document was properly delivered

examples.en: I kept proof of service in case there was a dispute over when I gave notice.
examples.zh: 我留存了「送达证明」，以防送达通知的时间出现争议。

examples.en: The clinic asked for proof of service before looking at the dates on my notice.
examples.zh: 咨询点请我先提供「送达证明」，再核对通知上的日期。

words.enDefinition: documentation showing that money was sent by bank transfer

examples.en: Please attach proof of transfer when you email the rent office about July.
examples.zh: 给房租办公室发邮件询问七月房租时，请附上「转账凭证」。

examples.en: I sent my flatmate proof of transfer so she could update our spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 我把「转账凭证」发给室友，好让她更新我们的表格。

words.enDefinition: a gentle warming mode for letting dough rise

examples.en: We used the proofing setting because the kitchen was too cold for the dough to rise.
examples.zh: 厨房太冷，面团发不起来，我们就用了「面团发酵档」。

examples.en: I looked for a proofing setting on the oven when I started baking my own bread.
examples.zh: 我开始自己烤面包时，在烤箱上找了找有没有「面团发酵档」。

words.enDefinition: the person who handles a building's rentals and repairs

examples.en: The property manager showed us the unit and answered our questions about parking.
examples.zh: 「物业经理」带我们看了房间，还解答了停车位的问题。

examples.en: Send maintenance requests to the property manager, not to the owner directly.
examples.zh: 维修请求要发给「物业经理」，别直接找房东本人。

words.enDefinition: calculate the charge for a shorter part of the rental period

examples.en: Could you prorate the rent if I cannot move in before the twentieth?
examples.zh: 如果我要到二十号才能搬进去，能「按比例计算房租」吗？

examples.en: The agent said they could prorate the rent for my final week.
examples.zh: 中介说他们可以把最后一周的「房租按比例计算」。

collocations: prorate the rent by the day
prorate the rent for the first month

words.enDefinition: rent adjusted to reflect only part of the rental period

examples.en: The portal shows prorated rent because I moved in halfway through the month.
examples.zh: 因为我是月中搬进去的，平台显示的是「按比例计收的房租」。

examples.en: I asked for a breakdown of the prorated rent before paying the bill.
examples.zh: 付账前，我要了「按比例计收的房租」的计算明细。

words.enDefinition: a utility bill covering a proportion of a full billing period

examples.en: I received a prorated utility bill for the ten days before my flatmate arrived.
examples.zh: 我收到了室友入住前十天的「按天折算的公用账单」。

examples.en: The prorated utility bill covered only the last two weeks of our summer lease.
examples.zh: 这份「按天折算的公用账单」只包括暑期租约最后两周。

words.expression: put the utilities in my name
words.lemma: put the utilities in my name
words.zhGloss: 把公用账户转到我名下
words.enDefinition: to register oneself as the person responsible for utility charges
acceptedZhAnswers: 把公用账户转到我名下
acceptedEnVariants: put the utilities in my name

examples.en: I can put the utilities in my name if you handle the internet.
examples.zh: 你要是负责办宽带，我就「把公用账户转到我名下」。

examples.en: When my roommate left, I asked how to put the utilities in my name.
examples.zh: 室友搬走后，我打听了怎么「把公用账户转到我名下」。

collocations: need to put the utilities in my name
agree to put the utilities in my name
ask how to put the utilities in my name

words.enDefinition: a freezer mode that temporarily cools food more rapidly

examples.en: Our freezer has a quick freeze option for adding a lot of food at once.
examples.zh: 我们家的冷冻柜有「速冻功能」，适合一次放很多食物时用。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether quick freeze would switch itself off on the new freezer.
examples.zh: 室友问，新冷冻柜的「速冻功能」会不会自己关掉。

words.enDefinition: a shorter program for washing lightly soiled items

examples.en: We ran a quick wash because we only needed clean cups before our guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人来之前只要有干净杯子，所以我们选了「快速洗程序」。

examples.en: My roommate uses quick wash for lightly soiled dishes after making breakfast in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 室友在厨房做完早餐后，会用「快速洗程序」洗不太脏的餐具。

words.enDefinition: set hours when residents must keep noise low

examples.en: The landlord explained that quiet hours start earlier on weekdays because many residents study at home.
examples.zh: 房东说工作日的「静音时段」开始得更早，因为很多住户在家学习。

examples.en: We moved our board game night forward so everyone could leave before quiet hours.
examples.zh: 我们把桌游活动提前了，好让大家在「静音时段」前离开。

words.enDefinition: an escape of water from a heating radiator

examples.en: The maintenance worker examined the radiator leak before deciding which parts were needed for repairs.
examples.zh: 维修人员先检查了「暖气片漏水」的问题，再确定需要哪些零件来修。

examples.en: I reported the radiator leak after finding a small pool of water beneath the window.
examples.zh: 我在窗下发现一小摊水后，报告了「暖气片漏水」。

words.enDefinition: ask tenants to pay more for the same accommodation

examples.en: The owner plans to raise the rent when our current agreement ends.
examples.zh: 我们现在的租约到期后，房东打算「提高房租」。

examples.en: Can the landlord raise the rent before we finish the spring semester?
examples.zh: 春季学期还没结束，房东就能「提高房租」吗？

collocations: raise the rent by ten percent
a decision to raise the rent

words.enDefinition: a unit above a stove that removes airborne cooking fumes

examples.en: The range hood is quite loud, but the kitchen smells much better after we fry onions.
examples.zh: 「抽油烟机」声音挺大，但我们炒洋葱之后，厨房的味道好闻多了。

examples.en: I asked whether the range hood vents outside when the landlord showed us the kitchen.
examples.zh: 房东带我们参观厨房时，我问「抽油烟机」的排气是不是通到室外。

words.enDefinition: remedial work carried out in response to a fault

examples.en: The manager said most of the old building's budget went toward reactive maintenance after breakdowns.
examples.zh: 物业经理说，这栋旧楼的大部分预算都花在故障后的「事后维修」上。

examples.en: The housing office wants to cut down on reactive maintenance by checking shared doors regularly.
examples.zh: 住房办公室希望通过定期检查公共门，减少「事后维修」。

words.enDefinition: to read small or easily overlooked contractual details carefully

examples.en: I reminded my flatmates to read the fine print before accepting the landlord's renewal offer.
examples.zh: 我提醒合租室友，接受房东的续租提议前要「细读合同小字条款」。

examples.en: My friend helped me read the fine print about who could use the bike storage area.
examples.zh: 朋友帮我「细读了合同的小字条款」，弄清谁可以使用自行车存放处。

collocations: read the fine print before signing

words.enDefinition: an amount that is fair given the circumstances involved

examples.en: We agreed to pay the reasonable cost of repairing the hinge after reviewing two quotes.
examples.zh: 看了两份报价后，我们同意支付修理铰链的「合理费用」。

examples.en: The adviser asked what a reasonable cost would be for a panel of that size.
examples.zh: 顾问问，更换那种尺寸的面板要多少钱才算「合理费用」。

words.enDefinition: advance warning that gives someone enough time to prepare

examples.en: I asked the landlord for reasonable notice before sending anyone to check the bathroom leak.
examples.zh: 我请房东派人检查浴室漏水前，给我「合理的提前通知」。

examples.en: With reasonable notice, I can arrange to be home when the repair crew comes.
examples.zh: 只要收到「合理的提前通知」，我就能在维修人员来时安排自己在家。

words.enDefinition: the unique number assigned to a receipt

examples.en: I quoted the receipt number when I called about the missing rent payment.
examples.zh: 我打电话查询查不到的房租时，报了「收据编号」。

examples.en: Keep the receipt number until the housing office confirms your payment has arrived.
examples.zh: 请保留「收据编号」，直到住宿办公室确认款项到账。

words.enDefinition: the point at which a formal notification is received

examples.en: The agent confirmed receipt of notice and emailed me a copy for my own record.
examples.zh: 中介确认「已收到通知」，并发给我一份副本留存。

examples.en: I asked for confirmation of receipt of notice after the online form disappeared from my account.
examples.zh: 在线表单在我的账户里找不到了，我就请对方确认是否「已收到通知」。

words.enDefinition: a chair whose back tilts and often has a footrest

examples.en: The secondhand recliner was too wide to fit through our front door.
examples.zh: 那把二手「可躺座椅」太宽，进不了我们家大门。

examples.en: My roommate found a recliner that folds down enough for an afternoon nap.
examples.zh: 室友找到一把能放倒到可以睡午觉的「可躺座椅」。

words.enDefinition: a fault that returns after apparent resolution

examples.en: The housing office sent a different contractor to look at the recurring fault with the lock.
examples.zh: 住房办公室换了个承包商来检查门锁「反复出现的故障」。

examples.en: I added photos of the recurring fault to the old report rather than starting a new one.
examples.zh: 我没重新报修，而是把「反复出现的故障」的照片加进了旧报告。

words.enDefinition: a payment repeated automatically at regular intervals

examples.en: I set up a recurring payment for the first of every month.
examples.zh: 我设置了每月一号的「定期付款」。

examples.en: Remember to cancel the recurring payment after you send your final rent.
examples.zh: 最后一笔房租付完后，记得取消「定期付款」。

words.enDefinition: a schedule showing when recyclable materials will be picked up

examples.en: I stuck the recycling collection calendar on the fridge beside our shopping list.
examples.zh: 我把「回收物收运日历」贴在冰箱上，挨着购物清单。

examples.en: The recycling collection calendar helped my new flatmate work out when to put boxes outside.
examples.zh: 新室友看了「回收物收运日历」，知道该什么时候把纸箱拿出去。

collocations: refer to the recycling collection calendar

words.enDefinition: a warning sign that something is dishonest

examples.en: A landlord who refuses any video call is a huge red flag.
examples.zh: 房东连视频看房都不肯，这是很大的「危险信号」。

examples.en: Ignore the grammar mistakes, but never ignore a red flag about money.
examples.zh: 错别字可以忽略，但涉及钱的「危险信号」绝不能忽视。

collocations: red flag when they rush you

words.enDefinition: charge less than the previous price for the accommodation

examples.en: We asked the owner to reduce the rent while the kitchen was unusable.
examples.zh: 厨房没法用的这段时间，我们请房东「降低房租」。

examples.en: The agent offered to reduce the rent if we moved in this week.
examples.zh: 中介说如果我们这周搬进去，可以「降低房租」。

words.enDefinition: verification of your references before you rent

examples.en: The referencing check took five working days because my old landlord replied late.
examples.zh: 「租房背景审查」花了五个工作日，因为前房东回复太慢。

examples.en: Fail the referencing check and the letting agent will offer the flat to someone else.
examples.zh: 要是没通过「租房背景审查」，中介就会把房子给别人。

words.enDefinition: the last date by which money should be returned

examples.en: We noted the refund deadline in our calendar before returning the keys on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们周五还钥匙之前，把「退款截止日期」记在了日历上。

examples.en: After the refund deadline passed, I emailed the manager with a copy of our handover form.
examples.zh: 「退款截止日期」过后，我给物业经理发了邮件，附上交接表的副本。

words.enDefinition: a formal or informal request to have money returned

examples.en: My refund request included the checkout date and a copy of the original fee receipt.
examples.zh: 我的「退款申请」中附上了退租日期和原始费用收据的副本。

examples.en: I asked the letting agency whether it had received my refund request before the holidays.
examples.zh: 我问中介公司，放假前有没有收到我的「退款申请」。

words.expression: refund to the original payment method
words.lemma: refund to the original payment method
words.enDefinition: return money through the same channel used to pay
acceptedEnVariants: refund to the original payment method

examples.en: The agency can refund to the original payment method if my card account is still open.
examples.zh: 如果我的银行卡账户仍在使用，中介就可以「原路退款」。

examples.en: Can you refund to the original payment method, or do you need my new bank details?
examples.zh: 你们可以「原路退款」，还是需要我提供新的银行账户信息才能退款？

collocations: request a refund to the original payment method
automatically refund to the original payment method
agree to refund to the original payment method

words.enDefinition: to replace the material between tiles so gaps are sealed

examples.en: The landlord plans to regrout the tiles once the bathroom floor has dried completely.
examples.zh: 房东打算等浴室地面彻底干透，再「重新填补瓷砖缝」。

examples.en: They offered to regrout the tiles while my roommates and I were away over the weekend.
examples.zh: 对方提出周末我和室友都不在时来「重新填补瓷砖缝」。

collocations: regrout the tiles in the bathroom

words.enDefinition: pay back a roommate for money they spent for you

examples.en: I had to reimburse a roommate after she covered the whole rent payment.
examples.zh: 室友垫付了整笔房租，我得「把自己那份还给她」。

examples.en: Can I reimburse a roommate by check if my bank app stops working?
examples.zh: 如果银行应用打不开，我能用支票「把垫付款还给室友」吗？

words.enDefinition: to alter a lock so old keys no longer work

examples.en: The landlord arranged to rekey a lock after the former tenant failed to return her keys.
examples.zh: 前租客没交回钥匙，房东就安排「重配锁芯，换用新钥匙」。

examples.en: I asked whether the locksmith could rekey a lock without replacing the entire handle.
examples.zh: 我问锁匠能不能在不换整个门把手的情况下「重配锁芯，换用新钥匙」。

collocations: hire a locksmith to rekey a lock
rekey a lock after a move

words.enDefinition: a formal discharge from an existing legal obligation

examples.en: I asked for a written release from liability before my replacement signed the new agreement.
examples.zh: 接替我的租客签新合同前，我要求房东出具一份书面的「免除责任」文件。

examples.en: The adviser checked whether the release from liability covered damage reported after I moved out.
examples.zh: 顾问确认了「免除责任」的范围是否包括我搬出后才报修的损坏。

words.enDefinition: authorize held security money to be paid out

examples.en: Both parties signed the form to release the deposit once the final deductions were agreed.
examples.zh: 就最终扣款达成一致后，双方签了用于「解付押金」的表格。

examples.en: The scheme cannot release the deposit while our disagreement about the missing key is still open.
examples.zh: 关于遗失钥匙的争议还没解决，押金保障计划运营方暂时无法「解付押金」。

collocations: authorize an agent to release the deposit

words.enDefinition: pay out the portion that nobody contests

examples.en: Could you release the undisputed amount while we wait for an answer about the carpet cleaning fee?
examples.zh: 我们还在等地毯清洁费的答复，能先「解付无争议款项」吗？

examples.en: The scheme agreed to release the undisputed amount before reviewing our photographs of the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 押金保障计划运营方同意先「解付无争议款项」，再核对我们拍的厨房地板照片。

collocations: request that they release the undisputed amount
agree to release the undisputed amount
authorize the agent to release the undisputed amount

words.enDefinition: a charge for finding a replacement renter before a tenancy ends

examples.en: The agent quoted a reletting fee after our exchange programme ended earlier than we had expected.
examples.zh: 我们的交换项目比预期结束得早，中介随后给出了「重新招租费」的报价。

examples.en: We asked whether the reletting fee would still apply if we found a replacement ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们问，如果自己找到接手租房的人，还要不要交「重新招租费」。

words.enDefinition: the part of the agreed rental period still left

examples.en: My friend offered to take over the remaining term when I transferred to another campus.
examples.zh: 我转到另一个校区时，朋友提出接手「剩余租期」。

examples.en: The adviser told us to check the remaining term before looking for a replacement roommate.
examples.zh: 顾问让我们先确认「剩余租期」，再去找接替的室友。

words.enDefinition: the period an item can still reasonably be used

examples.en: We asked whether the remaining useful life of the old rug affected what we would owe.
examples.zh: 我们问，旧地毯的「剩余使用年限」是否会影响需要赔偿的金额。

examples.en: The adviser used the remaining useful life of our kitchen appliance to estimate a fair deduction.
examples.zh: 顾问参考我们那件厨房电器的「剩余使用年限」，估算了合理的扣款金额。

words.enDefinition: a van used to carry belongings to another home

examples.en: The removal van arrived just as I was taking my last box downstairs.
examples.zh: 我正把最后一箱东西搬下楼时，「搬家货车」到了。

examples.en: Make sure there's enough space outside for the removal van on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 周六早上要确保外面有足够空间停「搬家货车」。

words.enDefinition: a contract provision governing continuation for another term

examples.en: The renewal clause tells us when we need to ask about staying for another year.
examples.zh: 「续期条款」写明了我们最晚什么时候该问能不能再住一年。

examples.en: I read the renewal clause because the agent had mentioned different terms for returning students.
examples.zh: 中介提到续住学生的条件不同，我就看了「续期条款」。

words.enDefinition: the right to continue an agreement under specified conditions

examples.en: I decided to exercise my renewal option once I knew I'd be studying here again.
examples.zh: 知道自己还会在这里上学后，我决定行使「续期选择权」。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where the renewal option was described in the apartment agreement.
examples.zh: 顾问给我指出了公寓合同里关于「续期选择权」的位置。

words.enDefinition: the period an agreement runs after it is renewed

examples.en: We asked for a six-month renewal term because we all expect to graduate next summer.
examples.zh: 我们预计明年夏天都毕业，所以要求把「续约租期」定为六个月。

examples.en: Please check the renewal term before you sign the new paperwork at the office.
examples.zh: 去办公室签新文件之前，请确认一下「续约租期」。

words.enDefinition: a temporary reduction or suspension of rent normally due

examples.en: We asked for rent abatement after the flood made our room unusable.
examples.zh: 房间被淹后没法住，我们申请了「租金减免」。

examples.en: The adviser explained how to request rent abatement while repairs were underway.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我们，在维修期间怎么申请「租金减免」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of rent remaining to be paid

examples.en: I checked my rent balance before sending the rest of my payment.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「房租欠款余额」，再把剩下的钱转过去。

examples.en: The portal should show a zero rent balance after the transfer clears.
examples.zh: 转账结算后，平台显示的「房租欠款余额」应该是零。

words.enDefinition: the financial pressure caused by the cost of rent

examples.en: Sharing with a third student helped reduce our rent burden last year.
examples.zh: 去年多找一个同学合租，减轻了我们的「房租负担」。

examples.en: My rent burden increased when I lost one of my weekend shifts.
examples.zh: 少上了一次周末班后，我的「房租负担」加重了。

words.enDefinition: a maximum allowed amount of rent for certain housing

examples.en: I asked whether the new rent cap applied to our building too.
examples.zh: 我问了新的「租金上限」是否也适用于我们这栋楼。

examples.en: The student union is asking for a rent cap in university housing.
examples.zh: 学生会呼吁给学校宿舍设定「租金上限」。

words.enDefinition: a discount or other financial incentive offered to renters

examples.en: The building manager offered a rent concession if I signed before September.
examples.zh: 楼管说如果我在九月前签约，可以给我「租金优惠」。

examples.en: The advertised rent concession applies only to people taking a twelve-month contract.
examples.zh: 广告上的「租金优惠」只适用于签十二个月合同的人。

words.enDefinition: the day by which regular rent must be paid

examples.en: I put the rent due date on the calendar we share at home.
examples.zh: 我把「房租到期日」记在了家里的共享日历上。

examples.en: The rent due date is on a Sunday this month, so I paid early.
examples.zh: 这个月的「房租到期日」是星期天，所以我提前付了。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement to hold rent separately while a dispute is resolved

examples.en: A legal clinic explained what rent escrow meant during my dispute with the landlord.
examples.zh: 我和房东发生纠纷时，法律援助机构给我解释了什么是「租金托管」。

examples.en: I asked whether rent escrow was available where my student apartment was located.
examples.zh: 我问了学生公寓所在地是否可以申请「租金托管」。

words.enDefinition: a period when the rent cannot be increased

examples.en: The housing office announced a rent freeze for students next academic year.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室宣布下学年对学生实行「租金冻结」。

examples.en: We signed for another year after getting a rent freeze in writing.
examples.zh: 拿到「租金冻结」的书面承诺后，我们又签了一年。

words.enDefinition: a change to a higher price for renting housing

examples.en: Our landlord mentioned a rent increase when we asked about staying another year.
examples.zh: 我们问能不能再住一年时，房东提到了「房租上涨」的事。

examples.en: A rent increase would leave me with less money for next semester's textbooks.
examples.zh: 要是「房租上涨」，我下学期买教材的钱就会少一些。

words.enDefinition: a document that lists the rent being charged

examples.en: The rent invoice lists our apartment number and the amount we owe.
examples.zh: 「租金账单」上写着公寓门牌号和应付金额。

examples.en: I emailed the office because the rent invoice showed the wrong month.
examples.zh: 由于「租金账单」上的月份写错了，我给办公室发了邮件。

words.enDefinition: a running record of rent charges and payments

examples.en: Could you send us the rent ledger for the last three months?
examples.zh: 能把过去三个月的「租金明细账」发给我们吗？

examples.en: The rent ledger shows my May transfer but not the one in June.
examples.zh: 「租金明细账」里有我五月的转账，却没有六月那笔。

collocations: request a copy of the rent ledger

words.enDefinition: money sent to cover the cost of renting accommodation

examples.en: My first rent payment came out of my savings account on Monday.
examples.zh: 我的第一笔「房租款」星期一从储蓄账户扣了。

examples.en: I called the office because my rent payment was missing from the portal.
examples.zh: 因为平台上查不到那笔「房租款」，我给办公室打了电话。

words.enDefinition: written proof that a landlord received a rent payment

examples.en: My landlord gave me a rent receipt when I paid in cash.
examples.zh: 我用现金交租时，房东给了我一张「房租收据」。

examples.en: I saved the rent receipt in case the housing office asked for proof.
examples.zh: 我把「房租收据」留了下来，以防住宿办公室要我提供付款证明。

collocations: keep a copy of the rent receipt

words.enDefinition: a decrease in the price paid for rented housing

examples.en: The agent offered a rent reduction while the bathroom was being rebuilt.
examples.zh: 卫生间翻修期间，中介提出可以「下调房租」。

examples.en: We sent photos of the damage when we requested a rent reduction.
examples.zh: 申请「下调房租」时，我们一并发去了受损部位的照片。

words.enDefinition: money paid back to someone for rent they covered

examples.en: I requested rent reimbursement for the month I spent on a research placement.
examples.zh: 我申请「房租报销」，报的是外出做科研的那一个月。

examples.en: The university needs my rent receipt before it can approve rent reimbursement.
examples.zh: 学校需要我的房租收据才能批准「房租报销」。

words.enDefinition: a message asking tenants to remember a rent payment

examples.en: I got a rent reminder even though I had already sent the money.
examples.zh: 虽然我已经转了钱，但还是收到了「交租提醒」。

examples.en: The agent sends a rent reminder three days before each payment is due.
examples.zh: 每笔房租到期前三天，中介都会发一条「交租提醒」。

words.enDefinition: the amount by which available money falls short of rent

examples.en: My new flatmate offered to cover the rent shortfall until the grant arrived.
examples.zh: 新室友说资助款到账前，他可以先帮我补上「房租缺口」。

examples.en: I emailed the student welfare team about a rent shortfall this month.
examples.zh: 这个月房租有「资金缺口」，我给学生福利部门发了邮件。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement for dividing the rent among several people

examples.en: We discussed the rent split before deciding who would take each bedroom.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论了「房租分摊方案」，再决定各住哪间卧室。

examples.en: The rent split changed when our fourth flatmate moved in last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天第四个室友搬进来后，「房租分摊方案」变了。

words.enDefinition: a document showing rent charges and payments for a period

examples.en: I checked the rent statement and found a payment listed under the wrong date.
examples.zh: 我核对「租金对账单」时发现，有笔付款的日期记错了。

examples.en: The agent sent a rent statement that covered my whole first semester.
examples.zh: 中介发来了一份涵盖我整个第一学期的「租金对账单」。

words.enDefinition: the proportion of someone's income spent on rent

examples.en: I checked my rent-to-income ratio before deciding whether I could afford a studio.
examples.zh: 决定能不能租单间公寓前，我算了算自己的「房租收入比」。

examples.en: The adviser used my rent-to-income ratio to explain why my budget felt tight.
examples.zh: 顾问用我的「房租收入比」解释为什么我的预算总是紧张。

words.enDefinition: a form a landlord uses to choose a tenant

examples.en: The landlord sent us a rental application within an hour of the viewing.
examples.zh: 看房后一小时内，房东就把「租房申请」发给了我们。

examples.en: A complete rental application needs ID, references, and proof of income.
examples.zh: 一份完整的「租房申请」需要证件、推荐人和收入证明。

words.enDefinition: Australian and New Zealand term for money paid as rental security

examples.en: My new roommate and I paid the rental bond before collecting the keys in Melbourne.
examples.zh: 我和新室友在墨尔本拿钥匙前交了「租房保证金」。

examples.en: After we returned the keys, the agent explained how to reclaim the rental bond online.
examples.zh: 还钥匙后，中介讲了怎么在网上申请退还「租房保证金」。

words.enDefinition: your record of past rentals and payments

examples.en: A clean rental history matters more to agents than your major.
examples.zh: 对中介来说，良好的「租房记录」比你的专业更重要。

examples.en: As a first-time renter my rental history is empty, so I added a guarantor.
examples.zh: 我第一次租房，「租房记录」是空白，所以加了担保人。

words.enDefinition: a posted offer to rent out a room or flat

examples.en: I replied to a rental listing this morning and the landlord emailed me back already.
examples.zh: 我上午回复了一条「出租信息」，房东已经回我邮件了。

examples.en: Read the rental listing carefully before you ask for a viewing.
examples.zh: 约看房之前，先仔细读一遍这条「出租信息」。

words.enDefinition: the supply and prices of rental homes in an area

examples.en: The rental market gets crazy every September when students arrive.
examples.zh: 每年九月学生报到，「租房市场」就疯狂起来。

examples.en: Compare prices across the city because the rental market varies by neighborhood.
examples.zh: 多比较全城的价格，不同社区的「租房市场」差别很大。

words.enDefinition: a trick that steals money from apartment seekers

examples.en: The classic rental scam asks for a deposit before you ever see the room.
examples.zh: 典型的「租房骗局」会让你还没看房就先交押金。

examples.en: Our international student group chats warn members about rental scams every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，留学生群都会提醒大家小心「租房骗局」。

words.enDefinition: a platform where tenants search for rental homes

examples.en: I set the rental website to email me whenever a studio comes on the market.
examples.zh: 我在「租房平台」上设置了提醒，一有单身公寓出租就发邮件给我。

examples.en: Read reviews of the rental website before you pay anyone anything.
examples.zh: 在给任何人付钱之前，先看看这个「租房平台」的评价。

collocations: create an account on a rental website

words.enDefinition: a prepared pack about you for landlord applications

examples.en: My renter profile includes ID, a reference letter, and my budget.
examples.zh: 我的「租客档案」包括证件、推荐信和预算。

examples.en: Send your renter profile within an hour of a promising listing.
examples.zh: 看到合适的房源，一小时内就把「租客档案」发过去。

words.enDefinition: to resume tracking a previously closed service request

examples.en: You can reopen a ticket if the same fault comes back after a repair visit.
examples.zh: 维修人员上门后如果同一故障再次出现，你可以「重新打开工单」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could reopen a ticket for the window that was sticking again.
examples.zh: 那扇窗户又卡住了，我问能不能「重新打开工单」。

words.enDefinition: an agreed time for a repair worker to visit

examples.en: I moved my repair appointment to Tuesday because a tutorial had been added on Monday.
examples.zh: 星期一临时加了辅导课，我把「维修预约」改到了星期二。

examples.en: The repair appointment was confirmed by text the evening before the plumber was due.
examples.zh: 水管工上门前一天晚上，我收到了确认「维修预约」的短信。

words.enDefinition: official approval to go ahead with specific repair work

examples.en: The contractor waited for repair authorization before removing the damaged tiles from our shower.
examples.zh: 承包商先等「维修许可」，才拆掉淋浴间损坏的瓷砖。

examples.en: I asked which person could give repair authorization while the landlord was overseas this summer.
examples.zh: 房东今年夏天在国外，我就问谁能给出「维修许可」。

words.enDefinition: a list of items to check during repair work

examples.en: The technician followed a repair checklist when inspecting the faults residents had reported that week.
examples.zh: 技术员按照「维修检查清单」，检查住户当周报告的故障。

examples.en: I asked whether the loose bathroom rail was on the repair checklist for the contractor.
examples.zh: 我问承包商的「维修检查清单」上是否列了浴室栏杆松动的问题。

collocations: put an item on the repair checklist

words.enDefinition: an approximate calculation of the cost of repair work

examples.en: The contractor sent the repair estimate to my landlord after examining the damaged window frame.
examples.zh: 承包商查看了受损窗框，随后把「维修费用预估」发给了房东。

examples.en: I asked for a written repair estimate before agreeing to pay for the cabinet damage.
examples.zh: 我先要求出具书面的「维修费用预估」，再同意承担橱柜损坏的费用。

words.enDefinition: a price offered by a contractor for a specified repair

examples.en: The landlord sent a repair quote before asking us to agree to any deductions.
examples.zh: 房东先发了「维修报价」，才请我们同意扣款。

examples.en: I asked a local carpenter for a repair quote to check whether the charge was fair.
examples.zh: 我找当地木工要了一份「维修报价」，想看看这笔收费是否合理。

collocations: compare a repair quote with the invoice

words.enDefinition: to replenish shared supplies after using some of them

examples.en: Please replace what you use so we always have tea and washing-up liquid.
examples.zh: 请「用多少补多少」，这样我们就总有茶和洗洁精可用。

examples.en: Our note says to replace what you use before the kitchen supplies run out.
examples.zh: 我们留了张纸条，请大家在厨房用品用完前「用多少补多少」。

collocations: remember to replace what you use
offer to replace what you use

words.enDefinition: the expense of obtaining a substitute for a damaged item

examples.en: The agent asked us to cover the replacement cost of two missing kitchen stools.
examples.zh: 中介让我们承担丢失的两把厨房高脚凳的「更换成本」。

examples.en: The replacement cost seemed high, so I checked the price of the same model online.
examples.zh: 「更换成本」看起来偏高，我就上网查了同一型号的价格。

words.enDefinition: a new component installed to replace a damaged one

examples.en: The technician identified the replacement part needed for the latch and ordered it that afternoon.
examples.zh: 技术员确认了门闩需要的「替换件」，当天下午就下单了。

examples.en: We had to wait until the replacement part arrived from the supplier the following week.
examples.zh: 我们不得不等到第二周供应商把「替换件」送过来。

words.enDefinition: someone who takes the place of a departing renter

examples.en: I found a replacement tenant through the student housing group before my semester abroad.
examples.zh: 出国交换前，我通过学生租房群找到了「接替承租人」。

examples.en: The agent asked the replacement tenant to send proof of enrollment before discussing the handover.
examples.zh: 中介让「接替承租人」先发在读证明，再谈交接。

words.enDefinition: to tell the person responsible about equipment not working

examples.en: Please report a fault if the door release stops working when a visitor calls upstairs.
examples.zh: 如果访客呼叫楼上时开门装置失灵，请「报告故障」。

examples.en: I tried to report a fault before work, but the office was still closed.
examples.zh: 我上班前想「报告故障」，但办公室还没开门。

words.enDefinition: to notify someone that water is escaping somewhere

examples.en: My flatmate called to report a leak after water began dripping through the bathroom ceiling.
examples.zh: 浴室天花板开始滴水后，我室友打电话「报告漏水」。

examples.en: We went downstairs to report a leak because the number on the notice board was outdated.
examples.zh: 公告栏上的电话号码过时了，我们就下楼去「报告漏水」。

collocations: report a leak to the landlord

words.enDefinition: to notify the electricity provider that the power has stopped

examples.en: I called to report a power outage after checking with the neighbours downstairs.
examples.zh: 我问过楼下的邻居以后，打电话「报告停电」。

examples.en: The provider's website says you can report a power outage without signing in.
examples.zh: 供电公司的网站说不用登录也可以「报告停电」。

collocations: call to report a power outage
report a power outage in your area

words.enDefinition: to arrange a new time for an existing repair visit

examples.en: Can I reschedule a repair online if the original time clashes with a class?
examples.zh: 如果原定时间和上课冲突，我能在网上「改约维修」吗？

examples.en: I had to reschedule a repair after the manager gave me a morning slot during exams.
examples.zh: 物业经理把时间定在考试期间的上午，我只好「改约维修」。

words.enDefinition: to renew the sealing material that blocks shower leaks

examples.en: The technician will reseal the shower while I am at the library working on my essay.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆写论文时，技术员会「重新密封淋浴间」。

examples.en: I asked when they could reseal the shower because we only had one in the flat.
examples.zh: 我们公寓只有一个淋浴间，我就问他们什么时候能来「重新密封淋浴间」。

words.enDefinition: to book exclusive or scheduled lift access for a move

examples.en: Make sure to reserve the elevator if we move the sofa upstairs tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果明天要把沙发搬上楼，记得先「预约电梯」。

examples.en: I called reception to reserve the elevator for an hour on moving day.
examples.zh: 我打给前台，在搬家当天「预约了一小时电梯」。

collocations: reserve the elevator for an hour

words.enDefinition: permission for a resident to park in a designated area

examples.en: We applied for a resident parking permit as soon as our tenancy began.
examples.zh: 租期一开始，我们就申请了「住户停车许可证」。

examples.en: I had to update my resident parking permit after borrowing my mother's car.
examples.zh: 我借来妈妈的车之后，得更新自己的「住户停车许可证」。

collocations: apply for a resident parking permit

words.enDefinition: an agreement to rent a home for personal use

examples.en: Our residential lease starts a week before classes, which gives us time to settle in.
examples.zh: 我们的「住宅租约」在开课前一周生效，这样就有时间安顿下来。

examples.en: The housing adviser read my residential lease and marked the sections about overnight visitors.
examples.zh: 住房顾问看了我的「住宅租约」，标出了有关访客留宿的条款。

words.enDefinition: a restriction limiting a property to use as a home

examples.en: The lease says residential use only, so I chose the library for my paid workshops.
examples.zh: 租约写着「仅限居住用途」，所以我选了图书馆来办收费工作坊。

examples.en: We asked whether the words residential use only would affect occasional video calls with clients.
examples.zh: 我们问「仅限居住用途」这几个字会不会影响偶尔和客户开视频会。

words.enDefinition: a group representing the interests of people who live in an area

examples.en: The residents' association helped us find out who managed the shared garden downstairs.
examples.zh: 「住户协会」帮我们打听到楼下共用花园归谁管。

examples.en: Our residents' association sends a monthly email with updates about the building and street.
examples.zh: 我们的「住户协会」每月发邮件，告诉大家楼里和街上的新消息。

words.enDefinition: a gathering where residents discuss issues affecting their building or area

examples.en: I went to the residents' meeting to ask about lighting by the back entrance.
examples.zh: 我去参加了「住户会议」，想问问后门附近的照明问题。

examples.en: The next residents' meeting will be held in the lobby on Thursday evening.
examples.zh: 下一次「住户会议」将在周四晚上于大堂举行。

words.enDefinition: a signal that a cooking surface is still hot

examples.en: The residual heat indicator stayed on after I turned off the cooktop in our kitchen.
examples.zh: 我关了厨房的灶面后，「余热指示灯」还亮着。

examples.en: My flatmate recognized the residual heat indicator because our previous cooktop used the same symbol.
examples.zh: 以前的灶面用了同样的符号，所以我室友认出了「余热指示灯」。

collocations: a cooking zone's residual heat indicator

words.enDefinition: the delay between reporting a problem and receiving a response

examples.en: The housing office promises a shorter response time for problems involving security or water leaks.
examples.zh: 住房办公室承诺，安保问题或漏水报修的「响应时间」更短。

examples.en: I asked what response time I should expect after filing the report on a Friday evening.
examples.zh: 我星期五晚上提交报修后，问了「响应时间」一般是多久。

words.enDefinition: return something to the state it was in before

examples.en: We had two days to restore the original condition before the landlord came back for another inspection.
examples.zh: 房东再次来检查前，我们有两天时间把房子「恢复原状」。

examples.en: The agent said a quick touch-up would restore the original condition after we removed the wall hooks.
examples.zh: 中介说，我们拆掉墙上的挂钩后稍微补点漆，就能让墙「恢复原状」。

collocations: try to restore the original condition
allow time to restore the original condition
work required to restore the original condition

words.enDefinition: a label with mailing details for sending equipment back

examples.en: The provider emailed a return shipping label for the router after we moved.
examples.zh: 我们搬家后，供应商发邮件寄来还路由器用的「退寄标签」。

examples.en: Print the return shipping label before taking the broadband equipment to the parcel shop.
examples.zh: 把宽带设备送去包裹代收点前，先把「退寄标签」打印出来。

words.enDefinition: to bring waste bins back after they have been emptied

examples.en: I'll return the bins once the collection truck has gone past our block.
examples.zh: 收垃圾的车开过我们街区后，我会「把垃圾桶推回来」。

examples.en: Could you return the bins before the evening so the pavement stays clear?
examples.zh: 你能在傍晚前「把垃圾桶推回来」吗？这样人行道就不会被挡住。

words.enDefinition: give back security money previously paid by a renter

examples.en: The landlord promised to return the deposit once we gave her our new bank details.
examples.zh: 房东答应，在我们提供新的银行账户信息后就「退还押金」。

examples.en: Could you return the deposit to the same account we used for the original payment?
examples.zh: 可以把「退还押金」的钱打到我们当时付款用的账户吗？

words.enDefinition: to give a property's keys back when leaving

examples.en: I need to return the keys after we take our last bags downstairs.
examples.zh: 我们把最后几袋东西搬下楼后，我就要「交还钥匙」。

examples.en: The landlord asked us to return the keys at the office before noon.
examples.zh: 房东请我们中午前到办公室「交还钥匙」。

words.enDefinition: a payment sent back because it could not go through

examples.en: A returned payment showed up after my bank switched my checking account.
examples.zh: 银行更换我的支票账户后，有笔「付款被退回了」。

examples.en: The portal shows a returned payment, but my bank cannot explain why.
examples.zh: 平台显示有笔「付款被退回了」，但银行说不清原因。

words.enDefinition: undo a billed amount and credit it back

examples.en: Can the office reverse a charge if we return the original key before the weekend?
examples.zh: 如果我们周末前把原来的钥匙还回去，办公室能「撤销这笔收费」吗？

examples.en: I asked how long it takes to reverse a charge after the manager spots a duplicate.
examples.zh: 我问物业经理发现重复收费后，要多久才能「撤销一笔收费」。

collocations: ask the office to reverse a charge
request that the manager reverse a charge

words.enDefinition: undo a recorded payment so it no longer counts

examples.en: The agent can reverse a payment if it was entered against the wrong flat.
examples.zh: 如果付款记到了别的公寓名下，中介可以「冲销这笔付款」。

examples.en: I asked whether the bank could reverse a payment made to the old agent.
examples.zh: 我问银行能不能把误付给原来中介的那笔「付款冲销」。

collocations: reverse a payment made in error

words.enDefinition: the right to occupy a home without undue interference

examples.en: The student adviser explained the right to quiet enjoyment after repeated unannounced visits from management.
examples.zh: 物业多次不打招呼就上门后，学生顾问解释了「安宁使用房屋的权利」。

examples.en: I asked whether the frequent surprise showings affected my right to quiet enjoyment as a tenant.
examples.zh: 我想知道经常突然带人来看房，会不会影响我作为租客「安宁使用房屋的权利」。

collocations: protect the right to quiet enjoyment
interfere with the right to quiet enjoyment
exercise the right to quiet enjoyment

words.enDefinition: a liquid that helps water drain off dishes and glassware

examples.en: The rinse aid indicator came on, so I added it to our shared shopping list.
examples.zh: 「洗碗机漂洗剂」指示灯亮了，我把它加进了共用的购物清单。

examples.en: My housemate asked whether rinse aid was the same thing as regular dishwasher detergent.
examples.zh: 室友问，「洗碗机漂洗剂」和普通洗碗机洗涤剂是不是同一种东西。

words.enDefinition: a program stage that washes away residue using water

examples.en: The display showed that the rinse cycle had almost finished after we cleared the table.
examples.zh: 我们收拾好桌子后，显示屏上显示「漂洗程序」快结束了。

examples.en: My housemate thought the rinse cycle was the final stage, but drying was still to come.
examples.zh: 室友以为「漂洗程序」是最后一步，后面其实还有烘干。

words.enDefinition: moisture drawn upward from the ground into walls

examples.en: The surveyor suspected rising damp after finding moisture along the bottom of the ground-floor walls.
examples.zh: 查勘人员发现一楼墙壁底部潮湿，怀疑是「地下潮气上升」。

examples.en: I asked how the contractor would distinguish rising damp from water coming through the window.
examples.zh: 我问承包商会如何区分「地下潮气上升」和从窗户渗进来的水。

words.enDefinition: an automatic vacuum cleaner that travels across the floor

examples.en: I picked my bag up before the robot vacuum started cleaning the living room.
examples.zh: 「扫地机器人」开始清洁客厅前，我把包拿起来了。

examples.en: Our robot vacuum sometimes changes direction when it sees chair legs in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们的「扫地机器人」在厨房遇到椅腿时，有时会掉头。

words.enDefinition: the persistent presence of unwanted mice or rats

examples.en: We reported signs of a rodent infestation after noticing gnaw marks around several kitchen cupboards.
examples.zh: 我们注意到几个厨房橱柜附近有啃咬痕迹，就报告了可能存在「鼠害」。

examples.en: The housing office sent a specialist to assess the suspected rodent infestation in the basement.
examples.zh: 住房办公室派专业人员检查地下室疑似存在的「鼠害」。

words.enDefinition: a window covering that coils around a horizontal tube

examples.en: I pulled the roller blind down to stop the glare on my screen.
examples.zh: 我拉下「卷帘」，免得屏幕反光。

examples.en: The roller blind fits inside the frame and leaves the windowsill free.
examples.zh: 「卷帘」装在窗框里，不会占窗台的地方。

words.enDefinition: a small wheeled shelving unit for holding everyday items

examples.en: My rolling storage cart fits between the desk and the foot of the bed.
examples.zh: 我的「带轮收纳车」刚好能塞在书桌和床尾之间。

examples.en: We use a rolling storage cart for art supplies in our shared studio.
examples.zh: 我们在共用工作室里用「带轮收纳车」装美术用品。

words.enDefinition: water entering a building through a damaged roof

examples.en: A roof leak forced us to move our desks away from the wall before class.
examples.zh: 因为「屋顶漏水」，我们上课前不得不把书桌搬离墙边。

examples.en: The contractor inspected the roof leak on the first clear day after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后第一个晴天，承包商检查了「屋顶漏水」的问题。

words.enDefinition: a post announcing an open room in a flat

examples.en: Her post says room available from October first, right by the engineering quad.
examples.zh: 她的帖子写着十月一日起「有房出租」，就在工学院广场旁边。

examples.en: Message quickly whenever you see room available in a quiet flat.
examples.zh: 一看到安静公寓里「有房出租」，就要马上联系。

collocations: room available in a shared flat

words.enDefinition: a label showing which room an item should go to

examples.en: We added a room label to each box to make unloading easier later.
examples.zh: 我们给每个箱子贴了「房间标识贴」，方便待会儿卸货。

examples.en: The room label said kitchen, but the box was full of my notes.
examples.zh: 「房间标识贴」上写着厨房，可箱子里全是我的笔记。

words.enDefinition: a service taking an item into a room you choose

examples.en: I paid for room-of-choice delivery because the wardrobe was too heavy to carry upstairs myself.
examples.zh: 衣柜太重，我一个人搬不上楼，于是付费选了「送货至指定房间」。

examples.en: The order includes room-of-choice delivery, so the driver can bring the bed upstairs.
examples.zh: 订单包含「送货至指定房间」，所以司机可以把床搬上楼。

words.enDefinition: a post saying you are looking for a room

examples.en: She posted a room wanted ad with her budget and preferred move-in date.
examples.zh: 她发了一条「求租广告」，写明了预算和期望入住日期。

examples.en: Reply to the room wanted ad quickly because good tenants get snapped up.
examples.zh: 看到「求租广告」要尽快回复，好租客很抢手。

collocations: reply to a room wanted ad
room wanted ad in the group chat

words.enDefinition: an agreement between people sharing a home about daily responsibilities

examples.en: We wrote a roommate agreement that covered overnight guests, dishes and weekday quiet hours.
examples.zh: 我们写了份「室友公约」，约定留宿访客、洗碗和工作日安静时段。

examples.en: The accommodation office sent us a sample roommate agreement before we moved into residence.
examples.zh: 搬进宿舍前，住宿办公室给我们发了一份「室友公约」范本。

words.enDefinition: a chat to see if you suit living together

examples.en: Treat the roommate interview like a casual chat, not a job interview.
examples.zh: 「室友面谈」就当闲聊，不用搞成求职面试。

examples.en: During the roommate interview, ask how they feel about overnight guests.
examples.zh: 「室友面谈」时问问他们对留宿客人是什么态度。

words.enDefinition: a post advertising an opening for a new roommate

examples.en: There is a roommate wanted post on the class forum for a September move-in.
examples.zh: 班级论坛上有一条九月入住的「招室友」帖子。

examples.en: The roommate wanted ad says bills are split four ways.
examples.zh: 那条「招室友」广告写着账单四人平摊。

words.enDefinition: a device that turns food continuously while it cooks

examples.en: The oven has a rotisserie, although we've only used it for two Sunday dinners.
examples.zh: 这台烤箱有「旋转烤叉装置」，不过我们只在两次周日晚饭用过。

examples.en: My flatmate read the manual because she had never used a rotisserie before.
examples.zh: 我室友以前没用过「旋转烤叉装置」，于是翻看了说明书。

words.enDefinition: the arrangement of paying to use a provider's router

examples.en: The company offers router rental if you don't want to buy your own equipment.
examples.zh: 如果不想自己买设备，这家公司提供「路由器租用」。

examples.en: I checked whether router rental was included in the price on the broadband website.
examples.zh: 我查了宽带网站上的价格是否包含「路由器租用」。

words.enDefinition: the process of sending rented router equipment back to its provider

examples.en: The shop gave me a receipt for the router return when I cancelled my plan.
examples.zh: 我取消套餐后，在门店「归还路由器」时拿到了一张收据。

examples.en: Check the router return instructions before leaving the flat at the end of term.
examples.zh: 学期末搬出公寓之前，先看一下「归还路由器」的说明。

words.enDefinition: regular work that keeps property in good condition

examples.en: The manager will give us a week's notice before routine maintenance on the building's heating system.
examples.zh: 大楼供暖系统做「日常维护」前，物业经理会提前一周通知我们。

examples.en: I asked whether changing the air filter counts as routine maintenance under my apartment lease.
examples.zh: 我问按公寓租约，更换空气滤网算不算「日常维护」。

words.enDefinition: a code identifying the bank for a US payment

examples.en: I checked the routing number twice before setting up my rent transfer.
examples.zh: 设置房租转账前，我核对了两遍「美国银行识别号」。

examples.en: The portal asks for a routing number and the number of my checking account.
examples.zh: 平台要我填「美国银行识别号」以及支票账户的账号。

words.enDefinition: money charged for collecting waste left at a property

examples.en: We asked about the rubbish removal charge because the bin bags belonged to a different flat.
examples.zh: 我们询问了「垃圾清运费」，因为那几袋垃圾是另一套公寓住户的。

examples.en: The agent removed the rubbish removal charge after we sent a photo of the empty yard.
examples.zh: 我们发去院子已经清空的照片后，中介取消了「垃圾清运费」。

collocations: a rubbish removal charge on the statement

words.enDefinition: a layer placed underneath a rug to keep it still

examples.en: We added a rug pad after the carpet kept shifting on the tiles.
examples.zh: 地毯在瓷砖地上总跑位，我们就加了「地毯防滑垫」。

examples.en: I cut the rug pad so it wouldn't stick out around the edges.
examples.zh: 我把「地毯防滑垫」裁小了一圈，这样边缘就不会露出来。

collocations: cut a rug pad to size

words.enDefinition: a long narrow rug used in a hallway or aisle

examples.en: We found a runner rug wide enough for the narrow hallway upstairs.
examples.zh: 我们找到一块「长条地毯」，宽度刚好适合楼上的狭窄走廊。

examples.en: The runner rug stops the floor feeling cold on early mornings in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天一大早，「长条地毯」让地面踩起来没那么冰。

words.enDefinition: a toilet that keeps refilling or flowing after flushing

examples.en: The running toilet was loud enough for my roommate to hear from the hallway.
examples.zh: 「持续流水的马桶」声音大到我室友在走廊都能听见。

examples.en: I recorded the sound of the running toilet so the maintenance team could hear it.
examples.zh: 我录下了「持续流水的马桶」发出的声音，让维修团队也能听到。

collocations: the sound of a running toilet

words.enDefinition: an area generally regarded as safe for residents

examples.en: After months of walking home from evening classes, I could tell it was a safe neighborhood.
examples.zh: 连续几个月晚课后步行回家，我感觉自己住在一个「治安好的社区」。

examples.en: We asked local students what they meant when they called it a safe neighborhood.
examples.zh: 我们问了本地学生，他们说这里是「治安好的社区」具体指什么。

words.enDefinition: an appliance with heated plates that presses and toasts sandwiches

examples.en: We used the sandwich press to make quick cheese sandwiches between our evening lectures.
examples.zh: 晚上两节课的间隙，我们用「热压三明治机」很快做好了奶酪三明治。

examples.en: The sandwich press went back in the cupboard after my roommate had finished making lunch.
examples.zh: 室友做完午饭后，把「热压三明治机」放回了橱柜。

collocations: toast bread in a sandwich press

words.enDefinition: bookmark a rental ad to look at again

examples.en: Save a listing right away because good rooms disappear within hours.
examples.zh: 看到合适的马上「收藏房源」，好房间几个小时就没了。

examples.en: I saved ten listings last night and messaged the three I liked best.
examples.zh: 我昨晚一共「收藏房源」十条，然后联系了最喜欢的那三家。

words.enDefinition: a planned period when a service will be unavailable

examples.en: The scheduled outage starts at noon, so I'll work from the library that day.
examples.zh: 「计划停供」从中午开始，那天我会去图书馆学习。

examples.en: I moved my online meeting after seeing the notice about the scheduled outage.
examples.zh: 看了「计划停供」通知后，我改了线上会议的时间。

words.enDefinition: a payment set up to go through on a chosen date

examples.en: I moved the scheduled payment to Friday because Thursday is a bank holiday.
examples.zh: 星期四银行放假，我把「预约付款」改到了星期五。

examples.en: The scheduled payment will go through before my morning lecture on Monday.
examples.zh: 这笔「预约付款」会在星期一早课前转出。

words.enDefinition: a kitchen work surface marked by shallow cuts

examples.en: I sent the landlord a photo of the scratched worktop before the maintenance worker arrived.
examples.zh: 维修人员来之前，我给房东发了一张「有划痕的厨房台面」的照片。

examples.en: The contractor said the scratched worktop could be repaired during a visit later this month.
examples.zh: 承包商说本月晚些时候上门就能处理「有划痕的厨房台面」。

words.enDefinition: money charged for assessing a prospective renter's suitability

examples.en: We asked whether each roommate had to pay a separate screening fee with the application.
examples.zh: 我们询问合租申请时，是不是每位室友都得单独交一份「租客审核费」。

examples.en: My screening fee covered the checks, but it wasn't enough to reserve the room.
examples.zh: 我交的「租客审核费」只用于审核，并不能保留房间。

words.enDefinition: a hole into which a screw is designed to fit

examples.en: One screw hole does not line up with the bracket on my desk.
examples.zh: 我书桌上的一个「螺丝孔」对不上支架。

examples.en: The screw hole is hidden by a small sticker on the inside panel.
examples.zh: 内侧板上有张小贴纸，把「螺丝孔」盖住了。

words.enDefinition: to close boxes securely so their contents cannot fall out

examples.en: We waited to seal the boxes until everyone had found their phone chargers.
examples.zh: 等大家都找到了自己的充电器，我们才「把箱子封好」。

examples.en: Could you seal the boxes while I take the last few bags downstairs?
examples.zh: 我把最后几袋东西拿下楼时，你能「封好箱子」吗？

words.enDefinition: the distance from the floor to the seat of a chair

examples.en: I adjusted the seat height so my feet could rest on the floor.
examples.zh: 我调整了「座面高度」，让双脚能平放在地上。

examples.en: The seat height is too low for the desk that came with my room.
examples.zh: 对房间原配的书桌来说，这个「座面高度」太低了。

words.enDefinition: furniture previously owned and used by someone else

examples.en: We bought secondhand furniture so we could spend more on course materials.
examples.zh: 我们买了「二手家具」，这样就能多留些钱买上课的材料。

examples.en: The charity shop sells secondhand furniture and can deliver it for a small fee.
examples.zh: 慈善商店出售「二手家具」，付一点运费就能送货。

words.enDefinition: a sofa made of separate sections arranged together

examples.en: The sectional sofa came in two pieces, which made it easier to carry upstairs.
examples.zh: 「组合沙发」分为两块，搬上楼容易一些。

examples.en: Our sectional sofa fits into the corner without blocking the balcony door.
examples.zh: 我们家的「组合沙发」正好放在角落里，不会挡住阳台门。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement letting tenants rent without a conventional cash deposit

examples.en: The building offered a security deposit waiver for a fee, but I chose to pay the deposit.
examples.zh: 这栋楼提供付费的「租房押金免缴方案」，但我还是选择直接交押金。

examples.en: I asked whether the security deposit waiver changed what we would owe for damage when leaving.
examples.zh: 我问选了「租房押金免缴方案」以后，退租时损坏物品的赔偿责任会不会变。

words.enDefinition: the process of putting a purchased item together yourself

examples.en: Our new wardrobe requires self-assembly, so I borrowed a screwdriver from the porter.
examples.zh: 新衣柜需要「自行组装」，我就向门房借了把螺丝刀。

examples.en: I chose self-assembly because the store wanted too much to build the bed.
examples.zh: 商家收的装床费太贵，我选了「自行组装」。

words.enDefinition: the equipment and instructions for setting up a service yourself

examples.en: The self-installation kit arrived just in time for the first week of classes.
examples.zh: 「自助安装套件」正好赶在开学第一周到了。

examples.en: Our self-installation kit was missing a cable, so we contacted the broadband company.
examples.zh: 我们的「自助安装套件」少了一根线，所以我们联系了宽带公司。

words.enDefinition: a site where customers rent private spaces to store belongings

examples.en: The self-storage facility offered a student rate if we booked before June.
examples.zh: 只要在六月前预约，「自助仓储中心」就给我们学生价。

examples.en: I chose a self-storage facility within walking distance of the new flat.
examples.zh: 我选了从新公寓步行可到的「自助仓储中心」。

collocations: book space at a self-storage facility

words.enDefinition: a mode that uses moisture levels to determine drying time

examples.en: I chose sensor dry so the dryer could stop once the shirts were dry.
examples.zh: 我选了「感应烘干」，衬衫一干，烘干机就能自动停下来。

examples.en: The campus dryer has sensor dry and a separate option for choosing the run time.
examples.zh: 学校烘干机有「感应烘干」，还可以另选按时长烘干。

words.enDefinition: to deliver a formal notice by a recognized method

examples.en: The adviser showed me how to serve notice under the terms of my lease.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我如何按租约规定「正式送达通知」。

examples.en: We agreed to serve notice in the way described on the first page of the agreement.
examples.zh: 我们约定按合同第一页写的方式「正式送达通知」。

words.enDefinition: the property address where a service is supplied

examples.en: The service address is my flat, but the bills go to my parents.
examples.zh: 「服务地址」是我的公寓，不过账单寄给我爸妈。

examples.en: The broadband company asked for the full service address before checking available speeds.
examples.zh: 宽带公司说，需要完整的「服务地址」才能查可用网速。

words.enDefinition: a check to see which services can reach a given address

examples.en: The service availability check showed only one broadband provider for our basement flat.
examples.zh: 「服务覆盖查询」显示，我们地下室的公寓只有一家宽带供应商可选。

examples.en: I ran a service availability check before putting down a deposit on the flat.
examples.zh: 交公寓押金之前，我做了一次「服务覆盖查询」。

words.enDefinition: a visit by a worker to inspect or repair equipment

examples.en: The contractor scheduled a service call to check why the balcony door would not close.
examples.zh: 承包商安排了一次「上门维修」，检查阳台门为什么关不上。

examples.en: I confirmed the service call before asking my roommate to stay at home on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 我确认了「上门维修」，才请室友星期三留在家里。

words.enDefinition: a lift intended for deliveries, equipment or building staff

examples.en: The building manager asked our movers to use the service elevator at the back.
examples.zh: 楼管请搬家工人走后面的「货运电梯」。

examples.en: We had to reserve the service elevator before bringing the wardrobe into the building.
examples.zh: 把衣柜搬进楼里之前，我们得先预约「货运电梯」。

words.enDefinition: a temporary break in the delivery of a service

examples.en: We got a text about a service interruption just before my online seminar.
examples.zh: 就在我的线上研讨课开始前，我们收到一条「服务中断」的短信。

examples.en: The supplier apologized for the service interruption and gave us an estimated return time.
examples.zh: 供应商对「服务中断」表示歉意，并告诉了我们预计恢复的时间。

collocations: notify customers of a service interruption

words.enDefinition: a charge for restarting a service that was disconnected

examples.en: Ask whether the service reconnection fee will be added to next month's bill.
examples.zh: 问问「服务恢复费」会不会加到下个月的账单上。

examples.en: Our housemates agreed to split the service reconnection fee evenly between four people.
examples.zh: 我们四个合租室友同意平摊「服务恢复费」。

words.enDefinition: the return of a service after it has stopped

examples.en: The supplier gave us a rough time for service restoration after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，供应商告诉了我们大致的「服务恢复」时间。

examples.en: We checked the website for updates on service restoration before coming back home.
examples.zh: 回家之前，我们上网站看了「服务恢复」的最新进度。

words.enDefinition: save a portion of your funds for paying rent

examples.en: I set aside rent money as soon as my wages reach my account.
examples.zh: 工资一到账，我就先「留出房租钱」。

examples.en: We set aside rent money before booking our train tickets for spring break.
examples.zh: 订春假火车票前，我们先「留出了房租钱」。

collocations: remember to set aside rent money

words.enDefinition: arrange for future payments to be made automatically

examples.en: I decided to set up autopay before leaving for my exchange semester.
examples.zh: 去交换学习前，我决定「设置自动付款」。

examples.en: The site lets you set up autopay after you confirm your bank details.
examples.zh: 确认银行账户信息后，你就可以在网站上「设置自动付款」。

collocations: set up autopay with a debit card

words.enDefinition: to arrange for essential services at a home

examples.en: We need to set up utilities before the first night in our flat.
examples.zh: 我们需要在搬进公寓的第一晚之前「开通公用服务」。

examples.en: The landlord showed us how to set up utilities when we collected the keys.
examples.zh: 我们领钥匙时，房东告诉了我们怎么「开通公用服务」。

collocations: set up utilities before moving in
set up utilities in your name

words.enDefinition: resolve a dispute by agreement without a court ruling

examples.en: The landlord offered to settle out of court after reviewing the pictures from our moving day.
examples.zh: 房东看过我们搬家当天的照片后，提出「庭外和解」。

examples.en: We decided to settle out of court because both sides were willing to accept a reduced deduction.
examples.zh: 双方都愿意接受较低的扣款额，所以我们决定「庭外和解」。

collocations: agree to settle out of court
offer to settle out of court
prefer to settle out of court

words.enDefinition: pay everything that remains owed on an account

examples.en: I can settle the balance on Monday after the university releases my grant.
examples.zh: 学校发放补助后，我星期一就能「结清余款」。

examples.en: Please send the updated total so we can settle the balance before moving out.
examples.zh: 请发来更新后的总额，我们好在搬走前「结清余款」。

words.enDefinition: a proposal intended to end a disagreement by agreement

examples.en: The landlord made a settlement offer that returned most of the money to us.
examples.zh: 房东提出了一项「和解提议」，愿意把大部分钱退给我们。

examples.en: I asked my housemates to consider the settlement offer before our call with the adviser.
examples.zh: 和顾问通话之前，我请合租室友考虑一下这份「和解提议」。

words.enDefinition: a provision preserving the contract when part is invalid

examples.en: I asked the adviser why our residential lease had a severability clause near the signature page.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，为什么住宅租约靠近签字页的地方有「可分割性条款」。

examples.en: The severability clause explains what happens to the rest of the agreement if one condition is invalid.
examples.zh: 「可分割性条款」说明了某项条件无效时，协议的其他部分如何处理。

words.enDefinition: the part of the rent that one person pays

examples.en: My share of the rent is higher because I have the bigger room.
examples.zh: 我住的是大房间，所以我「应分摊的房租」更高。

examples.en: I sent my share of the rent before leaving campus for the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末离校前，我把「自己那份房租」转了过去。

collocations: pay your share of the rent
cover someone's share of the rent
calculate each person's share of the rent

words.enDefinition: an apartment where tenants share the kitchen and bathroom

examples.en: In a shared apartment you get your own bedroom but share the kitchen.
examples.zh: 住「合租公寓」有自己的卧室，但厨房是共用的。

examples.en: My shared apartment has three flatmates from Korea, Brazil, and Germany.
examples.zh: 我的「合租公寓」里有三个室友，分别来自韩国、巴西和德国。

words.enDefinition: a bathroom that several tenants take turns using

examples.en: With a shared bathroom, set an alarm or you will be late.
examples.zh: 用「共用卫浴」就得定闹钟，不然上课要迟到。

examples.en: The shared bathroom is cleaned weekly, but bring your own mat.
examples.zh: 「共用卫浴」每周有人打扫，但防滑垫要自己带。

words.enDefinition: an open yard used by residents of several homes

examples.en: Our building has a shared courtyard where flatmates sometimes eat lunch on sunny days.
examples.zh: 我们楼有个「共用庭院」，天晴时室友有时在那里吃午饭。

examples.en: The residents asked everyone to clear the shared courtyard after the summer barbecue.
examples.zh: 夏日烧烤结束后，住户请大家一起收拾「共用庭院」。

words.enDefinition: a driveway that more than one property uses for access

examples.en: I let the neighbours know before leaving the van on the shared driveway.
examples.zh: 把货车停在「共用车道」上之前，我先和邻居打了声招呼。

examples.en: Please leave enough room on the shared driveway for both cars to get through.
examples.zh: 请在「共用车道」上留出足够空间，让两辆车都能通过。

words.enDefinition: money put together to buy groceries that housemates share
