examples.en: We started a shared grocery fund for milk, bread and other kitchen basics.
examples.zh: 我们凑了笔「合租共用食品费」，用来买牛奶、面包等日常食品。

examples.en: Each flatmate pays a little into the shared grocery fund at the start of term.
examples.zh: 开学时每个室友都会往「合租共用食品费」里交一点。

collocations: set up a shared grocery fund
pay into the shared grocery fund

words.enDefinition: a kitchen that everyone in the flat uses

examples.en: Six tenants use one shared kitchen, so Sunday nights get crowded.
examples.zh: 六个租客合用这间「共用厨房」，周日晚上特别挤。

examples.en: Label your food in the shared kitchen or it disappears fast.
examples.zh: 「共用厨房」里的食物要写上名字，不然很快就没了。

words.enDefinition: a meter measuring combined usage for more than one unit

examples.en: There is a shared meter for both flats, so our bills are combined.
examples.zh: 两套公寓用一块「共用计量表」，所以账单合在一起。

examples.en: Ask the landlord how costs are divided if the property has a shared meter.
examples.zh: 如果房子用的是「共用计量表」，就问房东费用怎么分摊。

words.enDefinition: one bedroom that two or more people sleep in

examples.en: A shared room halves the rent, but bring earplugs and a sleep mask.
examples.zh: 住「合住房间」房租减半，但要带上耳塞和眼罩。

examples.en: The ad offers a shared room in a flat five minutes from campus.
examples.zh: 广告上说有一间「合住房间」，离学校五分钟。

words.enDefinition: a shelf that several people use to keep common items

examples.en: We keep tea and coffee on the shared shelf near the kitchen door.
examples.zh: 茶和咖啡放在厨房门附近的「共用置物架」上。

examples.en: Please leave a little space on the shared shelf for the new flatmate.
examples.zh: 请在「共用置物架」上留一点位置给新室友。

collocations: put something on the shared shelf

words.enDefinition: a stairwell used by residents of several homes

examples.en: We kept our shoes inside so the shared stairwell would stay clear for everyone.
examples.zh: 鞋子我们放在家里，免得挡了大家走「共用楼梯间」。

examples.en: The caretaker said bikes could not be left unattended in our shared stairwell.
examples.zh: 管理员说，自行车不能随便停在「共用楼梯间」。

words.enDefinition: thin curtains that let some light through

examples.en: The sheer curtains let enough daylight through for the plants by my window.
examples.zh: 窗边的植物隔着「纱帘」也能晒到足够的阳光。

examples.en: We chose sheer curtains to keep the living room bright in the mornings.
examples.zh: 我们选了「纱帘」，让客厅早上也能保持明亮。

collocations: layer sheer curtains behind heavier curtains

words.enDefinition: coordinated sheets and usually pillowcases sold as one set

examples.en: My aunt bought me a sheet set as a present for moving into residence.
examples.zh: 姨妈送了我一套「床单套装」，当作搬进宿舍的礼物。

examples.en: The sheet set includes one pillowcase, so I ordered a spare separately.
examples.zh: 「床单套装」只带一个枕套，所以我另外买了个备用的。

words.enDefinition: a protective sheet placed on the surface of a shelf

examples.en: I cut the shelf liner to fit the narrow shelves in the hall cupboard.
examples.zh: 我把「搁板垫」裁成合适的大小，铺在门厅柜子的窄搁板上。

examples.en: We put down shelf liner so the mugs wouldn't slide around when we opened the cabinet.
examples.zh: 我们铺了「搁板垫」，这样开柜门时马克杯就不会滑动。

words.enDefinition: a freestanding or wall-mounted frame holding several shelves

examples.en: The shelving unit fits neatly into the space between our two desks.
examples.zh: 「多层置物架」正好可以放进我们两张桌子之间。

examples.en: I brought my notes upstairs after we finished assembling the shelving unit.
examples.zh: 我们装好「多层置物架」后，我把笔记搬上了楼。

words.enDefinition: a quick, easy journey from home to campus

examples.en: I pay two hundred extra for a short commute and never regret it.
examples.zh: 为了「短通勤」我多付两百，从不后悔。

examples.en: A short commute means I can go home for lunch between lectures.
examples.zh: 「短通勤」意味着课间能回家吃个午饭。

words.enDefinition: a rental for a few weeks or months only

examples.en: Book a short-term rental for your first month while you search properly.
examples.zh: 第一个月先订个「短租」，再慢慢认真找房。

examples.en: A short-term rental near campus costs more per week but buys you time.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「短租」每周贵一些，但能为你争取时间。

words.enDefinition: storage rented for a limited period rather than permanently

examples.en: We needed short-term storage because our leases did not overlap that summer.
examples.zh: 那年暑假，新旧租期接不上，我们需要「短期寄存」。

examples.en: My housemate suggested short-term storage instead of taking everything home on the train.
examples.zh: 室友建议办「短期寄存」，免得坐火车时把所有东西带回家。

words.enDefinition: a small list of the best options you found

examples.en: After two weeks of searching I finally narrowed it down to a shortlist of three.
examples.zh: 找了两周后，我最终把范围缩小到一份只有三个房间的「候选清单」。

examples.en: Send your shortlist to a friend and ask which apartment she would pick.
examples.zh: 把「候选清单」发给朋友，问问她会选哪套公寓。

words.enDefinition: to formally approve a repair as complete

examples.en: The manager wanted to test the lock before she would sign off a repair that involved access.
examples.zh: 这项维修关系到出入，物业经理想先试一下锁，再「确认维修验收」。

examples.en: I asked who would sign off a repair if none of the tenants were there that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我问那天下午租客都不在的话，由谁来「确认维修验收」。

collocations: ask someone to sign off a repair
sign off a repair after inspection
refuse to sign off a repair

words.enDefinition: the section of a document reserved for signing details

examples.en: My surname was misspelled in the signature block, so I asked for a fresh copy.
examples.zh: 「签名栏」里我的姓拼错了，我就要求换一份。

examples.en: The agent added a separate signature block for each roommate at the end of the lease.
examples.zh: 中介在租约末尾给每个室友加了一个独立的「签名栏」。

words.enDefinition: a duplicate document that bears the required signatures

examples.en: I kept a signed copy on my phone so I could check the move-out date.
examples.zh: 我在手机上存了一份「已签字的副本」，方便查搬出日期。

examples.en: The letting agent promised to email a signed copy once the landlord had approved it.
examples.zh: 中介答应房东确认后发来一份「已签字的副本」。

words.enDefinition: signing separate copies that together form one agreement

examples.en: The agent suggested signing in counterparts because my two roommates were still in different countries.
examples.zh: 两位室友还在不同国家，中介建议「各自签署合同副本」。

examples.en: We asked whether signing in counterparts meant we each kept an identical version of the lease.
examples.zh: 我们问「分签合同副本」是不是指每个人都留一份内容相同的租约。

collocations: a clause permitting signing in counterparts

words.enDefinition: a setting reducing noise or lights for overnight use

examples.en: The air purifier dims its lights when I choose sleep mode before going to bed.
examples.zh: 我睡前选「睡眠模式」时，空气净化器会把指示灯调暗。

examples.en: I could barely hear the fan after my housemate switched it to sleep mode.
examples.zh: 室友把风扇切到「睡眠模式」后，我几乎听不到声音。

words.enDefinition: a removable fabric cover fitted loosely over furniture

examples.en: We put a slipcover on the sofa to hide the old stains.
examples.zh: 我们给沙发套了个「可拆卸家具罩」，把旧污渍遮起来。

examples.en: I washed the slipcover before handing the living room back to the landlord.
examples.zh: 把客厅交还房东之前，我把「可拆卸家具罩」洗了。

words.enDefinition: an electric pot for cooking food slowly over hours

examples.en: I made stew in the slow cooker and shared it with my flatmates after class.
examples.zh: 我用「慢炖锅」做了一锅炖菜，下课后和室友分着吃了。

examples.en: The slow cooker is useful when we want enough soup for several lunches this week.
examples.zh: 这周想多做点汤带午饭时，「慢炖锅」就派上用场了。

collocations: cook stew in a slow cooker

words.enDefinition: a drain that lets water out more slowly than expected

examples.en: The slow drain left water standing in the bathroom sink for several minutes each morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上浴室洗手池都积水几分钟，因为有个「排水缓慢的排水口」。

examples.en: I compared notes with my flatmates to see whether we all had a slow drain.
examples.zh: 我和室友交流了一下，看是不是大家都遇到了「排水缓慢的排水口」。

words.enDefinition: a leak that releases only a little liquid over time

examples.en: I noticed a slow leak because a small puddle kept forming under the kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 厨房水槽底下总积一小摊水，我才发现有「缓慢渗漏」。

examples.en: The plumber said the slow leak was coming from a connection behind the washing machine.
examples.zh: 水管工说，「缓慢渗漏」是洗衣机后面的一个接口造成的。

words.enDefinition: a court that hears disputes involving relatively small amounts

examples.en: I asked the housing adviser how small claims court handles disagreements about deposits after a tenancy.
examples.zh: 我问住房顾问，租期结束后的押金争议在「小额索赔法院」会怎么处理。

examples.en: We kept all the photographs in case the dispute went to small claims court.
examples.zh: 我们留存了全部照片，以防争议要提交「小额索赔法院」。

collocations: file a claim in small claims court
take a dispute to small claims court

words.enDefinition: a move involving a limited number of belongings

examples.en: We only had a few boxes, so the company booked us for a small move.
examples.zh: 我们一共才几箱东西，所以搬家公司给我们约的是「小件搬家」。

examples.en: Ask if they charge a minimum fee even for a small move across town.
examples.zh: 问问即使是同城「小件搬家」，他们是否也有最低收费。

words.enDefinition: a meter that sends usage readings electronically to a supplier

examples.en: After the smart meter was installed, we could track energy use more easily.
examples.zh: 装上「智能计量表」以后，查看能源用量方便多了。

examples.en: Ask whether the smart meter will keep sending readings if you switch suppliers.
examples.zh: 问问如果换了供应商，「智能计量表」还能不能继续发送读数。

words.enDefinition: a screen that shows usage information from a smart meter

examples.en: Our smart meter display shows how much electricity we used to cook dinner.
examples.zh: 「智能表显示屏」显示了我们做晚饭用了多少电。

examples.en: I checked the smart meter display after turning off every light in the flat.
examples.zh: 把公寓里所有的灯关掉后，我看了看「智能表显示屏」。

collocations: set up a smart meter display

words.enDefinition: a sofa that opens or folds out into a bed

examples.en: My cousin slept on the sofa bed when she came for graduation.
examples.zh: 表妹来参加毕业典礼时，睡的是「沙发床」。

examples.en: We fold the sofa bed away each morning to free up the living room.
examples.zh: 每天早上我们都把「沙发床」收起来，腾出客厅的空间。

words.enDefinition: the only person renting a home under the agreement

examples.en: I was the sole tenant on the lease even though my brother visited often.
examples.zh: 虽然我弟弟经常来，但租约上的「唯一承租人」是我。

examples.en: As the sole tenant of the studio, Maya dealt directly with the landlord about repairs.
examples.zh: 作为这套开间的「唯一承租人」，玛雅有维修问题就直接找房东。

collocations: the sole tenant on the lease

words.enDefinition: a code identifying a UK bank and branch

examples.en: The agent sent the sort code separately from the landlord's account number.
examples.zh: 中介把「英国银行分行代码」和房东的银行账号分开发给了我。

examples.en: Check the sort code before sending rent to the new property manager.
examples.zh: 给新物业经理交租前，请核对「英国银行分行代码」。

words.enDefinition: noise travels easily from one place to another

examples.en: In this building, sound carries through the walls even when people speak quietly.
examples.zh: 这栋楼里「声音很容易传开」，即使隔壁说话不大声也能听见。

examples.en: We didn't realise sound carries so far along the corridor after ten at night.
examples.zh: 我们没想到晚上十点过后，「声音很容易传到」走廊很远的位置。

words.enDefinition: facing towards the south

examples.en: The south-facing bedroom overlooks the garden, while the kitchen faces the street.
examples.zh: 「朝南」的卧室俯瞰花园，厨房则面向街道。

examples.en: Ask which rooms are south-facing before you pay a deposit.
examples.zh: 交押金之前先问清楚哪些房间「朝南」。

words.enDefinition: an extra bedroom not currently being used

examples.en: Our flat has a spare room, so we posted an ad for a third flatmate.
examples.zh: 我们公寓有个「空余房间」，所以发帖招第三个室友。

examples.en: The landlord turned the spare room into storage, which annoyed the tenants.
examples.zh: 房东把「空余房间」改成了储物间，房客们很不高兴。

collocations: turn the spare room into a study

words.enDefinition: an extra group of keys for the same property

examples.en: My roommate kept a spare set of keys while I was abroad for summer.
examples.zh: 我暑假出国时，室友留了一套「备用钥匙」。

examples.en: The landlord asked whether a spare set of keys was still with reception.
examples.zh: 房东问前台是否还留着一套「备用钥匙」。

collocations: keep a spare set of keys
make a spare set of keys
return a spare set of keys

words.enDefinition: how fast a washer drum rotates to remove water

examples.en: I used a lower spin speed for the sweater I'd just washed by itself.
examples.zh: 刚才单独洗那件毛衣时，我选了较低的「脱水转速」。

examples.en: The display shows the spin speed next to the water temperature for each program.
examples.zh: 每个程序的显示界面上，水温旁边就是「脱水转速」。

words.enDefinition: divide the rent among the people living together

examples.en: We split the rent evenly even though my room is slightly bigger.
examples.zh: 虽然我的房间稍大一点，我们还是平均「分摊房租」。

examples.en: Splitting the rent three ways brings each share down to four hundred.
examples.zh: 「分摊房租」三份之后，每人只要四百。

collocations: split the rent by room size
agree on how to split the rent

words.enDefinition: to divide the cost of household services among several people

examples.en: We agreed to split utility bills according to how long each person stayed.
examples.zh: 我们同意按照每个人住的时间来「分摊水电等费用」。

examples.en: My flatmates use an app to split utility bills at the end of each month.
examples.zh: 月底室友们会用一个应用来「分摊水电等费用」。

words.enDefinition: a rotating dishwasher part that sprays water across the racks

examples.en: The tall plate was too close to the spray arm, so I moved it sideways.
examples.zh: 高盘子太靠近「喷水臂」，我把它挪到旁边了。

examples.en: The manual shows a separate spray arm for the two levels inside our dishwasher.
examples.zh: 说明书上画着我们洗碗机里上下两层各自的「喷水臂」。

collocations: leave room for the spray arm

words.enDefinition: containers designed to sit securely on top of each other

examples.en: We used stackable storage bins to make better use of the closet space.
examples.zh: 我们用了「可堆叠收纳箱」，把壁橱的空间利用得更充分。

examples.en: The stackable storage bins hold notebooks from all four years of university.
examples.zh: 这些「可堆叠收纳箱」里装着我大学四年的笔记本。

words.enDefinition: a chair shaped to stack neatly with other matching chairs

examples.en: The stacking chair can sit on top of the other chairs after dinner.
examples.zh: 吃完饭后，可以把这把「可叠放椅」摞到别的椅子上。

examples.en: We picked a stacking chair because our shared kitchen has little storage space.
examples.zh: 公用厨房没多少收纳空间，所以我们挑了一把「可叠放椅」。

collocations: buy a set of stacking chairs

words.enDefinition: a motorized kitchen mixer that sits on a fixed base

examples.en: We used the stand mixer to mix enough cookie dough for everyone in our building.
examples.zh: 我们用「台式搅拌机」拌了面团，够给整栋楼的人做饼干。

examples.en: The stand mixer belongs to my roommate, but she lets me borrow it for baking.
examples.zh: 「台式搅拌机」是我室友的，不过她愿意借给我做烘焙。

words.enDefinition: a rental agreement written using a common prescribed form

examples.en: The agent sent us the standard lease so we could read it before signing.
examples.zh: 中介把「标准租约」发给我们，方便我们签字前先看一遍。

examples.en: I compared the standard lease with the one my previous landlord had given me.
examples.zh: 我把「标准租约」和上一位房东给我的那份做了比较。

words.enDefinition: a default energy plan whose rates can change over time

examples.en: We stayed on the standard variable tariff while we compared longer contracts online.
examples.zh: 在网上比较期限更长的合同期间，我们继续用「标准浮动费率」。

examples.en: The supplier emailed to say its standard variable tariff was changing next month.
examples.zh: 供应商发邮件说，他们的「标准浮动费率」下个月会调整。

collocations: move to a standard variable tariff
stay on a standard variable tariff

words.enDefinition: a low-power state in which a device remains available

examples.en: The display went dark after the coffee machine entered standby mode at the end of breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐结束时咖啡机进入「待机模式」，显示屏暗了下去。

examples.en: The manual explains how long the appliance remains in standby mode when nobody is using it.
examples.zh: 说明书介绍了没人用的时候，电器会在「待机模式」下保持多久。

words.enDefinition: a daily fee charged even when no energy is used

examples.en: The standing charge still applied while we were away for the whole break.
examples.zh: 整个假期我们都不在家，但「按天收的固定费」照收。

examples.en: A low unit price can still leave you paying a high standing charge.
examples.zh: 单价低，也可能要付很高的「按天收的固定费」。

words.enDefinition: a desk designed for work while standing up

examples.en: I use a standing desk for video calls because I like to move around.
examples.zh: 视频通话时我喜欢活动活动，就用「站立式书桌」。

examples.en: The standing desk is too tall for my chair at its highest setting.
examples.zh: 「站立式书桌」调到最高时，我坐椅子就够不着了。

words.enDefinition: begin looking for housing months ahead of term

examples.en: Start searching early because international students need time for video viewings.
examples.zh: 要「提早找房」，国际学生还得留出视频看房的时间。

examples.en: My roommate started searching early and got the cheapest room on our street.
examples.zh: 我室友因为「提早找房」，拿到了我们街上最便宜的一间。

words.enDefinition: cleaning by applying hot vapour to a surface

examples.en: The cleaner recommended steam cleaning for the sofa because normal washing had left a mark.
examples.zh: 普通清洗后仍留有痕迹，保洁员建议给沙发做一次「蒸汽清洁」。

examples.en: We asked if steam cleaning was included in the quote for cleaning both bedroom carpets.
examples.zh: 我们问，两间卧室的地毯清洁报价里是否包含「蒸汽清洁」。

words.enDefinition: an iron that uses steam to remove wrinkles from fabric

examples.en: I borrowed a steam iron to press my trousers before the presentation at university.
examples.zh: 去学校做展示前，我借了个「蒸汽熨斗」把裤子熨了一下。

examples.en: My flatmate bought a compact steam iron that fits on the laundry shelf.
examples.zh: 室友买了个小巧的「蒸汽熨斗」，正好放得下洗衣区的架子。

collocations: iron clothes with a steam iron

words.enDefinition: a floor cleaner that uses hot steam to loosen dirt

examples.en: My housemate borrowed a steam mop for the tiled floor in our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 室友为公用厨房的瓷砖地借来一把「蒸汽拖把」。

examples.en: I checked the floor type before deciding whether to buy a steam mop for our flat.
examples.zh: 决定要不要给公寓买「蒸汽拖把」之前，我先查了地板的材质。

collocations: a steam mop for sealed flooring

words.enDefinition: a door that rubs against its frame when moved

examples.en: The contractor checked the sticking door because it had been hard to open after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后门很难打开，承包商就检查了这扇「开关不畅的门」。

examples.en: I emailed a short video of the sticking door to show where it rubbed.
examples.zh: 我发邮件附上了一段「开关不畅的门」的视频，标明它卡到哪里。

words.enDefinition: not yet rented and open to offers

examples.en: I messaged the landlord to ask if the studio is still available.
examples.zh: 我给房东发了消息，问那间单身公寓是不是「还没租出去」。

examples.en: The listing says still available, but agents often forget to update it.
examples.zh: 房源上写着「还没租出去」，不过中介经常忘记更新。

collocations: ask if it is still available

words.enDefinition: an instruction telling a bank not to honor a payment

examples.en: I put a stop payment on the check after it went missing.
examples.zh: 支票丢了之后，我给这张支票办了「止付」。

examples.en: The bank suggested a stop payment before I mailed the landlord a replacement check.
examples.zh: 银行建议我先办「止付」，再给房东寄一张新支票。

collocations: place a stop payment on a check

words.enDefinition: a bed with compartments or drawers built into its frame

examples.en: I chose a storage bed because there was no room for a wardrobe.
examples.zh: 房间里没地方放衣柜，所以我选了一张「收纳床」。

examples.en: The storage bed has drawers I can open from either side of the frame.
examples.zh: 这张「收纳床」带抽屉，从两侧都能拉开。

words.enDefinition: a long seat with space inside or underneath for belongings

examples.en: I put a storage bench by the door to hold shoes and bags.
examples.zh: 我在门边放了张「储物长凳」，用来放鞋和包。

examples.en: We needed a narrow storage bench so the hallway would stay clear.
examples.zh: 为了让走廊不碍事，我们需要一张窄点的「储物长凳」。

collocations: a storage bench with a lid

words.enDefinition: an individually secured compartment rented for keeping belongings

examples.en: My small storage locker had enough room for two suitcases and a guitar.
examples.zh: 我的小「储物柜」能放下两个行李箱和一把吉他。

examples.en: We left the spare bedding in a storage locker near the station.
examples.zh: 我们把备用床品放在车站附近的一个「储物柜」里。

words.enDefinition: a padded footstool with a compartment inside

examples.en: I keep spare bedding inside the storage ottoman beside my bedroom door.
examples.zh: 我把备用床品放在卧室门边的「储物脚凳」里。

examples.en: The storage ottoman doubles as an extra seat when friends come around.
examples.zh: 朋友来时，「储物脚凳」还能当一个额外的座位。

collocations: lift the lid of a storage ottoman

words.enDefinition: a charge to fund drainage for rainwater and runoff

examples.en: The city listed a stormwater fee alongside the other charges on our statement.
examples.zh: 市政府把「雨水排放费」和账单上的其他费用列在一起。

examples.en: My landlord said the stormwater fee helped pay for drainage along the street.
examples.zh: 房东说，「雨水排放费」用来分担这条街的排水成本。

words.enDefinition: the day when a council cleans a street with dedicated equipment

examples.en: I moved my car before class because Monday was our street cleaning day.
examples.zh: 周一是本街的「街道清扫日」，我在上课前挪了车。

examples.en: The sign shows street cleaning day for each side of the road near campus.
examples.zh: 标牌标明了学校附近这条路两侧各自的「街道清扫日」。

collocations: move the car on street cleaning day

words.enDefinition: traffic and street sounds heard inside the flat

examples.en: Street noise on the second floor kept me awake until the bar closed.
examples.zh: 二楼临街，「街道噪音」吵到酒吧打烊才停。

examples.en: Visit after nine to judge the street noise for yourself.
examples.zh: 九点以后再去看房，亲自感受一下「街道噪音」。

words.enDefinition: stretchy plastic film used to hold items together

examples.en: The movers used stretch wrap to keep the dresser drawers from sliding open.
examples.zh: 搬家工人用「拉伸缠绕膜」固定五斗柜的抽屉，免得它们滑开。

examples.en: I removed the stretch wrap from the chair legs after the delivery arrived.
examples.zh: 送货到了以后，我拆掉了椅腿上的「拉伸缠绕膜」。

words.enDefinition: housing built or reserved mainly for students

examples.en: Private student housing is pricier than dorms but includes cleaning.
examples.zh: 私立「学生公寓」比宿舍贵，但包含保洁。

examples.en: Ask the international office whether student housing is guaranteed for first years.
examples.zh: 问问国际学生办公室，第一年是否保证有「学生公寓」。

words.enDefinition: moving services designed for students and their belongings

examples.en: The union recommended a company that does student removals during the summer holidays.
examples.zh: 学生会推荐了一家暑假提供「学生搬家服务」的公司。

examples.en: I found cheaper student removals by booking before everyone finished their final exams.
examples.zh: 我赶在大家期末考完前下单，订到了更便宜的「学生搬家服务」。

words.enDefinition: one small room combining bed, kitchen, and living space

examples.en: A studio apartment is cheaper, but you cook and sleep in the same room.
examples.zh: 「单身公寓」便宜一些，但做饭和睡觉都在同一个房间。

examples.en: She rents a studio apartment ten minutes from the engineering building.
examples.zh: 她租了一间离工学院大楼十分钟的「单身公寓」。

words.enDefinition: rent your leased place to someone else temporarily

examples.en: My lease says I need written consent before I can sublease the room.
examples.zh: 我的租约写明，我需要先得到书面同意，才可以「转租」房间。

examples.en: I plan to sublease my apartment over the internship and keep my lease.
examples.zh: 实习期间我打算把公寓「转租」出去，自己的租约继续保留。

collocations: sublease my room for the summer

words.enDefinition: a tenant who rents leased space to another person

examples.en: The agreement lists my roommate as the sublessor because she holds the original lease.
examples.zh: 协议上我室友是「转租出租人」，因为原租约是她签的。

examples.en: I asked the sublessor for a copy of the written permission from the apartment manager.
examples.zh: 我请「转租出租人」给我一份公寓物业经理的书面许可。

words.enDefinition: a place rented out again by its current tenant

examples.en: I found a cheap sublet for July and August near the main library.
examples.zh: 我在主图书馆附近找到一处七八月的便宜「转租房源」。

examples.en: The sublet ends in December, so ask what happens to the deposit then.
examples.zh: 这处「转租房源」十二月到期，问问到时候押金怎么处理。

words.enDefinition: to rent a room onward as its current tenant

examples.en: I hope to sublet a room in our flat while I am away doing fieldwork.
examples.zh: 我去外地做田野调查期间，希望能把公寓里的「一间房转租出去」。

examples.en: My friend needed permission to sublet a room before she left for an internship in Glasgow.
examples.zh: 朋友去格拉斯哥实习前，要先拿到「转租一间房」的许可。

collocations: request permission to sublet a room
sublet a room for the summer

words.enDefinition: a contract between a current tenant and a subtenant

examples.en: We signed a subletting agreement that says exactly when the room must be handed back.
examples.zh: 我们签了「转租协议」，里面明确写了什么时候必须交还房间。

examples.en: The housing adviser checked my subletting agreement before the visiting student arrived for her placement.
examples.zh: 来实习的学生到之前，住房顾问审查了我的「转租协议」。

words.enDefinition: a lease provision governing rental to another occupant

examples.en: I checked the subletting clause before offering my room to a friend for the summer.
examples.zh: 我先看了「转租条款」，才提出暑假把房间租给朋友。

examples.en: The agent highlighted the subletting clause because my summer travel plans were still uncertain.
examples.zh: 我的暑期出行计划还没定，中介就标出了「转租条款」。

collocations: a subletting clause in the lease

words.enDefinition: a separate meter measuring usage for one unit within a property

examples.en: The submeter records our usage separately from the rest of the student residences.
examples.zh: 「分户计量表」把我们的用量和学生公寓其他住户的分开记录。

examples.en: I photographed the submeter before moving in so I had my own record.
examples.zh: 搬进去之前，我拍下了「分户计量表」，好自己留个记录。

words.enDefinition: to send a recorded meter value to your utility supplier

examples.en: We can submit a meter reading through the supplier's app before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我们可以在截止日前通过供应商的应用「提交表计读数」。

examples.en: Please submit a meter reading this week so we can check the bill together.
examples.zh: 请这周「提交一下表计读数」，好让我们一起核对账单。

collocations: submit a meter reading by phone
submit a meter reading through the app

words.enDefinition: send in your rental form for consideration

examples.en: Submit an application online the same day you view the flat.
examples.zh: 看完房的当天就在网上「提交申请」。

examples.en: We submitted an application for both rooms to double our chances.
examples.zh: 两间房我们都「提交申请」，双保险机会更大。

words.enDefinition: someone who rents a property from an existing tenant

examples.en: Our lease says the landlord needs to approve a subtenant before anyone moves in.
examples.zh: 我们的租约写明，「转租租客」入住前得先获房东同意。

examples.en: As a subtenant in this flat, I pay rent directly to the main tenant.
examples.zh: 作为这套公寓的「转租租客」，我直接把房租付给主租客。

words.enDefinition: to give up the lease with the landlord's agreement

examples.en: We asked whether we could surrender the lease after our study program ended earlier than planned.
examples.zh: 学习项目提前结束后，我们问能不能「协议退租」。

examples.en: The landlord agreed we could surrender the lease once we settled on a handover date.
examples.zh: 房东同意，只要确定交接日期，我们就可以「协议退租」。

words.enDefinition: to trade assigned cleaning days with another person

examples.en: Could we swap cleaning days because I have an exam early on Tuesday?
examples.zh: 我周二一早有考试，我们能不能「交换清洁值日」？

examples.en: My roommate offered to swap cleaning days after I covered her shift last week.
examples.zh: 上周我替室友值日后，她主动提出「交换清洁值日」。

words.enDefinition: to move your electricity or gas contract to another company

examples.en: We decided to switch energy supplier after comparing rates on a student advice website.
examples.zh: 在学生咨询网站上比过价格后，我们决定「更换能源供应商」。

examples.en: Before you switch energy supplier, check whether your current agreement has an exit fee.
examples.zh: 「更换能源供应商」之前，先查查当前协议是否收解约费。

words.enDefinition: a chair whose seat turns around its vertical support

examples.en: The swivel chair lets me turn from the desk to the shelves.
examples.zh: 坐在「旋转椅」上，我可以从书桌边转向置物架。

examples.en: I bought a swivel chair that fits underneath my desk when pushed in.
examples.zh: 我买了一把推到底就能收进桌底的「旋转椅」。

words.enDefinition: to obtain control and use of the rented property

examples.en: We can take possession on Friday if the cleaner has finished and the keys are ready.
examples.zh: 如果保洁已经做完、钥匙也准备好了，我们星期五就能「接收房屋」。

examples.en: Before we take possession, the agent wants us to confirm who will collect the keys.
examples.zh: 我们「接收房屋」前，中介希望先确认谁会去拿钥匙。

words.enDefinition: to put rubbish bins outside for collection

examples.en: Could you take the bins out before you leave for your evening class?
examples.zh: 你出门上晚课之前，能「把垃圾桶推出去」吗？

examples.en: We forgot to take the bins out on Tuesday because of the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期弄混了日子，我们周二忘了「把垃圾桶推出去」。

collocations: remember to take the bins out
take the bins out on Tuesday
offer to take the bins out

words.enDefinition: to share cleaning duties by doing them one after another

examples.en: The four of us take turns cleaning the shared kitchen after Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 我们四个人每周日晚饭后「轮流打扫」共用厨房。

examples.en: Could we take turns cleaning instead of asking the same person every week?
examples.zh: 我们能不能「轮流打扫」，别每周都让同一个人来？

words.enDefinition: a sensor inserted into food to measure its temperature

examples.en: The oven has a temperature probe that shows the temperature inside whatever we're roasting.
examples.zh: 这台烤箱配了「测温探针」，能显示正在烤的食物的内部温度。

examples.en: My roommate lent me a temperature probe when we cooked a roast for our guests.
examples.zh: 我们烤肉招待客人时，室友借给我一根「测温探针」。

words.enDefinition: an address used for a short period before settling elsewhere

examples.en: I gave the bursar my temporary address until I knew where I would live.
examples.zh: 住处还没定下来，我先把「临时地址」留给了财务办公室。

examples.en: Use a temporary address if your new flat will not be ready by Monday.
examples.zh: 如果新公寓到周一还不能入住，就先留个「临时地址」。

words.enDefinition: a short-term measure used until the problem is properly repaired

examples.en: The plumber made a temporary fix because the correct replacement part was out of stock.
examples.zh: 正确的替换件没货，水管工先做了「临时修补」。

examples.en: We asked how long the temporary fix could stay in place before the contractor returned.
examples.zh: 我们问承包商回来之前，「临时修补」能维持多久。

collocations: put a temporary fix in place

words.enDefinition: a short-stay place while you find something permanent

examples.en: The international office helped me arrange temporary housing for my first fortnight.
examples.zh: 国际学生办公室帮我安排了头两周的「临时住处」。

examples.en: Do not sign a year lease just to escape temporary housing.
examples.zh: 别为了摆脱「临时住处」就草草签下一年的租约。

words.enDefinition: UK term for money held as security under a tenancy

examples.en: I paid the tenancy deposit after signing and saved the transfer confirmation for my records.
examples.zh: 我签约后交了「租赁押金」，留存了转账凭证。

examples.en: Could you confirm where the tenancy deposit is held while we are living here?
examples.zh: 请问我们住在这里期间，「租赁押金」存放在哪里？

words.enDefinition: a disagreement between parties to a rental arrangement

examples.en: I brought our emails to a campus advice session about a tenancy dispute with my landlord.
examples.zh: 我带上往来邮件，参加了校内咨询，讨论我和房东的「租赁纠纷」。

examples.en: The tenancy dispute started when the landlord refused to let us use the promised storage space.
examples.zh: 房东不让我们使用原先承诺的储物空间，「租赁纠纷」就这样开始了。

words.enDefinition: the New Zealand body that decides residential tenancy disputes

examples.en: A New Zealand housing adviser explained when the Tenancy Tribunal could look at a deposit dispute.
examples.zh: 一位新西兰住房顾问解释了在何种情况下，「新西兰租赁裁决庭」可以处理押金争议。

examples.en: The landlord sent the same condition report to us and to the Tenancy Tribunal.
examples.zh: 房东把同一份房屋状况报告发给了我们，也提交给了「新西兰租赁裁决庭」。

words.enDefinition: harm to the property resulting from a renter's actions

examples.en: The agency distinguished tenant-caused damage from the fading paint that was already visible in August.
examples.zh: 中介区分了「租客造成的损坏」和八月就看得出来的油漆褪色。

examples.en: The report described the cracked shelf as tenant-caused damage and attached photographs from our checkout.
examples.zh: 报告把裂开的搁板写成「租客造成的损坏」，附上了退租时拍的照片。

words.enDefinition: the duties a renter must fulfill under an agreement

examples.en: I read the section on tenant obligations to find out who should replace smoke alarm batteries.
examples.zh: 我看了「租客义务」一节，想知道该由谁更换烟雾报警器的电池。

examples.en: The adviser helped us understand which tenant obligations apply when we share a kitchen.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我们弄明白了共用厨房时有哪些「租客义务」。

words.enDefinition: a website for renters to manage their accounts

examples.en: I use the tenant portal to check when my rent payments arrive.
examples.zh: 我通过「租户服务平台」查看每笔房租什么时候到账。

examples.en: The tenant portal is down, so I called the office about my payment.
examples.zh: 「租户服务平台」打不开，我就打电话给办公室问了付款的事。

collocations: log in to the tenant portal

words.enDefinition: legal protections and entitlements available to a renter

examples.en: Our university runs a free workshop on tenant rights at the start of every semester.
examples.zh: 我们大学每学期开学都会办一场免费的「租客权利」讲座。

examples.en: I read about tenant rights after the management company stopped answering repair requests from our flat.
examples.zh: 物业公司不再回复我们公寓的报修申请后，我查了「租客权利」。

words.enDefinition: checks a landlord runs before accepting a tenant

examples.en: Tenant screening usually covers ID, income, and your rental history.
examples.zh: 「租客筛查」通常包括身份、收入和租房历史。

examples.en: The tenant screening fee added another thirty dollars to my moving costs.
examples.zh: 「租客筛查」费又让我的搬家开销多了三十美元。

words.enDefinition: an organization formed to represent and support tenants

examples.en: I joined the tenant union after talking to other students who rent near the station.
examples.zh: 同住在车站附近的其他学生聊过之后，我加入了「租客联合会」。

examples.en: The tenant union organized a meeting about recurring maintenance problems across buildings in our neighborhood.
examples.zh: 「租客联合会」就我们社区多栋楼反复出现的维修问题组织了一次会议。

words.enDefinition: an adjustable rod held between two surfaces by pressure

examples.en: I used a tension rod because my landlord doesn't allow drilling holes.
examples.zh: 因为房东不允许打孔，我就用了「撑压式伸缩杆」。

examples.en: We put a tension rod across the bedroom alcove and hung a curtain.
examples.zh: 我们在凹位两侧撑了一根「撑压式伸缩杆」，再把帘子挂上去。

collocations: hang curtains on a tension rod

words.enDefinition: a document recording mutual consent to end an arrangement

examples.en: We signed a termination agreement that confirmed the room would be empty by Friday.
examples.zh: 我们签了份「终止协议」，确认在星期五前腾空房间。

examples.en: The adviser checked the termination agreement before we gave the apartment keys back to management.
examples.zh: 我们把公寓钥匙交还给物业前，顾问审查了「终止协议」。

words.enDefinition: the effective date on which an agreement ends

examples.en: The termination date in the letter differs from the day I planned to move out.
examples.zh: 信里的「终止日期」和我计划搬出的日子不一样。

examples.en: I asked the landlord to confirm the termination date before handing over my keys.
examples.zh: 我请房东先确认「终止日期」，再交还钥匙。

words.enDefinition: a unit of heat used on some gas bills

examples.en: The price per therm is printed beside the usage line on my gas bill.
examples.zh: 我那张燃气账单的用量旁边标着每「撒姆」的价格。

examples.en: I asked what a therm was after noticing the unit on our heating bill.
examples.zh: 我在暖气账单上留意到这个单位，就问了「撒姆」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a small blanket draped over seating for style and warmth

examples.en: My flatmate draped a throw blanket over the corner of our old sofa.
examples.zh: 室友在旧沙发的一角搭了条「装饰小毯」。

examples.en: I pulled the throw blanket over my knees while we watched the film.
examples.zh: 看电影时，我把「装饰小毯」盖在了膝盖上。

words.enDefinition: a small decorative cushion placed on a bed or sofa

examples.en: I added a throw pillow to make the sofa feel less bare.
examples.zh: 我加了个「装饰抱枕」，这样沙发就没那么空了。

examples.en: My roommate picked a yellow throw pillow to match the rug we bought.
examples.zh: 室友挑了一个黄色「装饰抱枕」，和我们买的地毯搭配。

collocations: arrange a throw pillow on the sofa

words.enDefinition: an electricity price that changes after usage reaches a set amount

examples.en: With a tiered electricity rate, the price can rise as we use more power.
examples.zh: 采用「阶梯电价」时，用电越多，单价可能越高。

examples.en: Our landlord explained the tiered electricity rate when we asked about last summer's charges.
examples.zh: 我们问去年夏天的费用时，房东给我们讲了「阶梯电价」。

collocations: calculate charges at a tiered electricity rate

words.enDefinition: an electricity plan with prices that vary by time of day

examples.en: A time-of-use tariff works for us because we usually do laundry at night.
examples.zh: 我们通常晚上洗衣服，所以「分时电价方案」适合我们。

examples.en: Ask when each price applies before you sign up for a time-of-use tariff.
examples.zh: 开通「分时电价方案」之前，先问清各档价格的适用时段。

words.enDefinition: a drying program that runs for a selected duration

examples.en: I picked timed dry for an extra ten minutes because the towels felt slightly damp.
examples.zh: 毛巾摸起来还有点潮，我用「定时烘干」又加了十分钟。

examples.en: My roommate selected timed dry instead of the automatic program shown on the left.
examples.zh: 室友选了「定时烘干」，没有选左边显示的自动程序。

collocations: use timed dry for another round

words.enDefinition: a sign or ad saying a place is available to rent

examples.en: I spotted a flat to let near the station and called the number right away.
examples.zh: 我在车站附近看到一套「房屋招租」的公寓，立刻拨了上面的电话。

examples.en: In Britain you often see rooms to let advertised in corner shop windows.
examples.zh: 在英国，街角小店的橱窗里常贴着「房屋招租」的小广告。

words.enDefinition: a small countertop oven that also makes toast

examples.en: I use the toaster oven for small portions when my housemates need the main oven.
examples.zh: 室友用大烤箱时，我用「台式小烤箱」做少量食物。

examples.en: The studio came with a toaster oven large enough for two slices of pizza.
examples.zh: 单间公寓配了个「台式小烤箱」，大小够放两片比萨。

collocations: toast bread in a toaster oven
reheat leftovers in a toaster oven

words.enDefinition: suspiciously perfect, usually hiding a trick

examples.en: A downtown one-bedroom for three hundred a month is too good to be true.
examples.zh: 市中心一居室月租只要三百？这种「好得难以置信」的价位多半有诈。

examples.en: That furnished flat near the beach seemed too good to be true, and it was.
examples.zh: 那套海滩边的带家具公寓「好得难以置信」，事实证明果然有诈。

collocations: rent seems too good to be true
deal too good to be true
if it seems too good to be true

words.enDefinition: a washing machine loaded through an opening on top

examples.en: Our laundry room has a top-loading washer near the window beside the dryer.
examples.zh: 我们洗衣房的「上开盖洗衣机」在窗边，就在烘干机旁。

examples.en: I checked for enough space above the top-loading washer before putting a shelf there.
examples.zh: 往「上开盖洗衣机」上面装架子之前，我先看了下上方预留的空间够不够。

collocations: the lid of a top-loading washer

words.enDefinition: the higher sliding shelf that holds dishes inside a dishwasher

examples.en: We loaded mugs on the top rack to leave more room below for dinner plates.
examples.zh: 我们把马克杯放上「上层碗架」，给下面的餐盘多留点位置。

examples.en: My tall glasses wouldn't fit on the top rack unless I adjusted its height.
examples.zh: 我得调一下「上层碗架」的高度，不然自己的高玻璃杯放不进去。

collocations: place glasses on the top rack

words.enDefinition: to add money or credit to a prepayment meter

examples.en: Can you top up the meter before you head out to lectures today?
examples.zh: 你今天出门上课前能「给预付费表充值」吗？

examples.en: I had to top up the meter when the heating went off last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚暖气停了，我只好「给预付费表充值」。

collocations: top up the meter at the shop
remember to top up the meter

words.enDefinition: paint intended for fixing small marks on an existing finish

examples.en: The caretaker left a tin of touch-up paint for the marks next to our desk.
examples.zh: 管理员留下一罐「补漆用涂料」，用来处理我们书桌旁边的痕迹。

examples.en: I asked the landlord about the paint colour before buying any touch-up paint for the hallway.
examples.zh: 买走廊的「补漆用涂料」之前，我先问了房东墙漆是什么颜色。

words.enDefinition: a tall, narrow fan that moves air through vertical openings

examples.en: I bought a tower fan because there was little floor space between the beds.
examples.zh: 两张床之间的地面不宽敞，所以我买了台「塔式风扇」。

examples.en: The tower fan sat beside the window when our shared sitting room got warm.
examples.zh: 公用客厅暖起来时，那台「塔式风扇」就放在窗边。

collocations: a tower fan for the bedroom

words.enDefinition: to follow signs of leaking water back to its source

examples.en: The contractor needed access to the upstairs flat to trace the leak above my kitchen.
examples.zh: 承包商需要进入楼上的公寓，才能「追查漏水源头」，查明我家厨房上方为什么漏水。

examples.en: I offered to move my books so the plumber could trace the leak behind the wall.
examples.zh: 我提出挪开书，好让水管工「追查漏水源头」，看看墙后是哪里在漏水。

collocations: trace the leak to its source
ask a plumber to trace the leak

words.enDefinition: a unique identifier for a particular financial transaction

examples.en: The agent asked for the transaction ID so she could locate my payment.
examples.zh: 中介要我提供「交易编号」，这样她就能查到我的付款。

examples.en: I copied the transaction ID from my bank app into the message.
examples.zh: 我把银行应用里的「交易编号」复制到了消息里。

words.enDefinition: a code used to identify a specific payment

examples.en: I sent the transaction reference so the landlord could match the payment to our flat.
examples.zh: 我发了「交易参考号」，方便房东确认这笔钱是我们这套公寓交的。

examples.en: The bank asked for the transaction reference when I called to trace the missing refund.
examples.zh: 我打电话追查一笔没到账的退款时，银行要我提供「交易参考号」。

words.enDefinition: to move an existing utility account to another property

examples.en: Can I transfer a utility account to my new address before I get the keys?
examples.zh: 我能在拿钥匙之前先把「公用服务账户转到」新地址吗？

examples.en: You may need both addresses on hand to transfer a utility account when moving.
examples.zh: 搬家办理「公用服务账户转移」时，你可能需要准备好新旧地址。

collocations: transfer a utility account to a new address
transfer a utility account when moving

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount that can be sent by transfer

examples.en: I reached my transfer limit before I sent the rest of the rent.
examples.zh: 最后一部分房租还没付，我就达到了「转账限额」。

examples.en: The bank raised my transfer limit for one day so I could pay rent.
examples.zh: 银行把我的「转账限额」临时提高了一天，这样我就能交房租了。

words.enDefinition: send the portion of a shared bill that you owe

examples.en: Please transfer your share by Thursday so I can pay the landlord on time.
examples.zh: 请在星期四前「把自己那份转过来」，我好按时交给房东。

examples.en: You can transfer your share separately if our flatmate has already paid hers.
examples.zh: 如果室友已经付过，你可以单独「转账付自己那份」。

collocations: transfer your share to a roommate

words.enDefinition: a circuit breaker that has automatically cut off power

examples.en: The electrician found a tripped breaker while investigating why our apartment had lost power.
examples.zh: 电工调查我们公寓停电的原因时，发现了一个「跳闸的断路器」。

examples.en: The manager said a tripped breaker briefly affected the ground-floor laundry room yesterday.
examples.zh: 物业经理说，昨天有个「跳闸的断路器」短暂影响了一楼洗衣房。

collocations: a circuit with a tripped breaker
a power loss caused by a tripped breaker

words.enDefinition: a low bed stored underneath another bed and pulled out

examples.en: My cousin slept on the trundle bed when she toured our campus last weekend.
examples.zh: 表妹上周末来参观我们学校时，睡的是「抽拉床」。

examples.en: We can pull out the trundle bed when the spare room is already taken.
examples.zh: 备用房间已经有人住时，我们可以拉出「抽拉床」。

collocations: a daybed with a trundle bed

words.enDefinition: an account holding money on behalf of other people

examples.en: The notice said that the letting agency kept client funds in a separate trust account.
examples.zh: 告示写着，中介公司把客户资金单独存在一个「信托账户」里。

examples.en: We asked for a statement showing when our money entered the agent's trust account.
examples.zh: 我们要求提供一份账单，显示我们的钱是什么时候转入中介的「信托账户」的。

words.enDefinition: a machine that dries clothing in a rotating drum

examples.en: Our residence has a tumble dryer downstairs that students can pay to use.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼下有台「滚筒烘干机」，学生可以付费用。

examples.en: I checked the tag before deciding whether this blanket could go in the tumble dryer.
examples.zh: 决定这条毯子能不能放进「滚筒烘干机」之前，我先看了标签。

collocations: put towels in the tumble dryer

words.enDefinition: the rotating plate that turns food inside a microwave

examples.en: The large plate wouldn't sit flat on the turntable in our little microwave.
examples.zh: 我们的微波炉很小，大盘子没法平放在「微波炉转盘」上。

examples.en: I took the turntable out to wash off the soup that had spilled.
examples.zh: 我把「微波炉转盘」拿出来，洗掉上面洒的汤。

collocations: place a bowl on the turntable

words.enDefinition: a US single mattress with extra length for one sleeper

examples.en: My residence hall uses a twin XL mattress in every single room.
examples.zh: 我住的宿舍楼，每间单人房都配「加长单人床垫」。

examples.en: These sheets won't fit a twin XL mattress, so I returned them.
examples.zh: 这些床单套不上「加长单人床垫」，我就退了。

collocations: sheets for a twin XL mattress

words.enDefinition: an apartment with two bedrooms and a shared living room

examples.en: Four of us looked at a two-bedroom apartment and agreed it was too crowded.
examples.zh: 我们四个人看了一套「两室公寓」，都觉得太挤了。

examples.en: A two-bedroom apartment near the lake rents for six hundred a month each.
examples.zh: 湖边那套「两室公寓」每人每月房租六百。

words.enDefinition: money received but not yet assigned to a specific charge

examples.en: There is an unapplied payment on the account, even though July still shows as overdue.
examples.zh: 账户里有一笔「未冲抵账款的付款」，但平台仍显示七月房租逾期。

examples.en: Could the unapplied payment be the transfer I sent without a reference?
examples.zh: 那笔「未冲抵账款的付款」会不会是我忘填附言的转账？

collocations: an unapplied payment on an account

words.enDefinition: renting out a leased property without required permission

examples.en: The manager sent a letter about unauthorized subletting after seeing an online listing for our rooms.
examples.zh: 物业经理看到网上有人挂出了我们的房间，就发了封关于「未经许可的转租」的信。

examples.en: The adviser explained what the lease says about unauthorized subletting before I posted my summer listing.
examples.zh: 我发布暑期转租信息前，顾问解释了租约关于「未经许可的转租」的规定。

words.enDefinition: a written payment order that has not been deposited or redeemed

examples.en: The agency traced an uncashed check that had been sent to my old address.
examples.zh: 中介查到一张寄往我旧住址的「未兑付支票」。

examples.en: The housing office agreed to cancel the uncashed check and send the money by bank transfer.
examples.zh: 住房办公室同意作废那张「未兑付支票」，改用银行转账退款。

words.enDefinition: space or containers for keeping belongings under a bed

examples.en: I use under-bed storage for the winter coats I won't need until November.
examples.zh: 我把十一月之前用不到的冬衣放进了「床下收纳区」。

examples.en: Our room has under-bed storage, so we don't need another chest of drawers.
examples.zh: 我们房间可以「在床下收纳」，所以不用再买抽屉柜。

words.enDefinition: the deeper issue responsible for an observed problem

examples.en: The technician wanted to find the underlying cause before replacing the same part for a third time.
examples.zh: 技术员想先弄清「根本原因」，再决定是否第三次更换同一个零件。

examples.en: I asked whether the underlying cause of the leak was in the flat above mine.
examples.zh: 我问漏水的「根本原因」是不是在我楼上的公寓。

words.enDefinition: pay less than the amount owed for the accommodation

examples.en: I might underpay the rent if I forget to update my standing order.
examples.zh: 要是忘了更新定期转账指令，我可能会「少交房租」。

examples.en: Check the exchange rate first so you do not underpay the rent.
examples.zh: 先查一下汇率，以免「少交房租」。

words.enDefinition: a fee not revealed before an agreement is made

examples.en: I complained about the undisclosed fee because it first appeared after we had moved in.
examples.zh: 这笔「未事先说明的费用」在我们入住后才出现，所以我提出了投诉。

examples.en: The adviser asked when we first found out about the undisclosed fee on our account.
examples.zh: 顾问问，我们最早是什么时候发现账上有这笔「未事先说明的费用」的。

words.enDefinition: a contract condition that unreasonably favors one party

examples.en: I asked the housing clinic whether that restriction on visitors might be an unfair term.
examples.zh: 我问住房咨询点，那项对访客的限制算不算「不公平条款」。

examples.en: Ravi pointed out a potentially unfair term and asked the agent to explain its purpose.
examples.zh: 拉维指出一项可能的「不公平条款」，请中介解释为什么要加这一条。

words.enDefinition: a rental with no furniture, so you buy your own

examples.en: The unfurnished apartment is two hundred cheaper, but beds and desks cost a lot.
examples.zh: 「不带家具公寓」便宜两百，但床和书桌花销不小。

examples.en: Most local landlords rent out unfurnished apartments, so plan a furniture budget.
examples.zh: 当地房东大多出租「不带家具公寓」，所以要预留买家具的预算。

collocations: buy furniture for an unfurnished apartment

words.enDefinition: the price charged for each unit of measured usage

examples.en: The unit rate on our new electricity plan was lower than we expected.
examples.zh: 新用电套餐的「单位费率」比我们预想的低。

examples.en: I checked the unit rate before buying a portable heater for my room.
examples.zh: 给房间买便携暖气之前，我先查了「单位费率」。

words.enDefinition: accommodation provided or managed by a university

examples.en: I applied for university housing before I started looking at rooms in town.
examples.zh: 在市区找房间之前，我先申请了「学校提供的住宿」。

examples.en: Our university housing included heating, so I could estimate my expenses for the term.
examples.zh: 「学校提供的住宿」包含供暖，所以我能估算这学期的开销。

words.enDefinition: removal of a tenant without following legal requirements

examples.en: The adviser asked whether I could document the events surrounding the suspected unlawful eviction.
examples.zh: 顾问问我能不能记录下涉嫌「非法驱逐租客」的事情经过。

examples.en: The student handbook lists organizations that can help renters dealing with a possible unlawful eviction.
examples.zh: 学生手册列出了可以帮助疑似遭遇「非法驱逐」的租客的机构。

words.enDefinition: a plan feature with no fixed limit on data use

examples.en: I chose unlimited data because both my flatmates join video calls most evenings.
examples.zh: 两个室友大多晚上都要开视频会，所以我选了「不限流量」。

examples.en: Unlimited data doesn't tell you how fast the connection will be at busy times.
examples.zh: 「不限流量」并不能说明高峰时段的连接速度有多快。

words.enDefinition: to take the things being moved out of a van

examples.en: We stopped for water before we started to unload the van at the flat.
examples.zh: 到了公寓，我们先停下来喝了点水，再「从货车上卸货」。

examples.en: My neighbour offered to help unload the van when she saw us outside.
examples.zh: 邻居看到我们在外面，就主动帮我们「从货车上卸货」。

words.enDefinition: to open moving boxes and take their contents out

examples.en: We didn't unpack the boxes right away because the room still needed cleaning.
examples.zh: 房间还没打扫，我们就没马上「拆箱整理」。

examples.en: I left the desk clear so I could unpack the boxes after class.
examples.zh: 我把桌面空了出来，准备下课后「拆箱整理」。

collocations: unpack the boxes one by one

words.enDefinition: change saved information used to process future payments

examples.en: I had to update payment details after my bank sent a replacement card.
examples.zh: 银行寄来补办的卡后，我得「更新付款信息」。

examples.en: The portal asked me to update payment details before the next rent was due.
examples.zh: 平台要求我在下一次交租前「更新付款信息」。

collocations: remind someone to update payment details

words.enDefinition: an amount that must be paid before something begins

examples.en: The second flat had a lower upfront cost even though both places charged similar rent.
examples.zh: 虽然两套房的租金差不多，但第二套的「前期费用」更低。

examples.en: We asked for the total upfront cost before deciding whether the room fit our budget.
examples.zh: 决定这间房是否符合预算前，我们先问清了总共要交多少「前期费用」。

words.enDefinition: the rate at which data is sent over an internet connection

examples.en: The slow upload speed meant my video project took an hour to submit.
examples.zh: 因为「上传速度」慢，我花了一小时才把视频作业交上去。

examples.en: Ask about the upload speed if you share large files from your flat.
examples.zh: 如果你经常在公寓里分享大文件，就问一下「上传速度」。

words.enDefinition: a freezer with front-opening doors and interior shelves

examples.en: The upright freezer has shelves, so each roommate can see what food is theirs.
examples.zh: 「立式冷冻柜」有分层架，每个室友都能看清哪些食物是自己的。

examples.en: We measured the alcove before buying a secondhand upright freezer for the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们给公用厨房买二手「立式冷冻柜」前，先量了凹进去的那块地方。

words.enDefinition: a person living in the home above yours

examples.en: Our upstairs neighbour offered to accept parcels while I was away for the holidays.
examples.zh: 我假期外出时，「楼上邻居」主动提出帮忙收包裹。

examples.en: I introduced myself to the upstairs neighbour while carrying boxes into the new flat.
examples.zh: 把箱子搬进新公寓时，我跟「楼上邻居」打了招呼。

words.enDefinition: work needed quickly to prevent serious harm or disruption

examples.en: The housing office classified the broken front lock as an urgent repair and sent someone that afternoon.
examples.zh: 住房办公室将楼门锁坏掉列为「紧急维修」，当天下午就派了人来。

examples.en: We called the manager about an urgent repair when rain started coming through the bedroom ceiling.
examples.zh: 雨水开始透过卧室天花板漏进来时，我们打电话请物业经理安排「紧急维修」。

words.enDefinition: an amount based on how much of a service you used

examples.en: The usage charge dropped after we stopped leaving the heater on overnight.
examples.zh: 我们不再整晚开暖气后，「按用量计的费用」降了。

examples.en: Our water statement lists the usage charge separately from the fixed monthly fee.
examples.zh: 我们的水费账单把「按用量计的费用」和每月固定费用分开列。

words.enDefinition: a sudden sharp increase in the amount of a service used

examples.en: A usage spike during the break made us check for a running toilet.
examples.zh: 假期里「用量骤升」，我们就去查了马桶是不是一直在流水。

examples.en: We noticed a usage spike after a cold weekend when everyone stayed home.
examples.zh: 一个寒冷的周末大家都待在家之后，我们发现「用量骤升」。

words.enDefinition: to unlock something with an extra copy of the key

examples.en: I told the manager she could use the spare key if I was still in class.
examples.zh: 我告诉物业经理，如果我还在上课，她可以「使用备用钥匙」。

examples.en: Reception asked for my permission to use the spare key during the repair visit on Monday.
examples.zh: 前台问我星期一上门维修时能不能「使用备用钥匙」。

collocations: allow the contractor to use the spare key
use the spare key to enter
permission to use the spare key

words.enDefinition: with utility charges payable in addition to the stated price

examples.en: The flat looked cheaper until we noticed the words utilities billed separately online.
examples.zh: 这套公寓原先看着便宜，后来我们在网上看到「公用费用另计」几个字。

examples.en: A place with utilities billed separately can cost more once you include winter heating.
examples.zh: 如果「公用费用另计」，把冬季供暖算进去后，这个住处可能更贵。

words.enDefinition: with utility service costs covered by the advertised price

examples.en: A room with utilities included would make it easier to plan my spending.
examples.zh: 如果租金「包含公用费用」，我就更容易规划每月开销。

examples.en: They advertised the flat with utilities included, so we asked which bills counted.
examples.zh: 广告上写这套公寓「包含公用费用」，所以我们问了具体包括哪些账单。

words.enDefinition: an account used to manage and pay for household services

examples.en: The utility account stayed in my name until the new tenant moved in.
examples.zh: 新租客搬进来之前，「公用事业账户」一直在我名下。

examples.en: I checked our utility account before asking my roommate to pay her share.
examples.zh: 请室友付她那份钱之前，我先查了我们的「公用事业账户」。

words.enDefinition: the number that identifies your account with a utility company

examples.en: Write your utility account number at the top of the form before sending it.
examples.zh: 寄出表格之前，请在顶部写上你的「公用服务账号」。

examples.en: I found the utility account number on the first page of my statement.
examples.zh: 我在账单第一页找到了「公用服务账号」。

words.enDefinition: an amount set aside to help cover basic household services

examples.en: The housing office said the utility allowance was already included in my grant.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室说，我的助学金已经包含了「公用费用补助」。

examples.en: We asked whether the utility allowance changes for students who live alone.
examples.zh: 我们问了独居学生的「公用费用补助」是否有不同。

words.enDefinition: utility charges that were not paid when due

examples.en: The student advice centre helped us find a way to deal with utility arrears.
examples.zh: 学生咨询中心帮我们想办法处理「拖欠的公用费用」。

examples.en: He asked if the utility arrears could be paid over several months instead.
examples.zh: 他问能不能把「拖欠的公用费用」分几个月付。

words.enDefinition: a scheme that helps households pay basic utility charges

examples.en: A campus adviser told me where to apply for the utility assistance program.
examples.zh: 校园顾问告诉我去哪里申请「公用费用援助计划」。

examples.en: The utility assistance program helped my roommate stay current on her winter charges.
examples.zh: 「公用费用援助计划」帮助我室友按时付清了冬季费用。

collocations: apply for a utility assistance program
qualify for a utility assistance program
enrol in a utility assistance program

words.enDefinition: a list showing how the total utility charge was calculated

examples.en: The utility bill breakdown shows how little water we actually used in July.
examples.zh: 「公用账单明细」显示，我们七月实际用水很少。

examples.en: I sent everyone the utility bill breakdown before collecting their shares on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五收钱之前，我把「公用账单明细」发给了大家。

words.enDefinition: the stopping of a service such as electricity or water

examples.en: The advice centre explained who to call if we faced utility disconnection.
examples.zh: 咨询中心解释了遇到「公用服务停供」时该给谁打电话。

examples.en: They discovered the utility disconnection was scheduled for a day after their move.
examples.zh: 他们发现「公用服务停供」安排在他们搬走后的第二天。

words.enDefinition: a company that supplies a household service such as electricity

examples.en: Our utility provider lets us see a year's worth of charges online.
examples.zh: 我们的「公用事业供应商」允许我们在线查看一整年的费用。

examples.en: Ask the utility provider whether the quoted price includes the daily charge.
examples.zh: 问问「公用事业供应商」，报价里是否包含按天收的费用。

words.enDefinition: a warning that an essential household service will be disconnected

examples.en: A utility shutoff notice arrived while I was away for reading week.
examples.zh: 我在阅读周离校期间，收到了一份「公用服务停供通知」。

examples.en: We called immediately after the utility shutoff notice was pushed through the door.
examples.zh: 「公用服务停供通知」从门缝塞进来后，我们马上打了电话。

collocations: respond to a utility shutoff notice

words.enDefinition: handover of a property free of occupants and belongings

examples.en: The tenancy adviser explained vacant possession after I found boxes in the room at handover.
examples.zh: 我交接时发现房里还有箱子，租赁顾问就解释了「腾空交付」的意思。

examples.en: We asked for vacant possession because the previous tenant had left furniture we did not want.
examples.zh: 前租客留下了我们不需要的家具，所以我们要求「腾空交付」。

words.enDefinition: to leave the property and remove one's belongings

examples.en: Our letter says to vacate the premises by Friday, so we booked a moving van.
examples.zh: 信上说星期五前要「腾退房屋」，我们就预约了搬家车。

examples.en: We need to vacate the premises before the agent can meet the new tenants there.
examples.zh: 我们得先「腾退房屋」，中介才能在那里和新租客见面。

collocations: be required to vacate the premises
vacate the premises by the agreed date

words.enDefinition: a bag that compresses soft items when air is removed

examples.en: I used a vacuum storage bag to fit my spare bedding into one case.
examples.zh: 我用了个「真空收纳袋」，把备用床品都装进一个箱子。

examples.en: The vacuum storage bag freed up enough room for my winter coat as well.
examples.zh: 用了「真空收纳袋」省出的空间，还能再放一件冬季外套。

collocations: pack in a vacuum storage bag

words.enDefinition: the rental of a van for a short period

examples.en: Van hire cost less when we moved on a weekday instead of Saturday.
examples.zh: 工作日「租厢式货车」搬家，比周六便宜。

examples.en: I checked whether the van hire came with unlimited mileage for our trip.
examples.zh: 我核对了这回「租厢式货车」是否不限里程。

words.enDefinition: a dryer that sends warm moist air through a vent

examples.en: Our old flat had a vented dryer connected to a duct through the wall.
examples.zh: 我们原来住的公寓有台「排气式烘干机」，连着一根穿墙的管道。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether a vented dryer was suitable for the available laundry space.
examples.zh: 顾问问，现有洗衣空间是否适合放「排气式烘干机」。

collocations: a vented dryer with an exhaust duct

words.enDefinition: check that a rental advertisement and its details are genuine

examples.en: I tried to verify the listing by checking whether the agency advertised it too.
examples.zh: 我查了中介有没有发布同一则广告，想「核实房源」。

examples.en: I verify the listing by asking for the landlord's ownership documents.
examples.zh: 我让房东出示产权文件来「核实房源」。

collocations: verify the listing on a map
verify the listing with the agent

words.enDefinition: seeing the unit live on a call with the agent

examples.en: We arranged a video viewing because I could not visit the apartment before classes began.
examples.zh: 因为开课前没法实地去公寓，我们安排了一次「视频看房」。

examples.en: During the video viewing, I asked the agent to show the nearest window to the desk.
examples.zh: 「视频看房」时，我请中介给我看看离书桌最近的那扇窗。

words.enDefinition: a fixed time arranged to see a rental unit

examples.en: My viewing appointment is at four on Friday, right after my lab.
examples.zh: 我的「看房预约」在周五下午四点，实验课刚结束。

examples.en: Confirm the viewing appointment by email in case the address changed.
examples.zh: 用邮件确认一下「看房预约」，以防地址有变。

words.enDefinition: walls that let you hear neighbors through them

examples.en: Thin walls mean you will know your neighbor's alarm schedule by heart.
examples.zh: 「墙薄」的话，邻居闹钟几点响你都能背下来。

examples.en: Press your ear to the wall during the viewing, thin walls tell immediately.
examples.zh: 看房时把耳朵贴在墙上，「墙薄」立刻就能听出来。

words.enDefinition: a locked room or rack for residents' bicycles

examples.en: Bike storage is free here, which saves me campus parking fees.
examples.zh: 这里的「自行车存放区」免费，帮我省了校园停车费。

examples.en: Ask whether the bike storage needs a separate key or the same fob.
examples.zh: 问问「自行车存放区」是另配钥匙还是刷同一张门禁卡。

words.enDefinition: harm to walls or floors caused by water

examples.en: Serious water damage near the window suggested the seal failed years ago.
examples.zh: 窗边严重的「水浸损坏」说明密封条几年前就失效了。

examples.en: The landlord promised the water damage was repaired before repainting.
examples.zh: 房东保证「水浸损坏」修复之后才重新刷的墙。

words.enDefinition: a private bathroom attached to a bedroom

examples.en: The en-suite bathroom means you never queue for the shower.
examples.zh: 有「卧室相连的套内卫浴」就不用排队洗澡了。

examples.en: Rooms with an en-suite cost about fifty dollars more each month.
examples.zh: 带「卧室相连的套内卫浴」的房间每月贵约五十美元。

words.enDefinition: recently modernized with new fittings and finishes

examples.en: The newly renovated bathroom still smelled strongly of fresh paint.
examples.zh: 「新装修」的浴室还有很重的油漆味。

examples.en: Newly renovated flats photograph well but sometimes hide rushed wiring.
examples.zh: 「新装修」的公寓上镜好看，有时却藏着赶工的线路。

words.enDefinition: a fan pulling steam and smells out of bathrooms

examples.en: Test the exhaust fan during the viewing, a silent one spreads mold.
examples.zh: 看房时试一下「排风扇」，不转的话容易长霉。

examples.en: Run the exhaust fan after hot showers to protect the paint.
examples.zh: 洗完热水澡开一下「排风扇」，保护墙面油漆。

words.enDefinition: a flat brown insect invading kitchens at night

examples.en: I saw one cockroach during the viewing and the agent pretended not to.
examples.zh: 看房时我看见一只「蟑螂」，中介装作没看见。

examples.en: Even one cockroach in daylight means there are many more hiding.
examples.zh: 白天见到一只「蟑螂」，说明暗处还有很多。

words.enDefinition: a door speaker system for talking and remote unlocking

examples.en: Press the intercom button and wait for the agent to answer.
examples.zh: 按一下「门禁对讲机」，等中介应答。

examples.en: The building intercom was broken, so the agent met us downstairs.
examples.zh: 楼的「门禁对讲机」坏了，中介直接下楼接我们。

words.enDefinition: wait overnight before making a final decision

examples.en: The agent held the paperwork for a day so we could sleep on it.
examples.zh: 中介把文件留了一天，好让我们「考虑一晚再决定」。

examples.en: Never sign under pressure, you can always sleep on it and call tomorrow.
examples.zh: 别在压力下签字，大可「考虑一晚」明天再打电话。

words.enDefinition: a flat partly or fully below street level

examples.en: Basement units cost less, but check the windows for damp first.
examples.zh: 「地下室单元」便宜，但先检查窗户有没有潮气。

examples.en: The basement apartment felt much darker than the online photos suggested.
examples.zh: 那套「地下室单元」比网上照片看起来暗得多。

words.enDefinition: a pipe letting water escape onto floors or walls

examples.en: A leaking pipe under the sink had warped the cabinet floor.
examples.zh: 水槽下的「漏水管道」已把柜底泡变形了。

examples.en: Look under every sink for a leaking pipe or a damp ring.
examples.zh: 每个水槽下面都看看有没有「漏水管道」或潮圈。

collocations: a leaking pipe under the sink

words.enDefinition: move from room to room inspecting a flat

examples.en: Walk through the apartment slowly and check behind every door.
examples.zh: 慢慢「把公寓走一遍」，每扇门后都要看。

examples.en: We walked through the apartment twice before deciding to apply.
examples.zh: 我们「把公寓走了两遍」才决定申请。

collocations: walk through the apartment one last time
the agent walked us through the apartment

words.enDefinition: the rubber strip around a window blocking drafts

examples.en: Run your finger along the window seal to feel for cracks.
examples.zh: 用手指沿「窗户密封条」摸一摸，查查有没有裂口。

examples.en: A worn window seal let cold air into the bedroom during our viewing.
examples.zh: 看房时，「窗户密封条」磨损，冷风从窗缝吹进了卧室。

words.enDefinition: a wall control that sets room temperature

examples.en: The thermostat is in the hallway, and the landlord sets a range.
examples.zh: 「温控器」在走廊，房东限定了温度范围。

examples.en: Ask how low the thermostat can go before the pipes risk freezing.
examples.zh: 问问「温控器」最低能调到多少，以免管道冻裂。

words.enDefinition: a discolored spot on carpet from spills

examples.en: Ask whether the carpet stain near the door will be cleaned professionally.
examples.zh: 问问门口那块「地毯污渍」会不会专业清洗。

examples.en: An old coffee carpet stain came out with the right spray.
examples.zh: 那块老旧的咖啡「地毯污渍」用对清洁剂就除掉了。

collocations: a carpet stain near the door

words.enDefinition: a recorded video that shows a property room by room

examples.en: The agent sent a video walkthrough because we could not visit until Friday.
examples.zh: 我们周五才能到，中介就发来了一段「逐间视频导览」。

examples.en: I paused the video walkthrough to check whether the desk would fit by the window.
examples.zh: 我暂停了「逐间视频导览」，想看看窗边能不能放下书桌。

words.enDefinition: a thin coating of fungal growth on a damp surface

examples.en: There was mildew along the shower tiles when we inspected the bathroom.
examples.zh: 我们查看浴室时，发现淋浴区瓷砖边缘有「霉斑」。

examples.en: I asked the agent whether the mildew on the window frame had been reported.
examples.zh: 我问中介窗框上的「霉斑」有没有人报修。

words.enDefinition: a room-by-room check done when receiving the keys

examples.en: Schedule the move-in inspection before you hand over any money.
examples.zh: 交钱之前先安排「入住验房」。

examples.en: During the move-in inspection, we found a burn mark on the counter.
examples.zh: 「入住验房」时，我们发现台面上有块烫痕。

words.enDefinition: a closet frame fixed into the bedroom wall

examples.en: The built-in wardrobe saves space, so we skipped buying a dresser.
examples.zh: 有「内置衣柜」就省空间，我们没再买五斗柜。

examples.en: Open the built-in wardrobe during the viewing to check the shelves.
examples.zh: 看房时打开「内置衣柜」，检查一下隔板。

words.enDefinition: test how strongly water flows from taps and showers

examples.en: Always check the water pressure while the dishwasher runs, it drops badly.
examples.zh: 洗碗机运行时一定要「检查水压」，会掉得很厉害。

examples.en: The agent let me check the water pressure in both bathrooms myself.
examples.zh: 中介让我亲自在两个卫生间「检查水压」。

collocations: check the water pressure in the shower
ask to check the water pressure

words.enDefinition: question the agent or tenants about people living nearby

examples.en: Ask about the neighbors before signing, thin walls make bad ones miserable.
examples.zh: 签字前先「打听邻居情况」，墙薄遇上差邻居会很难熬。

examples.en: I asked about the neighbors and learned the upstairs guy practices drums.
examples.zh: 我「打听了邻居」，得知楼上的人在练架子鼓。

collocations: remember to ask about the neighbors
ask the current tenant about the neighbors

words.enDefinition: a small electronic tag tapped to unlock shared doors

examples.en: Each resident gets a key fob for the gym and the main gate.
examples.zh: 每位住户都有一枚「门禁钥匙扣」，用于健身房和大门。

examples.en: My key fob stopped working, so security had to reprogram it.
examples.zh: 我的「门禁钥匙扣」失灵了，保安只好重新写卡。

words.enDefinition: a device that sounds an alarm when it detects carbon monoxide

examples.en: Our flat has a carbon monoxide detector in the hallway near the utility cupboard.
examples.zh: 我们公寓在杂物柜附近的走廊里装了「一氧化碳报警器」。

examples.en: The carbon monoxide detector was missing, so I asked the landlord to install one.
examples.zh: 屋里没有「一氧化碳报警器」，我请房东装了一个。

words.enDefinition: a washing machine and drying machine set

examples.en: The washer and dryer are stacked in the hallway closet, which saves floor space.
examples.zh: 「洗衣机和烘干机」上下叠放在走廊壁橱里，省地面空间。

examples.en: Since the unit has its own washer and dryer, I save on laundry costs.
examples.zh: 这套房自带「洗衣机和烘干机」，省下不少洗衣开销。

collocations: the washer and dryer are included

words.enDefinition: fixed appointment times offered for visiting a rental

examples.en: The leasing office only offers viewing slots on weekday afternoons this month.
examples.zh: 租赁处这个月只在工作日下午安排「看房时段」。

examples.en: All the viewing slots for Saturday were gone within an hour.
examples.zh: 周六的「看房时段」一小时内就被抢光了。

words.enDefinition: thin marks where furniture has scraped paint

examples.en: I noted several scratches on the wall where the old bed had stood.
examples.zh: 旧床靠过的墙上留了几道「划痕」，我都记了下来。

examples.en: Photograph the scratches on the wall so you are not blamed later.
examples.zh: 把「墙上划痕」拍下来，免得日后算到你头上。

collocations: note the scratches on the wall
photograph the scratches on the wall
scratches on the wall near the door

words.enDefinition: an outside staircase for emergency use

examples.en: Never store boxes on the fire escape, the landlord checks monthly.
examples.zh: 千万别在「太平梯」堆纸箱，房东每月都会检查。

examples.en: The old fire escape looked rusty, so I asked when it was last inspected.
examples.zh: 「太平梯」锈迹斑斑，我问了上次检查是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: the small area just inside the front door

examples.en: The entryway has hooks for coats and a spot for shoes.
examples.zh: 「玄关」有挂外套的钩子和放鞋的地方。

examples.en: Check the entryway floor for scratches when you view the flat.
examples.zh: 看房时留意「玄关」地面有没有划痕。

words.enDefinition: record problems with notes, photos, and dates

examples.en: Document the damage with dated photos before moving your boxes in.
examples.zh: 搬箱子之前，先用带日期的照片「记录损坏情况」。

examples.en: We documented the damage and emailed the agent the same afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们当天下午就「记录了损坏情况」并邮件发给中介。

collocations: document the damage before moving in

words.enDefinition: check a room's size to see if furniture fits

examples.en: Measure the room before paying, my desk barely fits now.
examples.zh: 付钱前先「量房间尺寸」，我的书桌现在差点放不下。

examples.en: Bring a tape measure and measure the room wall by wall.
examples.zh: 带上卷尺，一面墙一面墙地「量房间尺寸」。

collocations: measure the room with a tape
measure the room before moving in

words.enDefinition: move a scheduled showing to a different time

examples.en: My midterm ran long, so I had to reschedule the viewing for Thursday.
examples.zh: 期中考试拖堂了，我不得不「改约看房」到周四。

examples.en: Can we reschedule the viewing to tomorrow morning instead of tonight?
examples.zh: 我们能「改约看房」到明天上午吗？今晚不方便。

words.enDefinition: a viewing question about the building's age

examples.en: How old is the building? Older pipes often mean surprise leaks later.
examples.zh: 「这栋楼有多旧？」管道越老，之后越容易突然漏水。

examples.en: Before signing, I asked, how old is the building and when was the roof done?
examples.zh: 签字前我问了「这栋楼有多旧」、屋顶何时翻修过。

collocations: ask how old the building is
how old is the building exactly

words.enDefinition: flushing toilets during a viewing to check plumbing

examples.en: Do a flush test in both toilets before you commit to the lease.
examples.zh: 签租约前，两个马桶都做一次「冲水测试」。

examples.en: An awkward flush test revealed the toilet needed two presses to clear.
examples.zh: 一次尴尬的「冲水测试」发现，马桶要按两次才冲得干净。

words.enDefinition: the highest storey of a building

examples.en: The top floor unit costs a bit more but no one walks above you.
examples.zh: 「顶楼」贵一点点，但楼上没人走动。

examples.en: Our top floor apartment stays quiet, though the stairs are a workout.
examples.zh: 「顶楼」公寓很安静，就是爬楼梯费劲。

words.enDefinition: mobile signal strength inside a building

examples.en: Cell reception dies in the bedroom, so check it during the viewing.
examples.zh: 卧室里「手机信号」很差，看房时一定要试。

examples.en: Walk every room with your phone to compare the cell reception.
examples.zh: 拿着手机走遍每个房间，比较「手机信号」。

words.enDefinition: a small door lens for checking who is outside

examples.en: Always check the peephole before you open the door to strangers.
examples.zh: 给陌生人开门前，一定先看「猫眼」。

examples.en: The agent showed us the wide-angle peephole on the new door.
examples.zh: 中介给我们演示了新门上的广角「猫眼」。

words.enDefinition: a fan hung overhead to move air

examples.en: The ceiling fan wobbles on high speed, so ask them to fix it.
examples.zh: 「吊扇」开高速会晃，让他们修一修。

examples.en: A quiet ceiling fan can replace air conditioning in early summer.
examples.zh: 初夏一台安静的「吊扇」就能替代空调。

words.enDefinition: a wet-looking area on a wall or ceiling

examples.en: We found a damp patch above the wardrobe and asked when it first appeared.
examples.zh: 我们在衣柜上方发现一块「潮斑」，就问它最早是什么时候出现的。

examples.en: The agent photographed the damp patch so the landlord could arrange an inspection.
examples.zh: 中介把「潮斑」拍了下来，方便房东安排检查。

collocations: a damp patch on the ceiling

words.enDefinition: a very small cooking area with basic equipment

examples.en: The kitchenette has a two-ring stove, so forget cooking big dinners.
examples.zh: 「小厨房」只有两个灶眼，大餐就别想了。

examples.en: She demonstrated how the kitchenette fridge clicks shut during the viewing.
examples.zh: 看房时她演示了「小厨房」的冰箱怎么关严。

words.enDefinition: old and badly worn from lack of care

examples.en: The run-down lobby made everyone nervous about the invisible landlord.
examples.zh: 「破旧的」大堂让大家对见不到面的房东更不放心。

examples.en: A run-down building can still be a gem if the unit inside is decent.
examples.zh: 楼再「破旧」，只要屋里够好也可能是宝。

words.enDefinition: a tap that keeps dripping after closing

examples.en: A leaky faucet is small, but it hints the plumbing is aging.
examples.zh: 「漏水的水龙头」事小，却说明管道老了。

examples.en: The leaky faucet in the kitchen kept me awake my first week.
examples.zh: 头一周，厨房「漏水的水龙头」滴得我睡不着。

words.enDefinition: your immediate feeling when you first see a place

examples.en: My first impression was the smell in the stairwell, not the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我的「第一印象」是楼梯间的味道，而不是厨房。

examples.en: Trust your first impression, but verify everything with your own photos.
examples.zh: 相信「第一印象」，但一切都要自己拍照核实。

words.enDefinition: having kitchen and living space share one room

examples.en: The open-plan kitchen makes the small flat feel twice as big.
examples.zh: 「开放式」厨房让小公寓显得大了一倍。

examples.en: I chose the open-plan layout because I hate feeling boxed in.
examples.zh: 我选了「开放式」布局，因为讨厌憋闷的感觉。

words.enDefinition: an agent who shows and rents out apartments

examples.en: Our leasing agent met us at the lobby with the keys.
examples.zh: 「租赁经纪人」带着钥匙在大堂等我们。

examples.en: The leasing agent said two other students had viewed it that morning.
examples.zh: 「租赁经纪人」说当天上午已有两个学生看过房。

words.enDefinition: a shaft trash bags drop down from each floor

examples.en: The garbage chute on our floor stinks if people leave bags open.
examples.zh: 有人不扎紧垃圾袋的话，我们这层的「垃圾道」就会发臭。

examples.en: A garbage chute on the same floor is a real convenience at exam time.
examples.zh: 同一层有「垃圾道」，考试周倒垃圾省事多了。

words.enDefinition: ask someone to unlock a door so you can enter

examples.en: I got there early and texted the agent, 'Please let me in.'
examples.zh: 我到早了，就给中介发消息说：请「让我进去」。

examples.en: The gate was locked, so I called the property manager to let me in.
examples.zh: 大门锁着，我打电话请物业经理「让我进去」。

collocations: let me in through the side door
ask the concierge to let me in

words.enDefinition: a cracked or chipped floor or wall tile

examples.en: One broken tile by the shower edge can cut your heel.
examples.zh: 淋浴间边缘一块「破损瓷砖」就可能划伤脚跟。

examples.en: List the broken tiles in the inspection report with close-up photos.
examples.zh: 把「破损瓷砖」连同特写照片一起写进验房报告。

collocations: a broken tile in the bathroom

words.enDefinition: the tank or unit supplying hot water

examples.en: The water heater is in the closet, and it rumbles loudly at night.
examples.zh: 「热水器」在壁橱里，晚上咕噜声很响。

examples.en: A small water heater means the second shower waits for the tank.
examples.zh: 「热水器」小的话，第二个人洗澡就得等水箱烧热。

words.enDefinition: search corners and ceilings for fungal growth

examples.en: Look for mold behind the wardrobe, where the wall never gets air.
examples.zh: 在衣柜后面「查找霉菌」，那面墙从不透气。

examples.en: I looked for mould under the sink while the agent was talking.
examples.zh: 中介讲话时，我在水槽下「查找霉菌」。

collocations: look for mold in the corners
look for mold around the window

words.enDefinition: the storage available inside closets and wardrobes

examples.en: There is barely any closet space, so we will need a rack.
examples.zh: 几乎没什么「壁橱收纳空间」，得再买个挂衣架。

examples.en: Compared with my dorm locker, this closet space feels absolutely enormous.
examples.zh: 和宿舍柜子比，这里的「壁橱收纳空间」大得惊人。

words.enDefinition: a documented record of a rental's condition for both parties

examples.en: Both of us signed the rental inspection report and kept scanned copies.
examples.zh: 我们俩都签了「租房验房报告」，并留了扫描件。

examples.en: Attach timestamped photos to the rental inspection report as proof.
examples.zh: 在「租房验房报告」上附上带时间戳的照片作为凭证。

collocations: attach photos to the rental inspection report
the rental inspection report protects your deposit

words.enDefinition: a mesh panel keeping insects out of open windows

examples.en: Every window screen had a small tear, so summer mosquitoes are guaranteed.
examples.zh: 每扇「纱窗」都有小口子，夏天蚊子肯定少不了。

examples.en: Ask the landlord to mend the window screen before June.
examples.zh: 让房东六月前把「纱窗」补好。

collocations: the window screen keeps bugs out

words.enDefinition: a number typed on a keypad to unlock a door

examples.en: She texted me the door code before I arrived at the flat.
examples.zh: 我到公寓之前，她把「门禁密码」发给了我。

examples.en: Change the door code often if your building shares it with couriers.
examples.zh: 如果「门禁密码」和快递员共用，就要经常更换。

words.enDefinition: a grinder under the sink shredding food scraps

examples.en: The agent demonstrated the garbage disposal, and it swallowed an orange peel.
examples.zh: 中介演示了「厨余粉碎机」，橙子皮直接搅碎了。

examples.en: Never put rice in the garbage disposal unless you want a plumber visit.
examples.zh: 别把米饭倒进「厨余粉碎机」，不然就得请管道工了。

words.enDefinition: switch machines on during a viewing to confirm they work

examples.en: Test the appliances one by one, the dishwasher was the deal-breaker.
examples.zh: 逐台「测试家电」，洗碗机是成败关键。

examples.en: The agent smiled when I asked to test the appliances, nobody ever had.
examples.zh: 我提出要「测试家电」时中介笑了，说从来没人这么做过。

collocations: test the appliances with the agent

words.enDefinition: a guided tour of each room in a unit

examples.en: During the walkthrough, take photos of anything you would hate to pay for.
examples.zh: 「逐间查看」时，凡是怕赔钱的地方都拍照。

examples.en: The move-in walkthrough took twenty minutes and saved us a deposit fight.
examples.zh: 入住时的「逐间查看」花了二十分钟，省掉一场押金纠纷。

words.enDefinition: a message asking to arrange an apartment showing

examples.en: I sent a viewing request through the app but nobody replied for two days.
examples.zh: 我在 App 上提交了「看房申请」，但两天都没人回复。

examples.en: Submit a viewing request early because good apartments get snapped up quickly.
examples.zh: 尽早提交「看房申请」，抢手的公寓很快就没了。

words.enDefinition: droppings or gnaw marks showing insects or mice

examples.en: Look behind the stove for signs of pests, droppings look like black rice.
examples.zh: 到灶台后面找找「虫害迹象」，虫屎像黑米粒。

examples.en: The agent promised that the earlier signs of pests were fully treated.
examples.zh: 中介保证之前的「虫害迹象」已经彻底处理过。

collocations: signs of pests in the kitchen

words.enDefinition: the nozzle spraying water in a shower

examples.en: Swap the shower head for a pressure-boosting one, they cost almost nothing.
examples.zh: 换个增压「花洒」，几乎不花钱。

examples.en: Scale had blocked the shower head, but vinegar fixed it quickly.
examples.zh: 水垢堵住了「花洒」，用白醋一泡就好了。

words.enDefinition: the frozen-food compartment of a fridge or a standalone chest

examples.en: The freezer is tiny, so bulk frozen dumplings are out of the question.
examples.zh: 「冰柜」太小，大袋速冻饺子就别想了。

examples.en: Check whether the freezer frosts up, old ones choke with ice fast.
examples.zh: 检查「冰柜」会不会结冰，老款很快就被冰堵死。

collocations: the freezer is full of ice

words.enDefinition: the wall control that turns a room light on

examples.en: Flick every light switch during the viewing, one by the bed was dead.
examples.zh: 看房时把每个「电灯开关」都按一遍，床头那个是坏的。

examples.en: The bedroom light switch is behind the door, which annoys me nightly.
examples.zh: 卧室「电灯开关」在门后，每天晚上都让我心烦。

words.enDefinition: the force of water coming out of taps

examples.en: The water pressure upstairs is weak whenever someone runs the washing machine.
examples.zh: 有人用洗衣机时，楼上的「水压」就变弱。

examples.en: Good water pressure was the deciding factor for me at that viewing.
examples.zh: 那次看房，好的「水压」成了我拍板的关键。

words.enDefinition: press the bell outside a door to announce yourself

examples.en: Ring the doorbell twice because the chime inside is very quiet.
examples.zh: 按两下「门铃」，屋里的铃声很小。

examples.en: The landlord asked us to ring the doorbell instead of calling.
examples.zh: 房东让我们「按门铃」而不要打电话。

words.enDefinition: watch carefully for something specific while looking around

examples.en: Keep an eye out for water stains when you view the ceiling corners.
examples.zh: 看天花板角落时，「留意观察」有没有水渍。
